Veil of Alaris is EverQuest's 18th expansion. It was announced on July 13, 2011, and had an official launch date of November 15, 2011.

- For the original announcement, see [this news story](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=27016).
- For the expansion release patch message, see [this news story](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=28274).

#### **Features**

- Improved Hotbars

  - Have better control of your characters experience with a revamp of the Hotbar system including the ability to display more hotbars with more buttons; assign icons to individual buttons; link and click on items from your hotbar instead of hot-swappping; and cool-down timers!

- Parcel & Coin Delivery system

  - Mail items and coin to your friends while they are offline; share profits from your adventures with your friends and receive items from them easier than ever before!

- New Guild Halls

  - Take Guild Halls to new heights with an integration of Tools and Functionality derived from EverQuest's robust Housing System. Customize and place your guild hall in one of our housing zones including multiple exterior and interiors.

- New Guild Rank-Based permission system â€“ Personalize your Guilds with namable ranks and customizable permissions

- New Guild Trophies with varying bonuses!

- More than 800 AAs â€“ Elevate your power and abilities beyond the norm

- 13 Raids â€“ Collect valuable rewards from all new adventures

- 12 Zones â€“ Be the first to discover untouched lands of Norrath

- 500+ Spells â€“ Exponentially add to your spell arsenal

- 20 Missions â€“ Experience intriguing lore and immersive Missions

- 110+ Quests â€“ Challenge your skills and gather useful loot

- Legends of Norrathâ„¢ - 5 Digital Booster Packs

* * *

#### **Getting There**

- There are three ways to get to Alaris:

  - Via the air ship in the southeastern part of the Steamfont Mountains
  - Via the Guild Hall portal (to Argath)
  - Via Druid or Wizard port (to various zones in the expansion, although these may be locked behind certain tasks/progression)

* * *

#### **Progression**

- There are no locked zones in this expansion. All zones are open.

- Progression centers around your Alaran Language skill level which is increased by doing tasks. You won't be able to request higher tier tasks until your language skill is up to a certain level.

  - Note: With the release of the Rain of Fear expansion in November 2012, you can raise your Alaran language skill level to 100 via a simple task in Shard's Landing: [**Words of the Unspoken**](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5979).

- Other than the missions, none of the tasks in Argath or the Valley of Lunanyn require any language skill to request them.

- For more details about learning Alaran and for a list of tasks in the expansion, see our main progression article: [Progression Through the Veil of Alaris Expansion](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Progression_Through_Veil_of_Alaris)

* * *

#### **Raids**

- This expansion offers a different method of raid progression and backflagging, as well as an alternative way for players to obtain a raid drop they'd like (as opposed to waiting for the RNG (random number generator) to give them something out of a chest).

- Fore more details, see our main raiding article: [Raiding in Veil of Alaris](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Raiding_in_Veil_of_Alaris)

* * *

#### **Armor**

- Armor is produced in the same manner as in House of Thule.

  - There are no progression requirements for producing Tier 1 and Tier 2 armor.
  - Tier 3 and Tier 4 armor is locked behind a certain Alaran language skill level.

- For more details, see our main armor article: [Veil of Alaris Armor Guide](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Veil_of_Alaris_Armor_Guide)

* * *

#### **AAs**

- Certain (or all) Class AAs may be locked behind an Alaran language skill requirement. This requirement should be low enough that a few tasks in Argath can overcome it.

* * *

#### **Spells**

- Spells are obtained in the same manner as in House of Thule (Rk. I vendorbought; Rk. II result from droppable turn-ins; Rk. III result from no-trade raid drops).

- Most spells are locked behind a certain Alaran Language skill level.

- Rank I Spells

  - These spells are bought from vendors (found in the first area in Argath; findable with CTRL+F), but some of them are locked behind a certain Alaran language skill (nothing that a few Argath tasks won't unlock):
  - Basic Level 91-93 spells have no language requirement.
  - Other Level 91-93 spells and basic Level 94-95 spells have a language skill requirement of 25.
  - Other Level 94-95 spells have a language skill requirement of 50.

    - Bards and Enchanters: [Nori](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38169) (-130, -50)
    - Clerics and Paladins: [Ephinia](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38167) (100, -35)
    - Rangers and Druids: [Wonav](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38165) (170, 60)
    - Shadow Knights and Necromancers: [Shelif](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38166) (135, 60)
    - Shamans and Beastlords: [Stup](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38168) (-17, -80)
    - Wizards and Magicians: [Matima](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38162) (285, 220)
    - Melee Tomes: [Danibi](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38164) (170, 60)
    - Auras, Summons, Illusions: [Prilt the Summoner](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38163) (340, 290)

- Rank II Spells

  - Tradeable Alaran Cantrips are dropped by mobs throughout the expansion.
  - Hail [The Sklyg](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38160) in Beasts' Domain (just outside Argath, within the confines of the gates). You can request a task from him and choose which spell you want.
  - Note: Rk. II spells require a certain Alaran language level before he'll give you the task (see below).

    - [Minor Alaran Cantrip](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=98702) results in a [Level 91 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5402) (no language pre-reqs)
    - [Lesser Alaran Cantrip](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=98703) results in a [Level 92 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5403) (minimum language: 25)
    - [Median Alaran Cantrip](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=98717) results in a [Level 93 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5404) (minimum language: 25)
    - [Greater Alaran Cantrip](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=99412) results in a [Level 94 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5405) (minimum language: 50)
    - [Glowing Alaran Cantrip](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=99752) results in a [Level 95 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5406) (minimum language: 50)

- Rank III Spells

  - NO TRADE Alaran Periapts are found in raid chests.
  - Hail [The Sklyg](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38160) in Beasts' Domain (just outside Argath, within the confines of the gates). You can request a task from him and choose which spell you want.
  - Note: Rk. III require a certain Alaran language level before he'll give you the task (see below).

    - [Minor Alaran Periapt](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=98787) results in a [Level 91 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5407) (minimum language: 25)
    - [Lesser Alaran Periapt](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=98788) results in a [Level 92 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5408) (minimum language: 50)
    - [Median Alaran Periapt](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=98789) results in a [Level 93 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5409) (minimum language: 50)
    - [Greater Alaran Periapt](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=99329) results in a [Level 94 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5410) (minimum language: 75)
    - [Glowing Alaran Periapt](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=99330) results in a [Level 95 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5411) (minimum language: 75)

- Note: Language skill requirements for spells are expected to lessen over time.

## Alaran Language

**Note: With the release of the Rain of Fear expansion in November 2012, you can raise your Alaran language skill level to 100 via a simple task in Shard's Landing: [Words of the Unspoken](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5979).**

In your skill listing, you'll find a new language: Alaran. This starts at 0 and caps out at 100 (5 and 105 if you did one of the pre-launch tasks resulting in "An Ancient Text").

Your Alaran language skill will advance as you complete tasks.

Most tasks, missions, and raids require a minimum language skill level in order to request them. (Note: You'll still have to complete certain tasks in order, if they are a part of a series.)

In SOE's Words

In Argath and Arelis _(AKA Valley of Lunanyn)_, each task gives a different book, each with its own bit of story. Each zone after that will give the same book for every task. Clicking any of these books will set your language skill to the proper value based on the tasks you have completed. Here are the language skill calculations.

Having completed the prelaunch mission (Baga's Stand) will add 5 points to the language value beyond the numbers below.

The tasks in Argath or Arelis will get your Alaran to 70 (75 if you have completed the prelaunch task). You can get the full value from those two zones by doing just about half of the content, or if you focus on either zone you can get the full 70 points by completing that one zone. Missions give more points than tasks, and more complex tasks give more points than the simple "kill" tasks.

Note: You get points for completing a task once. Repeating those tasks will not improve your language skill.

The tiers after that will grant 5, 10 and 15 language points respectively, giving a total of 100 (105 if you have done the Baga's Stand task).

Tier 2

- Doing all of Sarith = 5 points
- Doing half of them = 3 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point

Tier 3

- Doing all of Rubak = 3
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point
- Doing all of Beast Domain = 3
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point
- Doing all of Resplendent Temple = 4
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point

Tier 4

- Doing all of City of Bronze = 3
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point
- Doing all of Pillars of Alra = 4
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point
- Doing all of Windsong = 4
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point
- Doing all of Sepulcher = 4
- Doing half of them = 2 points
- Doing 1 of them = 1 point

In addition to progression, your Alaran language skill level also factors in to being able to buy certain spells, class AAs, and armor templates for upper tiers.

* * *

## Language Requirements

- Tier 1 (Argath, Valley): None for partisan and mercenary tasks; 10 for missions.
- Tier 2 (Sarith): 70
- Tier 3 (Rubak Oseka, Beasts' Domain, Resplendent Temple): 73
- Tier 4 (Windsong, Pillars, City of Bronze): 81
- Tier 4 (Sepulcher of Order): 88

## List of Tasks

Listed here are all tasks and group missions.

- **Bolded** tasks represent that zone's central task arc.

  - These tasks make up a linear series to be completed in the order they're listed below.

- Unbolded tasks are stand-alone, usually with no pre-requisites other than a minimum level and a minimum Alaran language skill, and not part of a series.

### Tier 1

#### Argath, Bastion of Illdaera

- Argath missions require an Alaran Language skill of 10 to request. All other tasks have no Alaran requirements.

- Partisan Tasks

  - **[This Is Argath](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5388) \- solo task from [Atleris, Council Pinnacle](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=38115) (-10, 445, 3 -- in the council building, west-central part of the zone-in area)**

_This is an overview of pre-launch tasks leading up to the Veil of Alaris expansion and will be updated as events change._
_Pre-Launch events are expected to run from October 1, 2011, through to November 14, 2011._
_Events emanate out of a work site in the southeastern part of the Steamfont Mountains and are expected to take place in stages, with most tasks only being available for a matter of days as the work site progresses._

**WHAT'S GOING ON**
_There are several hints as to what's going on in Steamfont:_
From a message at EQLive:
Deep in the valleys of the Steamfont Mountains the Gnomes are preparing perhaps their most ambitious endeavor to date, the construction of a massive airship. Does this have anything to do with the Emissary of Brell? Where do the Gnomes plan to travel? Has the King of Ak'Anon contrived some plan of his own? Journey to the land of the Gnomes and investigate their enterprise. Perhaps you could lend a hand, as the gnomish people have been known on occasion to be generous to those who assist them.
Go forth and find the answer to this gnomish enigma! Seek the Chief Engineers for revelations on the future of Norrath!
The Chiefs
_Chief Engineer Dougal has a word about things:_
You say, 'Hail, Chief Engineer Dougal'
Chief Engineer Dougal says 'Hello. Pretty busy here, you know. Big [project] and all that. What can I do for you?'
You say, 'What's this project?'
Chief Engineer Dougal says 'I'm sure you've heard. We're building an immense rigid airship. It will be a masterpiece when we're done. It will be a dream come true for most of us. Despite the [danger] that prompted this project, we're all very excited about it. This is the sort of amazing project that comes along once in a lifetime, if that. All of Ak'Anon is working to make this project happen. Are you [interested] in helping?'
You say, 'What danger?'
Chief Engineer Dougal says 'Ah, that. Most people want to know about that. I don't know that much. Just that there is some danger and we will need to travel to a faraway place to find and defeat it. You know, the usual thing. If you really need to know more, [Olim] knows a lot more than I do. He told it all to me, but I have to admit that I didn't listen much past the point where he mentioned making a huge airship.'
You say, 'Olim?'
Chief Engineer Dougal says 'Olim is a Telmira, sent to us directly by Brell. He's the one that let us know of the danger. Lucky fellow, that Olim. He gets to work directly with the Duke of Bellow. It makes me jealous of the dead some times.'
_If you offer help to the non-active Chiefs around the area:_
Chief Smelting Engineer Whistle says 'I don't have anything right at this moment, but please check back later. There is a lot going on here, and I'm sure something will come up.'
The Workers
_If you hail the gnome workers around the area:_
a worker says 'When this is over, I'd like to be the first one to fly in it! Though, I bet they won't let me. After all, I do suffer from severe motion sickness.'
an engineer says 'Hi! Isn't it great to be working on a project for Brell himself? I'm almost giddy about it!'
a worker says 'Hello! Isn't it wonderful to be alive in these great times! I'll be able to brag to my grandchildren that I worked on this project.'
a worker says 'Hail. I'd really like to chat, but I've got stuff to do. Lots of stuff to do.'
a foreman says 'Hello there. If you're looking for work you should talk to one of our chief engineers. They have certain had enough work for the rest of us, no doubt they could spare some for you too.'
The Emissary
_An emissary of Brell Serilis has arrived in the Steamfont Mountains -- a telmiran known as "Olim, Underfoot Emissary" can be found near the entrance to Ak'Anon:_
You say, 'Hail, Olim, Underfoot Emissary'
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'Hello upworlder. I hope you are well. I have been sent to you by Brell to inspire your leaders and heroes to explore a lost land. I explained to him that his word was enough inspiration for any creature. It seems that things are going well, and I thank you for any assistance you can lend. Speak with the engineers at the site, for they are organizing the efforts.'
_And once you've completed a task:_
You say, 'Hail, Olim, Underfoot Emissary'
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'Hello \_\_\_\_\_. I understand that you have been helping with the project. This pleases me. I still have in my mind the memory of the day I was sent here and the conversation that I was allowed to hear. I believe that it was meant that you upworlders, those that have proven themselves, are meant to know what happened as well. If you have interest, I can show you [what transpired].'
You say, 'Show me what has transpired'
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'As you wish. Let me give you those memories.'
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'The goddess of life, Mother of All spoke with the soft voice of a summer breeze. 'We are all worried. Some are near panic, which manifests in them in terrible ways. Never before has any of us died. Some seek to take a direct approach, forcing open the barrier to the continent and confronting the new foe directly. Most are taking a wait and see approach, expecting the forces already deployed to be enough to deal with any problems.''
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'The two gods, hoary old Brell and the lovely young Tunare looked concerned. Brell's voice sounded softer than usual, likely due to the presence of the life goddess. 'Neither of us is interested in getting directly involved in this. I certainly am not. I have my own realm to run, and I trust my creations to do what they need to do. But my realm is now open to the mortals, so I must get involved in some way if only to provide safety for the Underfoot. I think we are in agreement, the best hope of defeating any foe are the mortals we have created. They have proven to be adept at killing powerful beings, including us.'
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says ''The easiest way to get them to go there', said Brell, 'is to tell them not to go.''
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'Smiling, Tunare responded, 'True. But perhaps in this case we should deal with them more openly. I know that this has not been the method of the gods in the past, but times are different. We should simply ask them. Surely a simple suggestion will motivate them.''
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'Brell let out a deep chuckle. Smiling he said, 'For my gnomes all I have to do is point. They are so much like me, yet so different. They will climb any hill that they think might not have any footprints on it. Yes, I can get them to the hidden land easily enough. And where they go, others will surely follow.''
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says ''It is good to have you with us again, Brell. You might have preferred to remain hidden away in your realm, but you were missed.''
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'And so Brell sent me to Ak'Anon to speak to the king. The king organized his engineers and gave them a command to build an airship that could reach this hidden continent. A small portion of the city's coffers have been given to this band of engineers, and they have begun construction of a flying ship based on the one built by Meldrath.'
Olim, Underfoot Emissary says 'Brell explained to me that it is his desire that people go and assist the other gods on the hidden continent. I offer no reward for doing so, and warn that death is the most likely consequence for taking up this task. Brell's faith in us, his creations, is substantial, and for that reason alone I hope you find it worthwhile to try to fulfill that desire for him.'
The Ancient Text
_Translated, the Ancient Text reads:_
I never saw anything so big, beautiful and terrifying. The invaders of our original planet were just horrifying. The great beasts of the beasts domain are tiny in comparison. But this being from our new home was just spectacular.
It flew in on great wings, larger than a mansion. Red iridescent scales blazed in the sunlight. They covered its body, starting from its long tail, over its strong, muscular body, across its long neck, and up over its huge fanged head to the tip of its snout. Fire billowed from its mouth as it raked over the buildings. Magic pulsed around it and slammed into the ground and the figures running from it. Its fearsome intelligence was used to great effect as it chose the best target to destroy.
But in the end it was chased away and we were saved by the power of the Spirit of Tides and a few blind dreamers.
If they had not brought such destruction, I would so love to live to see one again. But the Veil closes in.

_This is the first task in a series of six; a solo task that begins with Atleris, Council Pinnacle, in Argath. He's located in the council building at -10, 445, 3 (west-central part of the zone-in area)._
You say, 'Hail, Atleris, Council Pinnacle'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle looks at you with resignation. 'It has come to this. Argath was once the pinnacle of strength in Alaris. A single warrior could cleave the helms of a hundred Erillion Blades. A regiment would secure surrender from a city with the mere whisper of our advance. Our mountain bled the finest steel; our steel bled our foes of life. Might and skill were ours, and we [lived] for battle.
You say, 'Lived?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says ''Indeed, so we once lived. But all things die. As from the corpses of wild and savage beasts grows the grass, warriors become crafters, swords become spades, and spears become cogs and gears. Peace has a way of conquering the strongest soldiers. Calm centuries dimmed the light of battle in our hearts. Commerce became our commander, and it dispatched us to the corners of Alaris, bearing [life] instead of death.'
You say, 'Life?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'The treaty with Erillion ended our lives as warriors. With the land at peace, we were reborn. We built houses, buttressed temples, and harvested crops. With our steel, we crafted the implements of Alaris, everything from walking sticks to sky ships. Our might strengthened others, while our own power withered. Now it has come to this: Argath needs the [help] of [outsiders].'
You say, 'Outsiders, us?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'What are you? Arriving on ships that rival the fleets of Windsong, you stride through our city with bold countenance, speaking as though unafraid of any Argathian or Erillian. Your shapes and sizes are varied and perplexing. You carry weapons of which even our Forge attendants could not conceive. You bring with you the smell of [battle]; I know you have taken many lives and would not hesitate to do so again.'
You say, 'What battle?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'I barely recognize it. You see these robes I wear. I have never lifted a sword. Time and peace made us weak, and most of us cannot handle a blade. Only the Regiment knows of battle, but they are tyros. Let it not be said outside this chamber, but Erillion will overwhelm us; our [defenses] will collapse.'
You say, 'Defenses?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Many nights have passed since Erillion breached the gates. Our citizens cower on higher ground, while the Regiment stymies the enemy with arrows. Our supplies dwindle; our defenders are slain. Argath will not last. You are our only recourse. Will you [help] us?'
You say, 'I'll help!'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'If we must, we shall employ your kind as mercenaries. Erillion must be driven from Argath. Our Forge, our livelihood, must be protected. Speak with Magistrate Altara; al coordinates the mercenary outsiders. Go now. Argath must not fall, or Erillion will rule Alaris. '
You have been assigned the task 'This Is Argath'.
The fortress of Argath has been besieged by the forces of Erilliion. Atleris, Pinnacle of Argath's council, has been using the newly arrived Norrathians to prevent Erillion from conquering all of Argath. Now, Atleris asks you to do what you can to aid the Argathians' defense.
Magistrate Altara, residing within the Pinnacle of Argath, coordinates the efforts of the many Norrathians in Argath.

---

Speak with Magistrate Altara 0/1 (Argath)
_Altara is found in the room to the south of the council chamber (-90, 400, 8)._
You say, 'Hail, Magistrate Altara'
Magistrate Altara says 'Another one of you? There must be many cities in the lands beyond the mists. It astonishes me how many strange creatures I have seen stepping from the ships on the dock, and they all seem so eager to help. Of course, some of our Champions have had to deal with unruly outsiders who want to test their strength against Argathians. But you are not like those fools, are you? No, or else [Atleris] would not have sent you to me.'
You say, 'Atleris'
Magistrate Altara says 'The invasion weighs heavily on the Pinnacle of the Council. Alir mood can be dark at times. I do not share alir pessimism, though. The outsiders have brought me new hope that Argath is not lost. When the first of you began arriving, Atleris ordered our spellwielders to destroy your ships. al thought your presence was a ploy of Erillion or Windsong. Were it not for my protestations, many of you would be dead. Because of my advocacy for the outsiders, I am their [coordinator].'
You say, 'Their coordinator?'
Magistrate Altara says 'Given Erillion besieges us, and we have only the food we grow here on the Crown, I cannot allow outsiders to run around Argath with no direction. I [direct] their efforts, making certain we work toward the defeat of Erillion and maintain our food supply.'
You say, 'How do you direct the efforts?'
Magistrate Altara says 'I have met enough outsiders to know not all of them can handle a blade. Some should lead peaceful lives as craftsmen or farmers. I can see you are eager to fight Erillion, but I judge you would be better suited helping the haulers [deliver] craet grain.'
You say, 'Helping deliver craet?'
Magistrate Altara says 'Many of our haulers have been killed delivering supplies to the Forge Overlook. The enemy camped in the Belly of Argath fires onto the Breath Spiral and the Overlook, catching our haulers as they unload their cargo. With so many dead, we must turn to outsiders to do their [jobs].'
You say, 'What jobs?'
Magistrate Altara says 'We need to deliver grain to everyone in Argath. This will give you a chance to prove your usefulness to us, and to see our city. Speak with Akesli Temlo. I believe al has almost finished harvesting a bundle of craet. Al will tell you where it needs to go.'
Speak with Akesli Temlo 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Akesli Temlo gathers grain from the small farm atop Argath's Crown. Altara wants you to assist with the harvest.
_Akesli Temlo is found southeast of the council building, across the stream (-260, 100, 2)._
You say, 'Hail, Akesli Temlo'
Akesli Temlo says 'Greetings, outsider. I will have to thank Altara for sending you to me! I was just about to finish harvesting a bundle of craet grain, but I could always use your help. Here, take this scythe and finish cutting the remaining sprigs I need.'
_You receive a Craet Scythe._
Harvest 8 sprigs of craet grain 0/8 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Akesli needs only a few more sprigs of grain. Use the scythe al gave you to finish the harvest.
_You can stand in the plantation nearby and right-click the scythe (you'll occasionally fail) until you get eight updates._
Speak with Akesli Temlo 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Ask Akesli what you need to do with the grain.
You say, 'Hail, Akesli Temlo'
Akesli Temlo says 'You work quickly! I wish I had five more outsiders like you to tend these fields! You wouldn't know much less about craet grain than I. We planted this farm only weeks ago, after the Forge incident and Erillion's overtures of war. We feared our food supply from the Valley of Lunanyn would be cut off, so the farmers of Lunanyn gave us craet. The farmers would know better than I how to properly plant and harvest it. But you do not have time to listen to me. You should deliver these sprigs to the people of Argath. Hauler Dinalo will help you bundle the craet.'
Speak with Hauler Dinalo 0/1 (Argath)
_Hauler Dinalo is found next to Akesli._
You say, 'Hail, Hauler Dinalo'
You receive a box of craet sprigs.
Hauler Dinalo says 'Altara has outsiders working as haulers now? It is shameful we cannot manage the task ourselves. Far longer than I have lived, haulers have been carrying goods from one end of Alaris to another. Now we cannot even carry a bundle of craet in our own [city].'
You say, 'Your city?'
Hauler Dinalo says 'As you no doubt have heard, Erillion has besieged Argath. When we try to deliver supplies to our defenders at the Forge Overlook, Erillian archers aim for our heads. Many of us have been [killed]. If this were not bad enough, hunger has driven some Argathians to thievery, raiding our storehouses and depleting our resources. Other Argathians have turned traitorous, attacking our own soldiers in the name of Erillion, hoping to be spared from execution if Erillion conquers Argath.'
You say, 'Killed?'
Hauler Dinalo says 'Do not worry, though. I will not send you right away to the Forge Overlook. Here is your list of Argathians to whom you should deliver craet sprigs. I have prepared the bundle. It is a bit heavy. Drag it if you must. Good luck, and watch for arrows!'
Hail Noble Allingvi 0/1 (Argath)
_If you look at your map, there are four small buildings on the inside of the river. Noble Allingvi is in the northeast building (location 80, -75, 5)._
You say, 'Hail, Noble Allingvy'
Noble Allingvy says 'Ah, my craet sprigs! Rations have diminished since the last delivery. Have you been eating my sprigs? No matter; it is either you or some other outsider siphoning food from the mouths of Argathians. I do not know why Atleris has tolerated your presence. Erillion still controls the Belly of Argath, in more ways than one. The outsiders have not [helped] in the least!'
You say, 'Helped?'
Noble Allingvy says 'Yes, you did bring my craet sprigs. Thank you. But I would have you working on the truly useful things: driving off Erillion and giving me back my [home]!'
You say, 'Home?'
Noble Allingvy says 'After the Forge incident, survivors were relocated to the Arms, the Neck, and the Crown. Atleris ordered us nobles to give up some of our houses to shelter affected Argathians. Then Erillion invaded, and more citizens were moved from the Arms to the higher reaches of Argath. Many nobles had to leave homes altogether and find residence in the palace. And so here I am.'
Hail Record Keeper Talantia 0/1 (Argath)
_Record Keeper Talantia is found in the room north of the council chamber (120, 525, 8)._
You say, 'Hail, Record Keeper Talantia'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'Thank you, outsider. I know you are busy, but will you [speak] with me a moment?'
You say, 'I'll speak with you'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'The tomes hold no record of your kind. Since the arrival of outsiders, I have scoured our annals in search of some description matching what has been arriving on our dock. But in all history, no Argathian has seen or heard of beings beyond the [Alaris] mists.'
You say, 'The Alaris mists?'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'We thought we were a people alone in this solitary land. Argath, Sarith, Windsong, Alra, and Erillion have been our centers of civilization as far back as our lore exists. The only exception is the founding of our city, but that is only a [legend].'
You say, 'A legend?'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'The namesake of our city, Illdaera, was said to be a powerful warrior who sought to craft the mightiest blade in the land. Al searched far and wide for the best source of iron, commanding alir soldiers to dig in every place they camped. Al would conquer cities to dig beneath them and search for iron; al could leave no part of Alaris unsearched. Then al found the mountain of [Argath].'
You say, 'Argath?'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'When the soldiers dug into the mountain, gouts of molten metal surged to the surface, killing many soldiers. Illdaera knew it was not ordinary iron, and al ordered a sword be forged from the metal. Drawing the sword from a pail of water, al swung it at a rock above the oozing wound of the mountain, cleaving it in twain. This was not iron; this was the most fantastic [steel] in all of Alaris.'
You say, 'What steel?'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'It was light as bronze but harder than stone. Illdaera wielded the sword and cut alir way into the mountain, piercing its heart. Around the wound, al built the Forge, the source of Argath's power. Armed with the mightiest blade in Alaris, crafted from the mightiest steel, Illdaera raised the city of Argath, a bastion which no adversary could [overtake].'
You say, 'Overtake?'
Record Keeper Talantia says 'Erillion certainly has proven the legend false. And with your appearance, I do not know what is true anymore. But I have kept you long enough. I will let you return to your deliveries.'
Hail Arthik Jantis 0/1 (Argath)
_Arthik is found in the southernmost building on the crown (-265, 0, 5)._
You say, 'Hail, Arthik Jantis'
Arthik Jantis says 'Craet! I thought I would never see it again! Citizens do not get a taste until everyone in the palace chews on it first. And you probably chewed on it too. Back when I lived on the Arms, craet was plentiful, and my belly was always full. After the Council [relocated] us, though, I have been getting leaner.'
You say, 'Relocated?'
Arthik Jantis says 'After the Forge incident, I had to leave my home and my shop, making room for the displaced citizens from the Belly. I settled in the Neck for a while, but then Erillion invaded, and we were all shifted higher. Now, here I am, still hungry. Have any more grain?'
Hail Mechanic Dalaber 0/1 (Argath)
_Head southeast to the ledge (-385, -170, -12)._
You say, 'Hail, Mechanic Dalaber'
Mechanic Dalaber says 'This is all you have? I am about to send down a shipment, but there is not enough here to sustain the Regiment. Even outsiders make poor haulers! We [mechanics] merely control the machines. Haulers must bring the right amount of goods!'
You say, 'Mechanics?'
Mechanic Dalaber says 'We keep Argath running. I personally built this crane, and I maintain it. We craft the machines that built Alaris! What have you done, hauler? You brought the stones; I built the palace!'
Hail Troopwielder Baris 0/1 (Argath)
_Troopwielder Baris is up on the ledge at -235, -235, 12._
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Baris'
Troopwielder Baris says 'Altara has you hauling craet? What a waste! I have seen the power outsiders wield. If we had an army of them, we would crush the invaders and drive them back to Erillion. The enemy has not encroached upon the Crown, so you are not needed yet among my troops. If I were stationed on the [Overlook], though, I would hand you a bow and put you in my lines of archers. Though we are [inexperienced], I have no doubt your skill would more than compensate.'
You say, 'The Overlook?'
Troopwielder Baris says 'Where Argath's Arms meet, directly above the Forge. Illdaera's Breath cascades through the Breath Spiral of the Neck, spilling onto the Forge Overlook before finally falling into the cooling molds outside the Forge. If you are traveling to the Overlook, be cautious. Erillion fires constantly upon the Neck and Overlook. Many haulers have died delivering supplies to troops and refugees.'
You say, 'Why are you inexperienced?'
Troopwielder Baris says 'Argath long ago abandoned war. The Council maintained the Regiment as a small strike force, capable of mobilizing for brief campaigns beyond Argath. With Alaris at peace, we had no need for a larger army. And with Argath's [impenetrable] walls, the city was its own defense.'
You say, 'Impenetrable?'
Troopwielder Baris says 'Were it not for the [incident] at the Forge, Erillion would never have entered our city.'
You say, 'What incident?'
Troopwielder Baris says 'The eruption. The Forge boiled over. Rivers of steel poured into the Belly, flooding homes and workshops in fire, weakening the walls of Argath, lowering our guard. Erillion attacked days later.'
Hail Lanessic Elset 0/1 (Argath)
_Head due north from the Troopwielder to the steps down at 85, -220, 12. Go to the second level down (z-loc -145) and into the first room on your right (loc -95, -160, -149)._
You say, 'Hail, Lanessic Elset'
Lanessic Elset says 'You are not hurt, are you? We do not see many haulers. Most of them lie dead at the bottom of the Spiral, killed by Erillian archers or magicians. Few of us venture outside anymore. It would have been better to remain in [Lunanyn] than escape to a prison in these cliffs.'
You say, 'Lunanyn?'
Lanessic Elset says 'Erillion claimed the valley beneath Argath. We farmers of the valley once provided food for much of Alaris, including Argath and Erillion. When Erillian troops marched upon us, we fled to Argath. Generiously, the Argathians gave us these homes in the Neck. But now this generosity is more of a curse. I am sure I will die either of an arrow or hunger.'
Hail Troopwielder Balath 0/1 (Argath)
_Back out of the room, all the way down the ramp, then due east to the Overlook (10, -495, -272)._
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Balath'
Troopwielder Balath says 'An outsider hauler! No wonder you made it without a scratch! Craet sprigs, troops! If you are hungry, come get them. Never mind the [arrows]!'
You say, 'Arrows?'
Troopwielder Balath says 'Erillion cannot hit anything directly above the Forge. We have the high ground, and the arches shield us. Besides, the enemy cannot move any closer with the [steel] still hot, so their aim is poor.'
You say, 'Steel?'
Troopwielder Balath says 'That which allowed Erillion to invade has prevented them from taking the city. The steel lives! Around the flow, swords and spears have sprung to life, and globs of metal wander as if sentient. Erillion fears the steel and has not ventured to take the Forge or climb the arms. We sit here, [safe], until our food dwindles or the enemy becomes emboldened.'
You say, 'Safe?'
Troopwielder Balath says 'Except for a few arrows, bolts, and magic blasts. But my troops never fear! My fellow troopwielders on the Arms might tell you differently, but they are mistaken. Argath will be victorious!'
Hail Troopwielder Latakan 0/1 (Argath)
_Head north until you come to Latakan on a bridge at 860, -215, -270._
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Latakan'
Troopwielder Latakan says 'You bear sprigs? And thieves have not accosted you? I do not want to accept your delivery while there are creat looters lurking nearby.'
Kill 2 looters or thieves 0/2 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ It is too dangerous to hand over the grain when there are creat looters neaby. Defeat them.
_Creat looters spawn to the west and south of Latakan. They hit for a max ~7,400._
Hail Troopwielder Latakan 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that the looters are dead, inform Troopwielder Latakan.
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Latakan'
Troopwielder Latakan says 'You handled those thieves well, outsider. You should be fighting with the Regiment! Thieves and looters have run rampant on the arms. Ever since the invasion of Erillion and the evacuation of citizens to the Neck and Crown, thieves and looters have been searching for food and valuables in the abandoned workshops and storehouses. Some of these vile naeya have even turned traitorous, pledging loyalty to Erillion and working to sabotage Argath's defenses. We will soon make a push to destroy them. I could use you. First, though, you should return to Magistrate Altara and tell ali you have finished your duties.'
Speak with Magistrate Altara 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Magistrate Altara'
Magistrate Altara says 'You were not killed, and you did not eat all the craet, judging from the size of your belly. I trust I can give you more responsibility. Troopwielder Baris told me al wanted to speak to an outsider about a pressing issue. Go to ali.'
_Reward:_
266 platinum
Experience

Veil of Alaris Information & Guides: An Overview | Group Progression & Task List | Raid Progression | Visible Armor
This task is the second in a series of six; a solo task that begins with Troopwielder Baris in Argath at about -235, -235, 12.
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
- Completion of "This is Argath"
- (no minimum skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Baris'
Troopwielder Baris says '_____, you live! I had hoped Altara might send you. Erillion has intensified its barrage on the Neck, and the defensive barriers we placed there are weakening. Someone needs to shore up the walls. The last mechanic I sent to do the job took an arrow in alir eye. Will you [finish] the task?'
You say, 'I'll finish the task'
Troopwielder Baris says 'I hope you will have better luck. Take these bricks and mortar. Do what you can. If you survive, speak with Troopwielder Balath. Al has been looking for an outsider.'
You have been assigned the task 'Shoring Up Defenses'.
Erillion's magic wielders and catapults pound the Neck of Argath, wearing down the defensive barriers that protect the citizens and refugees. Troopwielder Baris has asked you to repair any broken barriers. Once you have done this, Troopwielder Balath has need for you.
Use the Brick and Mortar Baris gave you to repair any walls in the Neck that have been damaged, but be mindful of Erillion's projectiles.
You receive a "Brick and Mortar".
Repair 5 broken defensive barriers on the Neck 0/5 (Argath)
Midway down the neck, you'll find several destructible objects called "a wall". You'll have to attack these until they're below 80%, and then right-click your Brick and Mortar to repair them.
While you're doing this, dervishes called "a malevolent exhalation" will float by and nuke you for 7,500 dmg at a time. These mobs are attackable and killable.
Speak with Troopwielder Balath 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Balath'
Troopwielder Balath says '_____, I need all the outsiders I can get! The Erillions have intensified their barrage, and they are pummeling the Neck. Take a bow and strike down the siege troopers below us! But take heed: Their aim is improving. You must strike swiftly!'
You receive Balath's Bow.
Shoot 6 siege runners with Balath's Bow 0/6 (Argath)
At the bottom of the ramp that leads into the "belly" (lowest level; forge area), you'll see several spawns of non-combative siege runners. You need to equip Balath's Bow and right-click it, then try to target the siege runners as they move towards the ramp.
Speak with Troopwielder Balath 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Balath'
Troopwielder Balath says 'That should quiet the enemy for a while. I have heard reports that Troopwielder Latakan needs assistance, though.'

This is a kill task that begins with Captain Walkath in the northwestern part of Argath (below the crown) around location 845, -140, -272.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Walkath'
Captain Walkath  looks into the foggy sky. 'We are [outnumbered]', al says.
You say, 'How are you outnumbered?'
Captain Walkath says 'Erillion's invading force lies in great number. We're in dire need of your [assistance].'
You say, 'I'll lend some assistance'
Captain Walkath says 'Take up arms and fight the Erillion force if you wish to remain in Argath!'
You have been assigned the task 'Slimming the Invaders'.

_This task is the first in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Geirdan Ath in the Valley of Lunanyn, located at 2295, -1700, 46 (in a building in the southeast part of the upper section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- (no minimum required skill level in Alaran Language)

---

You say, 'Hail, Geirdan Ath'
Geirdan Ath says 'You are not one of mine! But you can be of use to me! We have [lost] many men recently and are unable to stop the Prophet's Army from raiding the crops here.'
You say, 'How were they lost?'
Geirdan Ath says 'Most of them have been killed in battle, but we are missing some that were on patrol. They seem to have vanished without a trace. I suspect the Prophet's Army is to blame. They are struggling to take the [crops] here to support their army and it is only a matter of time before they will outlast us.'
You say, 'What about the crops?'
Geirdan Ath says 'They take the crops from their own people, who hide in fear from their own army. Will you [help] us?'
You say, 'I'll help'
Geirdan Ath says 'Excellent! I will see to it that you rewarded should your efforts prove successful!'
You have been assigned the task 'Raid and Recover'.
Geirdan Ath is spread thin until reinforcements arrive. He will need you to seek out the Erillion Army raiding parties and put a stop to their taking of the local crops. You will need to be careful during your engagements as the Prophet's army has been taking prisoners for a reason that Geirdan has yet to ascertain. He would also like you to find the soldiers that have gone missing.
You must slow down the Prophet's army from taking the crops to their troops.

_This solo kill task begins with Hallay in the Valley of Lunanyn, located at 1725, -1150, -45 (in the Rallosian camp in the northeastern part of the larger section of the zone)._
You say, 'Hail, Hallay'
Hallay says 'Grrr!' She snarls like an animal, 'What do yeh want, ye pesky Halfling? Can`na yeh see I'm [busy] thinkin'?'
You say, 'Busy with what?'
Hallay says 'I know we're low on supplies, but I can'na go out to collect more provisions with those wretched wraiths ou' there.' She seems to be more irritated by them than afraid, 'I'd like ta slaughter the lot o' 'em, but meh cleaver just goes clean through 'em! There must be some way fer me to [defeat] those blasted things.'
You say, 'I can defeat for you'
Hallay says 'Yeh think yeh can defeat them, do ye?' She seems to have taken your offer of assistance as a challenge, instead, 'If yer are so eager fer death then, be my guest!'
You have been assigned the task 'Who You Gonna Call?'.
Hallay has challenged you to vanquish the wraiths which haunt the valley.

---

Kill 12 wraiths of Arelis 0/12 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Return to Hallay and tell ali of your triumph 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
You say, 'Hail, Hallay'
Hallay seems momentarily stunned, and then begins to beam approvingly, 'Survived, have yeh? I had mistaken yeh fer a weakling, but it seems ye do have some fire in yer blood, after all. Well done!'
_Rewards:_
Experience
106 platinum
- Eltarki's Diary - Life and Death [item=98146]

# Argath #3: Protect the Arms

**Level:** 90 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 90
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Veil of Alaris Information & Guides: An Overview | Group Progression & Task List | Raid Progression | Visible Armor
This is the third task in a series of six; a solo task that begins with Troopwielder Latakan in Argath at 865, -200, -270 (the northwestern section of the "arms" part of the zone area).
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
- Completion of "This is Argath"
- Completion of "Shoring Up Defenses"
- (no minimum skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Latakan'
Troopwielder Latakan  squints at the sky, looking into the distance. '[Windsong] attacks from air! Thieves and looters are now my secondary concern, for Windsong approaches, carrying troops to drop upon the Arm. We must shoot them down before they reach the walls of Argath. If we allow them to land, our position will be overrun. Would you [speak] with Mizzenblast and discuss a strategy of attack?
You say, 'Windsong?'
Troopwielder Latakan says 'Windsong floats above Alaris -- how, I do not know. Its people long ago mastered flight and music, and in calmer times Argath built for them great flying ships. I know not why they have joined in Erillion's aggression, but now the people of the clouds are our enemies.'
You say, 'I'll speak with him'
Troopwielder Latakan says 'You are truly an ally of Argath! Mizzenblast strategizes in the building near us. Like you, al is an outsider, so I do not doubt you will understand alir plan better than I.'
You have been assigned the task 'Protect the Arms'.
Windsong, an ally of Erillion, has begun their air assault on the left arm of Argath. On the right arm, Argathian traitors and Erillion troops prepare for an assault.
Mizzenblast, a Norrathian gnome, has been creating inventions to defeat Erillion. He has devised a plan to stop Windsong's incursion.
Speak with Mizzenblast 0/1 (Argath)
Mizzenblast is found in the building near Latakan.
You say, 'Hail, Mizzenblast'
Mizzenblast says 'Brell's beard! I didn't think Latakan would send me a Dark Elf! But forgive my surprise; I've gotten so used to seeing Argathians! I've been working with them since I [arrived] on the airship. They are a fascinating people, and I can't wait to see the rest of Alaris! But first I must do what I can to [help].'
You say, 'Arrived?'
Mizzenblast says 'It seems none of us could resist traveling to an undiscovered land. I just had to see the kind of [clockworks] the inhabitants might have.'
You say, 'Clockworks?'
Mizzenblast says 'It turns out my own clockworks were more advanced than the Argathians'. When I gave them a demonstration, they sent me immediately to this house and set me to scheming up defense [projects].'
You say, 'What projects?'
Mizzenblast says 'It can be hard to think with arrows flying about and thieves buzzing around, but I haven't been this excited in years. How often do your [inventions] save an entire city?'
You say, 'Inventions?'
Mizzenblast says 'Yes, I was getting to those. Atleris thought Erillion might send Windsong's air brigades to attack Argath, so I designed a little countermeasure I call the 'Mizzenblast [LRK400].''
You say, 'What's the LRK400?'
Mizzenblast says 'The Long Range Killer, accurate to 400 units. Nothing in the sky escapes this beauty. I nearly shot down our own airships testing it out, and birds fear me! Now [Erillion] will feel fear!'
You say, 'Erillion?'
Mizzenblast says 'They will never take this Arm as long as we have the LRK400! You should be the one to use it, though. I get too shaky near battle. You will [help], won't you?'
You say, 'I'll help!'
Mizzenblast says 'I sent out an Argathian earlier. I think his name was Kanleth. He probably got splattered out there. Carry the Long Range Killer 400 and see if you can find him. I'm sure the Windsong transports will be arriving nearby!'
You receive the "Mizzenblast LRK400".
Destroy 5 Windsong transports 0/5 (Argath)
In the northern part of the "arms" section of the zone (around 1200, -780), you'll see dervish mobs appear far up in the air, "a Windsong transport". Target these and right-click the LRK400.
NOTE: These transport mobs drop add spawns in the area you'll be standing. Adds hit for a max ~3,500 and, if left unattended, can add up fast.
Speak with Troopwielder Latakan 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Latakan'
Troopwielder Latakan says 'Windsong should have clung to its music! With Mizzenblast on our side, the skies are ours! My troops can clear out the remaining thieves and looters on this Arm, but Troopwielder Stalvec might need help with the traitors amassing on the right Arm.'
Speak with Troopwielder Stalvec 0/1 (Argath)
Troopwielder Stalvec is on the opposite side of the arms level.
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Stalvec'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'Many speak of the outsiders' strength, courage, and nobility. Many are mistaken. What better time is there to capture a city than when it is under siege? When the Erillians are dead, the Argathians will follow. You outsiders perch like [scavengers], waiting for warriors to fall in battle before picking clean the corpses. When Erillion is driven out, and our Regiment is destroyed, the outsiders will claim Argath.'
You say, 'What scavengers?'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'You claim a noble cause, but you lust after steel. You want to feel the heft of an Argathian blade in your hand. You want our fortress to be your fortress. You want our land to be your land. When you have conquered Argath, you will spread over Alaris and plunder it of all riches. You are no better than the [traitors] on this Arm.'
You say, 'Traitors?'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'Eager to avoid death and rule over a fallen Argath, they have defected to Erillion. They would trade their honor and the lives of everyone in Argath for their own gain. And there is no doubt you would do the same. But the [truth] cannot be helped.'
You say, 'The truth?'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'We need you. Erillion is more powerful than Argath. Without the help of outsiders, we will perish. And now, traitors have occupied this Arm. Some of my troops, along with a group of citizens, attacked the guards stationed near the ramp. While my forces were in disarray, a squad of Erillians penetrated our barrier and rushed onto the [Arm].'
You say, 'What about the Arm?'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'We failed to drive them down the ramp. The best we could do was confine them to the rest of this Arm. Cut off as they are from the main Erillian forces, they grow increasingly desperate, and I think they will [strike] soon.'
You say, 'Let's strike!'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'We must attack before they do. My intelligence sources have located three enemy commanders. If we kill them, the traitors and forces of Erillion will be in disarray.'
This opens up the next three steps.
Kill Commander Jesala 0/1 (Argath)
Kill Commander Ilvestra 0/1 (Argath)
Kill Influencer Zagrala 0/1 (Argath)
Task Window Says: You must find and kill the enemy commanders that are leading Erillion forces on the right arm: Commander Jesala, Commander Ilvestra, and Influence Zagrala.
The three southeastern-most buildings in the south part of the arms house these three nameds. The nameds appear to be immune to all crowd control. One or all of them may spawn their own adds, or come with regular zone adds. Non-nameds are mezzable.
Speak with Troopwielder Stalvec 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Troopwielder Stalvec'
Troopwielder Stalvec says 'Zagrala's words trouble me. Does Erillion desire only our Forge? Atleris should be told.'
Pop-up Story Book
266 platinum
ExperienceRewards:
- Pop-Up Story Book [item=99363]

This solo task begins with Atleris, Council Pinnacle [npc=38115] in Argath inside the council building on the zone-in level.
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of This is Argath [quest=5388]
\- Completion of Shoring Up Defenses [quest=5389]
\- Completion of Protect the Arms [quest=5412]
\- (no minimum skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Atleris, Council Pinnacle'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'You have done much to [help] us, but let us discuss the matter at hand. Zagrala speaks truly. Erillion first desired the Forge. Days before the Forge erupted, a messenger of Erillion knelt before me and said the Orator proposes a pact: join the Order of Alaris and cede control of the Forge to Erillion. Al promised peace, prosperity, and land for all Argath if we acquiesced. I thought ali [mad].'
You say, 'Mad?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Alaris was at peace. Argath possessed abundant land. I had never heard of the Orator. I dismissed the messenger. When al left, al said the Orator aleself would return. Days later, our sentinels in the valley spied an army marching upon the town of Arelis. The army wore Erillian colors. I sent a vanguard into Arelis, but all that escaped the town were death cries and smoke. [Lunanyn] fell next.'
You say, 'Lunanyn?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'The terraced farms of Lunanyn fed Alaris. Now they burn. I pulled defenses back to Argath as Erillion swept past Arelis. We secured the fortress doors, confident Argath could withstand any assault. Then it happened: The Forge erupted in a burst of molten steel. It swept through the streets and dwellings of the Belly like a fiery tide. It [devastated] our population and defenses. It melted the bars and bolts of our fortress door.'
You say, 'Devastated?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Evacuating our citizens and treating the wounded distracted us. Erillion's threat fled our minds -- until three days later. The fortress gates opened, and Erillion stormed into the smoldering streets. Their battle cry called for the Forge -- and were it not for the Forge's own [eruption], Erillion would have taken it.'
You say, 'What eruption?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'I know not why the Forge erupted. I first suspected Erillian saboteurs, but Erillion desires the Forge intact. As it is now, the Forge is unusable. No, there must be another [cause].'
You say, 'What cause?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'You must have seen the swords that float on air and the metal that crawls along the ground. Argathian steel always held magic: light and strong, it could cleave the hardest rock. Somehow, the powers of the steel must have become imbalanced. I tasked one of our finer minds, Mechanic Vitesal, to discover the nature of this imbalance. You have proven yourself as capable, outsider. Would you [speak] with Vitesal and help ali resolve this matter?'
You say, 'I'll speak with him'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Hurry. If we cannot find how to repair the Forge, there is no telling when it shall erupt again.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Riddle of Steel'.
Atleris wants to discover why the forge erupted in order to prevent it from happening again. Mechanic Vitesal has been studying the living steel that has spilled from the forge, and they might have some insight into what caused the disaster.

---

1\. Speak with Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
Mechanic Vitesal [npc=38135] is found on the "arms" level at about +375,-210,-271 near the entrance to Beasts' Domain.
You say, 'Hail, Mechanic Vitesal'
Mechanic Vitesal stares at a floating sword, oblivious to your presence until you call their name. 'Have you waited long? My apologies! Stand back, though; this [sword] could get loose, and then we would be in trouble!'
You say, 'Sword?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'Argathian swords have been called the lightest in all Alaris, but this is ridiculous! I suspect that somehow, whatever magic has imbued them has become unbalanced, and Atleris has tasked me with discovering [how and why].'
You say, 'How and why?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I do not know for sure yet, but I suspect the answer lies within the steel itself. You have seen the different forms of steel wandering around the Belly, have you not? The steel takes the form of swords, shards, or oozes. Each of these forms must contain a different aspect of the steel. If I were to [combine] these forms together in various ways, I could analyze the results and determine the imbalance.'
You say, 'Combine the forms?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'The marvelous outsider, Mizzenblast, developed for me a machine that can combine the different types of steel. You merely get two types of steel near each other, weaken them, and then blast them with this machine. It will fuse the two types of steel together. Then, [you] can bring them to me.'
You say, 'You? Me?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I am not going down into the Belly! I have not tested Mizzenblast's machine yet, but al swore it would work perfectly. And while you are at it, collect for me some of the swords lying around the Belly. I would like to inspect them and figure out why they have not become animated. Be careful, though: I have seen a large mass of steel wandering the belly that appears quite protective of those swords.'
You receive a Mizzenblast FUSOR [item=97984].
_Task Window Says:_ Mechanic Vitesal wants you to bring samples of fused steel from living steel creatures in the Belly. Using the Mizzenblast FUSOR, you can join two entities of living steel that have been physically weakened. This will produce a product fit for Vitesal to study. While you are in the Belly, Vitesal also wants you to collect any Legendary Argathian Swords you find, since they might have been affected by the influx of Forge energy.
For the next 6 loot steps, you'll have to head into the belly (the lower area of the zone) and fight mobs two at a time, bringing them both down to 50%. Once they're both under 50%, click the "Mizzenblast FUSOR" on one of them to transform them into a single mob.
The mobs involved are living steel [npc=38251], molten steel [npc=38241], living blades [npc=38247], empowered blades [npc=38231], a steel cyclone [npc=38235] and a steel hurricane [npc=38240].
The transformed mobs each hit for a max ~10,500 and have an AE called Radiant Discharge (about 15k unmitigated damage).
In order to fuse mobs together, they must be very close in proximity. If they are too far away, you get an error emote. Note that you CAN fuse a mezzed mob.
2\. Loot 1 Twitching Drop of Steel (Argath)
Fight steel + steel, get one to below 50%, then click to make them into a Quivering Steel [npc=39116] which drops 6x Twitching Drop of Steel [item=99792].
3\. Loot 1 Bubbling Steel Knife 0/1 (Argath)
Fight steel + living blades, get one to below 50%, then click to make them into a Mass of Blades [npc=39117] which drops 6x Bubbling Steel Knife [item=100018].
4\. Loot 1 Energized Steel Particulates 0/1 (Argath)
Fight steel + cyclone, get one to below 50%, then click to make them into a Churning Steel [npc=39118] which drops 6x Energized Steel Particulates [item=99793].
5\. Loot 1 Steel Vortex Sliver 0/1 (Argath)
Fight living blades + cyclone, get one to below 50%, then click to make them into a Steel Vortex [npc=39120] which drops 6x Steel Vortex Sliver [item=99847].
6\. Loot 1 Steel Multifacet 0/1 (Argath)
Fight living blades + living blades, get one to below 50%, then click to make them into a Fourfold Edge [npc=39119] which drops 6x Steel Multifacet [item=99794].
7\. Loot 1 Steel Scrap Heap 0/1 (Argath)
Fight cyclone + cyclone, get one to below 50%, then click to make them into a Steel Devastation [npc=39121] which drops 6x Steel Scrap Heap [item=99867].
8\. Deliver 1 Twitching Drop of Steel to Mechanic Vitesal (Argath)
9\. Deliver 1 Bubbling Steel Knife to Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
10\. Deliver 1 Energized Steel Particulates to Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
11\. Deliver 1 Steel Vortex Sliver to Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
12\. Deliver 1 Steel Multifacet to Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
13\. Deliver 1 Steel Scrap Heap to Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
14\. Collect 1 Legendary Steel Sword 0/1 (Argath)
Legendary Steel Sword [item=97969] is a ground spawn found in various places throughout the lower area (appears as a sword on the ground).
_NOTE: If you have this in your possession and run over one of the large, untargettable grey steel masses, you'll be hit with the spell Steel Slumber and lose your sword (you'll have to pick up another ground spawn)._
Steel Slumber: Single Target, Unresistable (-700)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 70000
15\. Deliver 1 Legendary Steel Sword to Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
Mechanic Vitesal says 'This is marvelous! Keep bringing me these steel essences, and I am sure to find out what ails the Forge!'
16\. Speak with Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Mechanic Vitesal'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I have analyzed everything you have collected, and all I can find is...nothing. This steel looks the same as every other piece of steel Argath has forged throughout the years, but it has the appearance of possessing some unknown magic. I do not understand it. Perhaps I am missing something. Could Erillion have poisoned the mountain with some strange power? Atleris will not be pleased that my findings are lacking.'
_Reward(s):_
Goral Hide Book [item=98068]
480 platinum
You gain experience!

_This solo task begins with Atleris, Council Pinnacle, in Argath inside the council building on the zone-in level._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "This is Argath"
\- Completion of "Shoring Up Defenses"
\- Completion of "Protect the Arms"
\- Completion of "The Riddle of Steel"
\- (no minimum skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Atleris, Council Pinnacle'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Your [help] has been invaluable to us! Thank you for [speak]ing with Vitesal, but ali disappoints me. Alir failures cost time. We still do not know why the Forge erupted. What we do know is that its increased power must not fall to Erillon. Even now the enemy redoubles their bombardment, pelting our forces with catapults. I would station more archers at the Forge Overlook, but the enemy's projectiles would crush them. We must destroy the catapults so we can push back Erillon's forces and [resupply] the defenders inside the Forge.'
You say, 'Resupply the defenders?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Argath's champions guard the Forge entrance. The Forge attendants and channelers labor to contain the Forge's steel well. These Argathians have served bravely without resupply since Erillon entered our gates. Unless we can destroy the catapults and [repel] the Erillons, those inside the Forge will perish of hunger.'
You say, 'How do we repel them?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Alassin formed a plan. Al collaborated with Mizzenblast the outsider. Will you [work] with them?'
You say, 'I'll work with Alassin'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'I place little faith in this plan, but we have no recourse. You may find Alassin on the crown. If you manage to destroy the catapults, try to capture any Erillian commander you can find. They must answer for Erillion's villainy!'
You have been assigned the task 'Breaking Ballistae'.
The Erillion catapults wear away at Argath's defenses. Atleris asks you to help Alassin and Mizzenblast destroy them. Atleris also told you to find and interrogate any commanding Erillion officers you find in the valley.
Speak with Alassin on the Crown.

---

Speak with Alassin 0/1 (Argath)
_Alassin is in the building closest to the air ship drop-off from Steamfont, at about 315, 200, 7._
You say, 'Hail, Alassin'
Alassin says 'Yes, I have been working with crazy Mizzenblast. Al is -- what is it called? -- a gnome? Are all gnomes crazy?'
Speak with Mizzenblast 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Alassin is not confident in Mizzenblast's plan, but it is the only plan.
_Mizzenblast is found in a building near Troopwielder Latakan in the northern part of the Arms._
You say, 'Hail, Mizzenblast'
Mizzenblast says 'Blow ourselves up? No! Have you been listening to Alassin? Maybe I don't speak Alaran as well as I thought I did. He's been telling everyone about how stupid he thinks my plan is, but he doesn't even understand it! It's really quite [simple].'
_You receive a Mizzenblast Exoblast._
You say, 'Simple?'
Mizzenblast says 'I modified some of my clockwork spheres, reinforcing them with several layers of steel. Within these layers, I wrapped packets of explosive powder. With a reflective coating of Argathian steel near the handle, the bearer of the device can stay safe from any shrapnel. So, we can walk right up to the catapults and [detonate] the explosives without fear!'
You say, 'Detonate, how?'
Mizzenblast says 'This is the genius of my design: The inner steel lining keeps the bearer completely unharmed! See, I'm not as crazy as Alassin thinks I am! Take a sphere and get to work!'
Destroy the first Erillian catapult 0/1 (Argath)
Destroy the second Erillian catapult 0/1 (Argath)
Destroy the third Erillian catapult 0/1 (Argath)
Destroy the fourth Erillian catapult 0/1 (Argath)
_The four catapults are found in the lower area of the zone. Get up close to them and then click the Mizzenblast Exoblast (20-second cast) to destroy them._
Subdue and interrogate Intellector Galdon 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have cripples the enemy's catapults, find and interrogate an enemy commander.
_Intellector Galdon spawns in the central area of the "belly", in the middle of the erupted forge (near Catapult #3). The two soother spawns next to him have a short respawn timer. They are splittable._
_Galdon hits for a max ~12,000 and AE rampages. He'll go inactive as he reaches low health:_
Intellector Galdon says 'Stop! Do not kill me! I will talk! Yes, Erillion wants the Forge. The Orator has commanded us to sieze it. Why would al not want it? It produces the finest steel in Alaris. And Argath has the greatest defenses. It is the perfect fortress for a great army! No, we did not poison the Forge. I have told you everything. Now please, spare my life!'
Speak with Bursin the Legend 0/1 (Argath)
_Bursin the Legend is found at about -160, -500, -400 (outside the main forge area, accessed via the southwestern part of Argath's "Belly"._
You say, 'Hail, Bursin the Legend'
Bursin the Legend says 'Halt! What sort of creature are you? [Explain] yourself! Are you a thrall of Erillion? Do you bring supplies?'

_This is the sixth task in a series of six; a solo task that begins with Bursin the Legend in Argath at about -160, -500, -400 (outside the main forge area, accessed via the southwestern part of Argath's "Belly")._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "This is Argath"
\- Completion of "Shoring Up Defenses"
\- Completion of "Protect the Arms"
\- Completion of "The Riddle of Steel"
\- Completion of "Breaking Ballistae"
\- (no minimum skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Bursin the Legend'
Bursin the Legend says 'There is a new [threat] to this Forge, greater than that of Erillion.'
You say, 'What threat?'
Bursin the Legend says 'The Forge grows hotter. When first the steel erupted from the mountain, the council sent the legends, attendants, and channelers to guard and salvage the Forge. We have kept temperatures low with our traditional cooling methods, but now the [heat] is becoming unbearable.'
You say, 'What heat?'
Bursin the Legend says 'A mass of molten steel has been welling up from the heart of the mountain. It is small now, but already our pipes and equipment are beginning to melt. The cooling tubes are melting, and we must carry water by hand to the mass. However, we do not have enough attendants to do the job. Could you [help]?'
You say, 'My help? Sure!'
Bursin the Legend says 'Thank you. If we cannot cool down the mass, I fear the Forge will erupt once again and collapse the rest of Argath. Speak with Attendant Shirian. Al has a plan.'
You have been assigned the task 'Critical Mass'.
The heat inside the Forge builds. Bursin the Legend believes it is close to erupting once more. Attendant Shirian believes al can cool the heat, but al needs help.

---

Speak with Attendant Shirian 0/1 (Argath)
_Attendant Shirian spawns nearby, inside the forge._
You say, 'Hail, Attendant Shirian'
Attendant Shirian says 'This heat is intense, even for me! We do not have much time. Our cooling tubes have melted shut, and even now living steel is rising up from our molding cauldrons and coalescing on the steel mass in the heart. We need to act quickly! Draw near to the cooling pots, fill a vessel with water, and douse the steel mass, as well as any living globs of steel heading toward the heart!'
Shrink and destroy the mass of steel 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ Fetch cooling water from the top of the water reservoirs. Use the water on the steel droplets and the erupting steel mass in order to cool them down.
_NOTE: You may be able to update this step simply by killing the Steel Eruption (no cooling required). It's possible you'll still need to cool it (details below) if you're too slow to DPS._
_At the center of the forge spawns a large ooze called "Steel Eruption". You need to go to the water reservoirs (the northwest and southwest parts extending from the center of the forge). Doing so causes a "Cooling Pitcher" to appear on your cursor (two charges of "Douse of Forge Coolant")._
_Equip the Cooling Pitcher in your primary, run up to the Steel Eruption (which will aggro you, hitting for a max ~10,000; in addition to regular "molten steel" spawns around and its own adds, "a steel droplet" which hit for a max ~1,000)._
_Use the Cooling Pitcher on the Steel Eruption. This will cause it to shrink in size. Once shrunk, you can kill it for the update._
_NOTE: As it's aggro'd, mobs called "a steel droplet" spawn and attack. If these make it to the main mob, the Steel Eruption grows in size. The Cooling Pitchers can be used to stun these droplets._
Speak with Bursin the Legend 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Bursin the Legend'
Bursin the Legend says 'Well done, \_\_\_\_\_, the Forge has cooled, for now. Tell Atleris what occurred here. And have ali send more food if al can!'
_Rewards:_
Braxi Hide Book
106 platinum, 6 gold, 6 silver, 7 copper
Experience

You have been assigned the task 'Reclaiming Argath'.

If you have completed the six pre-quest solo tasks but have not yet done this mission, you see this instead:
You say, 'Hail, Atleris, Council Pinnacle'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Bursin lives? If you speak truthfully, the Forge will consume ali. I count all of the lost lives of those in the Forge; they have [sacrificed] themselves for Argath. But this is a weighty matter. We always need [help] delivering grain. You could again [speak] with Vitesal, if you wish to solve the mystery of the Forge. Or you could [work] with Alassin and Mizzenblast to defeat our enemies.'
You say, 'Sacrificed?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'The Forge will erupt. This can be delayed, not prevented. The Mountain will have its vengeance against Erillion. The enemy, and Argath with them, will drown in [steel].'
You say, 'Steel?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'The Mountain's steel ruined the Belly, and now Erillion occupies it. I would rather the whole of Argath sink into the heart of the mountain than see Erillion conquer my people. Either the Forge will [end] the lives of the enemy in the Belly, or I will.'
You say, 'End?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'I conspired with the gnome, Mizzenblast. Alir weapons, unleashed upon the Belly, will devastate Erillion. The flying [ships] of the outsiders will swoop over the Belly and rain fire upon our enemies.'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'You would know best how to pilot your own ships. [Join] Mizzenblast, and wipe Erillion from Argath before the Mountain does!'
You say, 'I will join.'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says '[Go] now. Mizzenblast waits by the dock.'

Speak with Mizzenblast 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Mizzenblast'
Mizzenblast says 'Are you the only volunteers Atleris sent? I'm not surprised. The way he talks now, you'd think he would forfeit the lives of everyone in Argath just to defeat Erillion. And what are the lives of a few Norrathian [adventurers] compared to the lives of his own people?'
You say, 'Adventurers?'
Mizzenblast says 'I suppose risking your own life is the cost of exploring new lands and meeting new civilizations. We must choose sides when people are dying. Even though Atleris uses us for his own ends, his cause is just. I have seen enough of Argath to know I will do anything to [save] it.'
You say, 'Save?'
Mizzenblast says 'To do so, I have created my finest weapons yet: the Battle Orb and the Arm Cannon. The Battle Orb works using the same principle as my Exoblast: throw it in the midst of the enemy, and it will explode into shards of steel. The Arm Cannon functions like the LRK: aim it at your target and fire an armor-piercing projectile. With these weapons, and an [airship], you can't lose!'
You say, 'What airship?'
Mizzenblast says 'Aelsworth has been generous enough to lend us his airship for this mission -- well, generous enough to allow me to retrofit the ship with a more powerful steam engine once the [mission] is complete. There is a special feature you should know about this airship. It has a safety device that will bring you to the ship within five seconds if you fall off. There may be a situation where you need to disable this, and even go to the dock. For this, I will give you a device. If you hold the device in your dominant hand, it will keep the airship from protecting you, but only if you are at the dock. This device is powered by the airship, so will only work when it is around. The airship will also remove any corpses that are on it, and deposit them to the docks.'
You say, 'What mission?'
Mizzenblast says 'Take these Battle Orbs and Arm Cannons. I have given Arm Cannons only to those who have no magical abilities. It will allow you to attack your enemies at long range. The Battle Orbs I have given to everyone: when you are over the Belly, drop them on the Erillian troops. Now, ask Aelsworth about -- hold on! What is Magistrate Altara doing here?'
_Everyone in the task receives a Battle Orb, an Arm Cannon, and an Airship Safety Suppression Device._

You say, 'Hail, Magistrate Altara'
Magistrate Altara says 'Outsider, Atleris sent me. You must know: Erillion and Windsong have taken our defensive towers that float beyond the fortress walls. With their new position, the enemy fires down upon the Arms and the Crown. And even now, Windsong flies more troops toward the Pinnacle. Before you can attack the troops in the Belly, you must [remove] the enemy from the towers!'
You say, 'Remove?'
Magistrate Altara says 'You must hurry. Speak with Aelsworth and board the ship!'
Speak with Aelsworth 0/1 (Argath)

Board the airship 0/1 (Argath)
_Everyone needs to get aboard the airship. NOTE: If you fall off at any time, you'll be ported back to its location. The ship will start moving on its own towards your first target._

Collect your reward 0/1 (Argath)

_This group mission begins with Mechanic Vitesal in Argath, located at -370, 200, -275 (on the "arms" level of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "This is Argath"
\- Completion of "Shoring Up Defenses"
\- Completion of "Protect the Arms"
\- Completion of "The Riddle of Steel"
\- Completion of "Breaking Ballistae"
