\- Completion of "Reclaiming Argath"
\- Minimum skill level in Alaran Language: 10
You say, 'Hail, Mechanic Vitesal'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I trust Atleris has told you of the dire situation. I have a plan, but I will need you in order to [rescue] Argath.'
You say, 'Rescue Argath?'
Mechanic Vitesal says '[Go] to the Pinnacle and meet me there. It is not safe here; the steel will be upon us at any moment!'
You have been assigned the task 'Illdaera's Vengeance'.
The Forge is erupting and steel is pouring into the Overlook. Mechanic Vitesal has formulated a plan that might save Argath.

---

Speak with Mechanic Vitesal 0/1 (Argath)
Mechanic Vitesal says 'Thank you for coming, outsider! Most of your kind have already fled Argath, and the rest of our people have taken shelter in the Pinnacle. You would not [leave] us, would you? No, you have the courage of Illdaera to stand alongside us! Had the Forge not been [consumed], Bursin would no doubt be at my side.'
You say, 'Consumed?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I could not bear to hear the screams of agony that came from the Forge as I stood on the Overlook, fearing for my life as the mountain shook beneath me. Staggering to the edge, I saw Bursin directing the attendants to flee as a wave of steel overtook ali. If only I had readied a [plan] sooner...'
You say, 'We need a plan...'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'You are right. We must focus now on saving Argath. In the course of studying the steel, I determined that energy radiates from the living steel of the Forge and resonates with any steel object long since cooled. Our carts and the cores of our floating towers were crafted from the Forge's steel. If we bring shards of living steel close enough to the carts or towers, we can provide to them enough energy to carry enormous [payloads].'
You say, 'What payloads?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'The living steel is not impervious. If we can [cool] it, we can then [break] it apart with a large enough explosion.'
You say, 'How do we cool it?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I have moved one of our floating towers and placed it in the waters of Illdaera. Our spelltamers have enchanted the tower's stones, enabling them to soak up the waters. With enough shards of living steel, we can provide the power needed to carry the large amount of water and dump it on the encroaching steel. Then we can [break] it. Speak with Spelltamer Frocal to learn more about our plans for the tower.'
You say, 'How do we break it?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'I have laden two carts with enough explosive material to shatter a river of steel. Having experimented with the living steel, I know that it is not enough to simply detonate the explosives when the steel is in its molten phase. It will just reform. But if we first cool and harden the steel, we can fracture it [permanently]. Speak with Hauler Talarnis or Hauler Thubner to learn more about our plans for the carts.'
You say, 'Permanently?'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'There is no telling if my plan is enough to save Argath, but we cannot find out standing here. We must make our way to the overlook and try to collect shards of steel. On the ledges of the Neck, adjacent to the Breath Spiral, I have mounted bolt guns that we can use to break pieces of steel from the living mass. Speak with Mechanic Dorsim to find out more about our plan for the bolt guns...Wait...Do you [hear] that?!'
You say, 'I hear it...'
Mechanic Vitesal says 'It sounds like the entire Breath Spiral is cracking and giving way! Hurry below and see what is happening!'
Your task 'Illdaera's Vengeance' has been updated.
Loot 9 Energized Steel Shard from golem splinters 0/9 (Argath)
_Head down to the bottom of the "neck" (the winding ramp) to the arms. There, you'll find the Avatar of Steel, a giant golem, attacking Argath itself._
_Someone will need to use the bolt guns in the middle areas of the "neck" (just click them) to spawn adds from the Avatar. Each click of a bolt gun spawns one add._
You say, 'Hail, Mechanic Dorsim'
Mechanic Dorsim says 'I have placed bolt guns along the five ledges that connect to the Spiral. Using the guns, we can shoot the steel golem. This will break off pieces of it, weaken its power, and damage it. We can then subdue the pieces of living steel and collect shards to provide power to the carts and floating tower.'
_Upon clicking one:_
Avatar of Steel is pierced by a bolt gun. A piece of molten steel breaks off of Avatar of Steel, weakening its power.
_These adds hit for a max ~9,500 and drop an item called "Energized Steel Shard". You need nine of them to update the task, but it's recommended you gather more just in case._
Power the left cart with Steel Shards and ride it to the center of the Overlook 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ You must move the carts next to the Avatar of Steel. Hold aloft the Energetic Steel Shards while standing on the cart near Hauler Thubner. You must remain in the cart in order for it to move.
To make the Avatar of Steel vulnerable to explosives, you must cool and harden its skin. Move the water tower into place over the Avatar's head by standing on the tower and holding aloft the Energetic Steel Shards. The tower is located near Spelltamer Frocal. You must remain on the tower in order for it to move.
_North of this area, you'll find a transport cart, beside which is Hauler Thubner who explains what you need to do._
You say, 'Hail, Hauler Thubner'
Hauler Thubner says 'We have loaded the cart with explosives. It is now so heavy we cannot move it without using the power of living steel. Use the bolt guns on the ledges next to the spiral ramp to break off pieces of the living steel. If you bring steel shards and hold them aloft while standing on the cart, we can provide enough power to move the cart toward the steel golem. When both carts have been placed near the golem, we can [destroy] it.'
You say, 'How do we destroy it?'
Hauler Thubner says 'Once the fiery skin of the golem has been cooled by water from the floating tower, the carts' explosives can be triggered.'
_Whoever has the shards needs to get on the cart and click the shards from their inventory. The cart will move on its own as long as the person with the shards stays on it. It will take three shards to move the cart all the way to the final location (at the Avatar). Along the way, you'll get a few adds which hit for ~9,000 (mezzable)._
Power the right cart with Steel Shards and ride it to the center of the Overlook 0/1 (Argath)
_You then need to do the same thing with the south transport cart. This time, as you're going along, piles of molten lava will drop. These have a damage aura around them which seem to get stronger with the longer they're up. You'll want to kill these before the next step._
Using the Steel Shards, position the tower over the center of the Overlook 0/1 (Argath)
_Back on the crown (the top level where you zoned in), you'll find a named Spelltamer beside a catapult who will explain what to do._
You say, 'Hail, Spelltamer Frocal'
Spelltamer Frocal says 'The tower next to me has been filling with water since the Forge began erupting. Use the bolt guns on the ledges next to the spiral ramp to break off pieces of the living steel. If you bring steel shards and hold them aloft while standing on the tower, we can provide enough power to move the tower toward the steel eruption for a short time. I have also modified this [catapult] to help you.'
You say, 'The catapult?'
Spelltamer Frocal says 'If you fall, use this catapult to fling yourself to the tower.'
_Get on the catapult to launch yourself onto the water tower. Click the shards to get the tower moving and it'll move to a position above the Avatar._
_NOTE: While you're on the tower, "a fiery blast" may hit it. These need to be ranged-attacked or nuked down before they get to the tower._
Detonate the explosives on the carts 0/1 (Argath)
Avatar of Steel's protection crumbles in the massive explosion.
The task locks.
Kill the Avatar of Steel 0/1 (Argath)
_Task Window Says:_ The Avatar's defenses are gone. Attack and destroy the golem!
_The Avatar of Steel goes live. It hits for a max ~17,000._
_About 30 seconds into the fight, he casts "Gravity Well". Every 35 seconds after, he casts "Crushing Swipe":_
Gravity Well: PB AE 100', Unresistable (0)
1: Decrease Movement by 75%
Crushing Swipe: PB AE 200', Fire (-900)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 20000
_NOTE: "Crushing Swipe" is preceded by the emote "Avatar of Steel prepares for a massive frontal strike" (5-second warning)._
_He may also start AEing "Rumble of Mountains" late into the fight, however this isn't known as one of its standard AEs._
Rumble of Mountains: PB AE 1000', Fire (-900)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 15000
_You'll also see time-based adds. You may see them about two minutes into the fight. They start out as "a steel pattern", seek out a random player, take the form of that player's weapons, and morph into "a recreation of steel" before attacking. The adds hit for a max ~8,500 (mezzable)._
Avatar of Steel has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Avatar of Steel's corpse's massive form collapses, shaking the Overlook.
Speak with Atleris, Council Pinnacle 0/1 (Argath)
You say, 'Hail, Atleris, Council Pinnacle'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Once again you have done what we could not. Our founder would be [ashamed] of us. '
You say, 'Ashamed?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'We lost the lust for battle that Illdaera held sacred. You have shown me this. Not only have you saved Argath, you have also reminded me that military might is paramount. We cannot [rely] upon commerce to save us.'
You say, 'Why can't you rely on that?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'I will rebuild our regiment into an army that Erillion and all of Alaris will fear to challenge. Erillion will be crushed and driven from the [Valley], never to return to Argath!'
You say, 'The Valley?'
Atleris, Council Pinnacle says 'Erillion still holds Arelis and Lunanyn. I have seen great flashes of light and heard deep rolls of thunder issuing from the Valley. As you have helped us here, go to the Valley and smite Erillion! Thank you, outsiders. Speak to Vitesal when you are ready to [leave] us.'
Collect your reward 0/1 (Argath)
_Open up the chest._
_NOTE: Make sure everyone is around the chest before doing so. Anyone who's not in range won't get experience for it._
_Rewards:_
Torn Tome
320 platinum
Experience
Possible Chest Loot (1 Item + 1 Cantrip Per Task)
Ancient Alaran Shield
Boneshard of the Blademaster
Facemask of the Burnmaster
Guards of the Dung Gatherer
Jagged Ring of Altercation
Kalkek's Warhammer
Keremar's Wand
Krucidon's Copper Earplug
Krucidon's Inverted War Charm
Steel Seed Blade
Minor Alaran Cantrip
Lesser Alaran Cantrip

_This task is the second in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Geirdan Ath in the Valley of Lunanyn, located at 2295, -1700, 46 (in a building in the southeast part of the upper section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Raid and Recover"
\- (no minimum required skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Geirdan Ath'
Geirdan Ath says 'I am glad to have you back. Your [help] was much appreciated last time. Our occupation here is important in finding out what happened to Cazic Thule and who stole his power. But until then, these farmers are causing some problems for us. Their involvement makes it more difficult than necessary in our fight against the Prophet's Army. Perhaps they can be [convinced] that our fight is not with them.'
You say, 'Convinced?'
Geirdan Ath says 'You may have to be... blunt... in the manner in which you convince them of this. But I trust you can find a way. Unless your [stomach] is not in this.'
You say, 'My stomach's in it'
Geirdan Ath says 'Excellent! There are three leaders that you must deal with. Egot Mek, Algot Yor, and Hemot Talas. Once they are dealt with, I am sure the others will fall in line. '
You have been assigned the task 'The Assassination Game'.
Geirdan Ath is concerned about the farmers within the valley. Although they share a common enemy, the farmers still choose to fight the Rallosian forces. They pray to nature to create barbarous mosstroopers, which make it difficult to concentrate on the Prophet's army itself. Perhaps if the farmers had no leadership, it would convince them to give up the fight against Geirdan's army.
Perhaps you can convince Egot Mek to lay down alir arms. Al tends the land high in the northwestern terraces.

---

_You'll have to hail and kill three named farmers in the northwestern boundary part of the zone._
_NOTE: If you have multiple people in the same party doing this task at the same, you can prevent non-update issues by doing the hails while everyone is invisible, then breaking the invis to kill the mob._
Speak to Egot Mek 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Kill Egot Mek 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Speak to Algot Yor 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Kill Algot Yor 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Speak to Hemot Talas 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Kill Hemot Talas 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Speak to Geirdan Ath 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
You say, 'Hail, Geirdan Ath'
Geirdan Ath says 'Excellent work! Now kill those moss troopers they have been creating. Thinning their number should help quite a bit.'
Kill 4 mosstroopers 0/4 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Speak to Geirdan Ath 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
You say, 'Hail, Geirdan Ath'
Geirdan Ath says 'Perhaps now these farmers will cooperate! '
You were able to put a stop to the raiders and have freed the missing soldiers, at least until more their reinforcements can arrive. With fewer moss troopers around, it should make traveling a bit easier for his men.
_Rewards:_
Eltarki's Diary - Life and Death
- Eltarki's Diary - Life and Death [item=98146]

_This task is the third in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Captain Gre Metkal in the Valley of Lunanyn (Rallosian camp in northeastern part of the lower section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Raid and Recover"
\- Completion of "The Assassination Game"
\- (no minimum required skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Gre Metkal'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'You must be the one who helped Geirdan. I can use someone who can take care of business. If you are [willing] to get your hands dirty, that is.'
You say, 'I'm willing...'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'Good to hear! I seem to be missing some scouts. I dispatched a small scouting party to keep an eye on the Erillian camp. But it has been many days since we have heard from them. They were ordered to set up in a location where they could easily see the camp, but not too close to be discovered. [Find] their camp and find out why we have not heard from them.'
You say, 'I'll find them...'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'Excellent! Be careful out there. This land holds many dangers.'
You have been assigned the task 'Uncharted Territory'.
Captain Gre Metkal is struggling to continue to fight. Once his army controls the valley, they will be able to move troops more freely into the other areas of Alaris. He has asked you to find the scouts with whom he has lost contact. Only when their whereabouts are known, will he be able to concentrate on doing something about the patrolling Erillion army nearby.

---

Find the Rallosian scout camp 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_The camp is found in the southern end of the zone near location -800, 1000._
Speak with Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ It appears that the camp has been deserted with signs of a struggle and no survivors. Captain Metkal will be disappointed to hear that his scouts have been killed.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Gre Metkal'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'The Erillion commanders must have sent scouts of their own to slaughter my troops! You must find those who are responsible and exact deadly revenge. Not only will it hamper their own scouting, it will be payback for what they have done!'
Loot 1 Prophet Order VI 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Loot 1 Prophet Order XII 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Loot 1 Prophet Order IX 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ The Erillion scouts who have killed Metkal's troops must be dealt with! Collect orders as proof of their demise.
_The scouts spawn in the central area of the zone. They're not KOS. They come in groups of three (one leader; two scouts). They can be split. Each drops one Prophet Order (so, if you have a full group of six, you'll need to kill each set twice)._
_NOTE: These items are NOT pre-lootable._
Deliver 1 Prophet Order VI to Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Deliver 1 Prophet Order XII to Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Deliver 1 Prophet Order IX to Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Speak to Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Gre Metkal'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'More trophies for Zek! Thank you for your efforts.'
You have found the location of the scout's camp, and have dispatched those believed to be responsible.

Eltarki's Diary - Life and Death
160 platinum
Experience

_This task is the fourth in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Captain Gre Metkal in the Valley of Lunanyn (Rallosian camp in northeastern part of the lower section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Raid and Recover"
\- Completion of "The Assassination Game"
\- Completion of "Uncharted Territory"
\- (no minimum required skill level in Alaran Language)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Gre Metkal'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'I have an idea. It will require a bit of [subterfuge] on your part, but should you be successful, it will help in removing the wraiths of Arelis village as another participant in the upcoming battles.'
You say, 'Subterfuge?'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'The wraiths seem to blame us for the destruction of their village. It seems to me that if their anger can be [redirected] to the Prophet army it will remove one obstacle from our efforts in controlling the valley.'
You say, 'Redirected?'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'Tell them whatever you like. I care little. You just need to get it done. Is this something that you can handle, or should I seek someone more [capable] to help Rallos?'
You say, 'I'm capable'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'Excellent! I will see to it that you rewarded should your efforts prove successful!'
You have been assigned the task 'The Enemy of My Enemy'.
Captain Gre Metkal believes it is important to get the wraiths of Arelis Village on his side of this war. Even if the wraiths do nothing more than agree to not attack the Rallosian army, it will be one less thing he will need to worry about.
The wraith Aedros is the leader of the former inhabitants of Arelis Village.

---

Speak with Aedros 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Aedros spawns in the undead camp in the east-central part of the zone (about -155, -515)._
Kill troopers while searching for evidence 0/5 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ You need proof that the Prophet's army is responsible for the destruction of the village. It is possible that Erillion troopers may have evidence on them.
_Kill five more troopers in the southern camp or in the farm area to the north._
Speak with Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ You have found nothing to tie the Prophet's army to the destruction of Arelis village. Captain Gre Metkal may know what to do next.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Gre Metkal'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'So, it wants proof? It will have its proof! Go to the foothill in the south and find Pika. He is a recluse that I have had dealings with early on. He will help you.'
Speak with Pika 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ According to Captain Metkal, the recluse, Pika, may be able to help. He loves to hide near the caves to the south.
_Pika spawns above the cave in the southwestern part of the zone (-1100, 1300)._
You say, 'Hail, Pika'
Pika says 'You Norrathians always come to Pika! Not know what is... worse, you or them Prophet army thugs! What do you... [want]?'
You say, 'I don't want anything; Gre Metkal sent me!'
Pika says 'The Captain sent you?! Of course! Come now... What can Pika do for the [Captain]?'
You say, 'You can do a lot for the captain...'
Pika says 'That is all? Pika can do... um... easy! You need to find Pika some official order of the Prophet. Pika not know where to get, you just get. Bring that to me and Pika can... begin!'
Loot the Orders of the Prophet from an Erillion soldier 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_These drop from the same mobs in the trooper camp._
Deliver the Orders of the Prophet to Pika 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Pika says 'This will do just fine. Now Pika will need you to get the poison from a huntsman. But it must be a mature huntsman! Not from those baby ones!'
Loot a Poison of the Huntsman 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_These drop from higher level huntsman spiders in the zone (Level 95+)._
Deliver the poison to Pika 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ Great care must be taken when handling the highly corrosive poison that is sometimes used to make etchings in skin and parchment.
Pika says 'Very good! Pika needs just a... moment. Here are the orders the Captain needs. Tell the Captain that Pika help any time!'
Take the Forged Orders to Aedros 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ These new orders from Pika should be enough to convince Aedros that the Prophet's army was involved in the destruction of Arelis village.
Speak with Captain Gre Metkal 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Task Window Says:_ Captain Gre Metkal will want to know the outcome of his ruse.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Gre Metkal'
Captain Gre Metkal says 'You have done well. I have to say that I am more than a little surprised that it worked. Thank you for your help. '
_Rewards:_
Eltarki's Diary - Life and Death
213 platinum
Experience
- Eltarki's Diary - Life and Death [item=98146]

_This task is the fifth in the series of five; a solo task that begins with Aedros in the Valley of Lunanyn (-160, -530 -- central part of the zone's lower half)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Raid and Recover"
\- Completion of "The Assassination Game"
\- Completion of "Uncharted Territory"
\- Completion of "The Enemy of My Enemy"

_This solo task begins with Grave Digger Undros in the Valley of Lunanyn at about 1400, -415, -45 (south of the small canyon that leads out from the upper section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks

---

You say, 'Hail, Grave Digger Undros'
Grave Digger Undros says, in Alaran, 'Those filthy oashim! Here I am trying to give decent burials for those that have fallen in combat, and the oashim tear the bodies to shreds before I can do anything! They are making quite a mess. Do you think you could [help] me out?'
You say, 'Of course I'll help!'
Grave Digger Undros says, in Alaran, 'See if you can find any of the oashim nests and destroy them! I know this won't solve the problem completely, but hopefully it will cut their numbers down a bit.'
You have been assigned the task 'Filthy Oashim!'.
Grave Digger Undros is just trying to give a proper burial to those who have fallen in battle. The oashim however are making it difficult as they enjoy feeding on corpses, and ripping them to shreds causing a huge mess.
Find some oashim nests and destroy them. Kill the baby oashim that emerge from the destroyed nests.

---

Destroy the oashim nests and kill the baby oashim that were hiding within 0/12 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Nests are found in the caves along the western boundary of the zone, inside a cave at /way -1091, 1284 (you can find Pika standing on the roof of the cave). Upon destroying a nest, several baby oashims pop out. These are simple kills._
Speak with Grave Digger Undros 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
You say, 'Hail, Grave Digger Undros'
Grave Digger Undros says, in Alaran, 'Good job taking those nests out. Some of the local farmers gave me this vial. They say it will kill the oashim. I haven't been able to test it though. Why don't you try it out on one of the oashim breeders? They are far too bloated with babies to attack, so this should be pretty easy. If you lose your poison, let me know and I can [give] you some more.'
You say, 'Give me some more!'
Grave Digger Undros says, in Alaran, 'Try not to lose it again.'
Give the oashim poison to an oashim breeder 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_Breeders are found in the backs of the caves on the western boundary of the zone and one by the Rallosian camp. Upon hand-in, the oashim attacks, hitting for a max ~11,000._
an oashim breeder does not react to the poison as you thought it would!
a mutated oashim is completely silent as it attacks.

a mutated oashim has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
a mutated oashim's corpse squeals in panic as the life leaves its body.
Speak with Grave Digger Undros 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)

Grave Digger Undros says, in Alaran, 'So the poison didn't quite have the effect we were hoping for, huh? Sorry about that. Thanks for helping me out though. Take this for your efforts. The previous owner won't be needing it anymore.'

You say, 'Hail, Aedros'
Aedros says, in Alaran, 'It is time to [make our move] on The Daevin and destroy him. ??????? you were unable to [convince] Taleg of The Daevan's devious deeds, I am certain that foul creature is to blame for the destructions of our village. We have too much to worry about on the battlefield without him spreading his chaos. This won't be easy though I'm afraid. He will be ready and waiting for now this time.'
You say, 'We're ready to make our move'
Aedros says, in Alaran, 'Prepare for battle and inform me when you are [ready] to strike!'
You have been assigned the task 'Into the Abyss'.
It is time to take our The Daevan once and for all. Aedros has sent you back into the caverns known as The Abyss. The Daevan has set up some portals so that you cannot easily reach him. Perhaps you can find a way around them.
Speak with Dory, one of The Daevan's minions.
You say, 'Ready!'
Aedros says, in Alaran, 'May The Daevan meet death by your hands!'
Speak with Dory 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
All trash mobs in this zone hit for a max ~10,000; are stunnable; and see invisibility. All mobs are immune to mez, but can be split from each other with careful pulling.
Make your way through the tunnels until you come across Dory.
You say, 'Hail, Dory'
Dory says 'You poor thing. The Daevan has trapped you here. All of these portals lead to the beginning of the caverns. There's no way you're gonna reach The Daevan to kill him. . . Unless you [help] me!'
You say, 'How can I help?'
Dory says 'I am no fan of The Daevan. He has been nothing but cruel to my brothers and I. What The Daevan doesn't know, is that my brothers and I have found his devices that can control these portals. You do what I [need], and I can help you get to The Daevan so you kill him. Unless that is, you are having second thoughts and want to [leave].'
You say, 'What do you need?'
Dory says 'Don't worry, it's nothing too difficult for a group of seasoned adventurers like yourselves. I just want you to take out some bullies that have been making life hard for my brothers and I. First up, I want you to kill Fizzlefingers. He is a reega that loves to brown-nose The Daevan. He thinks he's a powerful wizard, but he is a fraud. [Agree] to kill him, and my brothers and I will help you get through the tunnels.'
You say, 'I agree; we'll kill him'
Dory says 'I knew you would help me! You don't have much choice in the matter anyway!'
Dory removes the portal blocking your way.
Speak with Fizzlefingers 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
You say, 'Hail, Fizzlefingers'
Fizzlefingers says 'So that crybaby, Dory sent you to try to kill me? Dory and his brothers are a bunch of cowards! It matters not, for now you die! Feel the wrath of my powerful magic spells!'
Fizzlefingers attacks. He hits for a max ~10,000 and casts the spell "Fingers of Flame" (or at least he attempts to; he fizzles a lot).

Gigglen and his oashim pet, Fuzzles are a pain in the neck. Gigglen takes that nasty oashim everywhere, and frankly it creeps me out. I hate oashim! I have tried asking Gigglen to keep Fuzzles away from me, but does he listen? No! Oh, and once you kill Gigglen, bring me his head. I shall keep it as a trophy.'

_This group mission begins with Zarbak in the Valley of Lunanyn, located in the vicinty of 1725, -1150, -45 (in the Rallosian camp in the northeastern part of the larger section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Raid and Recover"
\- Completion of "The Assassination Game"
\- Completion of "Uncharted Territory"
\- Completion of "The Enemy of My Enemy"
\- Completion of "The Memory Remains"
\- Completion of "Into the Abyss"

You say, 'Hail, Zarbak'
Zarbak says 'You, \_\_\_\_\_! Let Zarbak feels the meats of your head! Yes, yes, good and thick! Perfect for knowings of the bashings and smashings! In the [army] of Zek you want to fight? Are you ready to [go]?'
You say, 'The army?'
Zarbak says 'Army of Zek is strong! With goblins and ogres, Zarbak says no need for weakling races. But Vallon says great [battle] is coming, need to fill valley with walls of sword and shield. So, you now in army of Zek!'
You say, 'What battle?'
Zarbak says 'Rumblings low shiver air on southern horizon. Mirage of sound lingers over enemy camp and hides goings and doings. Powerful voice bellows in strange tongue. Even Rallos concerned. Zarbak sees Rallos talking with Sol Ro, alliances forming, armies meeting as one. Zarbak thinks Rallos finds what he [seeks].'
You say, 'He seeks what?'
Zarbak says 'You have not much knowings as I thought! All gods have had much talking. Cazic is dead, his plane empty! Where fled his essence? An [island] appears, and Rallos says Zarbak and army must go.'
You say, 'An island?'
Zarbak says 'Now search we do, resting not until Rallos satisfied. No army thwarts us, not with big thick heads like you to think for our front lines! Do you bring with you [many] companions, or but a [few]?'
You say, 'A few'
Zarbak says 'Much can be accomplished with little. [Go] and achieve victory!'
You have been assigned the task 'The Herald of Oratory'.
You say, 'We're ready to go'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Valley of War.
The forces of Erillion march across Arelis Valley to defeat the armies of Rallos Zek and Solusek Ro. Command the soldiers of the Norrathian gods to stop Erillion's advance.
Prevent the army of Erillion from reaching Solusek Ro and Rallos Zek. Defeat the Herald of Oratory.

---

Defend Rallos Zek and Solusek Ro from the forces of Erillion and kill the Herald of Oratory 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
Claim your reward from the chest the gods have given you 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)

---

_Buy soldiers from the Quartermaster, position both offensive and defensive soldiers around the gods and use offensive soldiers in the valley below in preparation for the named._
_NOTE: The invaders and the named (to begin with) aren't killable by players. You have to use the soldiers, which will kill mobs as they wander through._
_All mobs have a damage aura up which will do about 15k damage per tick as long as you're in range._
_The Herald of Oratory has the same damage aura as well as a shield that prevents damage from being done to her._
_In order to destroy the shield and make her killable, you have to position numerous soldiers around her. Once you get the emote saying her shield has been destroyed, you can attack and kill her by normal means. Note that even once she's live, the invading forces continue to attack the gods, so you'll have to keep them defended as well._

---

_Zarbak gives you details about how the task works:_
You say, 'Hail, Zarbak'
Zarbak says 'These streaks of light do you see? Rallos Zek and Solusek Ro light the paths of the enemy as they march from the south! If the gods stay concentrated, Zarbak thinks we can know where to place [defenses]!'
You say, 'Defenses?'
Zarbak says 'A thick, strong head have you, not like Zarbak! You must tell army where to defend. Keep enemy from reaching gods and distracting them. I will tell you [how].'
You say, 'How?'
Zarbak says 'Zek army don't trust outsider like you. They won't take orders unless you pay them. I put moneys in this chest. Take it and talk to quartermaster. He assigns you [troops] for moneys.'
You say, 'What about the troops?'
Zarbak says 'Stand where you want troops to stand, and call the ones you hired. They will hold strong at that spot. If they die, [pay] for more. [Fend off] the enemies, and kill the Herald of Oratory!'
You say, 'Pay for more?'
Zarbak says 'Rotten thieving enemies sneaked in camp at night and stole our moneys! Kill them and retrieve it! Pleased would be the quartermaster!'
You say, 'We'll fend off the enemies'
Zarbak says 'Speak with the quartermaster, and place your defenses. Once you do this, tell me you are ready to [begin]. If you believe you failed your task, you should [try again]. Don't even think to [leave] like a coward!'

_A chest called "chest of the gods" is found by the zone-in and contains numerous "Marks of the Gods". You can use the marks to purchase soldiers from the Quartermaster. Simply say the number of the soldier type you'd like to use:_
You say, '7'
Quartermaster Gelblat says 'You have chosen well!'
_You receive an item which you can right-click to summon that soldier type. The soldier will be permanently rooted in place and will defend its position according to the type as listed above._
_You'll want to have several soldiers positioned around the two gods, as well as several attack soldiers positioned in the valley below, as this is where the Herald will position herself._
_Place the soldiers as you wish and then say "begin" to Zarbak to initiate the event:_
You say, 'We're ready to begin'
Zarbak shouts 'Everyone to their positions! The enemy will be upon us quickly!'
Lower your weapons and surrender! You will be taken under control of Erillion, unharmed!
Rallos Zek says 'Mortals, you must destroy the Herald! It commands these hordes. If you kill it, its army will retreat.'
Solusek Ro says 'Position our troops around the Herald. With concentrated effort, the troops can destroy the Herald's shield and render it vulnerable.'
The full power of Erillion will bear down upon those who threaten to sunder our unification!
_As Erillion forces reach the gods, you'll see emotes like this:_
an Erillian footsoldier reaches the gods and drops their concentration to 190 of 200.
_If it reaches zero from 200, the task resets:_
You have failed to defend Rallos Zek and Solusek Ro.
_As the army forces kill off Erillion invaders, you'll see emotes like this:_
You have defeated 10 enemy units.
_Any time a soldier kills a member of the Erillion invaders, a chest spawns in its place. Loot the chest for more Marks and use those to buy and place additional soldiers._
_Soon after the event has been started, the Herald of Oratory makes her way into the valley and positions herself in about the center area. Once she's positioned, you'll see this emote:_
You interfere with an internal matter. What happens in our land concerns you not.
_Once the soldiers have done enough collective damage to her, her shield will be destroyed:_
Herald of Oratory's shield has been destroyed.
_At this point, you can move in and kill her. She has about 5 million hitpoints, so if you don't have the DPS to kill it fast enough, you'll need to make sure the gods remain defended as invaders continue to attack them._
Herald of Oratory has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Herald of Oratory shouts 'My body's demise is not the end. The Orator shall decimate every one of you!'
_Open the chest to complete the task:_
You have driven back Erillion's forces and defeated the Herald of Oratory.
You say, 'Hail, Zarbak'
Zarbak says 'Powerful was that [Herald]! What great strength must lie on this continent! Fear swells in Zarbak! We should [leave] from here and return to safer lands!'
You say, 'What about that herald?'
Zarbak says 'Zarbak hears the name of the Orator whispered on lips. He must be powerful that an entire valley trembles at his name!'
_Rewards:_

You say, 'Hail, Falthen Berros'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'Greetings! Come on in. We have rooms available, if you are looking for a place to stay. If you want [information], well, I can help you out there too. I hope you don't run into any [trouble] out there. Oh, and if you need me to hold onto your things, just ask! I have a lockbox for customers and travelers alike.'
You say, 'What information?'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'Certainly, my friend. Just ask about [Sarith] or anyone in town, and I'll tell you what I know.'
You say, 'Tell me about Sarith'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'The wonderful city state of Sarith, exporting the treasures of the ocean, friend to tourists and travelers from Erillion and Argath alike. Or, that's how it used to be. Our little ocean paradise was stripped from us not too long ago when [Vyers], [Archon Eries], and the rest of the [Orator]'s Erillion forces took our city. I hope one day to see it return to its former glory, and the City of Bronze become a trading partner instead of an invading force once again.'
You say, 'Who is Vyers?'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'High Priest Vyers. The vessel of [Oseka], the cause of trouble in all the ocean with that Prexus fellow, and the occupier of my city along with that horrid [Archon Eries]. High Priest Vyers controls the Archon, and through ali the Orator's City of Bronze soldiers in Sarith. I don't have much good to say about ali, but I can tell you a secret. Before all this divine vessel business, Vyers Rinad was a sea-faring explorer, treasure hunter, and part-time pirate. I knew ali back then. I never thought al'd turn into a monster like this, though.'
You say, 'What about Oseka?'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'Oseka is the God of the Tides and watches over the ocean, and [Sarith]. Or so the legends say. [High Priest Vyers] claims to be a vessel for Oseka, and commands powerful magical powers. Seen that structure out in the ocean? That's the Temple to Oseka, Rubak Oseka. There is a god-like creature I've heard called Prexus attacking Rubak Oseka and Oseka's Chosen creatures, the Hadal, at that location. I'd stay out of the ocean.'
You say, 'Archon Eries?'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'A fearsome, terrifying Archon serving under [High Priest Vyers] under the [Orator]'s orders. Al is one of the greatest warriors from the City of Bronze. Just alis gaze drives my blood cold. That's the look of someone who long ago got used to killing.'
You say, 'The Orator?'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'The Orator, the reason for the current state of [Sarith]. Out of Erillion, the City of Bronze, the Orator and alis high priests, including [High Priest Vyers] who led the attack here, have started conquering land, capturing and killing people. I can't say for sure what this is all about, but I've heard rumors about something regarding the old gods. A clash of the gods, maybe? Not something a normal, respectable businessman like myself wants to get involved in. I'm more focused on [Sarith] at the moment.'
You say, 'What about this trouble?'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'A lot of people in Sarith nowadays have nothing but problems, \_\_\_\_\_. Say, you can handle yourself pretty well, or so I hear. Would you mind helping out a few of my friends? Something to think about. I can definitely find a way to scrape together a reward for you. Just chat me up if you're interested.'
You have been assigned the task 'Systematic Oppression'.
Falthen Berros has asked you to help the citizens of Sarith facing oppression from the City of Bronze occupiers.

---

Converse with Falthen Berros 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Falthen Berros'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'I appreciate your willingness to help with this. I know this isn't your city, and these people aren't your problem, but if you could find it in your heart to help us, it'd mean a lot. The invasion may be over, but our suffering surely isn't. I've been hearing a few tales of people who could use a hand. I'll gladly pay you what I can. Tayron, a local fisherman, has his family threatened by a few City of Bronze thugs who they accidently bumped into. Stires, a trader, is missing a few family heirlooms. Weken, a cartographer, is missing alir sibling. If you could maybe just talk to them, and see if you could do something?'
_This opens up the three "Talk to..." steps below. Talking with the given NPCs opens up small side quests with them (the remaining steps, separated in sections below)._

---

Talk to Fisherman Tayron in the residential area 0/1 (Sarith)
_Fisherman Tayron is found in the south-central part of the zone at -695, 130, -22._
You say, 'Hail, Fisherman Tayron'
Fisherman Tayron says, in Alaran, 'Sorry, I can't really talk right now, I have to think of a plan. Hm? Oh, you talked to Falthen? It's worse now. They are holding my family captive, and are demanding money I do not have! I don't know what I'm going to do now. Oh, if someone would just save them!'
Defeat the hostage takers at Tayron's residence 0/2 (Sarith)
_The hostage takers can be found inside the nearby building._
Talk to the freed hostages 0/1 (Sarith)
a hostage family member says, in Alaran, 'Thank you so much! You saved us!'
Return to Fisherman Tayron 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Fisherman Tayron'
Fisherman Tayron says, in Alaran, 'Bless you, you have no idea how happy I am now! I'm going home right away. Thank you, thank you!'

---

Talk to Merchant Stires at the tavern 0/1 (Sarith)
_Merchant Stires is found in a building in the central part of the city (-290, -160, -4)._
You say, 'Hail, Merchant Stires'
Merchant Stires says, in Alaran, 'My story? I may be alive, but I've lost everything I've worked my entire life for. Worse, all my family heirlooms are missing. Those are all that I have left of my parents. And now they were looted, stolen, and confiscated! Could you retrieve them? You should find them in the residential area, either taken by accident, or looted by City of Bronze thugs and kept in occupied houses.'
Collect Merchant Stires' heirlooms from the houses in the southwest section of the city 0/2 (Sarith)
_These spawn on tables inside the buildings around the hostage taker's area._
Return the heirlooms to Merchant Stires 0/1 (Sarith)

---

Talk to Cartographer Weken at the inn 0/1 (Sarith)
_Cartographer Weken is found in the same room as Falthen._
You say, 'Hail, Cartographer Weken'
Cartographer Weken says, in Alaran, 'I could use a drink. My sibling is missing. Reqin. I lost track of ali during the attack. I'll never forgive myself. I've checked everywhere that I can think of inside the city. I don't know what I'll do if I find ali and al has passed away.'
Locate Cartographer Weken's missing sibling Reqin 0/1 (Sarith)
_Reqin is located outside the city gates, far west from the front gate at location 290, 700, -3._
You say, 'Hail, Reqin'
Reqin says, in Alaran, 'Who are you? Leave me alone! Oh, Weken sent you? What does al want? I'm busy hiding from the City of Bronze. I'm way too scared to go back inside. You can tell ali I'm okay, though.'
Return to Cartographer Weken 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Cartographer Weken'
Cartographer Weken says, in Alaran, 'I'm so glad to hear al is alive! Hiding outside the city, you say? Well, it may have been safer at the time! I think I will go tell ali it is time to come home, though.'

---

Inform Falthen that you've taken care of the citizens 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Falthen Berros'
Falthen Berros says, in Alaran, 'It warms my heart to see you help those people. \_\_\_\_\_, you are alright in my book. You are welcome anytime.'
You've saved a number of innocent Sarith citizens, and earned the gratitude of the city.

_This is a solo task that begins with Commander Marrien Kavus in Sarith (in the far northeastern part of the city at about 145, -845, -4)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 70 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Commander Marrien Kavus'
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, '\_\_\_\_\_! I hope to you're here to help. If you're just here to ask questions, you're better off talking to my sibling, Ain. Al's got all the answers. I'm more into [acting] than talking.'
You say, 'Acting?'
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'That's what I'm talking about! There are a number of traitors that we need to deal with.'
You have been assigned the task 'Unforgivable Betrayal'.
Marrien Kavus needs your help in eliminating the traitors who have sided with the Orator's forces. Guard Captain Reles can provide you with information about where to look.

---

Receive instructions from Commander Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Commander Marrien Kavus'
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'When the City of Bronze attacked, we didn't stand much of a chance. My sibling can give you more of the gory details. However, what made it worse are the people who betrayed us. I'm not just talking about those who followed Vyers after the occupation. I mean people who betrayed us while the fight was still going on. I want you to investigate a few areas and a few people. I have my suspicions, but I don't want to jump to conclusions. Here, take this list. Take notes. I want you to find the traitors, if you can.'
Question Guard Captain Naraind Reles in their office 0/1 (Sarith)
_The captain is found in the northwestern building (location 10, 620, 0)._
You say, 'Hail, Guard Captain Naraind Reles'
Guard Captain Naraind Reles says, in Alaran, 'I see. Marrien has you looking into some of the problems we faced during the invasion? I can think of a few things that stand out. One: A number of our lookouts were assassinated, caught off guard. Very unusual. I suspect Lieutenant Arulien, as al is missing alir issued sword and has no alibi for alir location at the time, but have no proof. Two: We had a large rate of magical failure among our tidalmages and tide priests by the docks. Something went wrong there. Three: It seemed like many of our moves were anticipated, including our city park ambush. Riago Barthes is a genius, certainly, but al's not a mind reader. Someone leaked information to the enemy. Investigate these areas and people, and you may find the answers. I would help myself, but Eries keeps me under close watch. Good luck.'
_This opens up the three sections below (each working essentially like a sub-task)._

---

Investigate the docked ships 0/1 (Sarith)
_This updates along the east side of the zone._
Look for a counter-magic spell scroll on one of the docked ships 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ You found part of a counter-magic scroll. Look for the rest.
_Counter Magic Scroll is at /waypoint -180, -704, -6 (on the railing of a small ship -- eastern dock on northwest side of the middle boat)._
Hunt down Tidalmage Karith 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ Confront the tidalmage who commanded the dock forces, Karith.
_Tidalmage Karith is found in the far southern part of the dock area (around -710, -100). He is no more challenging than your average trash mob._
Tidalmage Karith has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Tidalmage Karith falls backwards, clutching their wounds. 'No! This wasn't supposed to happen! Riago promised I'd be safe if I helped.' Karith lets out a death rattle and topples backwards.

---

Investigate the city park 0/1 (Sarith)
_This updates in the southwest part of the zone._
Search the area around the park fountain for a discarded notebook 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ You found part of a map drawn in a book. Check the area around the city park fountain for the book.
_Marinsi's Notebook is at -517, 484, -6 (just west of the fountain on the grass between two plants)._
Hunt down Tide Priest Marinsi 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ Inside the book was a hidden missive as well. The culprit is Tide Priest Marinsi.
_Tide Priest Marinsi overlooks the residences in the southern part of the zone. He's found at about -625, 315 (average trash mob difficulty)._
Tide Priest Marinsi has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Tide Priest Marinsi coughs up some blood and wipes their mouth. 'So, are you really that short sighted? I did what I had to do. Oseka has returned, and I will not deny my true god. Oseka will protect me.' Myrinsi tries to stand, and fails, collapsing to the ground in a bloody heap.

---

Search Lieutenant Arulien's room in the barracks 0/1 (Sarith)
_Enter the building located northeast of Guard Captain Reles' building. Arulien's room is the first room on the right._
Search the waterfall pool for a discarded weapon 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ You found a note in Arulien's journal indicating the lookout's positions. They were mostly stationed around the waterfall. Check around there for Arulien's service weapon.
_Arulien's Broken Sword is at 907, -80, -13 (behind the waterfall north of the city's main gate)._
Hunt down Lieutenant Arulien 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ You've found the sword used to kill the lookouts. Confront Arulien.
_Lieutenant Arulien is found on the top side of the bridge, around -325, 25, 23. This fight is no more challenging than a trash mob._
Lieutenant Arulien has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Lieutenant Arulien falls to one knee, bleeding heavily. 'So you figured it out? How? I don't care. I'd go it again! The City of Bronze is going to conquer everything, and I want to be on the winning side!' The Alaran tries to remain steady, but falls to the ground, unmoving.

---

Deliver the counter-magic scroll evidence to Commander Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Karith betrayed us? Heh, I guess I should not be surprised. Al was very ambitious. Dangerously so. This explains why the magic of the tides so often failed when cast by our mages ahd priests. Karith paid today for all their deaths.'
Deliver the discarded notebook evidence to Commander Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Marinsi had been acting odd ever since news of the Orator from the City of Bronze reached our ears. It should not surprise me that al gave intelligence on our defensive efforts to the invading 'holy' army. I cannot forgive this. Thank you for taking care of Marinsi.'
Deliver the missing weapon evidence to Commander Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'I was afraid of this. I neven trusted ali. So shifty, so paranoid. When I saw ali disappear during the attack, I knew al was up to no good. Arulien got what he deserved for killing alir fellow guards and giving the City of Bronze a clear opening to the city.'
Talk to Commander Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ Tidalmage Karith was responsible for the spell failures. Tide Priest Marinsi was responsible for the leaked intelligence. Lieutenant Arulien was responsible for the murdered scouts.
You say, 'Hail, Commander Marrien Kavus'
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Thanks again for all your help. These three were responsible for a lot of innocent people's deaths when High Priest Vvers and Archon Eries attacked. Who knows whot further damage they could have done if they had been left alone.'
You've defeated the traitors who betrayed their own people and sold out Sarith to the City of Bronze. Marrien feels their people have been avenged, and Captain Reles appreciates your contribution to Sarith.
_Rewards:_
246 platinum
Eltarki's Diary - Time and Tides

_This task is the first in a series of three; a solo task that begins with Governor Parrin Wenst in Sarith. He's found in a building at location -600, -685, 4 (the northern room of the large building in the far southwestern part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 70 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Governor Parrin Wenst'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'Oh, hello there, \_\_\_\_\_. I'm always glad to see another of you outsiders here. It gives me hope. I'm not ashamed to say that [Sarith] needs your [help]. Once we get the more pressing matters settled, we'll be ready for a big [mission] that I hope you will be a part of. I will do everything in my power to see that you are rewarded for your efforts.'
You say, 'Sarith?'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'I was proud to serve as this city's Governor. Sarith is the greatest city state in the region, with a robust export of ocean commodities. Well, that's how it used to be. Now [Guard Captain Reles] and I are just the puppets of [High Priest Vyers] and [Archon Eries].'
You say, 'Who is Guard Captain Reles?'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'Guard Captain Reles is the only thing keeping [Sarith] together. I know al's frustrated being under [Archon Eries]' control, but I keep telling ali to be patient. The people need ali. If al were to be killed, what little al can do in delaying or preventing the suffering of [Sarith]'s people will be destroyed.'
You say, 'Who is Archon Eries?'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'A frightening person. For your own safety, please do not make ali angry. Al took this city in mere days. It was horrific.'
You say, 'Tell me about High Priest Vyers'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'High Priest Vyers is a very intimidating fellow. If al truly is powered by [Oseka], do we have any chance to win? That other god-creature, Prexus, will destroy this city trying to get at ali. We'll be caught in the middle.'
You say, 'Oseka?'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'Oseka, Prexus. All these ocean gods are going to destroy my city! Is this what it is all about? A god-war? When the Orator took over the City of Bronze, I knew things were going to get worse!'
You say, 'I'll help you'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'Ah, yes! I'm so glad to hear you say that. It just so happens [Guard Captain Reles] and I were planning something. Well, it was mostly alis idea, but I'm doing what I can to help. Please go speak to ali to find out what you need to do. I'll send a messenger along so al will be expecting you.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Governor's Plot'.
Sabotage the efforts of the Orator's army by working with Governor Wenst and Guard Captain Reles.

---

Speak with Governor Parrin Wenst 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Governor Parrin Wenst'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'You have no idea how happy I am to hear that you want to help! I believe the Guard Captain and the rebels are formulating a plan to take back the city before the one called Prexus and his Kedge destroy it. Please, go speak to the Guard Captain. I'll be sending a messenger along with information vital to the success of their mission, and telling the Guard Captain to expect you.'
Report to Guard Captain Naraind Reles 0/1 (Sarith)
_The captain is found in the northwestern building (location 10, 620, 0)._
You say, 'Hail, Guard Captain Naraind Reles'
Guard Captain Naraind Reles says, in Alaran, 'The Governor's aide arrived shortly before you. This mission is the start of something big, and I personally want to thank you, as an outsider, for helping our city state. I want to get this taken care of before Prexus destroys our home. I know he's after High Priest Vyers, and to get to Vyers, we need to take out the City of Bronze military. For the rebels to have a chance, you'll need to take their equipment and give it to their leader, Ain Kavus. Find the quartermaster, defeat ali, and take what you need. I have good intelligence suggesting the quartermaster has an important missive from Archon Eries aleself. If you find anything like that, give it to Ain Kavus as well, at the drydock.'
Defeat Orator's army troops 0/8 (Sarith)
Collect City of Bronze equipment chests from the Orator's army 0/4 (Sarith)
Defeat the Orator's army quartermaster, Gilles near the barracks 0/1 (Sarith)
Take Archon Eries' plans from Quartermaster Gilles 0/1 (Sarith)
_Quartermaster Gilles spawns in a building just west of the city's front gate (once inside, head right; he's in the first building on your right). He drops one_
Deliver equipment to Rebel Leader Ain Kavus at the drydock 0/4 (Sarith)
Give Archon Eries' documents to Rebel Leader Ain Kavus at the drydock 0/1 (Sarith)
_The Rebel Leader is in the far northeastern part of the city at about 145, -845, -4)._
Talk to Rebel Leader Ain Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Rebel Leader Ain Kavus'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'This equipment could be the catalyst that changes this entire fight, and these plans contain all the information we could have hoped for. You've been a great help. Let the Governor know we appreciate alis help as well.'
Report to Governor Parrin Wenst at the City Hall 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Governor Parrin Wenst'
Governor Parrin Wenst says, in Alaran, 'I'm so relieved to hear things went through without a hitch. I, Captain Reles, the rebels, and all of Sarith owe you a debt of gratitude. I will make sure you are rewarded properly for your efforts. If you would be willing, we'd like your help with the next phase of this operation. Please speak to Ain Kavus at the drydock, whom you've met. Let Ain know you want to help.'
You've set the Orator's army back, assisted the citizens of Sarith, and weakened the control Archon Eries has over the city. The rebel leader Ain Kavus is said to be preparing the next strike against Archon Eries and High Priest Vyers if you'd wish to assist further.
_Rewards:_
273 platinum, 3 gold, 3 silver, 4 copper
Experience

This task is the second in a series of three; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Rebel Leader Ain Kavus [npc=38383] in Sarith (found in the far northeastern part of the city at about /way +145,-845,-4).
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
\- Completion of The Governor's Plot [quest=5434]
\- 70 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Rebel Leader Ain Kavus'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Good to see you, \_\_\_\_\_. How are you liking [Sarith]? Or what's left of it. That idiot [Vyers] and that butcher [Archon Eries] have destroyed this once-beautiful city state. And me and others are here to put a stop to it. I won't lie, we're outnumbered and underpowered. We aren't above taking help from you travelers that have been showing up lately. Care to [lend a hand]? Once we've gotten everything set up, we'll be ready for the big [operation].'
You say, 'Sarith?'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'We used to do a lot of exporting of seafood and other goods from the ocean. Now we're just a pawn of the City of Bronze, Erillion, in the [Orator]'s army. A lot of the guards have joined the [Orator], but some of us are resisting, and some of the citizens are on our side.'
You say, 'The Orator?'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'I hate the Orator. Once we've taken back [Sarith], I'll do anything to kill this fool. Talking about the old gods? Turning the City of Bronze into fanatics? How is this going to help anyone?'
You say, 'Who is Archon Eries?'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Archon Eries' loyalty, bravery, and skill are nearly impossible to match. If I didn't hate ali so much for destroying my city, I'd admire ali. Al took [Sarith] in days, paving the way for [Vyers]' take-over.'
You say, 'Who is Vyers?'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'The so-called High Priest of the Tides? [Oseka]'s little prophet? Vyers is an ass. I don't care what magical powers al thinks al has, al's no deity. The Hadal, the race that inhabits Rubak Oseka, may think differently. But that's not the first time I've ignored them.'
You say, 'What about Oseka?'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Oseka is the God of the Tides, and is supposed to watch over the ocean. [High Priest Vyers] claims to be a vessel for Oseka, and wields some rather potent magical powers. What's more, you can see the Temple to Oseka, Rubak Oseka, out in the ocean not too far out. The god-creature you foreigners call Prexus is launching an attack there, but it seems things are at a standstill.'
You say, 'I'll lend a hand'
_Without pre-requisites:_
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'Great! I actually don't have anything for you right now, though. But I was told to let you know that [Governor Wenst] is planning something big with Captain Reles. Please go see the Governor in his office in City Hall and see what al says.'
You say, 'Who is Governor Wenst?'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'The Captain thinks highly of the [Governor]. I trust ali if the Captain does. I'm not sure what good a politician is going to do at this stage, though.'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'We'll have to rely on the outsiders for help. These Erillion soldiers are too much. But that doesn't mean we won't do our best, right everyone?'
With pre-requisites:
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'I'm glad to hear it. Your help with the governor has been invaluable. Thanks to ali and the Captain, we have enough equipment to move forward, and we have an idea of the enemy's plans. The next step will be more dangerous. Let me know when you are ready for your briefing.'
You have been assigned the task 'Rescue Ranger'.
Rescue the captured rebels while preparing for a counter-attack against Archon Eries and High Priest Vyers.

---

1\. Receive a briefing from Rebel Leader Ain Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
2\. Report to Commander Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
Hail the above two mobs.
3\. Find the Sarith Prison 0/1 (Sarith)
_Task Window Says:_ Assault the prison and defeat any of the traitorous Sarith guards who get in your way.
The Sarith prison is due west from the drydock area, in the building southeast of Guard Captain Reles' building.
4\. Defeat Sarith guards 0/6 (Sarith)
5\. Defeat the Prison Warden Tuley 0/1 (Sarith)
6\. Rescue jailed Sarith rebels 0/6 (Sarith)
a Sarith rebel prisoner says, in Alaran, 'You're a true hero! i'm going to report to Marrien right now! I'll hide and sneak out. Good luck!'
7\. Rescue jailed Sarith citizens 0/6 (Sarith)
a Sarith prisoner says, in Alaran, 'Thank you so much! I didn't even do anything wrong!'
8\. Inform Commander Marrien Kavus of your results 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Commander Marrien Kavus'
Commander Marrien Kavus says, in Alaran, 'It's a shame that some of our own has turned against us, but I will not forgive them. They made thiir decision. I, on the other hand, will never let Vyers or Archon Eries push me around. Thanks again. My sibling wanted to speak to you.'
9\. Speak to Rebel Leader Ain Kavus 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Rebel Leader Ain Kavus'
Rebel Leader Ain Kavus says, in Alaran, 'You are quite amazing. With you on our side, getting our home back before Prexus destroys it is looking more like a realistic goal. We will scrape together whatever rewards we can for you as a token of appreciation.'
The rebels have been freed. Ain and Marrien are grateful for your help, and the second phase of the plan is complete. They told you that Guard Captain Reles is heading up the third part.

_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed The Governor's Plot

You say, 'Hail, Rebel Leader Ain Kavus'

That idiot [Vyers] and that butcher [Archon Eries] have destroyed this once-beautiful city state. And me and others are here to put a stop to it. I won't lie, we're outnumbered and underpowered. We aren't above taking help from you travelers that have been showing up lately. Care to [lend a hand]? Once we've gotten everything set up, we'll be ready for the big [operation].'

_This is a group mission that begins with Governor Parrin Wenst in Sarith. He's found in a building at location -600, -685, 4 (the northern room of the large building in the far southwestern part of the zone)._

Once we get the more pressing matters settled, we'll be ready for a big [mission] that I hope you will be a part of. I will do everything in my power to see that you are rewarded for your efforts.'

_The Tide Oracle hits for a max ~12,000._
_Once the above mobs are dead, hail Vyers again._
Challenge High Priest Vyers again 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, High Priest Vyers Rinad'
Vyers says, 'I underestimated you. Very well. But I have that fool Prexus just where I want him. I will not let you weaklings be the thing that ultimately gets in my way! Stay away from Rubak Oseka, if you value your pathetic life.'
Guard Captain Reles shouts, 'The High Priest has left for Rubak Oseka to deal with Prexus! We'll take care of things here, you go on ahead!'
Chase High Priest Vyers to the outskirts of Rubak Oseka 0/1 (Sarith)
_You'll now find him on the spiral of Rubak Oseka (in the water to the east). Hail him to spawn three named sharks around the spiral._
You say, 'Hail, High Priest Vyers Rinad'
High Priest Vyers Rinad says, in Alaran, 'Can you not take a hint that you are not wanted here? I'd take care of you myself, but I have to deal with Prexus right now. Why don't I summon some playmates for you instead? Three legendary ocean terrors, all under my control. Nhron the Sea-Eater, Leveth the Shark King, and Desalin the Sea Terror. Have fun.'
Defeat the giant sea monsters summoned by Vyers 0/3 (Sarith)
_These named sharks hit for a max ~12,000. As you kill one, Vyers transfers its power to the remaining sharks:_
Vyers has transferred the essence of the dead sea beast to the remaining creatures!
_Note: Leveth the Shark King may spawn two shark adds (hit for a max ~10,000 each). Leveth also has two spells (one of which, a buff):_
Shark King's Presence: Self 0', Unresistable (-650)
1: Increase AC by 300
2: Increase Attack Speed by 25%
3: Increase ATK by 50
4: Increase Chance to Dodge by 50%
5: Increase Accuracy by 25%
Swallow: Single Target, (0)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 14000 per tick
2: Stun (1.50 sec)
_Once all sharks are dead, hail Vyers again, at which point he'll attack._
Confront High Priest Vyers 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, High Priest Vyers Rinad'
High Priest Vyers Rinad glares at you. 'I suppose this showdown was inevitable. You may be great at what you do, but with the power of Oseka and the power of Cazic-Thule, I think you'll find that I am a little bit more than you can handle!' The High Priest has teleported to the top of Rubak Oseka!
Defeat High Priest Vyers 0/1 (Sarith)
_Vyers hits for a max ~12,500. He summons 2x "a Hadal warrior" to help him, as well as clones of himself at 25% health and under._
High Priest Vyers raises their hands. 'Waters of Oseka, come forth!' Vyers vanishes in a flash of light, appearing at the top of Rubak Oseka, leaving behind a pool of water that slowly forms into a clone of the High Priest!
_He also casts a few spells:_
Flood: Unknown(32) 100', Cold (-910)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 20000
Oseka's Lifeforce: Group v1 250', Magic (-910)
1: Increase Hitpoints by 100000
Tidal Pull: Single Target, Cold (-910)
1: Root
_Note: Adds don't despawn._
Report the results of your confrontation to Reles 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Guard Captain Naraind Reles'
Guard Captain Naraind Reles says, in Alaran, 'You've helped our city so much. I don't know what we would heve done without your aid. I have a feeling that isn't over for you, however. If you're going into Rubak Oseka to stop Oseka from using this thing you call a Cazic-Thule, we wish you the best of luck. You will always be welcome in Sarith. It'll take us some time to clean out the rest of the City of Bronze soldiers and others that serve the Orator, but now it's no longer an impossibility.'
Retrieve your reward from the equipment chest 0/1 (Sarith)

_This task begins with Braxi Keeper Yubai in the Beasts' Domain, located at -850, -95, -6 (southeastern part of the upper-third of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Braxi Keeper Yubai'
Braxi Keeper Yubai says, in Alaran, 'What do you want, outsider? Your influence on the wilderness worries me. In fact, I think you and your kind are to blame for the braxi becoming [sick].'
You say, 'Sick?'
Braxi Keeper Yubai says, in Alaran, 'Some of the braxi in the wilderness have become ill, and I am unable to investigate further, but I think it has something to do with the arrival of your kind. If the sickness continues to spread, we will have no braxi to tame as mounts. As this is most likely your fault, you will [investigate] the illness, or you can leave and stay out of my sight.'
You say, 'I'll investigate'
Braxi Keeper Yubai says, in Alaran, 'Find one of the sick braxi and after you have slain it, take its stomach. Perhaps we can see if it is something they have been eating that is making them ill.'
You have been assigned the task 'Braxi Trouble'.
Something in the wilderness is making the braxi ill. Braxi Keeper Yubai blames outsiders for the sickness. You have agreed to track down the true cause.
Obtain a braxi stomach from a sick braxi.

---

Obtain a Braxi Stomach from a sick braxi 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_"a sick braxi" is found mostly in the south-southwestern area of the zone's upper-third. It drops the stomach very commonly (if not 100%)._
Deliver the Braxi Stomach to Braxi Keeper Yubai 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Braxi Keeper Yubai takes the stomach from you and slices it open. A nauseating stench overcomes you as bits of undigested plant matter pour from the stomach. Yubai takes some of the plany matter and sniffs it. 'I do not recognize this plant. It is foreign to me. Your kind must have introduced this plant species to our wilderness. I was right to cast judgement upon you. The spread of this foreign plant must be stopped. We will need to make some [weed killer]. Also, if you happen to lose your mortar and pestle, just let me know, and I can [give] you a new one.'
Collect a Binaesa Venom Sac 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Collect a Wyvern Scent Gland 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Collect a Sample of Selyrah Saliva 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Collect a Filthy Ape Liver 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Task Window Says:_ It appears that a plant, foreign to the wilderness has been introduced to the ecosystem and is making the braxi sick. You recognize this plant from Antonica. It is a common weed known as Bristlepoint. Yubai has asked you to collect a binaesa venom sac, wyvern scent gland, a sample of selyrah saliva, and a filthy ape liver.
_The above four items are common drops from the said mob types (all found throughout the upper half of the zone), and may be looted ahead of time._
Use the mortar and pestle and create the weedkiller 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_NOTE: This combine must be performed in the Beasts' Domain. This step will not update if you do it in any other zone._
_Combine the four items in the container to produce 4x "Weedkiller"._
Give a dose of the weed killer to a wilting bristlepoint weed 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Found at -3161, +316.
Give a dose of the weed killer to a poisonous bristlepoint weed 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Found at -2551, -422.
Give a dose of the weed killer to a foul bristlepoint weed 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Found at -2996, -426.
Give a dose of the weed killer to a deadly bristlepoint weed 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Found at -3049, -108.
The weeds appear as flowers on the floor of the zone (known to spawn in the zone's upper and middle sections). Their spawn table seems to be random, so just roam around until you've come across and handed the Weedkiller into all four types.
Speak with Braxi Keeper Yubai 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Braxi Keeper Yubai'
Braxi Keeper Yubai says, in Alaran, 'Perhaps I can forgive you and your kind for what has happened. Thank you. I was planning on trading this to the Domain clan for some supplies, but I think you should have it for helping.'
_Rewards:_
273 platinum
Experience - 18% to 19% in level 97
Eltarki's Diary - Beasts Know More
- Eltarki's Diary - Beasts Know More [item=99366]

_This task is the first in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Mea Treg in the Beasts' Domain, located at 315, 2800, 10 (far northwestern part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Mea Treg'
Mea Treg nods to acknowledge your presence, 'I see you there. Why is it that your people need to be acknowledged so often? You should come to me with something specific to say, or not come to me at all. If you need something of me, tell me. If I need something of you, I will tell you, if you are [willing].'
You say, 'I'm willing'
Mea Treg looks at you questioningly, 'So you say. Well then, we need food. My people don't eat your food. It has been known to make us ill. We need food from out there.' Mea points out into the forest. 'If you want to help us, go out there and gather some for us. This is no simple thing. The Domain is deadly, and you don't know our ways. If you return, I will be surprised.'
You have been assigned the task 'Beasts for the Stew'.
Gather some food for Mea's tribe and beware of any domain hunters that may be hunting nearby.

---

Hunt the creature of Beasts' Domain and collect some carcasses 0/4 (Beasts' Domain)
_These are dropped by the animal creatures of the Beasts' Domain, and are prelootable._
Defeat any domain hunters that stand in your way! 0/4 (Beasts' Domain)
_Kill any four "a domain hunter" (found throughout the northern part of the zone). Note: While the animals can be safely kited, the domain hunters summon when damaged._
Collect some Windberries from the jungle floor 0/6 (Beasts' Domain)
Collect some Bloodbeets from the jungle floor 0/6 (Beasts' Domain)
_The above items are ground spawns throughout the northwestern and north-central part of the zone (appear as small green and small red items on the ground)._
Deliver the carcasses to Mea Treg 0/4 (Beasts' Domain)
Deliver the Windberries to Mea Treg 0/6 (Beasts' Domain)
Deliver the Bloodbeets to Mea Treg 0/6 (Beasts' Domain)
( _There is no turn-in dialogue._)

246 platinum
Eltarki's Diary - Beasts Know More
_NOTE: Druids also receive their Beasts' Domain port spell set._

_This is task is the second in a series of five; it's a shared task that can be obtained solo. It begins with Mea Treg in the Beasts' Domain, located at 315, 2800, 10 (far northwestern part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Beasts for the Stew"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Mea Treg'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'You are not weak. I will consider trusting you. I need you to [find] a Domain clansman for me. His name is Kar, and he could be anywhere in the jungle.'
You say, 'I'll find him!'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'Find Kar and ask him about the razor teeth and the stone skull. I need to know about these things, and he is the one best suited to provide the answers I need.'
You have been assigned the task 'A Question of Intergrity'.
Mea Treg has asked you to seek out Kar of the Domain Clan and ask about the razor teeth and stone skull. You are unsure why you are to ask him this. Is this perhaps some sort of test?

---

Speak with Kar 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Find Kar of the Domain Clan at about -2900, 2600, -7 (southwestern part of the zone's middle section)._
You say, 'Hail, Kar of the Domain Clan'
Kar of the Domain Clan says, in Alaran, 'Have you come to tease me about the wyvern sinking its teeth into my skull? Of course you have. I tire of this childish teasing. You're lucky I don't run my spear through your heart. I think however, that you can be of use to me. Make amends for your insult by bringing me the skull of a wyvern. Only a wyvern skull will do. Yes. Bring one to me.'
Loot a Wyvern Skull from a Wyvern 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_As you may have guessed, these drop from wyverns (known to drop off any mob in the zone with "wyvern" in its name)._
Give the Wyvern Skull to Kar 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Kar of the Domain Clan says, in Alaran, 'Something is in the bushes nearby. I think it is coming our way. I know that smell. That's Etani Treg.'
Etani Treg says, 'Such strange company you keep, Kar.'
Return to Mea Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)

205 platinum
