_This task is the third in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Mea Treg in the Beasts' Domain, located at 315, 2800, 10 (far northwestern part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Beasts for the Stew"
\- Completion of "A Question of Integrity"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Mea Treg'
Mea Treg glares it you. 'Always meaningless greetings from you. You have proven yourself brave enough, it seems. I don't know that your values match mine or those of my people, but perhaps that doesn't matter, as long as you remain willing to [help] us.'
You say, 'I'll help'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'I have a favor to ask of you. My people can't or won't enter the forest again, and I need someone to carry a [message] for me.'
_You receive 3x "Message from Mea"._
You have been assigned the task 'Message of Faith'.
Mea disagrees with the religious views of the domain clan and subsequently decided to leave and form a new clan. Mea has asked you to deliver a message to some Elders of the Domain clan to perhaps persuade them to change their views.
You say, 'What about this message?'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'I believe that the way our people worship Kolos is wrong. I don't think that we reed to be beasts in order to show our faith. We have become feral monsters, and such monsters have no ability to worship what they are. In order to be able to worship something, you have to be separate from that thing. Somehow we need to make them understand this. I need you to deliver some messages for me.'

---

Deliver Mea's message to Elder Giaborn of the Domain clan 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_The three elders are found in the eastern part of the upper section of the zone, in a camp of hunters at about -45, -380. Be advised there are several KOS NPCs in their proximity._
Elder Giaborn says, in Alaran, 'I have no need for Mea's rhetoric. Begone, outsider.'
Deliver Mea's message to Elder Hilnaah of the Domain clan 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Elder Hilnaah says, in Alaran, 'Mea is a traitor to the Domain clan. I will not be swayed by her ramblings.'
Deliver Mea's message to Elder Poanag of the Domain clan 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Elder Poanag says, in Alaran, 'What does Mea know about Kolos? She is a traitor and a blasphemer.'
Speak with Etani Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'Why to you preach Mea's religion to a people you do not know? Who are you to say that the ways of the Domain clan are wrong? You should not judge my people until you have lived the life of the clan. You should try to live for a day or two in the forest. Let us just see how you can survive. Collect enough windberries and beast flesh to survive on for one day. Next gather enough materials to build a shelter. I will not ask you to build the shelter; just bring the materials back to me.'
_This opens up the next four steps:_
Collect Windberries from the forest floor 0/5 (Beasts' Domain)
Kill the beasts of the forest and scavenge some of their flesh 0/4 (Beasts' Domain)
Collect some Giant Leafs from the forest floor 0/3 (Beasts' Domain)
Collect some Bamboo Chutes from the forest floor 0/3 (Beasts' Domain)
_Task Window Says:_ Collect enough Windberries Beast Flesh _(sic)_ to survive on for one day. The Windberries grow on the forest floor. Etani Treg would also like you to collect some Large Leafs and Bamboo Chutes from the forest floor to prove that you can gather adequate materials to build a shelter.
_As in the previous task, windberries are known to spawn throughout the northern part of the zone (ground spawn). The "kill" step updates randomly as you kill creatures in the zone (there are no items involved). The Giant Leafs and Bamboo Chutes are ground spawns found throughout the northern part of the zone._
Give the Palm Fronds to Etani Treg 0/3 (Beasts's Domain)
Give the Bamboo Chutes to Etani Treg 0/3 (Beasts's Domain)
Speak with Etani Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'Perhaps you are not as ignorant of the ways of the forest as I thought you were. However, my people and I will not adopt Mea's religious views.'
Speak with Mea Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Mea Treg'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'It is as I thought. They are too ignorant and beast-like to listen to reason.'
_Rewards:_
Eltarki's Diary - Beasts Know More
273 platinum
Experience

_This task is the fourth in a series of five; a solo task that begins with Etani Treg in the Beasts' Domain, located at -170, -380, -10 (eastern part of upper section of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Beasts for the Stew"
\- Completion of "A Question of Integrity"
\- Completion of "Message of Faith"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'You have proven something to me, but not very much. At least you got here alive. But you haven't done enough. If you really want me to trust you, then you will have to. . . you will have to pass our trials, and you can't possibly survive them. It you are [willing to die], then at least you will die in the proper fashion.'
You say, 'I'm willing to die...'
Etani Treg looks surprised. 'You seem certain. That also makes you seem foolish. Very well. You are to seek out a vicious beast known as a ripclaw raptor and obtain its head. One of our hunters, Grall, also thought he was brave and decided go hunt for ripclaws. He never returned. If you find his spear, return it to me. Lastly, you are to hunt down the great dark ape and obtain its head. I shall burn a sprig of sweetleaf on your pyre, as I suspect you will not return to me.'
You have been assigned the task 'Trial of the Beast'.
Etani Treg has a trial for you to undertake before he fully trusts your capabilities.
Find a Ripclaw Raptor and obtain its head. Grall, a member of the Domain clan set off long ago to hunt the Ripclaw Raptors. He never returned. See if you can find his lost spear.

_This is a ground spawn in the middle of the raptor camp._

_This task is the fifth in a series of five; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Etani Treg in the Beasts' Domain, located at -168, -389 in the northeastern part of the zone._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Beasts for the Stew"
\- Completion of "A Question of Integrity"
\- Completion of "Message of Faith"
\- Completion of "Trial of the Beast"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'You return. Perheps tyat is yood. I need an agent that might be able to speak with other clan leaders. My own people would be attacked on sight. You cou d approach the others more easily. Will you [speak to them] on my behalf?'
You say, 'I'll speak to them'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'That is good. Here is what I need you to do for me. Bale is the youngest of the Domain clan leaders but al lacks the status to rule more than alis own small clan. I plan on making Bale my warleader. Al will need a proper symbol of that office though. There is a very old tradition among my people of granting a finely crafted warspear to all new warleaders. Make one and offer it to Bale. If you have [lost] your spear making kit, let me know, and I will give you another one.'
_You receive a 3-slot container called "Spear Making Kit"._
You have been assigned the task 'One To Lead Them'.
Etani Treg wishes to become the leader of all the clans in the Domain. To do so, Etani Treg needs the backing of the four most powerful clan leaders. You will need to convince them that having Etani Treg lead them to the control of the Domain is better than things as they are. Killing them will do nothing to help. If they are to be killed Etani Treg must do it aleself.
Obtain a Raptor Bone, a Strong Vine, and a Chunk of Obsidian. The apes might possess a strong vine, and the crocodiles have been known to swallow obsidian. Once you have these items, use the spear making kit to construct a Warleader's Spear. If you lose your Spear Making Kit, let Etani know you've lost it so Etani can give you a new one.

---

Assemble the Warleader's Spear 0/1 (ALL)
_Combine the Raptor Bone, the Strong Vine, and the Chunk of Obsidian to produce the Warleader's Spear._
Give the Warleader's Spear to Bale 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Bale is located in the southestern part of the upper-third of the zone (a little ways west of Braxi Keeper Yubai)._
Bale says, in Alaran, 'You saw this is from Etani Treg? Me be warbeeder of the Domain clan? Tell Etani Treg I accept!'
Tell Etani Treg that Bale has accepted the offer of warleader 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'Bale has accepted my offer? That is most fortunate. Next, you will be speaking to Yurv. Yurv is clever and will be difficult to sway. All the clans know of Mea's betrayal. I am willing to offer myself to Yurv. Yurv will require some serious proof of my willingness in the form of a dowry. Collect the items for the dowry and present it to Yurv. If you lose your dowry kit and [need] another one, let me know.'
_You receive "A Dowry Kit"._
Assemble a dowry for Yurv 0/1 (ALL)
_Task Window Says:_ Obtain two Clear Ocean Quartz, two Windberries, and two Bloodbeets. The quartz can be found on the ocean floor in Sarith, near the temple of Rubak Oseka. The Windberries and Bloodbeets grow on the wildness floor of the Beasts' Domain.
_Combine the items to create "Dowry for Yurv"._
Give the dowry to Yurv 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Yurv is located at -1065, 1010, 25 (in the south-central part of the upper-third of the zone)._
Yurv says, in Alaran, 'Etani Treg is a clever one. Tell Etani Treg that I accept alis offer.'
Tell Etani Treg that Yurv has accepted the dowry 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'Yurv accepted the dowry? Good. Now we must convince Wart to join my side. This, I fear will not be so easy. Wart is an ugly, nasty individual. Al is rumored to possess magical powers that rival most and rules alis clan by fear. Wart will need to be tricked into joining my side, and I just so happen to have a plan. Gather a scent gland from a Grendlaen. Put it inside the supplies in Wart's camp. This should bring Grendlean from all over to Wart's camp. You can then conveniently step in and offer to help get rid of the Grendlaens, only if Wart agrees to join my side that is.'
Place a grendlaen scent gland inside some supplies at Wart's camp 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Loot the scent gland from any grendlaen and give it to "Supplies" in Wart's camp (located in the north-northeastern part of the zone's middle-third -- -1600, 600, -12)._
Speak to Wart 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_NOTE: The task locks upon hail._
You say, 'Hail, Wart'
Wart says, in Alaran, 'Etani Treg wants me to join alis clan? I have no time for such things! Can you not see that my camp is being overrun by [grendlaens]?'
You say, 'I'll get rid of those grendlaens for you, if...'
Wart says, in Alaran, 'You will get rid of the grendlaens if I join Etani Treg's clan? Ok, ok! Just get rid of them before they tear us all to shreds!'
Kill the grendlaens that have come to Wart's camp 0/3 (Beasts' Domain)
_The grendlaens (which do NOT auto-aggro and are splittable) hit for max ~10,000; and are rootable and stunnable (but NOT mezzable)._
_Note that if you leave them idle for too long, they may despawn._
Let Etani Treg know that Wart has accepted the offer 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Etani Treg'
Etani Treg says, in Alaran, 'So my plan worked on Wart? That was almost too easy. It is good al agreed to join. There is one more clan leader you must speak with. Klar is old and wise and has ruled alis clan for a very long time. The only thing I can think of that might persuade Klar to join me is the promise of a prolonged life. I believe that those that worship the goddess Lunanyn might know of such a thing.'
Speak to Klar 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Klar spawns at about -2325, 1200, -9 (central part of the zone's middle section)._
You say, 'Hail, Klar'
Klar says, in Alaran, 'Etani Treg wishes for me to join alis clan? I am not interested. Actually, if you care to help me obtain something, I might reconsider. A follower of Lunanyn named Breinne has been seen wandering the southern parts of the wilds. I hear alis may be able to know how to make a potion of youth. If you obtain such a potion, return it to me, and I will agree to join Etani Treg.'
Speak with Breinne, a follower of Lunanyn 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Breinne can be found roaming around the lake area in the far southeastern part of the zone (about -5600, -550, -2)._
You say, 'Hail, Breinne'
Breinne says, in Alaran, 'You seek a potion of youth? If there were such a thing, don't you think I would use it for myself?'
Tell Etani Treg of your failure 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Task Window Says:_ You have failed in getting Klar to join Etani Treg's side. Let Etani Treg know of your failure.
Etani Treg was unhappy at your failure to get agreement from all of the clan leaders, but does not seem surprised.
_Rewards:_
Eltarki's Diary - Beasts Know More
273 platinum

This group mission begins with Captain Portencia in Argath (just outside the air ship drop-off point at 238, 492, 2).
Pr-requisites for requesting the task:
- Completion of "Beasts for the Stew"
- Completion of "A Question of Integrity"
- Completion of "Message of Faith"
- Completion of "Trial of the Beast"
- Completion of "One to Lead Them"
- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Captain Portencia'
Captain Portencia says 'You are _____, correct? Mea has told me about you. I have been meeting with Mea for some time now and we have reached a [deal] that could benefit Argath immensely.'
You say, 'What deal?'
Captain Portencia says 'Mea has informed me that some members of the Domain clan have recently acquired a brood of naeya pups. These pups would make great [companions] on the battlefield if trained correctly. I want those pups and I want you to [get] them for me.'
You say, 'Companions?'
Captain Portencia says 'The naeya pups would be very useful as scouts to help defend our lands. They also have an incredible sense of smell and are deadly in a fight.'
You say, 'I'll get them'
Captain Portencia says 'Getting to the naeya pups won't be easy unfortunately. A strong sect of the Domain clan are guarding them. You look like you might be able to handle them though. I will compensate you for your time if you are able to get the pups for me. Can you [do this] for me?'
You have been assigned the task 'Pups of War'.
Mea has told Captain Portencia that a new brood of naeya pups has been born to one of the clans. These creatures would be very useful to help the folk of Argath scout and defend their own lands, as the creatures have an amazing sense of smell, good enough to find invisible and hidden enemies of all sorts. Of course they are deadly in a fight too. Captain Portencia has asked you obtain the naeya pups.
You say, 'I will do this'
Captain Portencia says 'I knew I could count on you. When you are [ready], I can send you to the Beasts' Domain. When you arrive, speak with Mea. One of Mea's offspring, named Trag, has agreed to show you the way to the Domain camp where the naeya pups are being kept.'
You say, 'Ready!'
Captain Portencia says 'I await your return.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Beasts' Domain.
NOTE: All mobs in this zone see invisibility. They hit for a max ~12,500 and are stunnable. Mobs are fairly spread out, but sometimes difficult to see due to the terrain.
Speak with Mea Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Mea Treg'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'The heroes return. I take it that you have agreed to get the naeya pups for Portencia? So be it. Trag here will show you the way do the Domain camp. Also, if you need to [leave] here for some reason, just let me know.'
Speak with Trag 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Trag'
Trag says, in Alaran, 'Are you ready to [depart]?'
You say, 'Ready to depart'
Trag says, in Alaran, 'Follow me.'
Follow Trag to where the domain hunters are keeping the naeya pups 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Trag will make his way southeast, along the east river, and towards the narrow valleys located in the northeastern part of the zone's middle section.
He doesn't aggro mobs unless the mobs aggro you first. Likewise, mobs don't aggro him unless he attacks them first. He can't tank a mob very long without dying, so try not to let him tank much.
Once he gets to the domain hunter camp entrance, you'll see this:
Trag says, in Alaran, 'The clan is near. I cannot help you fight them. Good luck.'
Defeat the domain hunters in your way 0/18 (Beasts' Domain)
Kill any 18 domain hunters. There is nothing special about them; just regular trash mobs.
Free the naeya mother from her crate and kill her 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Destroy the large crate to free the naeya mother, and kill her (again, nothing special about this mob).
Collect the naeya pups from the small crates 0/6 (Beasts' Domain)
Destroy the small crates and loot the pups.
Give the pups to Mea Treg 0/6 (Beasts' Domain)
Speak with Mea Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Mea Treg'
Mea Treg says, in Alaran, 'I'm sorry little ones, but you'll be happier where you now go. You have done as asked. Portencia will come my collect the pups. Take something from the chest beside me and when you are ready to [leave], let me know.'
Loot the chest for your reward 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
Anyone within 300 range of the chest gets experience (1-2 AAs depending on your AA count).

_This group mission begins with Kalda Treg in the Beasts' Domain, located at 315, 2800, 10 (far northwestern part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Beasts for the Stew"
\- Completion of "A Question of Integrity"
\- Completion of "Message of Faith"
\- Completion of "Pups of War"

---

You say, 'Hail, Kalda Treg'
Kalda Treg says, in Alaran, 'Do you know how this great land works? The Domain has a King. A King of Beasts. A King that takes power from the echo of Kolos in these lands. It takes a powerful creature to dethrone the current beast, and when it does it grows even stronger. However, the current King has reigned too long. And he drains the power of the Domain, rather than using it. We need your help to defeat him, as we are not capable alone. If you agree, there are two ways we can deal with this threat: a small [group] to attack by stealth, or a large group to [assault] the King directly.'
You say, 'A small group'
_Without pre-requisites:_
Kalda Treg says, in Alaran, 'It does not seem right at this moment. We need more time to prepare. Continue to assist Mea Treg, and then we can talk.'
_With pre-requisites:_
Kalda Treg says, in Alaran, 'That might be best. I will gather a few hunters. Keep your own group small and agile. Let me know when you are [ready].'
You have been assigned the task 'King of the Beasts'.
The King of the Beasts has reigned for over a decade and must be deposed. The hunters of the Beasts' Domain have requested help.
Talk to Kalda and lead the hunters to victory.
Defeat the King of the Beasts. The creature must be prevented from draining the Domain.

---

Talk to Kalda Treg 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Hailing Kalda Treg triggers the event, so don't hail Kalda until ready._
You say, 'Hail, Kalda Treg'
Kalda Treg shouts, 'Be wary! The strongest opponent of the King will draw powers from the Domain. It will empower you, but shortly after it will start to control you! Be agile! Now, the beast must be destroyed! Attack!'
There appears to be a storm overhead.
Challenge the King of the Beasts 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_Kalda Treg and the hunters charge the King of the Beasts and assist you in attacking._
_The King hits for a max ~12,500 and has several AEs:_
Entangling Domain Vines: Single Target, Chromatic (-900)
1: Root
King's Charge: PB AE 20', (0)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 50347
King's Quake: PB AE 100', (0)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 36763
2: Stun (0.30 sec)
King's Roar: PB AE 100', (0)
1: Inhibit Melee Attacks by 1%
2: Silence
King's Slam: Single Target, (0)

King's Toss: Single Target, (0)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 58346
Magic of the Domain: Single Target, Unresistable (-650)
1: Increase Attack Speed by 35%
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 3200 per tick
3: Decrease AC by 225
4: Increase STR by 250
5: Increase DEX by 250
6: Increase ATK by 100
7: Trigger Effect: Call of the Domain on Fade
8: Increase corruption counter by 40
_About every minute (or longer), the King spawns an add called "a beast" (hits for a max ~8,500; stunnable). If this isn't killed within about 60 seconds, the King consumes it and regenerates 5% health:_
The King of the Beasts snaps up another beast and eats it whole!
_Midway through this encounter (or, this may be a timed mechanism), you'll see a power-up emote:_
The King is highly agitated! It appears to be building up power!
_This step updates as you kill the King._
Search the chest found in the King's lair 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
The King of the Beasts has been defeated. The draining effect the creature has harmed the land with will reverse itself, and a new King of the Beasts will rise to power.

You say, 'Disgusting gorals?'

You say, 'How about I go hunting?'

You have been assigned the task 'Eewww!'.

_This solo kill task begins with Blackwort in the Beasts' Domain, located at -3900, 1185, 16 (at the far southern part of the upper half of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Blackwort'
Blackwort says, in Alaran, 'Yes. Yes, I know my name sounds like something you'd find on a goral's bottom.' Al sighs, twitching alir tentacles, 'Hmph! If you must know, I was named after a [medicinal herb] - NOT a foot sore.'
You say, 'A medicinal herb?'
Blackwort says, in Alaran, 'I'm actually hunting for herbs which grow near the river, but I'm not much of a fighter, and the river is swarming with crocodiles! Unless I can find some way to [fight them off], I may not get any herbs today.'
You say, 'I'll fight them off'
Blackwort toys with a stray tentacle, giving you a skeptical look. 'That's very kind of you to help, I suppose..', al says with a final shrug. It's clear that al doubts you'll survive, but al's willing to let you go if you're foolish enough to try.
You have been assigned the task 'At The Water's Edge'.
Blackwort needs you to kill nearby crocodiles so that he can gather herbs from the river's edge.

You say, 'Hail, Yahnoa'
Yahnoa says, in Alaran, 'Greetings _____, I have been [waiting] for you!'
You say, 'Waiting for me?'
Yahnoa says, in Alaran, 'Yes. I felt sure that if I waited near this place, Kolos would send someone to aid me in my [mission].'
You say, 'What mission?'
Yahnoa says, in Alaran, 'I had a dream the other night, that I stood atop the hill and was given Kolos' blessing - but the hill was not made of dirt and grass as it is now; it was a [pile of wyvern corpses].'
You say, 'A pile of wyvern corpses?'
Yahnoa says, in Alaran, 'When I awoke, I knew in my heart that this was a sign from Kolos, that the wyverns' time on this earth has come to an end. They are grown too soft and tame, and should be wiped out so a new order of beasts can arise. Will you [help] me?'
You say, 'I'll help!'

_This solo kill/collection task begins with Hunter Bindani in the Beasts' Domain, located at -3600, 600, -11 (in the far southern part of the upper half of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Hunter Bindani'
Hunter Bindani says, in Alaran, 'Have you seen the hill yet? It surges with Kolos' power. Only the most powerful of beasts can hold the sacred hill. It is these beasts that I hunt. Perhaps you can [help] me.'
You say, 'I'll help'
Hunter Bindani says, in Alaran, 'Seek out the mighty beasts that hold the hill and collect some parts from them. Only one type of beast can hold the hill at a time, so this hunt will require some time and luck. I think you're up to the challenge though. Am I [correct]?'
You have been assigned the task 'Hunters' Bounty'.
You have agreed to take part in the Hunters' Bounty! You are to hunt the various empowered creatures that appear when a beast claims control of the hill where Kolos is buried.
Collect various body parts from the empowered minions of the current king of the hill. You will need to kill the current king as well, to ensure that different beasts have a chance to become king. Deliver the body parts to Hunter Bindani.
You say, 'Correct!'
Hunter Bindani says, in Alaran, 'Good hunting to you then! Oh, and be careful. The beasts near the hill are more powerful than elsewhere in the forest.'

---

_The eight items all come from the "empowered" mobs that surround the king's hill in the center of the Beasts' Domain. To get the mob type to switch, you have to kill their king (located in the very center). Once the king is dead, all empowered mobs despawn and a new set spawns a few minutes later._
_Empowered creatures hit for a max ~12,500 while the king itself generally hits for around ~13,800. None of them have any AEs or any other special attacks._

Renarra says 'The Temple is filled with various inhabitants; mainly the Alarans and Hadal. There may also be ophidians as they are the beloved animals of Oseka, the God of Tides. Take your pick and remove them. Prexus will ensure you are greatly rewarded for your valiant efforts.'
_A task window pops up with five tasks to choose from._
You have been assigned the task 'Diminishing the Temple - Ophidians'.
Being Oseka's beloved animals, Renarra believes that killing the sacred ophidians may reduce Oseka's power. Dive into the watery depths and take out the ophidians.

Defeat the revered ophidians 0/4 (Rubak Oseka)
Defeat the ringed ophidians 0/4 (Rubak Oseka)

_This solo task begins with a Kedge named Coraln Seagazer in Sarith, located in the northeastern part of the dock area (35, -1090, -4)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_

---

You say, 'Hail, Coraln Seagazer'
Coraln Seagazer says 'Such sorrow the [water spirits] feel.'
You say, 'Water spirits?'
Coraln Seagazer says 'The water spirits in the Temple of Rubak have become innocent casualties of the conflict between us and Oseka and nobody seems to notice, or care. I however do care and wish to [soothe] them.'
You say, 'How can we soothe them?'
Coraln Seagazer says 'I am unable to enter the Temple, but you can. Will you take these vials of soothing [water] and give them to the water spirits?'
You say, 'I'll take some water'
Coraln Seagazer says 'War is an inevitable part of life, but it is not right that the water spirits needlessly suffer. Take these vials of water and give them to the agitated water spirits. If you are successful in this endeavor, return to me and let me know so my mind can be at ease.'
You have been assigned the task 'Soothing the Spirits'.
Coraln Seagazer is concerned about water spirits in the Temple of Rubak. They have become agitated by the ongoing conflct between Prexus and Oseka, the goddess of Tides and nobody else seems to care. Coraln has asked you to give the water spirits some soothing water to see if it can soothe them.
_You receive 4x "A Vial of Soothing Water"._
_You may need more than 4 vials, so just say "water" to Corain to get more._

If this happens, you can either fade aggro or kill it (note that it sees invisibility). If faded, it will respawn non-aggro after about a minute. If killed, it has a fairly quick respawn._

_This is the first task in a series of five; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with a Kedge named Solphius Kelprunner in Sarith, located in the northeastern part of the dock area (-35, -905, 0)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Solphius Kelprunner'
Solphius Kelprunner says 'The tides of battle turn quickly. The forces of Prexus are winning for now, but we must remain vigilant to keep our edge. In this, I believe you can [help].'
You say, 'How can I help?'
Solphius Kelprunner says 'If you wish to serve Prexus, you must enter the temple of Rubak Oseka and gather information on those that dwell there, so that we may be better [informed] before we launch an offensive against them.'
You have been assigned the task 'Oseka's Knowledge'.
Solphius Kelprunner wants you to investigate some murals in Rubak Oseka.
You will need a scrying device before you can fully understand the murals. Kill Hadal in Rubak Oseka to obtain one.
You say, 'Informed?'
Solphius Kelprunner says 'Religious murals line the walls of the temple interior. Unfortunately we have been unable to decipher them. It is said however that some of the Hadal may hold items that can decipher the murals. Obtain one of these items and decipher some of the murals.'

---

Kill Hadal in Rubak Oseka to obtain a Hadal Scrying Device 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Kill Hadal mobs (the fishman creatures) until one drops a "Hadal Scrying Device". This will open up the next four steps. Whoever loots the item must click on the four murals. These are the painting/picture-looking things you'll see on the center's walls as you make your way down the ramp._
_Side Note: Whoever does the mural clicks for this task will be automatically granted a skill of 100 in the Hadal language (25 per click)._
Decipher the first mural 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Using the Hadal Scrying Device, you are better able to decipher the mural. On Alaris, there was a city dedicated to the sea god, and it too was called Sarith. Sarith means "Unbounded" in the Alaran tongue. It was a huge city, obviously the safest port in the world. When Oseka arrived on Norrath, al did alir best to recreate the city that was dedicated to ali on Alaris. As a mortal, Oseka was a sea-fearing explorer, treasure hunter, and part-time pirate.
Decipher the second mural 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Using the Hadal Scrying Device, you are better able to decipher the mural. Oseka has loved the sea ever since al was a child in Sarith, and always had a thirst for adventure and a cunning mind. Al became quite famous for alir exploits, carving out a name for aleself among the Alarans world-wide.
Decipher the third mural 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Using the Hadal Scrying Device, you are better able to decipher the mural. As time progressed, Oseka gained a loyal set of followers, the best explorers and most notorious pirates of the surrounding seas. Chased by a few high profile members of authority, al always managed to slip away, quickly cobbling together devious tricks and traps to escape capture. Doing so gained ali the respect of those authorities as well, adding to alir legend.
Decipher the fourth mural 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Using the Hadal Scrying Device, you are better able to decipher the mural. Oseka became a god by becoming a famous maritime explorer and a legendary pirate. Though never being one for rules, al did not have a problem with the Triumvirate in most situations, given alir free dominion over the ocean and tides. Alir hometown of Sarith, which al adored despite always being on the move, worshipped al and al rejoiced in it. Al also gained the devout worship of the Hadal, a mysterious underwater race that resided in alir temple of tides called Rubak Oseka. Not that alir free-spirited nature didn't come into conflict with the Triumvirate. And when they did clash, al was never shy about using alir devious mind to find loopholes and rules to bend the Triumvirate's laws.
Return to Solphius Kelprunner in Sarith and speak with him 0/1 (Sarith)
_Note: With no lock point, players can be added to this task right up to its completion._
You say, 'Hail, Solphius Kelprunner'
Solphius Kelprunner says, 'So the foolish Hadal and Alarans wish to resurrect their god, Oseka? Even if they did, they are no match for Prexus' forces. I think it's time to use their religious relics against them. Speak to me again if you are interested.'
_Reward:_
273 platinum

\- Completion of "Sacred Relics"

You say, 'Hail, Solphius Kelprunner'
Solphius Kelprunner says 'So eager to help. Prexus will remember your contribution to this war. Head back to Oseka and seek out the sacred ophidians that dwell in the watery depths. You are to obtain several vials of their blood. Once you have the blood, place the relics at the various altars and sprinkle them with the ophidian blood. This will either anger, or convince the followers of Oseka to give up any false hope that Oseka can save them from the coming storm.'
You have been assigned the task 'Tides of Change'.
Solphius Kelprunner hopes that he can convince some of the Alarans and Hadal that worship Oseka to defect to Prexus' army. To accomplish this, you will need to place the artifacts, now blessed with Prexus' power, you stole earlier into several altars and pour the blood of Oseka's sacred serpents over them.
Obtain several vials of Sacred Ophidian Blood from the ophidians that inhabit the bottom of the temple of Rubak.

Collect vials of Ophidian Blood from the Ophidians in Rubak 0/4 (Rubak Oseka)
_The ophidians are snakes found mostly in the bottom floor of the temple, and in greater numbers in the water under the bottom floor. The vial is a common drop._

Give a Vial of Ophidian Blood to the Altar of Tides 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Give the Prexus-Infused Rune of the Sacred Ophidian to the Altar of Serpents 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Give a Vial of Ophidian Blood to the Altar of Serpents 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_The altars are found in the side rooms adjacent to the main ramp. In each altar room are 3-4 trash mobs. Killing them isn't necessary to complete the task, but will make the turn-ins easier._
_NOTE: Each time you complete a set of turn-ins, a Cursed Water Elemental spawns at the altar and attacks._

_The Altar of Serpents is at 0, -250, 375._

Go to him now and see how you can further serve Prexus.'

_This is the fourth task in a series of five; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with an elemental named Aquarn the Tidalmaster in Sarith, located in the northeastern part of the dock area (around -35, -905, 0)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Oseka's Knowledge"
\- Completion of "Sacred Relics"
\- Completion of "Tides of Change"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Aquarn the Tidalmaster'
Aquarn the Tidalmaster says 'Before we launch an attack against Rubak, there is one more task I need you to undertake. One of our operatives, a Kedge named, Silbek, has been captured and is to be sacrificed to Oseka, the Goddess of Tides. We need to get him [out] of Rubak.'
You say, 'How do we get him out of Rubak?'
Aquarn the Tidalmaster says 'Unfortunately it will not be so simple. He is being held under a powerful spell generated by four magical orbs. We have discovered, much to our fortune, that the Hadal priests sometimes carry colored gems that can disable these [orbs].'
You say, 'What about the orbs?'
Aquarn the Tidalmaster says 'If you were able to collect the gems, perhaps you can disable the gems and get Silbek out of there. Are you [up to] this most important of tasks?'
You say, 'I'm up to it'
Aquarn the Tidalmaster says 'I knew you would not disappoint me. Return to me after Silbek has been rescued.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Key to Freedom'.
Before an all-out attack can be carried out on the Temple of Rubak, Aquarn needs you to rescue a Kedge named Silbek who is to be sacrificed to Oseka.
Collect a green, orange, red, and blue gem from the Hadal priests in the Temple of Rubak.

---

Collect a Green Gem 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Collect an Orange Gem 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Collect a Red Gem 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Collect a Blue Gem 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_The gems drop randomly from "a priest" (Hadal model). Once you've looted the four gems, you'll have to turn them in to the colored orbs next to the pearl on the bottom floor of the temple._
_NOTE: These are NOT pre-lootable. If you give a gem to the wrong colored orb, it will give it back to you._
Give the Green Gem to the correct orb 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_The Green Gem goes to the Red Orb._
Give the Orange Gem to the correct orb 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_The Orange Gem goes to the Blue Orb._
Give the Red Gem to the correct orb 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_The Red Gem goes to the Green Orb._
Give the Blue Gem to the correct orb 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_The Blue Gem goes to the Orange Orb. Upon this last turn-in, a Kedge named Silbek spawns._
Speak with Silbek 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ You have disabled the orbs that had incapacitated Silbek! Speak with him before you leave the temple.
You say, 'Hail, Silbek'

Return to Aquarn the Tidalmaster and speak with him 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Aquarn the Tidalmaster'
Aquarn the Tidalmaster says, 'I have received word or your success with rescuing Silbek. I am pleased. With your aid, the forces of Prexus are sure to be victorious. Speak with Tiljin of the Deep for your next assignment. He should be somewhere nearby.'

_This is the fifth task in a series of five; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Tiljin of the Deep in Sarith, located in the northeastern part of the dock area with the Kedge._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Oseka's Knowledge"
\- Completion of "Sacred Relics"
\- Completion of "Tides of Change"
\- Completion of "The Key to Freedom"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Tiljin of the Deep'
Tiljin of the Deep says 'I hope you're here to [help], otherwise I have no time for distractions.'
You say, 'I'm here to help'
Tiljin of the Deep says 'Good. We are beginning our offense against the Temple of Rubak Oseka. We plan to [weaken] the structure and hopefully draw the high priest out of hiding.'
_You receive 4x "An Explosive Rune"._
You have been assigned the task 'Begin the Offensive'.
Tiljin of the Deep has tasked you with gathering samples of a strange, powdered coral held by the Hadal in the Temple of Rubak. When combined with the runes you were given, a highly explosive device can be created.
You say, 'How to we weaken the temple?'
Tiljin of the Deep says 'Take these runes. Alone, they are harmless. Infused with a certain [item], and they can cause large amounts of damage.'
You say, 'What item?'
Tiljin of the Deep says 'You will need to collect some samples of a powdered coral that the Hadal use for various ceremonies inside Rubak. The coral, in powder form, is strangely reactive to water and certain magics. We have found that under the correct circumstances, it becomes a highly effective [explosive].'
You say, 'Explosive?'
Tiljin of the Deep says 'We have placed specialized rune holders at various locations on the outside walls of the Temple of Rubak. Once you have the powdered coral, you will need to place the runes at these locations and then apply the powdered coral to the runes. That will prime the runes to explode when we are ready for them to do so.'

---

Obtain samples of powdered coral from Hadal Priests in the Temple of Rubak 0/4 (Rubak Oseka)
_This is a common drop from Hadal mobs in Rubak. NOTE: This is NOT pre-lootable._
Place an Explosive Rune in the first rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place one sample of the Powdered Coral in the first rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place an Explosive Rune in the second rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place one sample of the Powdered Coral in the second rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place an Explosive Rune in the third rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place one sample of the Powdered Coral in the third rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place an Explosive Rune in the fourth rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
Place one sample of the Powdered Coral in the fourth rune holder on the outside wall of the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Sarith)
_The rune holders are on the outside of the temple underwater. The first rune is the west one; the second is the southeast one; the third is the northeast one; the fourth is the southwest one._
_Be advised there are mobs in the vicinity of the runes, some of which see invisibility._
Return to Tiljin of the Deep in Sarith and speak with him 0/1 (Sarith)
You say, 'Hail, Tiljin of the Deep'
Tiljin of the Deep says, 'So all four of the runes have been placed and the powdered coral applied to them? You have done well. The next phase of our plan will be much more dangerous. General Serobi, here in Sarith, will have more information for you when you are ready to proceed.'

_This is a group mission that begins with General Serobi in Sarith. He's found in the northeastern part of the dock area at about 20, -1050._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "Oseka's Knowledge"
\- Completed "Sacred Relics"
\- Completed "Tides of Change"
\- Completed "The Key to Freedom"
\- Completed "Begin the Offensive"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, General Serobi'
_Without pre-requisites, you'll see:_
General Serobi says 'You are not yet ready for the task I have planned. Speak with Solphius Kelprunner, Tiljin of the Deep, or Aquarn the Tidalmaster if you wish to help.'
_With pre-requisites, you'll see:_
General Serobi says 'I've been expecting you. With the explosive runes armed, now is the time to make our [move] against the Temple of Rubak Oseka.'
You say, 'Let's make our move'
General Serobi says 'Take these detonators and use them at the various altars in Rubak. They will detonate the explosive runes you armed. Hopefully we can do enough damage to the temple that we can get the attention of the High Priest. If the High Priest does appear, destroy him! Are you [ready] to undertake this most important of missions?'
_You receive four detonators._
You have been assigned the task 'Assault the Tower'.
You are to enter the Temple of Rubak Oseka and use the four detonators to detonate the runed explosives you previously armed. It is hoped that enough damage is done to the temple, the High Priest will show himself and you can slay him.

---

_The steps will open up one at a time. You'll need to begin with the furthest altar, the Altar of Whispers, and make your way back up._
_\- The Altar of Whispers is at 250, 150, 290._
_\- The Altar of Wisdom is at 0, 250, 320._
_\- The Altar of Tides is at -200, -100, 350._
_\- The Altar of Serpents is at 0, -250, 375._
_All trash mobs in the altar rooms will have to be killed before you can turn in a detonator. If you try to do a turn-in without doing so, you'll see:_
You can't put the detonator on the altar with those attendants watching!
Give Detonator One unto the Altar of Whispers 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ Give Detonator One unto the Altar of Whispers. It will self-detonate, causing the explosive rune you had previously armed to explode and damage the temple.
Give Detonator Two unto the Altar of Wisdom 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
Give Detonator Three unto the Altar of Tides 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_NOTE: The task locks as you turn in the third detonator._
Give Detonator Four unto the Altar of Serpents 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Upon turning in the last one, the temple rumbles and you'll see:_
The temple shakes violently as the runed explosion is triggered!
High Priest Xalziks shouts, 'Enough! You shall not damage our temple any further! The forces of Prexus shall be destroyed! If you wish to prove your true courage, I await you at the bottom of the temple, cowards!
Defeat High Priest Xalziks 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ The High Priest has shown himself just as General Serobi had hoped. Destroy him!
_High Priest Xalziks spawns on the bottom floor. He hits for a max ~12,500 and casts no AEs. He does, however, spawn a whirlpool on a random person, complete with a damage aura (hits every two seconds):_
Raging Vortex: Single Target, Cold (-900)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 6346
_Note: You can pull Xalziks into this whirlpool to do extra damage to him. There's also an achievement for doing this five times._
_As he reaches low health (you'll need to do about 1 million hp of damage to get to this point), you'll see:_
High Priest Xalziks says, in Alaran, 'I have no time for your childish games. You are foolish to think you could have defeated me, for I am the embodiment of Oseka herself! Run back to your leader like the cowards you are and let them know that the forces of Oseka shall win this war!'
Speak with General Serobi in the Temple of Rubak 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
You say, 'Hail, General Serobi'
General Serobi says 'So, Oseka is using the High Priest's body to do her dirty work. It is most fortunate for you that he did not finish this battle. You are not yet ready to confront him; this much is clear, but we have learned much from this encounter. Take your reward from this chest and rest for now. There is still much work to be done. When you are ready to [leave] the temple, let me know and I will send you back to Sarith.'
Loot the Cold Steel chest for your reward 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)

_This is a group mission that begins with General Serobi in Sarith. He's found in the northeastern part of the dock area at about 20, -1050._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "Oseka's Knowledge"
\- Completed "Sacred Relics"
\- Completed "Tides of Change"
\- Completed "The Key to Freedom"
\- Completed "Begin the Offensive"
\- Completed "Assault the Tower"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, General Serobi'
_Without pre-requisites, you'll see:_
General Serobi says 'You are not yet ready for the task I have planned. Speak with Solphius Kelprunner, Tiljin of the Deep, or Aquarn the Tidalmaster if you wish to help.'
_With pre-requisites, you'll see:_
You say, 'Hail, General Serobi'
General Serobi bows respectfully in greeting, 'You look well rested, \_\_\_\_\_. This is good. You will need your strength for what lies ahead. While your efforts thus far have been commendable, it is clear now that it will take a much greater force to stop Oseka. Large or small, all help is needed. Tell me, do you have a [group] or a [raiding party] on hand, or perhaps you're willing to make another [move] against the Temple of Rubak Oseka?'
You say, 'I have a group'
General Serobi nods with understanding, 'Ah, a group. This will help immensely. To be able to possess the bodies of alir High Priests is a power unlike any I have ever witnessed. If the source of alir [strength] lies in Rubak, we shall find it, and use it against alir.'
You say, 'Strength?'
General Serobi says 'Just as Prexus derives power from the oceans of Norrath, Oseka must be sustained from something within Rubak. Finding this source of power, however, won't be an easy task. Oseka and alir High Priests are likely expecting an attack...' The General reaches within his robe and withdraws a water-filled crystal flask. 'Within this [vial], the tremulous waters of Prexus are contained. The vial may be small, but the strength within is boundless. One drop alone can embody the power of the sea.''
You say, 'What vial?'
General Serobi says 'A gift bestowed upon me by Prexus himself. While he cannot [travel] to the domain of Oseka, his power could, if contained. The Fury of the Tides, when unleashed near the heart of Rubak, may cause enough of a disruption for you to find the source of Oseka's power and use it against alir.'
You say, 'We'll travel there'
General Serobi hands you the crystal flask with great care. 'You hold the power of Prexus in your hands. When you are ready to [begin], I will lead you to the heart of Rubak.'
You have been assigned the task 'Time and Tides'.
_Everyone receives a "Fury of the Tides"._
Travel to Rubak Oseka, Temple of the Sea, and find Oseka's source of power and use it against alir.
Defeat devout templars in Rubak, and loot the talismans or signets which are the souce of their ancient power.

---

Loot ancient relics from templars within Rubak 0/6 (Rubak Oseka)
Defeat devout templars 0/6 (Rubak Oseka)
_Clear your way down to the bottom floor of the temple. As you're doing so, three people should each loot two items (dropped by the templars): "Pearlescent Signet" and "Ancient Pearlescent Talisman"._

---

Travel to the pearl at the heart of Rubak 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ At the heart of Rubak the High Priests of Oseka gather.
_On the bottom floor of the temple are 4x "High Priest of Oseka". They are non-aggro until the event is triggered._

---

Release water from Fury of the Tides to interrupt the High Priests 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ Using the Fury of the Tides, create a distraction large enough to interrupt the High Priests of Oseka.
_NOTE: The task locks when you update this step._
_When ready for a fight, someone needs to move into their vicinity and click the "Fury of the Tides", causing all four to activate._
A drop of water spills from the vial, causing a tremulous wave of disruption.
_The four mobs rush your party (one of the priests turns into "High Priest Xalziks")._

---

Defeat High Priests 0/3 (Rubak Oseka)
Defeat Zealots 0/2 (Rubak Oseka)
**In Summary...**
\- Burn down three High Priests as quickly as possible
\- Get out of the whirlpools as they spawn
\-\-\- NOTE: Whirlpools won't spawn as long as your DPS is focused on Xalziks
\- Kill the zealots before they reach the water
\- Once you have only High Priest Xalziks left, use the six click effects on it
\- Kill the newly spawned zealots before they reach the water
**In Detail...**
_The four mobs each hit for a max ~12,500. The High Priests of Oseka (which are mezzable) each cast "Up From the Depths":_
Up From the Depths: PB AE 40', Magic (-900)
1: Knockback (7) and Toss Up (2)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 14200
_High Priest Xalziks (which is not mezzable) casts "Up From the Depths" and "Riptide" (hits multiple targets at a time):_
Riptide: Single Target, Magic (-900)
1: 100% Chance to trigger: Tide Pull
2: Unknown #343
3: Decrease Hitpoints by 15050
_"Riptide" triggers "Tide Pull" which is a one-tick pull-spell (will pull you towards the mob)._
_During the encounter, you'll see emote warnings about a whirlpool spawn:_
_Target Sees:_ A whirlpool begins to form around you.
_Everyone Else Sees:_ Swirls of violent water and wind begin to form around \_\_\_\_\_.
_This emote is a 9-second warning that a whirlpool is about to spawn on the targeted player. It comes with a large damage aura and pull effect._
_NOTE: As long as your DPS is focused on "High Priest Xalziks", the whirlpools will not appear._
_Additional emotes seen during the encounter (their effect, if any, is unknown):_
A surge of water can be heard rushing up from the depths of Rubak.
The tide begins to turn.
_As the fight goes on, "High Priest Xalziks" will turn into "High Priest of Oseka" and, consequently, one of the "High Priest of Oseka" will turn into "High Priest Xalziks". When this happens, there is no change in health. If you kill a High Priest while its name is "High Priest Xalziks", it still counts towards towards the task update._
_If you kill "High Priest Xalziks" while other "High Priest of Oseka" are still alive, one of the remaining mobs will turn into "High Priest Xalziks"._
_While all this is going on, non-aggro Hadal zealots will spawn and wander towards the water. These need to be killed before they reach the water, otherwise they turn into an add ("a devout templar"). If this happens, you'll see this emote:_
A zealot has made the ultimate sacrifice, allowing another High Priest to appear.
_Zealots spawn one at a time (about every 45 seconds) and can appear in any of the bottom three alcoves._

---

Confine Oseka's spirit in the body of High Priest Xalziks 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ Use the Pearlescent Talismans or Pearlescent Signets to bind Oseka's essence into the body of High Priest Xalziks.
_With the three High Priests dead, leaving Xalziks as the only remaining one up, the people who looted the talismans and signets need to click them on Xalziks. The clicks all need to be done within seconds of each other._
_NOTE: The clicks won't work properly if there is still a "High Priest of Oseka" alive. "High Priest Xalziks" must be the only mob left._
_If you try clicking on a regular High Priest, you'll see this failure emote:_
Oseka can only be confined while in the body of High Priest Xalziks.
_Upon successful clicks, you'll see:_
The tides begin to calm, as a portion of Oseka's power returns to the pearl.
Zealots begin marching toward the water, in an attempt to free Oseka's spirit through their own death.
_...And several zealots spawn and begin walking towards the water. They all must be killed before they reach the water. Once the zealots are dead, this step updates. The remainder of the task is non-combat._

---

Hear Oseka's words and ensure alir essence returns to the pearl 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ Unable to find a new host for alir spirit, Oseka's essence is forced to return to the pearl, but not without having the final word.
High Priest Xalziks gurgles while struggling to form cryptic words, 'Your so-called Gods are weak; pathetic. Fear is easily trumped, as you proved by defeating one of your own lesser Gods. I suppose I should thank you for your unintentional gift.'
High Priest Xalziks trembles as the remnants of life fade from its body, but the voice of Oseka continues, 'Do not think that you have seen the last of me. I may not be able to possess another mortal body, but I will assume my rightful place amongst my followers. This land will be reclaimed from the lesser gods, one way or another. I will not spend eternity confined in the depths of Rubak!' As Oseka's final words echo throughout Rubak, a brilliant light escapes the limp body of High Priest Xalziks and travels toward the pearl.
_An "Essence of Oseka" appears and disappears into the pearl._

---

Loot the watery chest for your reward 0/1 (Rubak Oseka)
_Task Window Says:_ Some treasures of Oseka are contained within this chest.
As a result of your heroic efforts, Oseka's spirit has returned to the pearl; no longer able to possess the mortal bodies of alir High Priests.

---

# Resplendent #1: The Light Within

**Level:** 95 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 95
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes

**Quest Type:** Task
**Alaran Language:** 73
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Veil of Alaris Information & Guides: An Overview | Group Progression & Task List | Raid Progression | Visible Armor
This is the first in a series of three; a solo task that begins with Nadja Irespine in the Resplendent Temple, located at 2715, 320, -37 (northwestern part of the zone, on the outside of the temple -- from Sarith, go across the bridge, then head north along the west wall of the temple).
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
- No tasks
- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Nadja Irespine'
Nadja Irespine  flashes an inviting smile as al waves you forward, 'Come traveler, share our fire and share your story. You must be weary from your journey. Many have come from distant lands to worship at the [temple].'
You say, 'What about this temple?'
Nadja Irespine tilts alir head toward the sky and with lightly closed eyes takes in a slow, deep breath. 'It's magnificent, isn't it? This place is filled with an energy I've never experienced before. Although my tired eyes won't ever [witness] what beauty lies within the temple, in my bones I can feel its luster.'
You say, 'Witness?'
Nadja Irespine solemnly stares at the ground while alir voice takes on an undeserving tone, 'Only the chosen may enter the temple; those of pure mind and body known as the [Nitore]. They pray to Ladrys, the epitome of splendor, and bask in the perfection al exudes.'
You say, 'What is the Nitore?'
Nadja Irespine beams as al begins to speak fondly of the sect that occupies the temple. 'The Nitore are gentle and orderly. Ascended beings who are filled with a light so pure, they have no worries or weaknesses. It's a state so many of us wish to attain, yet is likely out of reach for ordinary Alarans who do not possess the [essential spark].'
You say, 'Essential spark?'
Nadja Irespine continues with greater fervor, 'The essential spark is something that the Nitore look for when accepting members into their ranks. If it exists, it means that the bearer of the spark has the ability to ascend to the state of being in which the Nitore thrive; it means that you might even be able to hear the sentry stones!' The aging Alaran sighs, taking a moment to calm the excitement brewing in alir veins. 'It is a rare thing, you know, this essential spark, but something that we're all willing to [discover] within aleselves.'
You say, 'Discover what?'
Nadja Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Nitore chancellors are the only ones who can detect the spark, but earning an audience with one of them is not an easy feat. You have to understand, many believe they have the spark, but only a few actually possess it.' The kind Alaran smiles warmly, 'My kin is among the lucky few who have ascended. Al proved alir worth by fighting many battles in this very grove. They say only a weapon wielded by someone with the essential spark can defeat the diseased that lurk nearby. If you're hoping to [prove] yourself as well, you should try to join the other recruits in their hunt. They crossed the bridge into the grove only this morning. They shouldn't be far.''
You say, 'I can prove myself'
Nadja Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Best of luck.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Light Within'.
Join the other recruits who are hunting diseased creatures on the outer portion of the grove near the temple.
Locate the recruits hunting in the grove 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You'll find "a diseased recruit" on the east side of the zone (outer edge of the grove area) at about 2150, -1225. Don't approach him until you're ready for battle. Upon standing on his location, two diseased mobs spawn. These are just trash mob difficulty.
Defeat the diseased creatures surrounding the recruit 0/2 (Resplendent Temple)
Note: These two mobs despawn a short time after appearing. If this happens to you, you can kill any two diseased creatures in the zone for this update.
Speak to the diseased recruit 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Upon hailing, he turns into "a Nitore recruit":
a Nitore recruit looks down at alir flesh-colored hands in disbelief. 'I'm... I'm alive. How is this possible? I felt my body die and decay!' With slight hesitation, the fully recovered recruit continues, 'You must visit the temple. Chancellor Corcelia would be very interested in meeting you.' Overcome with shock, the grateful recruit pauses before running toward the temple.
Make your way to the temple 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Task Window Says: The diseased recruit you found in the grove insisted you visit the temple and speak with Chancellor Corcelia.
This step updates as you approach the temple entrance.
Speak to Chancellor Corcelia within the temple 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Hail Chancellor Corcelia just inside the temple's front doors.
Chancellor Corcelia looks you over with a skeptical eye. 'So you're the one a recruit spotted in the grove. They claim you have the spark within you.' The doubtful Nitore continues to peer at you, alir head tilting to the side. 'It's a rare thing for someone other than a chancellor to spot the essential spark. You'll have to excuse me for not taking the word of an untrained eye too seriously. We din't extend invites to just anyone, you know. Each must earn their way into the temple, even those who claim to possess natural gifts.' Chancellor Corcelia forces a strained smile as al continues, 'Head into the grove and defeat many diseased creatures that plague our pristine lands. If the spark exists, you should be able to purge the decay from the wretched beasts and return it to me for prompt disposal.'
Kill diseased animals within the grove 0/6 (Resplendent Temple)
Task Window Says: To test if you possess the essential spark, you must kill diseased animals within the grove and purge the decay from their bodies. Collect a soiled essence to serve as proof of your actions.
Return a soiled essence Chancellor Corcelia 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Kill and six diseased mobs and loot their soiled essence (pre-lootable), then return it to the Chancellor.
Chancellor Corcelia appears slightly agitated at your return, but manages a polite grin. 'It appears you have succeeded, _____. So the spark may exist within you after all.' The curt Nitore pauses for a moment, caught in contemplation. With an affirmative nod, al continues, 'Yes, the spark does exist within you, though it is very dim. I fear that it maj bo extinguished by the decay that plagues your mind and body. ot is only through careful meditation that you will be abne to grasp the essential spark wi hin.' The Chancellor extends a frail limb into the air, pointing to the left. 'Yau'll find our prophet, Lesir, in tho mebitation room. Al will helr you overcome the darkness that suppresses your spark.'
Speak to Lesir the Seer 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Task Window Says: Lesir the Seer will help you confront the decay that festers within your mind and body.
Lesir the Seer is found in the small room just east of Corcelia. NOTE: Don't hail Lesir the Seer until you're ready for a fight.
You say, 'Hail, Lesir the Seer'
Lesir the Seer doesn't seem surprised by your presence. With eyes closed, al places als hands on your shoulders, sending a wave of relaxation through your body. You feel a strange force tug at your soul...
a mirror image takes on a familiar form.
"a mirror image" spawns and attacks. It hits hard and fast (~11,000) and is immune to mez/stun.
Overcome the decay that plagues your mind and body 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Task Window Says: You must battle the decay within in order to emerge purified.
Kill the mirror image for the update.
Return to Chancellor Corcelia 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Task Window Says: Now that your mind and body have been purified, speak once again to Chancellor Corcelia within the temple.
You say, 'Hail, Chancellor Corcelia'
Chancellor Corcelia welcomes you with a genuine smile, 'Your spark is much brighter than it was when you first stood before me. I can only assume this means you were successful in your quest to expel the darkness and decay from your mind. That feat deserves a reward. _____, I present you with your Nitore Initiate Robes. Welcome to the Chosen. May Ladrys bystow alir radiance upon you.'
The essential spark has been found within you, allowing your ascent into the Nitore's ranks.
You receive "Nitore Initiate Robes".
Experience
205 platinum

- Eltarki's Diary - Priceless Beauty [item=99799]
- Nitore Initiate Robes [item=100100]

_This is the second in a series of three; a solo task that begins with Chancellor Corcelia in the Resplendent Temple, located at 1700, -15, -22 (inside the front door if coming in from Sarith)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The Light Within"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Chancellor Corcelia'
_Without pre-requisites:_
Chancellor Corcelia completely ignores your presence.
_With pre-requisites:_
Chancellor Corcelia gestures to alir spotless surroundings, 'As you can see, we like to keep the temple in pristine shape. It's what Ladrys aleself would want, and what we should all strive to attain. It's an initiate's duty to [help] keep the temple clean and free from... undesirables.'
You say, 'How can I help?'
Chancellor Corcelia says, in Alaran, 'It would do you a world of good to familiarize yourself with the temple, making a note of areas that are off limits to initiates and recruits.' The Nitore's grin grows wider, 'Our temple is a rather large place, and you wouldn't want to end up lost and alone, now would you? There are a few other Nitore [leaders] you should speak with. They may have some tasks for you. In exchange for your help, they should offer some history on our magnificent temple.''
You say, 'I'll speak with the leaders'
Chancellor Corcelia smiles warmly as al jots something down, 'Lest you forget, I've noted in your journal the names of those you should speak with.'
You have been assigned the task 'An Initiate's Task'.
Chancellor Corcelia has asked you to seek out a few key people within the temple who may have tasks for you to complete in exchange for history surrounding the temple.

---

Seek out Blademaster Morje 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Blademaster Morje spawns in the large circular room (ground level) northeast of the Cancellor (location approximately 1900, -310, -16)._
You say, 'Hail, Blademaster Morje'
Blademaster Morje peers at you suspiciously, 'Another initiate I see. It seems Corcelia's greed has caused her to let just about anyone into the temple now, but never mind that. As long as you're able to kill swinetor, you won't hear me complain. The filthy creatures that burrow beneath this temple are constantly stealing our weapon supplies. None of the Nitore seem to want to get their hands dirty, so I count on initiate's like yoyrself to recover the weapons.'
Recover stolen temple weapons from swinetor 0/4 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ The Swinetor burrowed below the temple have been stealing weapons from their neighbors above.
_This step updates as you kill Swinetor in the "In Between" (the undergrounds caves of the zone -- accessed from a cave entrance on either side of the temple, or by letting yourself fall into the gorge that surrounds the temple)._
_There is no actual item. This updates upon random kills. Upon an update, you see the emote:_
You retrieve a dirty weapon from the dead swinetor.
Seek out Sentry Loesk 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Sentry Loesk spawns in the top of the western tower. On your map, you'll see a large, circular room northwest of Chancellor Corcelia's location. To access the top level, you need to use the ramp/stairwell that's in the room to the north of that one. Go all the way up the spiral ramp to get to Sentry Loesk's level (1830, 215, 410)._
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Loesk'
Sentry Loesk bows deeply in your presence. 'Have you come to pray at the [sentry stone]?'
You say, 'I'm here to pray at the sentry stone...'
Sentry Loesk takes alir time recalling the history surrounding the powerful relics, 'While many travel here in search of beauty, those that dwell in the temple know its true treasures are the sentry stones. On display in various areas throughout the temple, the stones offer cleansing to those who pray at their base, and wisdom to those who are pure enough to hear their [words].'
You say, 'Their words?'
Sentry Loesk smiles at your eagerness, 'Everyone wishes to hear the words of the sentry stones, but only the truly ascended will be spoken to. For now, it's best that you stay near and pray.'
Pray at the sentry stone 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Sit at the sentry stone nearby until you get an update._
Faint murmurs escape the sentry stone and fill the air with words of decay and beauty.
Your task 'An Initiate's Task' has been updated.
Seek out Surmo, the temple attendant 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ Find Surmo, the Halfling temple attendant who works in the grand hall.
_Surmo is on the base level of the temple; just head due north of the zone-in to the circular room furthest north (2500, 25, -21)._
You say, 'Hail, Surmo'
Surmo nearly trips over himself to greet you, 'Hello there, friend! My name's Surmo, originally from Rivervale and now a dutiful servant of the temple, charged with waste [disposal]. I came here on one of the first few airships, and I have to say, I've been having some awfully strange dreams since I arrived!'
You say, 'Disposal?'
Surmo shrugs his shoulders with indifference, 'As you know, the temple's surroundings are occasionally infested with filth, and sometimes that filth sneaks into the temple. It's my job to get rid of it and toss whatever junk is left down these [chutes].'
You say, 'What chutes?'
Surmo scratches his head with obvious confusion, 'I don't really know much about the chutes, except that's where I'm told to put the [waste]. I've also been told not to travel down below the chutes under any circumstances, which is fine by me. I'm a stickler for the rules!' The clumsy halfling puts on a proud smile.
You say, 'Waste?'
Surmo says 'I know, I know! This temple's so pretty, it's hard to imagine any kind of waste within its walls. I blame the pig-people down below. I'm sure they're responsible for the strange swirls of filth I've seen in the eastern sentry tower. They appear faster than I can dispose of them lately, but luckily Corcelia sent you to help me!''
Collect waste from soiled essences 0/4 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ Eradicate soiled essences from the temple and clean up their waste.
_Soiled essences spawn in the top of the east tower (the opposite side tower from Sentry Loesk -- around 1800, -330, 406) and in the bottom at the dead sump. As with the swinetor, these are kill updates. There are no actual items involved._
_These mobs don't summon and are snareable/rootable._
Return to Chancellor Corcelia 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Chancellor Corcelia'
Chancellor Corcelia welcomes you back with a guarded smile. 'So you've completed your tasks, \_\_\_\_\_. I trust that you know your way around the temple quite well by now.'
Through a set of initiate tasks, you have met many key people within the Resplendent Temple.
_Rewards:_
205 platinum
Experience

_This is the third in a series of three; a solo task that begins with Chancellor Corcelia in the Resplendent Temple, located at 1700, -15, -22 (inside the front door if coming in from Sarith)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The Light Within"
\- Completion of "An Initiate's Task"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Chancellor Corcelia'
_Without pre-requisites:_
Chancellor Corcelia completely ignores your presence.
_With pre-requisites:_
You say, 'Hail, Chancellor Corcelia'
Chancellor Corcelia wrinkles alir nose in disgust as you step near. 'What is that foul [smell] that surrounds you?'
You say, 'Me? Smell?'
Chancellor Corcelia ignores your words as al steps closer. Without permission, the disgusted Nitore rifles through your bags, retrieving the offending items before placing them into a burlap sack. With alir hand extended far from alir body, al hands you a large pile of waste. 'Do not bring such filth before me! Did you not learn anything from our attendant? You must [dispose] of this refuse immediately!
You say, 'OK, I'll dispose of it...'
Chancellor Corcelia waves a hand at you dismissively, 'Return to Surmo at once and get rid of this waste.'
You have been assigned the task 'At Your Disposal'.
At Chancellor Corcelia's request, deliver the large sack of waste to Surmo so that he can dispose of it.

---

Give the Large Sack of Waste to Surmo 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_On hand-in:_
Surmo looks at the size of the chute and then glances back at the sack of waste with a sigh, 'This bag is much too big. It will never fit!' With as much effort as he can muster, the halfling attempts to stuff the sack into the chute. Clearly not fitting, Surmo uses the weight of his body to shove the bag in, but when it finally budges, the clumsy halfling goes tumbling after!
Find out what happened to Surmo 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ Surmo seems to have slipped down the trash chute.
_Follow Surmo down the chute, clear the mobs in the area. You'll see large cauldrons and a scene that will leave Halflings of all types cringing. As you approach the dead Halflings, 2x "a Nitore butcher" spawn (hit for a max ~12,000; stunnable but not mezzable)._
_NOTE: These butchers will despawn if you leave them idle for more than 60 seconds, but are reportedly re-triggerable._
Kill the Nitore butchers 0/2 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ You've been ambushed by Nitore butchers who appear to have harmed Surmo.
Report your findings to Chancellor Corcelia 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Chancellor Corcelia'
Chancellor Corcelia glowers at you, clearly seething from your accusations, 'How dare you speak out against the Nitore! We welcomed you into our home, and this is how you repay us, by attempting to tarnish our good name? We are the chosen! The purest beings you will ever encounter. Guards! Remove this traitor from my sight!'
Find a way out of the cell 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_You'll be ported to a jail cell, after which you'll see:_
a melodic voice flows into your ears from an unknown direction, 'Well isn't this a pity. How is it that someone like you ends up in the bowels of such a duplicitous temple? It appears as though you could use a little [help].'
_Stand in the middle of the cell, visible, and with no target, and say "help" and "seek":_
You say, 'I need help!'
a melodic voice drifts through the air, 'I would love to help, really I would. But you see, I could use a little help myself. It's a bit lonely beneath the temple. No one visits, no one prays. I've been discarded, tossed aside. If I show you an exit, will you [seek] me out and complete one small and simple task?'
You say, 'I'll seek you out'
a melodic voice speaks only to you, 'Find me nestled beneath the temple amongst the st aming heaps of profuse filth.'
Your task 'At Your Disposal' has been updated.
Find the origin of the melodic voice 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ The voice that whispered to you said it could be found beneath the temple, in a place known as the in-between.
_The origin is "a decayed sentry stone" in the far northeastern part of the "In Between"._
You say, 'Hail, a decayed sentry stone'
a decayed sentry stone is surrounded by a putrid aura which strengthens as you approach, 'It pleases me to see you've found your way here, to the true heart of the temple where imperfections are embraced. The Nitore are obsessed with their plight for purity, casting their unwanted waste into the bowels below, but they are limited in what they can attain. Perfection has its peak, you realize. Filth on the other hand, festers and swells, multiplying in both power and reach.' The decayed sentry stone pulses as the melodic voice continues, 'I assume your presence indicates that you are [ready] to complete your end of the bargain?'
You say, 'I'm ready'
a decayed sentry stone speaks in a voice only you can hear, 'There was a time when living amongst the grime was enough to satiate my hunger, warm waves of decay washing over my surroundings. Lately it's simply not enough. The beasts that roam these pits I call home are brimming with disease, their insides spoiled. I desire the blackened hearts of these pig-people. Fret not, no one will miss them, and their deaths will bring me much joy.'
Kill swinetor and retrieve their filthy hearts 0/4 (Resplendent Temple)
_This updates randomly as you kill "swinetor" mobs (not an actual drop). Emote upon success:_
You rip a blackened heart from the chest of a swinetor corpse.
Return to the decayed sentry stone 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, a decayed sentry stone'
a decayed sentry stone calls to you without using spoken words, 'You've done what I've asked; you've brought me the sickly hearts of many swinetor, but I fear the hunger has not been subdued. It gnaws at my essence, refusing to be ignored. I am but a prisoner to my desires. Please, I implore you; assist me with one last request. There is a Nitore found on the highest floor of the temple who has managed to escape corruption. Bring to alir untainted heart and I shall reward you with treasures beyond your wildest dreams.'
Seek out a pure soul 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ The voice coming from the decayed stone has pleaded with you to recover a pure heart from the uncorrupted Nitore who dwells on the top floor of the temple.
_Find Reklor Irespine all the way at the top of the temple, at about 1800, -100, 436 (travel up the middle parts of the temple)._
You say, 'Hail, Reklor Irespine'
Reklor Irespine appears rather annoyed at your presence, 'Can you not see I am busy with my [research]? What is it that you [want]?'
You say, 'I want information!'
Reklor Irespine eyes you cautiously before speaking, 'An air of disease surrounds you, outsider. I hope you have not given in to the corruption that lives within this temple, like so many others. I have [knowledge] to share with those who will listen, but anything else you may want from me will not be taken without a [fight].'
You say, 'What about your research and knowledge?'
Reklor Irespine looks you over with cautious eyes before responding, 'I've been investigating the curious dichotomy of the sentry stones found within the temple. The Nitore reveal in beauty, praying to their immaculate sentry stones, and the pig-people below worship their ruined remains. Both relics appear to be cut from the same stone, yet the two represent two very different ideals. Have you ever heard these stones speak?'
You say, 'Yes, I've heard them speak'
Reklor Irespine nods with enthusiasm, 'And doesn't their voice sometimes sound strikingly similar? It is my belief these stones are one in the same; two sides of a very twisted being. I am glad I have found a confidant in you, \_\_\_\_\_. Hopefully we can work together to get to the bottom of this mystery.'
You have uncovered the horrible connection between the temple and the in-between below.
_Note that if you say "fight" to Reklor Irespine, he attacks (hits for a max ~65,000)._
_Rewards:_
Experience
410 platinum
