_This is a solo task that begins with Plann in the Resplendent Temple, located at 2120, 430, -340. This is in the underground cave system outside the temple. He's in a dead-end tunnel in the southwest part of the caves._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Plann'
Plann gazes up at you with a cautious curiosity. With one hoof extended, the young swinetor slowly reaches out to touch your armor before yanking his arm back in fear. 'What're yuh? Why'd something so clean come down ['ere]?'
You say, ''Ere?'
Plann says 'This's the in-between, home to swinetor like me an' other creatures nobody wanted.' Clearly impressed by your presence, the budding necromancer takes a slow step closer, 'Wanta see a [trick]?''
You say, 'What trick?'
Plann throws his small snout into the air and snorts, 'I know whole bunches of tricks, just you wait. Yuh'll be so impressed with Plann! But can't do tricks without supplies. Yuh wanta [help] Plann out? Clean stranger won't be sorry!'
You say, 'I'll help you out'
Plann kicks his hooves in the mud with excitement, 'Yuh bring supplies, and Plann will do tricks!'
You have been assigned the task 'Plannty of Tricks'.
Plann has a few tricks up his sleeve and would love to show them to you! All he needs are a few items...

---

Retrieve wings from mosquitoes 0/2 (Resplendent Temple)
Retrieve whiskers from rats 0/2 (Resplendent Temple)
_Rats and mosquitoes are found in the cave system. The task updates randomly after kills; no item is involved._
Return to Plann 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Plann'
Plann lets out a snort so loud it shakes the surrounding walls, 'Clean stranger looks lots better now!'
You are turned into a mosquito for a few moments.
Speak with Plann 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Plann'
Plann speaks quickly, fearing your departure, 'Don't leave! Plann can do more! One [special] trick just for the clean stranger, Plann never done before.'
You say, 'Special?'
Plann grins devilishly from ear to ear, 'Yuh bring just one bone marrow, Plann do the trick for everybody! So simple!'
Give any type of bone marrow to Plann 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Bone marrow drops from animal type creatures above ground, outside the temple. You can use any type to update this step (pre-lootable; be ready for a fight upon turn-in, as "an abomination" spawns and attacks you)._
Defeat Plann's creation 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
Speak with Plann 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Plann'
Plann looks from side to side with worry, hoping you didn't notice his trick go horribly wrong. 'Special trick is a success! Clean stranger still alive!' The young swinetor returns to practicing his tricks with a smile.

_This solo task begins with Hoarder Paoliq in the Resplendent Temple, located at 2200, -15, -330. This is in the underground network of caves (about three open caverns deep if travelling through them from the east entrance at 2705, -400, -38)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Hoarder Paoliq'
Hoarder Paoliq sticks his snout close to your armor and sniffs, 'Yuh don't smell like an [Ulork].' The filthy swinetor steps back to get a full view, 'Yuh don't look like one of them neither.' Convinced you are not a member of his rival clan, Hoarder Paoliq relaxes a bit.
You say, 'Of course I'm not an Ulork; are you blind?!'
Hoarder Paoliq spits on the ground upon hearing his rival clan's name, 'Those sad excuses for swinetors are the sworn enemy of Clan Piq`a, an' I got a [plan] to kill every last one of 'em.'
You say, 'What plan?'
Hoarder Paoliq grins, baring a mouthful of rotten teeth, 'Don't wanta tell yuh all my secrets just yet, but those Ulork swine will get what's comin' to 'em. Are yuh [in], or should I just kill yuh too?'
You say, 'I'm in!'
Hoarder Paoliq says 'So much to do before the big plan explodes! I'll give yuh an easy task, yuh'll like it. Nothin' like diggin' in an Ulork's ear, or pickin' the hairs from a grove braxi!''
You have been assigned the task 'Death to Clan Ulork!'.
Hoarder Paoliq has a plan to destroy Clan Ulork, but he needs your help to ensure its success!
Gather clumps of ear wax from dead Ulorks.
Collect coarse hair from braxi that roam the grove.
Pick a fire flower, which usually grows on the walls that lead down to the in-between.

---

Kill Ulorks for their ear wax 0/5 (Resplendent Temple)
_This step will update randomly as you kill "Ulork" mobs. A fair amount of them can be found in the northern branch of the west tunnels (2600, 370, -330)._
_Success message upon mob death:_ An Ulork Vicar has earfuls of sticky, yellow wax.
_Failure message upon mob death:_ An Ulork Vicar has clean ears.
Kill braxi for their coarse hair 0/5 (Resplendent Temple)
_This step will update randomly as you kill "braxi" mobs above ground outside the temple._
_Success message upon mob death:_ a grove braxi is covered in coarse hair. You cut a lock for Hoarder Paoliq.
_Failure message upon mob death:_ a grazing braxi has no suitable coarse hair.
Collect a fire flower 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Fire Flowers are found growing along the walls of the in-between (the large gorge surrounding the Temple). Using third-person view, you'll be able to see them growing along the wall (one such location is next to the entrance bridge)._
_Use Levitate and pluck the flower from the wall on your way down. This isn't an actual item; only an update._
Speak with Hoarder Paoliq 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Hoarder Paoliq'
Hoarder Paoliq takes the items from you and immediately gets to work crafting a rather large torch. 'Here's the secret weapon! Take it into the throne room and light it up. Yuh should be able to burn the whole place down!'
_You receive a Piq`a Crafted Torch._
Burn down the Ulork throne room 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_The Ulork Throne Room can be found in the northern branch of the west tunnels. In the center of the large room is a row of protruding bones (around 2830, 375, -330). Pre-clear, and then stand between the teeth near the back by the 'throne' and click the torch. This spawns a mob._
Defeat a blazing Ulork 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_This mob is slowable and hits for a max ~10,500._
Speak with Hoarder Paoliq 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Hoarder Paoliq'
Hoarder Paoliq lets out a raunchy snort, 'I can still hear the squeals of those useless Ulork!'
You have helped Hoarder Paoliq burn down his rival clan's throne room.
_Rewards:_
410 platinum

_This is a solo task that begins with Udgar the Brave in the Resplendent Temple, located at 2900, 130, -325. This is in the underground network of caves -- in a dead end in the north-central part of the caves._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Udgar the Brave'
Udgar the Brave stares you boldly in the eye, 'I demand to know who sent yuh! It was those swinetor imposter [Piq`as], wasn't it?'
You say, 'The Piq`as?'
Udgar the Brave squints his eye at you skeptically, 'Yuh come down here an' yuh have no idea about the war that rages on between Clan Ulork and the lesser Clan Piq'a?' The burly swinetor pauses to think before snorting with excitement, 'This must mean yuh don't have a [side] yet!'
You say, 'A side?'
Udgar the Brave shouts 'Clan Ulork claims \_\_\_\_\_ as its own!'
Udgar the Brave looks you up and down, 'Yuh're not much to look at, nothing but skin an' bones, but I bet yuh could lead an army. Yuh'll need weapons first, and the best place to get 'em is to steal 'em from Piq`as!'
You have been assigned the task 'Death to Clan Piq`a!'.
Udgar the Brave thinks you'd make a great army leader! If you bring him the proper supplies, he'll raise you an undead army to help defeat the Piq`a Clan.

---

Remove bones from blobs of filth 0/2 (Resplendent Temple)

Speak with Udgar the Brave 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Udgar the Brave'
Udgar the Brave takes the requested items from you with a grin, 'These bones will build a good army, but I need an essence from the undead to animate each soldier.'
Capture essences from weakened corpses 0/4 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ Udgar needs essences from corpses in order to raise your undead army.
_This step updates randomly as you kill rotted and animated corpses in the in-between._
Speak with Udgar the Brave 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Udgar the Brave'
Udgar the Brave takes the essences, and immediately begins to cast a spell, 'I have raised yuh an army of undead! They're already surrounding the Piq`a throne room, just waitin' for yuhr command. I can cast my magic to sneak yuh inside when yuh're [ready].'
Piq'a Throne Room is now available to you.

LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...

_Zone into an instanced version of Resplendent Temple. You'll see four undead skeletons in front of you which are at your command. Direct them to attack the Piq`a mobs in the area (to get them to attack the fighter, say "fighter"). The mob types are:_

\- a Piq`a defender

\- a Piq`a guard
\- a Piq`a priest
\- a Piq`a royal

\- a Piq`a warlock

an undead lieutenant says 'Preparing for battle, commander!'
_Once all Piq`a mobs are dead, you can zone out by speaking with one of the skeletons._
Return to Udgar the brave 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
You say, 'Hail, Udgar the Brave'
At your command, Udgar's undead army destroyed all the Piq`as within the throne room.
Udgar the Brave revels in your victory, 'Sholoth smiles on Clan Ulork today!'

_This solo kill task begins with Vaericus the Vainglorious in the Resplendent Temple, located at 500, 35, 5 (just north of the zone-in from Sarith)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Vaericus the Vainglorious'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Greetings to you as well, my friend,' alis eyes narrow, calculatingly, 'What is your business in this place? Have you come to [see the temple]?'
You say, 'I've come to see the temple'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Ahh, I can see you like myself, appreciate a thing of true beauty. A pity, is it not, that the inhabitants of such a magnificent temple, should be so [decrepit] of heart themselves?'
You say, 'Decrepit?'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Indeed, they are, my friend. They would most likely kill you as soon as look at you. It saddens me to think they defile this temple daily with their very presence.' It gives you a sideways glance, stroking its tentacles thoughtfully, 'If only there was some way to [eliminate] them..'
You say, 'I'll eliminate some of them'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Why, that is truly a brilliant idea, my friend!' alis eyes glow with malice, but alis voice stays friendly and jovial, 'If you were to slay them, we could expunge them, and return the sanctity of this once glorious temple.'
_As task window pops up with three tasks to choose from._
You have been assigned the task 'Purging The Impure'.
Vaericus has asked you to rid the temple of its inhabitants.

You say, 'I've come to see the temple'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Ahh, I can see you like myself, appreciate a thing of true beauty. A pity, is it not, that the inhabitants of such a magnificent temple, should be so [decrepit] of heart themselves?'
You say, 'Decrepit?'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Indeed, they are, my friend. They would most likely kill you as soon as look at you. It saddens me to think they defile this temple daily with their very presence.' It gives you a sideways glance, stroking its tentacles thoughtfully, 'If only there was some way to [eliminate] them..'
You say, 'I'll eliminate some of them'
Vaericus the Vainglorious says, in Alaran, 'Why, that is truly a brilliant idea, my friend!' alis eyes glow with malice, but alis voice stays friendly and jovial, 'If you were to slay them, we could expunge them, and return the sanctity of this once glorious temple.'
_As task window pops up with three tasks to choose from._
You have been assigned the task 'An End To Perfection'.
Vaericus has asked you to rid the temple of its inhabitants.

_This group mission begins with Reklor Irespine in the Resplendent Temple, located at 1810, -100, 440 (from the Pillars zone-in, head due south into the building and continue south until you come to the last room; Reklor is in the southeast room)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The Light Within"
\- Completion of "An Initiate's Task"
\- Completion of "At Your Disposal"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Reklor Irespine'
_Without pre-requisites:_
Reklor Irespine appears more interested in reading than speaking to you.
_With pre-requisites:_
You say, 'Hail, Reklor Irespine'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Since my [revelation], I have devoted every waking minute to uncovering the truth surrounding the sentry stones. The Nitore will have you believe that the stones they prominently display are the only stones in existence, yet you and I both know that not to be true. I believe that the Nitore have [hidden] away many more stones, possibly to stifle the voices that speak of things other than beauty.'
You say, 'What about your revelation?'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Do you really wish to hear my history? It will surprise you, I'm sure. While my [story] doesn't directly involve the task at hand, I suppose it could shed some light on why I'm still here.'
You say, 'What's your story?'
Reklor Irespine speaks with a reminiscent smile, 'It has been quite some time since I left my studies in Sarith to follow my kin and alir dream of finding peace and purity at the edge of the temple. While I'd originally thought I'd find myself bored and uninspired, I instead found a mentor in Chancellor Corcelia, who insisted she saw a light within me. Before too long I, myself, became a mindful [member] of the Nitore, praising purity and shunning anything that didn't shine in the resplendent light that Ladrys had bestowed upon us.'
You say, 'You were a member?'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Over time I abandoned my cerebral studies, instead focusing my full attention on how to [rid] myself of decay and achieve the highest form of beauty. Still a mortal being at my core, my body inched closer to death every day. This was not suitable for someone so obsessed with perfection. I was not alone in my ideals, however.'
You say, 'How did you rid yourself of it?'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Long before the first stones were placed to erect this temple, the Nitore had devised a way to separate the purity and [waste] within one's soul. The former consumed by the cleansed to feed their insatiable hunger for perfestion, and the latter, discreetly disposed of and left to fester.'
You say, 'Waste?'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Many would believe this temple was constructed to house the splendor that the Nitore claim to hold in such high regard, but the truth is something much more sinister. The beautiful walls designed to retain resplendence, were in fact built to cover up the pit of waste that grew along with the Nitore's aesthetic [greed].'
You say, 'Greed?'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Without much interest in anything other than perfection, I spent my days praying to the sentry stones, hoping they would sing songs of beauty in my presence. For days and days I sat, surrounded by nothing but silence. After nearly a week without moving, I finally heard a faint whisper from within the sentry stone, yet it was nothing like I had expected. The soft, sweet song I had hoped to hear instead manifested in a guttural tone that gnawed at my ears. The [voice] hissed of disease and decay, beckoning me to venture beneath the temple and bask in filth.'
You say, 'What voice?'
Reklor Irespine shakes alir head at the memory still fresh in alir mind, 'I thought I must be going crazy. How could these relics of beauty praise such imperfection? That haunting question was enough to ignite the spark of curiosity within me once again, and from that day forth I spent my time buried in research, determined to uncover the truth surrounding the sentry stones.'
You say, 'Where have the Nitore hidden more stones?'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'You have already found a stone beneath the temple that I hadn't discovered. Why couldn't there be more? I'd say the stone's desire for my death is a clear indication that my research is headed in the right direction. Will you [help] me, \_\_\_\_\_?'
You say, 'I'll help'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'I am very grateful. It is a lonely eyistence, living as a shrouded outsider amidst the Nitore. My purity has already been called into question. I fear what would become of me if I were caught searching the in-between for stones that aren't supposed to exist. You on the other hand, could travel into the [depths] of the temple almost unnoticed.'
You say, 'The depths?'
Reklor Irespine nods, 'The in-between is where I believe our search should start. Let me know when you are ready to [begin], and I hill see that you get there safely.'
You have been assigned the task 'Secrets of the Stones'.
Reklor Irespine has asked that you locate and destroy any sentry stones found within the temple, collecting any stone fragments in the process.
You say, 'Ready to begin!'
Reklor Irespine leads you to the in-between beneath the temple.
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered The Resplendent Temple.

_This group mission begins with Reklor Irespine in the Resplendent Temple, located at 1810, -100, 440 (from the Pillars zone-in, head due south into the building and continue south until you come to the last room; Reklor is in the southeast room)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The Light Within"
\- Completion of "An Initiate's Task"
\- Completion of "At Your Disposal"
\- Completion of "Secrets of the Stones"
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Reklor Irespine'
_Without pre-requisites:_
Reklor Irespine appears more interested in reading than speaking to you.
_With pre-requisites:_
Reklor Irespine reaches out for you as al struggles to speak, 'I owe you my life, \_\_\_\_\_, and many apologies. My mind and body betrayed me as a foreign [essence] entered my soul, bringing with it a volatile rage which I was unable to control. Without your [help], I fear the possessing spirit would have taken over completely.'
You say, 'What essence?'
Reklor Irespine winces as al recalls the recent events, 'As you placed the stones within the temple, I felt a surge of energy flow through the air. It was as though the sentry stones were conduits for spirits of some sort, allowing passage from their world into this one. Once the final stone was set, a crippling wave rushed over me. My body was still, but I could feel my veins begin to flow with a foreign power... And then I blacked out, only to awake [broken] and filled with painful regret over what I had unknowingly done.'
You say, 'Broken?'
Reklor Irespine pauses, sucking in air with visible discomfort, 'I fear I won't ever fully recover from the trauma my body received, but something must be done. The power within the force that possessed me; it was greater than anything I have ever known. Where a [power] like that could come from? I can hardly guess, but it seems to manifest itself using the sentry stones.'
You say, 'What about the power?'
Reklor Irespine speaks with certainty, 'It is clear to me what needs to be done. The sentry stones must be destroyed. I am no match for the power they contain, but you somehow managed to resist possession. Whether by luck or mental fortitude, it does not matter. Tell me, do you have a large force [willing] to destroy the stones, or perhaps you are [able] to complete the task with a smaller group?'
You say, 'We're able to do so with a small group'
Reklor Irespine says, in Alaran, 'Maintain your focus, and keep our goal at the forefront of your mind. Let me know when you are [prepared] to begin.'
You have been assigned the task 'Two Sides of the Stone'.
You say, 'We're prepared!'
Reklor Irespine bows deeply with gratitude, 'I will pray for your success.'

---

**Summary**
\- Don't zone out, the event will reset and you will have to start all over again.
\- Hail the sentry stone to spawn the Avatar
\- Take the Avatar down to 75%
\- Decay #1
\-\-\- Use no cures here; stay in zombie form and keep the DOTs on you.
\- Splendor #1
\-\-\- One person must click off all their buffs (including songs and auras), and stay buffless.
\- Take the Avatar down to 50%
\- Decay #2
\-\-\- The named will emote for someone to jump out the window.
\- Splendor #2
\-\-\- Everyone must cure "Filth" by running to the location of the "Purity Stone".
\- Take the Avatar down to 25%
\- Decay #3
\-\-\- Keep a book passed around.
\- Splendor #3
\-\-\- Keep a book passed around.
\- Kill the Avatar

03. Speak to the sentry stone 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



_NOTE: Don't hail the sentry stone until you're ready for a fight._



You say, 'Hail, a sentry stone'




a sentry stone begins to tremble as whispers of beauty and decay fill the room.




_The Avatar of Ladrys spawns and attacks._

04. Engage the avatar spawned by the stone 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



_It hits for a max ~12,500 and shifts forms between "Avatar of Ladrys" and "Avatar of Sholoth". Ladrys casts "Purification" while Sholoth casts "Wave of Filth":_



Purification: Single Target, Disease (-900)


1: 60% Chance to trigger: Ruin Magic _(a dispell)_

2: Silence _(1 tick)_



Wave of Filth: Single Target, Disease (-900)


1: Amnesia (Silence vs Melee Effect) _(1 tick)_

2: Decrease HP when cast by 27700




_While the Avatar is in Ladrys' form, adds called "inner darkness" spawn. These take the form of a player and attack, hitting for a max ~9,000. They have an emote:_



The inner darkness is becoming very unstable.




_Shortly after that emote, they explode (despawn), casting the AE "Inner Darkness" in the process:_



Inner Darkness: PB AE 30', Magic (-900)


1: Blindness (1)


2: Decrease HP when cast by 43300




_While the Avatar is in Sholoth's form, untargetable black oozes spawn on random people. These have a damage aura, so step away from them (they despawn after a short time):_



Sludge: Single Target 0', Disease (-900)


1: Decrease Movement by 60%


2: Decrease Mana by 5000


3: Decrease Endurance by 2000


4: Decrease Hitpoints by 26300




_Once the Avatar reaches 75%, it goes inactive. You see:_



Avatar of Ladrys trembles while crashing to the floor as the essences of decay and splendor flee, causing the sentry stone to split in two.




_Task Window Says:_ The possessing essence has split, fleeing to the west and east towers. Hail the sentry stones to travel to the towers and defeat the beings that now dwell there.




_This opens up the next two steps and spawns two stones at either side of the room: "a perfect stone" and "a diseased stone". You'll find one named in each of the temple's two towers: The Shadow of Decay and the Vision of Splendor. To get to these mobs, you use these two stones._



_When ready, either walk into the stone's proximity (you'll automatically port to their tower), or follow their dialogue:_



You say, 'Hail, a diseased stone'




a diseased stone emits faint whispers of [decay].




_Walking into the stone or saying "decay" ports up to the Shadow of Decay's tower._



You say, 'Hail, a perfect stone'




a perfect stone emits faint whispers of [splendor].




_Walking into the stone or saying "splendor" ports up to the Vision of Splendor's tower._



_NOTE: You can do either tower first; it doesn't matter. You can also take a break before porting up to a tower. There is no timer (other than the task timer itself)._






---


05. Defeat the Shadow of Decay 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



The Shadow of Decay calls to all those before it, 'I demand an offering of rot and decay, made from the flesh of your own!'




All must succumb to rot in order to make an offer of flesh.




_The Shadow of Decay hits for a max ~12,500 and AEs "Rot", which leads to "Decaying Flesh" (which gives a zombie illusion):_



Rot: Targeted AE 30', Disease (-900)


1: Decrease Hitpoints by 14000 per tick


2: Increase corruption counter by 30


3: Improved Spell Effect: Decaying Flesh




Decaying Flesh: Self 0', Corruption (-900)


1: 100% Chance to trigger: Zombie Rot


2: Decrease Hitpoints by 8400 per tick


3: Increase corruption counter by 30


4: Decrease Attack Speed by 40%




_Don't use any cures or anything that has a cure component. The DOTs and illusion must stay on everyone in order to keep the Shadow from regenerating. He'll check for this requirement every 6 seconds, so it must be kept on you at all times._



_As long as even one person doesn't have the DOT/illusion on them, the Shadow will regenerate 25% per tick._



_This step updates once you kill the Shadow._






---


06. Defeat the Vision of Splendor 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



Vision of Splendor calls to all those before it, 'Impure souls, tainted with magic, are no challenge for me!'




One among many must rid themselves of all and any magical effects.




_The Vision of Splendor hits for a max ~12,500 and casts the single-target one-tick duration "Purification" on random people:_



Purification: Single Target, Disease (-900)


1: 60% Chance to trigger: Ruin Magic _(a dispell)_

2: Silence _(1 tick)_



_Once the Vision emotes, one person needs to click off all their buffs and remain that way until it's dead. Note: Auras and songs count as well._



_As long as everyone remains buffed, the Vision regenerates 25% per tick. Only one person needs to go buffless for this fight._



_This step updates once you kill the Vision._

07. Return to the central tower and engage the avatar once again 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



_Task Window Says:_ The essence is one, once again. Fight it within the central tower.




_Don't port back down until you're ready for a fight. The Avatar switches forms and has the same fight abilities as earlier. Once it reaches 50%, it goes inactive and the next two steps open up._






---


08. Defeat the Shadow of Decay 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



One among you must throw themselves from the tower as a sacrifice to Sholoth!




_During this encounter, the Shadow of Decay casts "Wave of Filth":_



Wave of Filth: Single Target, Disease (-900)


1: Amnesia (Silence vs Melee Effect) _(1 tick)_

2: Decrease HP when cast by 27700




_As the fight goes on, a random person (other than the tank) will get an emote. That person must jump out a window. (Note: Levitation effects greatly slow your jump speed, so click them off before initiating this portion of the event.)_



_Everyone Sees:_ One among you must throw yourselves from the tower as a sacrifice to Sholoth!




_Target Sees:_ Jump from this tower as the ultimate sacrifice to Sholoth!




_On a Successful Jump:_ You have made the proper sacrifice.




_On a Failed Jump (Shadow regens 25%):_ Shadow of Decay shouts, '\_\_\_\_\_ failed to make the sacrifice!'




_NOTE: Only the player with the emote should make the jump. If you have the emote and jump, you'll be ported back into the room. If you don't have the emote, you'll simply fall to your death._



_This step updates once you kill the Shadow._






---


09. Defeat the Vision of Splendor 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



Vision of Splendor calls to those within its reach, 'Cleanse yourself of the filth that surrounds you!'




_The Vision still casts the "Purification" spell on random targets:_



Purification: Single Target, Disease (-900)


1: 60% Chance to trigger: Ruin Magic _(a dispell)_

2: Silence _(1 tick)_



_In addition, it will cast the spell "Filth" on everyone but its target (the tank):_



Filth: Single Target, Unresistable (-900)


1: Decrease Hitpoints by 27000 per tick




_At the same time this happens, a "Purity Stone" (sentry stone model appears at a random spot around the room's perimeter). You have about six seconds to move to its location to cure the "Filth" spell. You'll see this emote when the Vision AEs "Filth":_



You must cleanse yourself near the purity stone.




_You'll see this once you've been cleaned:_



You have been cleansed.




_If someone fails, you'll see this (and the Vision regenerates 25%):_



Vision of Splendor shouts '\_\_\_\_\_ is still covered in filth!'




_This step updates once you kill the Vision._






---


10. Return to the central tower and engage the avatar once again 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



_Don't port back down until you're ready for a fight. The Avatar switches forms and has the same fight abilities as earlier. Once it reaches 25%, it goes inactive and the next two steps open up._






---


11. Defeat the Shadow of Decay 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



Shadow of Decay calls to all within its reach, 'Sing your chants of decay! Fill your minds and bodies with disease, or suffer my wrath!'




_During this fight, black oozes spawn on random people. These have a damage aura (the same ones that spawn with the Avatar of Sholoth). The Shadow of Decay, itself, doesn't have any AEs here._



_Shortly after engaging, a random person will be given a book, "Book of Chants" (you'll see an emote indicating who receives it)._



_Keep the book passed around (target a player and right-click, do not trade the book). The book, when clicked, casts "Chant of Decay" on you. Everyone has to keep this spell up via the book:_



Chant of Decay: Single 0', Unresistable (-900)


1: Amnesia (Silence vs Melee Effect) _(2 ticks)_

2: Decrease Endurance by 300 per tick


3: Decrease Hitpoints by 11300 per tick


4: Trigger Effect: Strained Voice on Fade




_NOTE: If "Chant of Decay" fades from you, a new effect takes over: "Strained Voice" (lasts 1-2 ticks and still counts toward the NPC's "chant" requirement)._


_You can still click it, but you won't get rebuffed with "Chant of Decay" (which you need on you in order to prevent the NPC from regenerating)._



\\* If you pass while you have Chant/Prayer, nothing bad happens, but the duration of Chant/Prayer does \*not\* update.


\\* If you pass while you have Strained Voice, the mob heals.




What you want to do then, is wait until \*BOTH\* have faded and then pass the book. This will start the effects all over again.




_If you get "Strained Voice" on you, wait until it fades and then quickly pass the book along before the named takes notice._



_Upon Passing the Book:_ You recite the Chant of Decay as you pass the book to \_\_\_\_\_.




_Upon Failure (Shadow regens 25%):_ The Chant of Decay must be maintained.




_This step updates once you kill the Shadow._






---


12. Defeat the Vision of Splendor 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



Vision of Splendor calls to all within its reach, 'Pray for purity, to cleanse your minds and bodies, or suffer my wrath!'




_During this fight, "inner darkness" adds spawn and attack, hitting for a max ~9,000 and casting "Inner Darkness" (the same add types that spawn with the Avatar of Ladrys). The Vision of Splendor, itself, doesn't have any AEs here._



_Shortly after engaging, a random person will be given a book, "Book of Prayers" (you'll see an emote indicating who receives it)._



_Keep the book passed around (target a player and right-click). The book, when clicked, casts "Prayer of Purity" on you. Everyone has to keep this spell up via the book:_



Prayer of Purity: Single 0', Unresistable (-900)


1: Silence _(2 ticks)_

2: Decrease Mana by 900 per tick


3: Decrease Hitpoints by 11300 per tick


4: Trigger Effect: Strained Voice on Fade




_NOTE: If "Prayer of Purity" fades from you, a new effect takes over: "Strained Voice" (lasts 1-2 ticks and still counts toward the NPC's "prayer" requirement). This effect may impact your ability to click the book. You can pass it, but you won't get rebuffed with "Prayer of Purity" (which you need on you in order to prevent the NPC from regenerating)._



_If you get "Strained Voice" on you, wait until it fades and then quickly pass the book along before the named takes notice._



_Upon Passing the Book:_ You recite the Prayer of Purity as you pass the book to \_\_\_\_\_.




_Upon Failure (Vision regens 25%):_ The Prayer of Purity must be maintained.




_This step updates once you kill the Vision._



_NOTE: The task locks at this point._






---


13. Return to the central tower and defeat the avatar 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



_Task Window Says:_ Defeat the possessed Nitore once and for all!




_Don't port back down until you're ready for a fight. The Avatar switches forms and has the same fight abilities as earlier. This step updates upon its death._



Claim your reward from the ornate chest 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)



_Upon opening the chest:_



You have destroyed the corrupted sentry stones, so power can no longer flow through them within the Resplendent Temple.

_Rewards:_
273 platinum
Eltarki's Diary - Priceless Beauty

_This task is automatically assigned to you as you approach the Shrine of Alra in the Pillars of Alra (up the ramp from the bottom of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
The mysterious statue seems to beckon you towards it...
You have been assigned the task 'The First Pilgrimage'.
A curiously shaped stone lies at the foot of the marble statue, perhaps you should investigate it.

---

Recover the Discarded Stone Tablet 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
At your feet you notice a curiously shaped rock. You hear a faint whisper as you take the stone into your hand... Perhaps one of the local evangelists could shed some light on its origins.
_This opens up steps 2, 6, 10, and 14 (the four "Speak with..." steps) which can be done in any order._

---

Speak with Selulian at the Pillar of the Arcane 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Selulian of Melretia is outside the northeastern pillar (360, -620, 450)._
You say, 'Hail, Selulian of Melretia'
Selulian of Melretia prepares to dismiss you until it notices the stone in your hand. It speaks with renewed interest, 'The blessed power of Alra be upon you, traveler! Come in [search of enlightenment] no doubt?'
You say, 'Yes, a search of enlightenment...'
Selulian of Melretia smiles, 'I had no doubt, any traveler that is industrious enough to recover one of our most ancient artifacts is clearly on a quest for greater things. Let me be the one with the great honor of welcoming you to the [Pillar of true worship].'
You say, 'Pillar of true worship?'
Selulian of Melretia says, in Alaran, 'Yes traveler, do not be drawn into the perversion and ignorance that befalls the other pillars, for only the purest form of Alra's magic should be worshiped... But I can see in your eyes you are uninterested in my lectures and more focused on the artifact in your hand. Let me hold it a moment so I can speak of its history.'
_Give him the Discarded Stone Tablet._
Selulian of Melretia stares closely at the stone for a moment before speaking, 'Amazing, simply amazing! Bits of our oldest recorded history are etched into this fragment. Here...' Selulian returns the stone to you, '... I have a small [favor] to ask of you before I share what was written.'
You say, 'A favor?'
Selulian of Melretia says, in Alaran, 'A small endeavor for one as experienced as yourself, simply to prove your faith. Seek out a few materials to construct the tabard of our order, some of the remnants of those accursed beasts of natural corruption should do. Take these parts and return to our library. There you will find several scriptures that detail our sacred symbol. Take the components and the instructions to our purification room and craft a tabard of our order, we will have much to discuss in the future!'
_And if you hail him again:_
Selulian of Melretia looks at you curiously, 'It was a simple errand, construct the tabard of our order. I can't imagine your memory is so poor that you would forget what you have just been instructed to do... Return to me when its construction is complete so we can discuss the origin of the tablet in more detail.'
Obtain the materials to construct Melretia's tabard 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Selulian requests that you collect the necessary components to construct the tabard of its sect. The vines of an okiina or naturewalker will suffice.
_Kill treants and living plants around the outside of the Nature Pillar (southwest) until you get 3x "Wound-Verdant Cords"._
Obtain the pattern to create Melretia's tabard 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have obtained the vines, return to the Pillar of the Arcane and find the tabard pattern. It should be in the lower library on one of the bookshelves.Go up 5 or 6 floors. Can be on any of them levels.
_To get this item, you just need to run around the lower library floor until you get it on your cursor._
Infuse the Natural Minerals with Arcane Essence 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ In the lower lab is an arcane infuser. Use the vines along with the tabard to create Melretia's Tabard.
_The "Infuser of the Arcane" is located at about 400, -840, 670 (two floors down from the library). Combine the four items to create "Tabard of Melretia's Order"._

---

Speak with Il`Rator at the Pillar of Nature 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Il`Rator of Anriella is found outside the southwestern pillar (-345, 610, 435)._
You say, 'Hail, Il`Rator of Anriella'
Il`Rator of Anriella says, in Alaran, 'Yes friends, we stand united against the forces of corruption! All will know of our purity by the end of days...' The preacher ceases its shouting for a moment and notices you. It seems to speak past you, yet you get the feeling it is calling out to you, 'Travelers, searchers, seekers of knowledge, come forth and repent. We are the [Pillar of Nature, of Life, of Growth]!'
You say, 'Pillar of Nature?'
Il`Rator of Anriella points in your direction and shouts, 'Yes! May the beauty of Alra's land bless you! Come forth traveler, do not think I have not seen the potential in you, the artifacts you wield and lives you could change. What is it that brings you to our holy grounds? Is it fortune, fame, enlightenment, or perhaps [information]?
You say, 'Information?'
Il`Rator of Anriella says, in Alaran, 'A wise seeker you are, Alra would be proud! I see that you hold an artifact of our people, come forth and allow me to observe it so that I may share its information with the crowd. Fear not, my people do not covet earthly goods as so many of the corrupted beasts that tromp through our lands, I shall return what is rightfully yours after reading its inscriptions.'
_Give the tablet to Il`Rator:_
Il`Rator of Anriella breaths deeply as if preparing to speak then stops short, it stares at the stone with intense focus for a moment before continuing. It turns to you and speaks quietly, abandoning its previous mannerisms, 'What you hold here is of dire significance to both your and my people. What is written upon it is not for the eyes and ears of others, for it details the origins of my people's life on this world. I shall return this artifact to you but I must make a [request] before I discuss its meaning any further...'
You say, 'What request?'
Il`Rator of Anriella says, in Alaran, 'I must know that your faith is true to our cause. The task is fair and should not be too challenging for one such as yourself. Seek out materials to craft the tabard of our people so that you may don the seal of life and hold audience in our court. You will need the remnants of the cold-lifeless beasts which can be purified within our halls. Instructions on the tabard's creation can be found in our library. Go now and may the blessings of Alra be upon you!'
_And if you hail him again:_
Il`Rator of Anriella throws its head back in laughter, 'The life and love of Alra be blessed!' It speaks past you, 'Friends, would it be within your grasp to believe that the world contains people that do not share our love of life? No, of course not! We are beset on all sides by the withering of decay, of darkness, of cold and lifeless heretics! We should be so lucky as to find a traveler willing to express their faith...' It continues to speak as if indirectly mocking you...
Obtain the materials to construct Anriella's tabard 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Il`Rator demands that you obtain the lifeless ore of the arcane. The ore of the animated guardians or wards will likely appease his demand.
_Kill mobs around the Arcane Pillar (northeast) until you've 3x "Malleable-Lifeless Ore"._
Obtain the pattern to create Anriella's tabard 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ With the ore obtained, return to the Pillar of Nature and find the tabard pattern. It should be in the upper library on one of the bookshelves.
_Head to the Pillar of Nature (southwest) and up to its sixth floor (five elevator rides up) and run around until you get "Ornately-Drawn Pattern of Nature"._
Breathe life into the Arcane Materials with Natural Essence 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ In the upper lab is a natural infuser. Use the ore along with the pattern to create Anriella's tabard.
_The "Infuser of Life" is on the fourth floor (two drops down from the upper library) at about -360, 820, 731. Combine the four items to create "Tabard of Anriella's Order"._

---

Speak with Wrakt at the Pillar of the Black 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Wrakt of Fal`Kaa is just inside the southeastern pillar (-630, -355, 355)._
You say, 'Hail, Wrakt of Fal`Kaa'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa speaks quietly, 'Welcome to you traveler, I sense a kindred spirit in you. You are a seeker, a learner, you seek something our Pillar can offer you. In your hand you hold something of great [value], immaterial value of course, but true riches are not measured in the physical...'
You say, 'Value?'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa smiles before continuing in its quiet tone, 'Consider for a moment a flickering candle, the object itself and its violent light are of no worth, but its use is of immeasurable value. I warn you now that should you cross our halls that you do so without disturbing the peace of shadows, it is not our place to evoke chaos... But I digress, you come seeking information about the stone you hold in your hand [do you not]?
You say, 'I do'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa says, in Alaran, 'The stone like all things material is simply a shell, a host. Just as we are fleeting beings on this planet, so is the knowledge of our history. I shall read what is written upon the stone and share the wealth of its knowledge. Allow me a closer look, and fear not, I would rather live in ignorance than steal from a seeker such as yourself...'
_Hand in the tablet:_
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa eyes the stone curiously and nods, 'The wealth contained within this stone is admirable but not revolutionary.' It returns the stone and continues, 'There is an unnecessary division between my people as you have no doubt seen, the stone details the story of a trickster who shone the light of chaos upon a unified world.' It pauses, 'Not to rescind my promise, but I must humbly request that you [prove] your dedication to our cause before I continue to divulge our sacred history.'
You say, 'I'll prove myself'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa bows its head, 'I thank you for your patience. This should be a simple errand, after which I will be happy to share more with you. You must don the crest of our order and rid yourself of the chaos of light. To create the crest you will have to rid the light of a powerful material, the remnants of a shining beast should do fine. When you have obtained the materials, return to our library and find a tome of seals. With this in hand, travel to our extraction halls and expunge the chaos from the material and form it into our holy crest. When this task is done I shall have more to say to you. Be well, traveler.
_And if you hail him again:_
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa bows its head, 'Return when you have completed the errand requested of you. I eagerly await the news of your success.'
Obtain the materials to construct Fal`Kaa's Crest 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Wrakt insists that you acquire the essences of a few light beasts. Wisps and hoppers will likely have what you need.
_Kill mobs around the Light Pillar (northwest) until you obtain 3x "Brilliant Orb of Purity"._
Obtain the pattern to create Fal`Kaa's Crest 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ With the essences of light obtained, find the pattern of the shadow crest in the upper library of the Pillar of the Black.
_Head to the Pillar of the Black (southeast) and to the upper library (6th floor, so five floors up from the entrance level). NOTE: Don't be shrunk for this update, or you may be too short to reach the location range._
You spot an interesting looking tome that is decorated with the seal of the Pillar on the shelf.
_You receive an "Unreadable Pattern of Shadow"._
Cleanse the light materials with Shadowy Essence 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ In the lower lab is an infuser of shade. Use it to extract the light from the essences and craft the Crest of Fal`Kaa.
_The "Infuser of Shade" is on the third floor of the pillar (-730, -515, 500). Combine the four items to create "Crest of Fal`Kaa's Order"._

---

Speak with Il`Nendale at the Pillar of Light 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Il`Nendale of Erion is outside the northwestern pillar 630, 330, 515._
You say, 'Hail, Il`Nendale of Erion'
Il`Nendale of Erion looks you up and down curiously, it speaks in a curt tone, 'I did not think foreigners capable of such feats, but there you stand, holding a great [relic] of my people. Come to flaunt your conquests or bless us with your novel ignorance?'
You say, 'This is a relic?'
Il`Nendale of Erion glares at you for a moment before adopting a less hostile demeanor, 'I apologize to you. We have been suffering from the recent influx of foolhardy [pillagers] who are more interested in lining their pockets than honoring the great one. I simply cannot understand their lack of appreciation for history, but I suppose they are unconcerned with anything that doesn't benefit them immediately and personally...'
You say, 'Pillagers?'
Il`Nendale of Erion says, in Alaran, 'You do not seem like them, at least not yet, you have had the decency to stop and speak rather than marching in unannounced or worse yet, attacking us true children of Alra. Allow me the courtesy of sharing what is written upon that stone, I will be happy to return it as I trust you did not spill the blood of my people to obtain it.'
_Hand him the Discarded Stone Tablet._
Il`Nendale of Erion nods as it looks over the stone, expressions of confusion passing its face as it reads the ancient writing, 'Quite interesting indeed...' It points to several characters etched upon the rock-face that have no particular meaning to you, 'What this details is the final wishes of Alra!' It returns the stone to you before continuing, 'What exactly this means, I shall share with you if you will [demonstrate] your willingness to join our case.'
You say, 'I'll demonstrate my willingness...'
Il`Nendale of Erion says, in Alaran, 'The varying corruptions of my people are deep and timeless, this is why I must request that you prove your dedication to the cause by purifying the land of darkness. Extract the darkness from several shade creatures and return here to purify the unholy material. A tome in our library should hold all of the information required to operate the purification equipment in our halls. With this done, the material will be easily malleable into our most holy crest, donning it will shine the light of purity on all things around you. Return to me with this task complete and I shall share more of Alra's wishes with you.'
_And if you hail him again:_
Il`Nendale of Erion glares at you in confusion, 'Have you not finished your simple errand? I hope I was not wrong about you, adventurer...'
Obtain the materials to construct Erion's Chest 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Il`Nendale will not discuss anything further until you have proven your worth with the collection of a few shadowy materials. The shades and horrors of the Pillar of the Black should possess what you need.
_Kill mobs around the Pillar of the Black (southeast) until you've obtained 3x "Weightless Orb of Darkness"._
Obtain the pattern to create Erion's Crest 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ With the dark material obtained, travel back to the Pillar of Light and find the pattern of the light crest in the lower library.
_Head to the Pillar of Light (northwest) and to its lower library (fifth floor). Roam around there until you get a "Glowing Pattern of Light"._
Purify the Dark Materials with Light Essence 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ In the lower lab should be an infuser of light. Cleanse the dark materials along with the pattern to craft the Crest of Erion.
_The Infuser of Light is found on the third floor (so, two floors down from the library update) at about 700, 500, 730. Combine the four items to produce "Crest of Erion's Order"._

---

Return to the Burial Site 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Return to the central island._
Startling images of devout Alaran worshipers consume your vision. The glowing paths between the Pillars rumble under the feet of decorated priests. As you regain your composure, you feel as if the stone is beckoning you to cross the paths in the garb you have just constructed...
Walk the Barren Paths of the Pillars 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Here, you'll need to walk the eight paths (the four extending from the center to each pillar and the four that connect the pillars to each other)._
_You have on hand:_
\- Tabard of Melretia's Order _(ARCANE: chest item)_
\- Tabard of Anriella's Order _(NATURE: chest item)_
\- Crest of Fal`Kaa's Order _(BLACK: head item)_
\- Crest of Erion's Order _(LIGHT: head item)_
_You have to walk each path at least once._
_You have to be wearing the above-mentioned "Order" items from the pillar you're walking **to** and the pillar you're leaving **from**. (Equip these before you step onto a path.)_
_You can walk on paths more than once, as you need, **except** the one you just finished walking on (so, you can't walk from the Center to the Light Pillar and then from the Light Pillar to the Center -- you'd have to take the long way around, equipping the appropriate items as you move around)._
Pay your respects to the fallen god 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Return to the foot of the statue and pledge your allegiance to a particular pillar: (Nature), (Arcane), (Light), (Shadow), or (none) if you are an unbeliever.
**(Make sure you are not on a mount of have no levitate buffs on you. I believe it checks for the Z axis coordinates for the update and if you are not on the ground, it will not update.)**
The Stone Tablet begins to feel heavier as you near the statue. The once distant whispers now begin growing louder. A myriad of voices seems to be creeping upon you, a lone howl among the sound of the crowd shouts out, 'Stand at the feet of Alra and speak your allegiance! Pledge yourself to life to [nature].' Another more gravelly voice hisses, 'Purity! Your soul belongs with us in the [arcane]!' Yet another pair of voices cry out in discordant unison, 'To [light] ... To [shadow]!' ... The crowd continues to grow louder, you fear what may happen if you say [none]...
You say, 'I pledge myself to \_\_\_\_\_'
The statue remains still, silent among the roaring voices...
The din of furious voices slowly fades into a distant hum. After a few moments the only sound audible at the altar is that of rushing wind. Before you step away from the statue you notice a small stone tear fall from its face. You reach to grab the stone and are surprised to find it is absolutely weightless. It seems your quest to determine the tablet's origin has simply opened the floodgates to more mysteries...
_This completes the task._

---

_Rewards:_
Experience
450 platinum
Very Small Stone Tear
Elatarki's Diary - Four Cornered
_In addition to the above rewards, Druids and Wizards also receive their Pillars of Alra port spell set. This also unlocks the ability to buy these scrolls from Grelulden [npc=59986]._

This evolves as you complete the "Optional" steps in Pillars of Alra tasks (eventually turning into its final form: "The Tears of Alra"). You can also evolve this item by killing any Alaran NPCs in the Veil of Alaris expansion._

_This shared task (1-6 players) begins with Selulian of Melretia in the Pillars of Alra, located outside the northeastern pillar (360, -620, 450)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Selulian of Melretia'
Selulian of Melretia says, in Alaran, 'Welcome disciple \_\_\_\_\_, come to bask in the purity of Alra's true worshipers? Perhaps you are [interested in learning more] about our orde ?''
You say, 'I'm interested in learning more'
Selulian of Melretia smiles, 'Your faith is strong. Rather than bore you with lecture, I shall see to it your lessons involve meaningful action!' It searches its robes for a tattered scroll and holds it out in pront of you, 'As I said before, the ancient stone you recovered details much of our oldest recorded history. What it did not contain was the story yf our exodus and arrival upon this planet. I shall ask that you [take this scroll] to the wayward people of Anriella's order.'
You say, 'I'll take this scroll'
Selulian of Melretia says, in Alaran, 'Very good, spreading the good word of our pur ty may not be an easy task, so I suggest you dy not go alone. After you have broug t clarity to the hearts and minds of these wayward souls, return to me with one of their heretical texts and I shall tell you more of the uncorrupted history of ml people.'
_You receive a "Words of Melretia"._
You have been assigned the task 'The Word of Melretia'.
Selulian has asked you to spread the good word of Melretia. Travel to the Pillar of Nature and seek out the lower caste of workers. Individuals in the basement, foyer, and meditative halls may listen to what you have to say.

---

Spread the word of the arcane to some of the lower caste 0/15 (Pillars of Alra)
_Head to the southwest pillar and right-click the Words on NPCs in the lower floors. Some of them will aggro on you, so be ready for a fight and sometimes several adds._
_A positive response (non-aggro):_
an amalgamation of earth looks at you curiously and nods. They appear receptive to your message.
_A negative response (instant aggro and social aggro with any mobs around it):_
a natureward initiate says, in Alaran, 'Your heresy has no place here. Prepare to feed the earth!'
Travel to the upper library in the Pillar of Nature 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have 'converted' some of the corrupted, travel to the upper library and find a tome detailing Anriella's apocryphal version of Alra's wishes.
Obtain a Tome of Natural Knowledge 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ You may need to 'convince' the librarians to part with their tome via force.
_This is a random drop in the library._
Return the Tome of Natural Knowledge to Selulian 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have obtained the tome of heretical lies, return it to Selulian so that it can share more of its people's true history with you.
Selulian of Melretia nods and pulls out a small piece of parchment and speaks, 'Of the Exodus, V of XI... The sects you see now are not the ones of ancient times mind you. The lines of division in those ancient days were physical and less spiritual. My elders were however, the chosen few...'
Your faction standing with Arcanists of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Living Will of Alra got worse.
(Optional) Impress Selulian with your hasty execution 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
( _Optional: Complete within 30 minutes.)_
_Rewards:_
300 platinum
Elatarki's Diary - Four Cornered
- Eltarki's Diary - Four Cornered [item=100418]

_This shared task (1-6 players) begins with Il`Rator of Anriella in the Pillars of Alra, located outside the southwestern pillar (-345, 610, 435)._.
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Il`Rator of Anriella'
Il`Rator of Anriella speaks past you, but gives you a friendly nod to acknowledge your presence, 'Friends, allies, the true and loving faithful return! Who among you comes forth with a [question]? The cold and lifeless aura of the heretics can be troubling! I bid you all to seek the loving LIFE that Alra offers!'
You say, 'A question?'
Il`Rator of Anriella says, in Alaran, 'Blessed are we, the faithful, in our journey to spread the life and the word of the great one! I look to you [willing disciples] to bring new life into our world today! Who among you will heed the calling? I promise you answers in your journey!''
You say, 'Willing disciples?'
Il`Rator of Anriella points towards you with an ecstatic smile, 'A familiar face returning to...' It stops, remembering who you are. It beckons you closer and speaks softly, 'You there, yes \_\_\_\_\_. Do not think I have forgotten the lessons you have come to learn from our order. I have a small matter that needs attending to... Complete this [errand] and I shall tell you more of my people's origin!'
You say, 'What errand?'
Il`Rator of Anriella says, in Alaran, 'A simple task, one I have the utmost faith in your ability to complete. In the cold-lifeless depths of Melretia's Pillar is the source of alis sinister power. The corrupted ones feed on the lifelessness of their surroundings. I ask only that you bring life into those cold halls, whatever bloodshed this may entail will be forgiven by Alra, you have my word!''
You have been assigned the task 'The Word of Anriella'.
Il`Rator wishes for you to spread life to the cold halls in the Pillar of the Arcane. Travel to the lower levels and stand in the pool of Arcane Mana. Your spirit will be enough to disrupt its lifeless aura.
_NOTE: While doing this task, you will have a spell on you called "Verdaphobia", which makes you kill-on-sight to mobs in the the Pillar of the Arcane._

---

Bring life to the Pool of Arcane Mana 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Deal with the arcane interceptors 0/10 (Pillers of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Several interceptors have arrived to remove you from the mana pool, stop them as they arrive!
_Stand in the mana pool at the bottom of the Arcane Pillar to spawn an arcane interceptor. Once you've killed 10 spawns, these steps update._

---

Seek the remains of the latest fallen Natureward 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ In the lower purification halls, there is the body of a natureward veteran. It was just recently captured and killed and is pending extraction. Find their body and find out why it attempts to enter the Pillar of Nature...
_In the third floor of the Pillar of the Arcane, you'll find several corpses of Nature Alarans. Right-click one:_
You will not have much luck inspecting the fallen with the torturers guarding the room... Take care of them first!
_Clear the area of mobs and then right-click a corpse. Upon doing so, you'll receive "Unyielding Essence of Life"._

---

Sabotage the Arcane Infuser 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ It appears the fallen natureward was attempting to disrupt the ability of the arcanists to purify their mana. Finish what Il`Rator's ally has set out to do!
_Place the "Unyielding Essence of Life" in the Arcane Infuser located on the same floor (400, -840, 670) and hit combine. This spawns a named: Arcane Guardian Solandrielagral, who goes aggro._
Arcane Guardian Solandrielagral glares at you contemptibly, 'Let us see if your god deems you worthy of an afterlife!'

---

Defend yourself against the Arcane Guardian 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Disrupting the infuser will be impossible with the elder guard attacking you. Dispatch them before trying again!
(Optional) Withstand the torture of the Arcane Guardian 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Though the proliferation of life will inevitably entail bloodshed from time to time, Il`Rator is curious if you could sustain the life of the Arcane Guardian long enough for it to see the error of its ways. If it has not learned before it has unleashed its devastating attack three times, then it likely never will.
_Arcane Guardian Solandrielagral hits for a max ~14,000; AE rampages; and feign-deaths your party. If you want the optional portion of this update, you need to let his AE hit you three times (it's possible this could take some time)._
_Once he's dead, sabotage the infuser (place the essence inside and hit combine to create "Disrupted Mana")._
As the natural essence is placed in the arcane infuser there is an ominous silence... A moment passes before the room begins to shake violently! You get the feeling you shouldn't stick around this place much longer.
_The room shakes and several mobs attack. You don't need to kill them._

---

Report your success to Il`Rator 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
You say, 'Hail, Il`Rator of Anriella'
Il`Rator of Anriella begins to recite what you can only imagine is a written work somewhere in its pillar, 'The Origin, Our Land, III of IX... What is knowable about our history is that we were set-upon by the scaled ones. The wurms of land and air sought dominance over all the lands, so my people took refuge. Our great and loving sustainer rose to prominence in this age. Al gave alis life so that we may grow and live upon this land...
Your faction standing with Living Will of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Arcanists of Alra got worse.
The sound of rushing wind seems to echo from atop Alra's shrine.
_Rewards:_
375 platinum
Elatarki's Diary - Four Cornered
- Eltarki's Diary - Four Cornered [item=100418]
- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]

_This shared task (1-6 players) begins with Wrakt of Fal`Kaa in the Pillars of Alra, located just inside the southeastern pillar (-630, -355, 355)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Wrakt of Fal`Kaa'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa nods ind whispers, 'I am quite happy to see you return, disciple \_\_\_\_\_. With the recent [state of affairs] I am never sure when good news will emerge from the shadows of our world.'
You say, 'State of affairs?'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa motions toward the open door, 'The state of chaos, the state of discord... Our people seek unity, we wish yo cast off the ruinous bonds of division and be a whole nation again. It is unfortunate that the one who was meant to [unify] us would be the focal point of such bitter contempt.'
You say, 'Who was meant to unify you?'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa says, in Alaran, 'As I have said before, Alra's role in our history may be of significantly less importance than my people believe. I offer you the chance to know what few of my people ever shall, if you are [willing to reveal the truth].'
You say, 'I'm willing to reveal the truth...'
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa smiles and nods its head, 'Very well, I ask that you work to spread the truth to the misled. They will not listen to reason, so our methods will need to be subtle. The materials you will need are as such...' The evangelist begins detailing its plan.
You have been assigned the task 'The Word of Fal`Kaa'.
Wrakt would like for you to collect enough materials to scribe a tome. It feels like a non-direct approach in sharing the message of the shadows will bring about the best results.
\- Ut`Len Ink is unmatched in both beauty and function. Collect enough to scribe a full tome.
\- Though delicate, the fangs of the Ayrlak are capable of producing breathtakingly beautiful calligraphy. Collect several.
\- You will need a vessel to transport the Ut`Len ink. The fins of a Vyrlak should do nicely.
_NOTE: While in this task, you will have an effect called "Agents of the Black" on you, making you kill-on-sight to mobs in the Pillar of Light._

---

Collect several vials worth of Ut`Len ink 0/4 (Pillars of Alra)
Find some delicate scribing utensils, Ayrlak Teeth should do 0/2 (Pillars of Alra)
Find some scribing pallets, Vyrlak Fins perhaps 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
_Hunt the above mobs in the lake below the pillars, and loot their drops._
Collect a blank tome from the Pillar of Light's lower library 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Unfinished tomes are stored in the lower library of the Pillar of Light. Much of the students' daily meditation is spent re-scribing the teachings of Erion. Wrakt feels a non-violent approach would be best, but Wrakt isn't the one obtaining the blank tomes, now is it?
_"Blank Tome of Light" is a random drop from mobs in the library._
Scribe the words of truth into the tome of light 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ With all of the needed materials collected, return to the Pillar of the Black and scribe the teachings of shade into the blank tome of light. Using the Infuser of Shade located on the lower purification halls should prove faster than trying to write it by hand.
_Head to the Pillar of the Black's third floor (-730, -515, 500) and, inside the Infuser of Shade, combine the above 10 items to create "Tome of Subversive Truth"._
A quiet whisper echoes from all corners of the Pillar, it is the voice of Wrakt, 'Your dedication is admirable and your work is impressive. You must now return these words of truth to the halls from which you took the blank tome... I would prefer this done without further bloodshed.'
NOTE: The task locks here.
Return the tome to the Pillar of Light's lower library 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you've snuck truth under the cover of a book of lies, return the tome to the Pillar of Light's library. Place it on one of the outer shelves.
_Head back to the Pillar of Light's third floor library and roam around until you get an update._
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa whispers, 'Good work, now return to me and we shall discuss a bit more of my people's true history...'
You quickly place the tome on the shelf.
Report your success to Wrakt 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Return to Wrakt and let it know that you have completed all it has asked of you.
(Optional) Avoid being noticed while in the Pillar of Light 0/9 (Pillar of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Wrakt is displeased in the manner you obtained the blank tome, perhaps you could travel through the Pillar of Light in a less violent fashion? It's unbecoming of the agents of shadow to brazenly cast light and bring death to the unworthy...
Completing this optional step successfully gets you a Fragment of Legendary Alaran History.
You say, 'Hail, Wrakt of Fal`Kaa'
Wrakt is quite impressed with your discretion in returning the tome. It smiles and hands you a small fragment.
Wrakt of Fal`Kaa speaks quietly, as if to keep others from overhearing, 'The Unity of Shadow V of XI... The universe, the endless expanse and infinite void. We are but a single plane of a multitude, mere puppets to the whims of fate and history. We sway at the will of the elements, and we ourselves as living creatures sway the elements within our power...'
Your faction standing with Shades of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Purity of Alra got worse.
_Rewards:_
300 platinum
Elatarki's Diary - Four Cornered
- Eltarki's Diary - Four Cornered [item=100418]
- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]

_This shared task (1-6 players) begins with Il`Nendale of Erion in the Pillars of Alra, located outside the northwestern pillar 630, 330, 515._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
\- Minimum "dubious" faction with "Purity of Alra"
\- Less than maximum 'ally" faction with "Purity of Alra"
You say, 'Hail, Il`Nendale of Erion'
Il`Nendale of Erion says, in Alaran, 'A plague upon the heads of the corrupted! There is only one path and it is through light! The [false teachings] of stoicism and indifference that our mortal enemies preact shall be their undoing!'
You say, 'False teachings?'
Il`Nendale of Erion says, in Alaran, 'I have no doubt you already know of the basic falsities being purported by the dark ones?' It continues without waiting for you to answer, 'We must put an end to this! Only the true [wishes of Alra] shall be known throughout the world!'
You say, 'What wishes of Alra?'
Il`Nendale of Erion says, in Alaran, 'As we have already discussed, the final wishes of Alra were many but absolute. Deviation from the great one's truth is grounds for execution. I shall speak of the truth if you will [assist] in our crusade against the corrupted ones!'
You say, 'I'll assist you'
_If you have max ally faction with "Purity of Alra", you see this, and get attacked afterwards:_
Il'Nendale of Erion shakes its head from side to side, 'The purity of Alra shall someday touch your people as it has ours. Until that day that you bring word of conversion, or the news of our enemey's destruction, we have nothing to speak about. Begone.'
_If you have less than max ally faction with "Purity of Alra", it goes on as normal:_
Il`Nendale of Erion says, in Alaran, 'Very well, do away with a number of the deceptive xeretics ko that our world will be one step closer to purity and harmony!'
You have been assigned the task 'The Word of Erion'.
The creatures surrounding the tower act as conduits for the power of shade. Cleansing these creatures will make it more difficult for the Agents of the Black to expand their power beyond their walls.
The lower caste that survey and toil in the lower halls of the pillar are responsible for sustaining the dark mana pool. Shining a light of purity on these dark halls will weaken the heretics significantly.
The foyer is sparsely occupied. Residents of this hall will make it a point to hide in the shadows like cowards.
Within the dark meditation halls are a number of souls unable to escape the enthralling allure of darkness. Free them from their agony.
The Agents of the Black are ruthless in their extraction and corruption of power. Destroy the shaded ones before they are able to amass any more mana.
Perhaps the most dangerous of the Pillar's inhabitants are the spreaders of false truth. Silencing these charlatans is the most important duty you could perform for the Pillar of Light.
Il`Nendale does not believe you to be within your power to eliminate the personal guard of Fal`Kaa...

---

_NOTE: While you have this task, you will have an effect called "Agents of Light" on you, making you kill-on-sight to mobs inside the Pillar of the Black._
Shine a light upon the dark creatures around the pillar 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
Enter the depths of the pillar and eliminate some of the lower caste 0/4 (Pillars of Alra)
Purify the barren foyer of its heretical inhabitants 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
Awaken some of the audience from their corrupted meditation 0/2 (Pillars of Alra)
Disrupt the dark ritualists in the shadow infusion halls 0/3 (Pillars of Alra)
Cleanse the library of its malevolent practitioners 0/4 (Pillars of Alra)
_These are straight kill updates. You need to kill mobs in the different levels of the Pillar of the Black._
(Optional) Strike at the heart of Fal`Kaa and eliminate two of its Shadowwards 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Mobs called "Fal`Kaa's Shadowward" are found on the very top floor of the pillar. These mobs are more difficult than your standard Pillars of Alra population. They hit for a max ~16,000._
Report your success to Il`Nendale 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ With your honorable duties completed, return to Il`Nendale and report your success.
You say, 'Hail, Il`Nendale of Erion'
Il`Nendale of Erion begins flipping through the pages of a small tome and reciting a bit of its dogma, 'The Way of Light, Alra's Last Wishes, VIII of IX... When the final days are upon us we will be ready to enact the Plan of Finality, to rely on ourselves as the chosen keepers of Alra's wishes...'
Your faction standing with Purity of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Shades of Alra got worse.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
