_This solo task begins with an apparition in the Pillars of Alra (roams around the Windsong Sanctuary entrance above the center island). Note: This NPC is only visible if you've done all of the task's pre-requisites (the see-invis buff "Visions of Faith" will automatically affect you if you approach the mob's area)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
\- Completion of "The Word of Melretia"
\- Completion of "The Word of Anriella"
\- Completion of "The Word of Fal`Kaa"
\- Completion of "The Word of Erion"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, an apparition'
an apparition continues pacing around the shrine, non-responsive to your introduction, leaving you to wonder [who they are]...
You say, 'Who they are?'
an apparition turns to face you and smiles. It waves its hand and suddenly your eyes are filled with visions. Scenes of chaos and turmoil that haunted you upon your first visit to Alra's shrine return. In your mind the sky shines a bleak red, the ground is stained with blood and the air is heavy with death. Amid the crowd of warring Alarans is a small figure, out of place and obviously [lost].
You say, 'Lost?'
an apparition waves its hand again and your vision changes from a scene of war to a scene of peace. The once lost figure now sits on a field of grass under a tree, two larger Alarans stand to the side, facing away toward what you recognize to be the Resplendent Temple. The larger figures appear to be speaking about the [Pillars], thinking the smaller one does not hear them...
You say, 'What about the Pillars?'
an apparition staggers backwards, your visions fade. The apparition turns its focus back to the surrounding pillars. Yet you feel there is more to this story, perhaps an investigation into the resplendent garden pill unearth some clues regarding this mysterious shade.
You have been assigned the task 'Crisis of Faith'.
In the Garden of Grandeur are a number of beautifully tended trees. The apparition seems to have some memory regarding them. Explore the garden and pay careful attention to the base of the trunk of each tree to see if you can gain any insight into the garden's importance...
(Optional) It is possible that completing this errand in a single day will allow the shade to piece together some memories from the clues you find.
_NOTE: While doing this task, you may be buffed with a spell as you approach each pillar that makes you kill-on-sight to that pillar's mobs._

---

Investigate the trees in the upper temple garden 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Zone into Resplendent Temple and walk around the trees in the upper garden (the area just outside the Pillars zone-in). Randomly, you'll get a directional emote like this:_
Carved into the base of the tree is a small arrow, it points south-west.
You feel the voice of the wind calling you south-west.
_You'll want to move from tree to tree in the directions the emotes tell you. At some point, the voice will stop:_
The voice of the wind grows silent. You are now on your own to find any remaining clues...
_At which point, you'll need to investigate the trees yourself. You have to stay at each tree for a full tick. If, after 6 seconds, you've gotten no update, move onto another tree. Eventually, you'll find one that gives you the update along with this emote:_
You hear echoing whispers emanating from all of the trees in the garden.
_This opens up the next step._

---

Find the source of the curious sound 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_Task Window Says:_ Although it may sound like there are voices whispering from all different directions, there is only one source. Find which tree the sound is originating from and shake out anyone who may be following you!
_You now have to go from tree to tree (again, standing under each one for a full 6 seconds) until you spawn a mob:_
The echoing whispers are interrupted by the cry of a screaming voice. Someone is not pleased with your presence here!
a verdantguard ambusher says, in Alaran, 'Your inquisitive nature shall be the end of you, \_\_\_\_\_!'
Defeat your attackers 0/1 (Resplendent Temple)
_"a verdantguard ambusher" attacks, hitting for a max ~12,500 (stunnable, slowable). It's auto-aggro on whoever triggered it, is not leashed (will follow you anywhere) and isn't social with the mobs in the zone._
_Upon its death, you receive a "Ragged Doll" on your cursor._
Return to the apparition with the doll 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ The doll appears to be a child's toy, though judging by its condition, that would have been a great number of years ago. Perhaps the apparition can shed some light on the strange relic's origin.
You say, 'Hail, an apparition'
an apparition looks at you with a confused expression, as if struggling to remember who you are.
The apparition reaches out and pulls the doll from your hand. Several seconds pass before it looks back toward you. The young Alaran's face contorts into a grimace, it opens its mouth to speak and you are overwhelmed by the storming sound of rushing wind. The din grows louder and louder until you are wracked with a pain so intense that you fear for your life! The shade closes its mouth and the sound ceases... All that is left in your mind is a vision of ethereal trees rooted in misty clouds...

---

Investigate the ethereal trees along the outskirts of Windsong 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Take the elevator platform to Windsong Sanctuary._
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Windsong Sanctuary.
A soft breeze gently pushes you north-west.
_Find a tree (it will be random which one you're directed to) in the direction of the emote you're given (the above-emote is an example). Do this for one more tree to open up the next step._
Find the source of the haunting melody 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Task Window Says:_ The sound of several flutes drifts over the gusting winds. As you pass each of the ethereal trees their chord progression migrates toward less and less harmonious tones. Seek out the source of this dissonant chorus!
_Once you find this tree (with the same type of emote as the last tree), a named will spawn on you: a lightward ambusher._
The haunting melody ceases and you are confronted by a glowing figure!
a lightward ambusher says, in Alaran, 'Your journey ends here, \_\_\_\_\_!'
_The ambusher is auto-aggro and not social with other mobs in the zone. It hits for a max ~13,500, is immune to stun and is slowable._
Silence the odius tune 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Upon the ambusher's death:_
You reach down and grab one of the less damaged pieces of parchment that the lightward dropped. Though the ink is smudged, you think you can make out an image of three Alarans standing near a body of water. Two of the figures tower over the third, parents and their child perhaps ... The apparition's motives are starting to become clearer.
_You receive a "Brightly Glowing Torn Page" on your cursor._
Return to the apparition with the recovered image 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ There is something curious about the figures depicted on the torn page. Bring the page to the apparition and see if it will shed any light on the situation.
You say, 'Hail, an apparition'
an apparition looks at you with a confused expression, as if struggling to remember who you are.
_Give it the page:_
The apparition looks at the torn page then stares into your eyes. Its sullen expression seems to suggest it knows something about the image, yet the shade does not speak. A moment passes before it gently takes the piece of paper from your outstretched hand. As the page transfers ownership it disintegrates into dust, yet their remains never touch the ground. The apparition motions toward the Pillar of Light and returns to its silent patrol...

---

Search for the rest of the journal 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Perhaps there are more pieces to the journal that the page was torn from. Start at the Pillar of Light's lower library and see what clues you can find.
_Head to the northwest pillar and up a few floors to the lower library:_
You begin looking around for something that resembles an old journal.
_An Erion tomeguard spawns and attacks. It hits for a max ~13,500 (slowable; immune to stuns) and is not social with the other mobs in the room._
Defend yourself 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ It seems someone has taken notice of your interference in the library. Defend yourself!
_Upon the tomeguard's death:_
As the tomeguard falls to the ground, you notice a novelty about its clothing. Around its neck is a small emblem reminiscent of the Pillar of the Black... Perhaps more can be learned in Fal`Kaa's extraction halls...

---

Investigate the origins of the torn journal 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ A lightward wearing the Crest of the Black is a troubling sight. Travel to the lower Purification halls in Fal`Kaa's Pillar and see if you can gather any relevant information...
_Head to the southeast pillar and head up to the third floor (around -800, -500, 500)._
You survey the walls as you climb the stairs into the "purification" hall. The dim lights overhead cast small shadows on the floor as you make your way toward the extraction rooms. Perhaps one of the fallen lightwards will have a postmortem clue about the journal.
_Right-click a corpse (this is just a normal update; no mob spawn)._
You kneel down to inspect the fallen lightward. Your vision begins to dim until only faint outlines of the room are visible. Silhouettes of shadow move against a background of darkness, memories of subversively planting the truth in the pillar of light begin to overshadow the dark scene. Without impetus you come to understand that the journal, while penned on parchment from the pillar of light, was written in the ink of darkest shade. The writing however, strikes of natural calligraphy practiced only by followers of Anriella...

---

Locate the journal's previous owner 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Your visions are becoming more troubling. You see connections between the warring factions never before conceived. Travel to the upper library in the Pillar of Nature and find why their handwriting would be in a tome carried by the agents of light...
_Head to the Nature Pillar's (southwest pillar) 6th floor:_
You should tread carefully in these halls, your presence is being monitored...
_Anriella`s tomekeeper spawns and attacks, hits for a max ~13,500 (slowable; immune to stun) and is not social with mobs in the room._
Defend yourself 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ The journal is being held by your assailant. Defeat them so you can return it to the apparition.
_Upon its death:_
The tomekeeper looks shocked as it begins falling to the ground. It uses the last of its strength to destroy the journal in its possession. The small book ignites and burns with an eerie blue flame, a flame less natural than any magic taught under the tutelage of Anriella... The final clues must lie in the source of the Arcane Pillar's power.

---

Seek answers from the Arcane Pool 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ With the journal destroyed, the hope for clarity is much less bright. Your only lead now is in the tenuous connection between arcane magic and the tome's embers. Travel to the Mana Pool in the Pillar of the Arcane. It will be here that any final guardians remaining will try to stop you...
_Head to the basement of the Arcane Pillar (northeast pillar) and clear the mobs in and around the pool. Once ready, step into it._
The pool begins to buzz and crack with the sound of thunder. An ominous voice echoes through the entire hall as it addresses you, 'It is such a shame that a failed disciple such as yourself would go to all this trouble just to fall dead in my halls. No matter, none shall challenge the will of the master!'
_"Melretia`s manatender" spawns and attacks. It hits for a max ~13,500 (slowable; immune to stun)._
Disrupt the Arcanist's ritual 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Upon the manatender's death:_
The manatender glares at you, it falls to one knee as its eyes close and it accepts its inevitable death. It grabs something at the bottom of the pool and clutches it tightly in its outstretched hand as it falls to the ground. Its final words are muffled and hoarse, '...garal... alsa.' You take the odd substance the former keeper held tightly.
_You receive a "Malleable Ooze" on your cursor._
Return to the apparition with the ooze 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Whatever this strange substance is, it's the last clue available to help get the apparition to speak. Deliver it to them and see if it will evoke any lost memories...
(Optional) Recover the clues in a single day 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Upon the final turn-in:_
You offer the strange ooze to the apparition who stares at it for a moment. It takes it from your hands and looks at it curiously. In a flash the shade's mood changes dramatically, it steps backwards and drops the substance on the ground and begins screaming as if in agony! The winds pick up and howl... Yet after mere moments the shade ceases its crying and returns to its patrol, acting as if the two of you had never once interacted...
The apparition seems unreachable, but this journey has shed new light on the motives of the warring factions. As you reflect for a moment on your journey, a soft voice enters your thoughts, 'Thelara ser! Thel Lrah...' The sound seems to originate somewhere around the shrine of Alra.
Your faction standing with Purity of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Shades of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Arcanists of Alra got better.
Your faction standing with Living Will of Alra got better.
_Rewards:_
675 platinum
Experience (4-5 AAs worth at Level 95)
Elatarki's Diary - Four Cornered

- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]

This group mission begins with "a shade" on the center island in the Pillars of Alra (20, 40, 667).
Note: This NPC may only visible if you've done all of the task's pre-requisites.
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
- Completion of "The Word of Melretia"

You say, 'Hail, a shade'
a shade continues staring at the stone shrine as it speaks, 'You have walked alir path and now your eyes are open to the [truth]?'
You say, 'The truth?'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'The truth surrounds us and yet evades the eyes of so many. Few are ever privileged enough to understand the reality around them. Even in death many will never see beyond the [grand deception].'
You say, 'What grand deception?'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'It should be no surprise by now that someone has been lying to you. You are not the first and will not be the last. It is in the nature of mortals to deceive, it is a selfishness that many will never outgrow. I do not condemn you for being the same. Though, if you are [willing] to reveal the truth, then I have an assignment for you. If you are not, I will not spite you for it, traveler...'
You say, 'I'm willing'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'Let me know when you are [ready] and I shall open your eyes to the truth that evades you...'
You have been assigned the task 'The Truth'.
The mysterious shade stands alone at the shrine of Alra. There seems to be more to this place than you may have originally imagined. Let the shade know that you are 'ready' to see the hidden truth of the shrine.
Let the shade know you are 'ready' 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
NOTE: The task locks here.
You say, 'Ready!'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'Very well.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Pillars of Alra.
Speak with the shade 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
You say, 'Hail, a shade'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'You stand witness to the true shrine of Alra, seeker.' The shade motions toward the statue, its previously pristine construction now lies as twisted remains. The figure nods mournfully, 'The facade, the grand deception, the lies that one stood upon these grounds have been wiped away. So too will you find with the [teachings] these factionalized sects have attempted to indoctrinate you with...''
You say, 'What teachings?'
a shade smiles, expressing a warm peacefulness as it speaks, 'What I ask of you is obedience, not compliance. I simply ask that you seek the truth for yourself... The upper castes of the Pillars are gathered together tonight to pay homage to their respective leaders. The teachings of Lrah, the great one, are far from the forefront of anyone's mind. The purveyors of deception, the readers of worthless [stones], the practitioners of torture, they are gathered while the lesser guard stands watch to keep outsiders away. Make your way to the source of each Pillar's power. I assure you that the answers you seek will be found within those halls...'
You say, 'What about the stones?'
a shade looks into your eyes, an expression of pained embarrassment passes the figure's visage, 'I am sorry, seeker... I stood upon these grounds as you made your first pledge. I watched as you walked the ancient paths in the crests of division. I saw the glimmer of hope in your eye as you carried the stones of these grounds to the purveyors of separation... I offer you this moment to atone, to see past the deception and lies. Even if you return from this unchanged, unwilling to part ways from your teachings, I shall not spite you...'
From here, the four "Lower the barrier..." steps open up. The next four sections listed below can be done in any order.

a forlorn spirit turns away, 'The light blinds all to the foul truth of the sect... They... I...' The figure struggles for breath, '...To sacrifice my own child for the purity of our worship...' The figure shakes its head and returns looking toward the apparition...

a forgotten soul says, in Alaran, 'The 'harmony' that exists between the Pillars is not a product of complacence or chance...' **NOTE: This is the quest entry for the group version of "The Growing Threat". See this quest entry [quest=5543] for the raid version.**

---

**Obtaining the Task**
_This is a mini raid (3-12 players) that begins with "a shade" on the center island in the Pillars of Alra (20, 40, 667). Note: This NPC is only visible if you've done all of the task's pre-requisites._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "The First Pilgrimage"
\- Completion of "The Word of Melretia"
\- Completion of "The Word of Anriella"
\- Completion of "The Word of Fal`Kaa"
\- Completion of "The Word of Erion"
\- Completion of "Crisis of Faith"
\- Completion of "The Truth"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran Language
You say, 'Hail, a shade'
a shade nods in response but remains transfixed on the shrine, 'Returning already, \_\_\_\_\_? We welcome all who return to seek the [truth]. Though perhaps you are ready to help us deal with a [growing threat]?'...The shade hesitates before continuing, '...Though it pains me to ask, I must also know if you are willing to undergo a [final trial].'
You say, 'What growing threat?'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'Thanks to your efforts in freeing our fallen kin, we have learned more of the wards' plan to raise the great one. The upper caste is now bolstering their ranks in an effort to bring about a day of reckoning. We must turn to you again to [resolve] this issue and disallow these twisted corrupters from gaining the uncontrollable power of Alra...'
You say, 'We can resolve this'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'We are once again indebted to you, seekers. Inform me when you are [ready] and I shall lift the veil of illusions that blinds you from the truth of this place.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Growing Threat'.
The devout shade has called upon you once again to help quell a growing threat. The four wards of the Pillars are aiming to resurrect Alra under their influence for some malicious purpose. Inform the shade that you are 'ready' to assist.

---

**Task Steps & Summary**
Let the devout shade know when you are 'ready' 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Speak with the shade 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of Light 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of the Arcane 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of the Black 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of Nature 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Battle against the combined spirit of the wards 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
Claim your reward from the reliquary of the fallen 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_After hailing the shade inside the instance, the four "Attempt to disrupt..." steps open up. Pick a pillar and approach its blind dreamer statue on the center island. This will port you into the pillar and start a five-minute timer._
_These steps will automatically update after five minutes (regardless of whether or not you beat it). The consequence for not beating a pillar, however, is that the final named will be stronger._
_The most common "strategy" is to send in an FD class to sit in each pillar for five minutes to update those steps, and then to deal with a very strong final encounter. Actually beating the pillars (making for a much easier final encounter) will require a well-rounded mini-raid._

---

**Zoning In**
Let the devout shade know when you are 'ready' 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
You say, 'Ready!'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'Very well.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Pillars of Alra.

---

**The Shade**
Speak with the shade 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you are once again free from the deceptive visions of this place, speak to the shade and find out how you will be able to stop the efforts of the wards.
You say, 'Hail, a shade'
a shade remains still, transfixed upon the barren shrine... What feels like an eternity passes before the shade utters its reply, '...Our greatest fears have come to pass. The Wards have begun exerting their power in an effort to wake the great one. I must call upon you seekers to [end this], to restore peace to our divided land... If you are unwilling or unable, you may still [leave]...'
You say, 'End this?'
a shade nods, still staring at the barren shrine, 'The enthusiasm of your people is inspiring, but I must warn you that the battle will not be easily won. Each Ward aims to cleanse the land of all outsiders and awaken Alra under their own influence. To defeat them, you will need to strike at the heart of each Pillar simultaneously. When you are [ready] I will have my allies weaken the barrier that protects each Pillar from entry. You will have only a few minutes to weaken their forces...'
You say, 'We are ready'
a shade calls out to its allies, 'These seekers aim to stop the Wards. It is time we lower the barrier.' The shade kneels before the barren shrine of Alra. The wandering apparitions begin chanting in a low monotone. The shade addresses you, 'Stand under the influence of the Pillar you intend to assault. Though we are able to disrupt their barrier, the wards will not allow more than a few of you to breach their defenses. Prepare yourself, seeker...'
The apparitions' chanting grows louder. The once still night air grows warm and restless. The spires begin to hum with renewed life...
The Pillars resonate with a unified voice, 'Minions, the harbingers of Discord have returned. Ready yourselves for their invasion. We shall not fall again this day!'
The ground trembles as the apparitions raise their eyes to the sky and shout in a unified voice! The stoic shade yells, 'The barrier is broken, is it time we put an end to the tyranny of the Wards!'
_Task Window Says:_ Each of the four wards is focusing their power within their Pillar. The shades are able to weaken the barrier keeping intruders out, but only for a short period of time. Gather your forces together and disrupt the remaining Pillars...
Stand under the spire of light to attack Erion's forces.
Stand under the spire of the arcane to attack Melretia's forces.
Stand under the spire of shadow to attack Fal`Kaa's forces.
Stand under the spire of nature to attack Anriella's forces.

---

**Pillar Timers**
_NOTE: Each pillar has a five-minute timer. As it ticks down, you'll see these emotes:_
The devout shade calls out through the valley, 'Seekers, you have three minutes remaining before the ward rids its Pillar of your presence.'
The devout shade looks up from the barren shrine and shouts, 'Seekers, the power of the wards is growing. You have only two minutes left.'
Drinal continues to climb the night sky. The shade is silent, yet you feel you have only one minute left.
_And in the event the timer runs out, you see:_
A booming voice echoes throughout the valley. The sound is guttural and its expression rings of untamed aggression, 'Enough of this! Begone from my domain, harbingers!'
Your mind is freed from the Pillar of \_\_\_\_\_'s grasp. _(at which point you're ported out and your task updates)_

---

**Light**
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of Light 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_NOTE: As pets are susceptible to this pillar's emotes, it is strongly recommended you suspend all pets before entering._
_Approach the Light spire:_
The island resonates with power as your forces gather under the Pillar of Light. You have five minutes to disrupt Erion's forces!
You are transported into the Pillar of Light.
The Pillar of Light seems to be drawing power from the Herald and Harbinger. They must be slain in order to stop Erion.
_What you'll see upon port-in: The Herald of Erion and The Harbinger of Erion on either side of the room._
_What to do: Engage the two nameds. Anyone who gets the debuff "Corrupted Reflections of Light" on them must stand under the "(Vulnerable)" named and get a single-target corruption cure. Properly curing these debuffs will unlock the two nameds' health. You'll want to kill adds as they spawn. The two nameds must be killed in order to beat this pillar._
_The Herald and Harbinger are both permanently rooted. Both flurry. Neither rampage._
_DPS both nameds down to 90% at which point their health will lock. You'll see an emote like this when their health locks (appears in text only):_
The Herald of Erion focuses its power and defends itself with a barrier of uncorrupted purity.
_Shortly into the fight, one of the nameds will become vulnerable (the word "(Vulnerable)" appears beside its name). This isn't known to affect their susceptibility to melee damage; however, it's important for curing yourself and progressing the event._
_Every 35 seconds, you'll see this emote (flashes up on screen and in text):_
Rays of light shine upon \_\_\_\_\_, \_\_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_.
_When you see the above emote, two people (named in the emote) will get the debuff "Pure Reflections of Light" and one person will get the debuff "Corrupted Reflections of Light". Both spells have 10 corruption counters. ONLY the "Corrupted Reflections of Light" spell should be cured. Do NOT cure the "Pure Reflections of Light" debuff._
_Before the inflicted target asks for a cure, they should move to the location of the named with the word "(Vulnerable)" beside its name. Curing oneself of "Corrupted Reflections of Light" while standing under the "(Vulnerable)" named will trigger this emote..._
The Harbinger of Erion staggers and looks weaker as corruption eats at its skin. It redoubles its effort to kill you by passing its vulnerability to the Herald.
_...and unlock that named's health to the next level. NOTE: Health locks occur at 90%, 45%, and 18%. You'll need six proper cures to make the nameds beatable (three for each named). Each cure causes the "(Vulnerable)" tag to switch to the opposite mob._
_As you are on a five-minute timer and mob health locks are directly tied into cures, failure to properly and timely cure yourselves will result in an unbeaten pillar._
_While all of this is going on, you'll get single add spawns called "a blinding fragment of light":_
a blinding fragment of light hovers menacingly toward \_\_\_\_\_.
_You'll get a total of two adds: The first, about a minute into the event. The second, about a minute after the previous spawn. These proc a blind spell on their target._
_Kill the two nameds to beat the pillar:_
The Harbinger of Erion has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The Harbinger of Erion disintegrates into pure light.
Your faction standing with Paragons of Purity got worse.
Your faction standing with Purity of Alra got better.
The Herald of Erion has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The Herald of Erion disintegrates into pure light.
Your faction standing with Paragons of Purity got worse.
Your faction standing with Purity of Alra got better.
The voice of Erion Ulrich, the Archon of Light, pierces through the air, 'How could this have happened!? Miserable corruptors! Do not think you have won this fight! You shall be purified by the cleansing light of Alra!'

---

**Arcane**
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of the Arcane 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Approach the Arcane spire:_
You stand in the power of the Pillar of the Arcane.
The island resonates with power as your forces gather under the Pillar of the Arcane. You have five minutes to disrupt Melretia's forces!
The Pillar of the Arcane seems to be drawing its power from the coalescence of mana. Shattering the crystallized mana will put a stop to Melretia, though the constructors will aim to stop you.
_What you'll see upon port-in: A large crystal called "an unstable coalescence" at the port-in location; a lone gargoyle ("an animate constructor") in the center of the room._
_What to do: The goal here is to pull gargoyles one at a time to the coalescence's location and mez them; charm the Alaran; and nuke the coalescence. The coalescence must be destroyed in order to beat this pillar._
_Shortly after you port into the pillar, the "an animate constructor" attacks (these are rootable, but not snareable):_
an animate constructor moves to defend the coalescence.
_This gargoyle needs to be positioned next to the coalescence and mezzed. While mezzed, the gargoyle takes a large amount of damage per tick. Upon its death, two more gargoyles spawn. Upon their deaths, three more spawn. Upon their deaths, four more spawn. All gargoyles have to be handled in the same manner: Single-pull them to the coalescence and keep them mezzed until they die._
_The gargoyles cannot be kept mezzed if they are close to each other. If you allow gargoyles to get close to a mezzed mob, you'll see this emote (and any gargoyles in the vicinity are awakened):_
The Animate Constructors react violently to each other and have been awakened!
_As you kill the gargoyles via mez, you'll see this:_
an animate constructor died.
an animate constructor spasms violently then vanishes.
an unstable coalescence cracks, looking slightly more fragile as the constructors die.
_The more gargoyles you kill, the more the coalescence can be damaged._
_While this is going on, a non-aggro Alaran called "an Arcward of Melretia" wanders around the room. This mob must be kept charmed. If left alone, it will regenerate the gargoyles and possibly the coalescence._
_Upon destroying the coalescence:_
an unstable coalescence has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
an unstable coalescence shatters into jagged shards.
an Arcward of Melretia died.
an Arcward of Melretia wretches forth what appears to be brain-matter before falling to the ground, dead.
The voice of Melretia Relward, The Arbiter of the Arcane, calls out through the valley, '...Unexpected... I dare say, nearly impressive. You prove to be a more vicious thorn in our side than originally anticipated... Though it is ultimately no matter, even with this small loss, the power of the Arcane shall give rise to the great one!'

---

**Black**
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of the Black 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Approach the Black spire:_
You stand in the power of the Pillar of the Black.
The island resonates with power as your forces gather under the Pillar of the Black. You have five minutes to disrupt Fal`Kaa's forces!
You are transported into the Pillar of the Black.
The Pillar of the Black seems to be channeling its power through the lone shade standing in the center of the room. You must eliminate the shade to put a stop to Fal`Kaa.
_What you'll see upon port-in: A lone mob, "The Shade of Temperance" stands on the other side of the room._
_What to do: Engage the named, follow emotes, kill the three add sets. The Shade of Temperance and adds must be killed in order to beat this pillar._
_The Shade of Temperance hits for a max ~18,000 (no flurry; no rampage; no spells other than its emote-based effects). You'll have several emotes to follow._
**Emote (seen by everyone):** The Shade of Temperance glares angrily at \_\_\_\_\_ as it draws strength from your disorganization.
**Means:** _Its target needs more aggro (or has too much aggro, depending on who's tanking): The tank should have about 30% more aggro than everyone else on its hate list._
**Emote (seen by everyone):** Shadowy tendrils reach out for \_\_\_\_\_. The Shade of Temperance beckons them to draw closer.
**Emote (seen by target):** The Shade of Temperance beckons you to draw near!
**Means:** _Move within the Shade's melee range._
**Emote (seen by everyone):** Coalescing darkness swirls around the room and encircles \_\_\_\_\_. The Shade of Temperance prepares to banish the intruder.
**Emote (seen by target):** The Shade of Temperance glares at you. You should move away!
**Means:** _Run away from the Shade._
**Success Emote (seen by everyone):** \_\_\_\_\_ has avoided The Shade of Temperance's banishment.
**Emote (seen by everyone):** A darkened shadow looms over \_\_\_\_\_'s head.
**Emote (seen by target):** A halo of darkness circles over your head. You should duck!
**Means:** _Duck._
**Success Emote (seen by target):** ???
**Emote (seen by everyone):** The ever-present eyes of Pain and Suffering turn their focus toward \_\_\_\_\_. Associate with them at your own peril!
**Emote (seen by target):** You feel the cold stare of Pain and Suffering upon your soul. You must escape or prepare to absorb its punishment!
**Means:** _If you have a fade spell/ability, use it; or move away from everyone else._
_Failure to follow emotes will result in large damage spells, possible death touches, and named regeneration. If you follow them properly, you will see success emotes indicating when it's safe to resume your role._
_Over the course of this fight (at 90%, 45%, and 20% health), you'll get add waves. Each wave consists of 1x "an impervious shade" and 1x "a reborn shadow". The reborn shadow should be tanked and melee'd to death. The impervious shade should be kited to death. As you kite the shade, you'll see this emote:_
an impervious shade spasms violently as it trudges through the hall.
_Kill The Shade of Temperance and the adds to beat this pillar:_
The Shade of Temperance has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The Shade of Temperance fades into the shadows.
Your faction standing with Paragons of Shadows got worse.
Your faction standing with Shades of Alra got better.
The voice of Fal`Kaa Karathra, The Sovereign of Shadow, breaks the stillness of the night air, 'Curious, I did not expect such tenacity from you outsiders. You are not unlike the ones who drove us here, riders of discord, purveyors of chaos and destruction... Alra shall stop you...'

---

**Nature**
Attempt to disrupt the Pillar of Nature 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_Approach the Nature spire:_
The island resonates with power as your forces gather under the Pillar of Nature. You have five minutes to disrupt Anriella's forces!
You are transported into the Pillar of Nature.
The Pillar of Nature seems to be channeling its power through the great Treant. You will need to eliminate the verdant lifetenders in order to disrupt Anriella's focus.
_What you'll see upon port-in: "The Focus of Anriella", a large treant, on the other side of the room; 2x "a verdant lifetender" next to it; 2-3x "a naeya syr`vitral" in the halls outside the room._
_What to do: Kill all the small treants as they spawn and kill the Focus of Anriella. All treants (adds and named) must be killed in order to beat this pillar._
_The Focus of Anriella is located in the back of the room. It is permanently rooted and non-aggro. It is susceptible to all forms of damage, but takes extra damage from damage-over-time spells._
_Every 30 seconds for the entire time in this pillar, the Focus casts debuffs on six random targets. There are four debuffs in total:_
\- Diseased Leaves _(3 disease counters; if cured, triggers "Root Rot")_
\- Diseased Leaves _(3 disease counters; if NOT cured, triggers "Root Rot")_
\- Poisonous Leaves _(3 poison counters; if cured, triggers "Root Rot")_
\- Poisonous Leaves _(3 poison counters; if NOT cured, triggers "Root Rot")_
_"Root Rot" turns you into a tree, perma-roots you, and silences you for 8 ticks._
_How to tell the debuffs apart: If you get a debuff that needs to be cured, you'll see the emote "You feel diseased" or "You feel poisoned" flash up on your screen and in text. There is no such emote for the debuff that should NOT be cured. If you don't see either of these emotes, do NOT cure the debuff on you._
_After you port in to the pillar, 2x "a verdant lifetender" charge you. These hit for a max ~9,000 and AE rampage. Upon their deaths, more of them spawn. You'll have to kill a total of 10 (?) to make the Focus of Anriella killable. The lifetenders stop spawning once you reach this kill total._
_You'll also have several mobs called "okiina kindling" appear in the room and aggro upon port-in. While it's not necessary to kill the kindlings, you can use them to help you kill the liftenders. If you use fire nukes on the kindlings, you'll see this emote:_
okiina kindling's appears to be catching fire.
_If you use enough fire on them, the kindlings do an AE that damages the lifetenders. This isn't necessary if you have enough regular DPS to kill all the lifetenders. Alternatively, you can just keep the kindlings kited._
_The final mob type in this pillar is "a naeya syr`vitral". There are 2-3 of these in the hallways extending from the main room. You don't have to aggro them (although you may get one via social aggro). It's not necessary to kill these either; however, they are animals and can be charmed for extra DPS. They hit quite hard while charmed._
The Focus of Anriella has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The Focus of Anriella breaks apart into a heap of lifeless leaves and bark.
The voice of Anriella Fawnwalker, The Caretaker of Nature, cries out to its minions, 'Frightening times lie ahead of us! The harbingers of chaos, disorder and destruction aim to crush all life that stands in front of them! We must make haste to seek the guidance of the great one!'

---

**The Final Encounter**
Battle against the combined spirit of the wards 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
_After finishing the fourth pillar, everyone will find themselves back on the center island. After a series of emotes, the final named (Vsariard, the Precursor) appears and kills all the shades in the area:_
A worried voice cries out over the din of battle, 'My comrades! These harbingers are proving to be a greater threat than anticipated. We must move forward with our plan sooner than later!'
The once radiating spires now grow dim, looking lifeless without the infusion of the Pillars. The small statues overlooking the gravesite crumble to dust.
You hear a unified voice, harmonious in both meter and pitch. Its words are carefully chosen and eloquently spoken, 'It is time... Through Alra we shall be reborn. Your struggle here will be fruitless. All you have done, all those you have killed and pillaged will be forgotten. The enslavement of these pathetic shades is eternal! If we fall, we shall live again, we are beyond death... Harbingers, all you have conquered and overcome will be swept away in the passing sands of time. Prepare to join your fallen allies in forgotten servitude!'
The sky darkens as the once harmonious voice cries out in perverted dissonance! The amalgamated essence of the wards takes form in the skies above.
Anriella Fawnwalker places its hand over its chest and slowly burrows its fingers into its own ribcage. As Anriella's corpse seizes and falls to the ground an eruption of verdant light spills from its mortal wound into the construct.
Melretia Relward focuses its power inward and explodes in a shower of eerie blue light which envelops the construct.
The wards of purity and darkness nod in unison as they focus their power and exchange mortal blows that feed the growing construct.
The newly empowered amalgamation hovers down and looks upon the nameless ghosts.
A friendly voice calls out, 'We shall keep this foul perversion at bay for as long as we are tied to this plane. Prepare yourselves should we fall!'
The devout shade motions to speak but is thrown backwards before any words escape its ethereal form. A friendly voice calls out, addressing you, 'Seekers! For all you have done, we owe you our afterlives. We shall keep this foul perversion at bay for as long as we are tied to this plane! Prepare yourselves should we fall!'
Vsariard casts the final shade into oblivion and now sets its sights on you!
_At its worst (if you've failed all four pillars), it hits for a max ~28,000 (possibly higher unmitigated; does not flurry or rampage); has approximately 10 million hitpoints; and casts a 76k AE ("Soulpart") every 35 seconds._
_Prior to being engaged, he also buffs himself with a damage absorption buff, a 300-point melee damage shield, and a 3000-point spell damage shield._
_These effects and abilities are significantly lessened if you've beaten some or all pillars. If you've beaten no pillar at all, you'll want to kill him as quickly as possible due to the area mana drain combined with the large AEs._
_You'll see these emotes, each related to his abilities based on how well you did with each pillar:_
Vsariard begins directing debilitating shadows in an effort to turn the tide of battle.
Vsariard channels the power of Erion and conjures a glowing sentry stone.
Vsariard focuses the blessings of Anriella and glows with a verdant light.
_As it lowers in health, you see:_
The disembodied voices of the four wards call out to you in dissonant rage, 'Harbingers!? Seekers!? Pillagers! What do you expect to accomplish here? You will never free these peons. You are simply opening yourselves to the unavoidable grasp of death! Should our revelation fall we will be reborn through the immortality of Alra...'
_Upon its death:_
Vsariard, the Precursor has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Vsariard, the Precursor's corpse falls over, dead.
The wards speak in four familiar, distinct and contrasting voices, 'Look now, harbingers. Look upon that which you would throw away your lives to pillage.'
A crumbling statue lies where the once pristine base stood. Upon every facet of the statue you see brightly glowing runes. Its appearance resembles the broken stone tablet that you recovered so long ago...
The disembodied voices of the wards ring through the air as their physical remains deteriorate into pillars of mana, 'Your victory here is meaningless, harbingers. It shall be expunged from the memories of both the living and dead. We are eternal...'
The voices continue but are stopped short by the voice of the lone shade, 'Seekers... Take what you have earned and continue on from here. There is much for you to do beyond these lands. Though the wards will be reborn, so shall my kin. The dead are never far from their home...'

---

**Completion & Loot**
Claim your reward from the reliquary of the fallen 0/1 (Pillars of Alra)
The shade nods, a solemn look of admiration on its ethereal visage. Though the rebirth of the corrupted wards is a troubling truth, you feel you have completed an admirable deed today... Perhaps in time the 'eternal' power of the enslavers will be worn down and the faith-blinded followers will be set free...
_The shade will send you away if you say you wish to "leave":_
You say, 'Hail, a shade'
a shade nods, 'I thank you, seeker. Though the cycle continues, your victory today is not without meaning. The gradual progress toward freedom, the release of any of my fallen kin, the power you have gained this day... Tell me when you are ready to [leave] and return to that grand deception.'
You say, 'I wish to leave'
a shade says, in Alaran, 'Very well.' The shade reaches out and motions your eyelids closed. The sound of flowing wind fills your ears as you awaken from these visions.'
_Rewards:_
300 platinum
Elatarki's Diary - Four Cornered
Possible Chest Loot (1 Item + 1 Cantrip Per Task)

This is a solo kill task that begins with a distraught worshipper in Windsong Sanctuary, located at about 670, -175, -30 (inside the southern entrance to the inner area).
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
- No tasks
- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, a distraught worshipper'
a distraught worshipper says, in Alaran, 'May the Winds bless me! This is truly an ill-fated day. First my beautiful lute is destroyed by a dimwitted jumper, and now a filthy Outsider has come to defile our sacred lands! Had I my lute still, I would slay you now, Outsider - I don't suppose you'd [mind] doing me a favor and killing yourself?'
You say, 'Maybe you think I'm out of my mind'
a distraught worshipper says, in Alaran, 'I'm not surprised, but as you've no intention of slaying yourself, and I'm unable to do it for you, we'll call it a draw this time.' It croons sadly over its broken instrument, 'Besides, I'm not in the mood for killing anything right now beyond that infernal [haze jumper] that smashed my beloved lute.'
You say, 'What haze jumper?'
a distraught worshipper says, in Alaran, 'The stupid beast landed on me, causing me to drop my precious lute! If you could [kill] the blasted things, I might be grateful enough not to announce your presence to my fellow worshippers - although, if they find you themselves, you're on your own, Outsider.'
You say, 'I'll kill some of them'
a distraught worshipper says, in Alaran, 'I never thought I'd say this to an Outsider, but I wish you luck in your hunt.'

You say, 'Hail, Kiroptik'

You say, 'Thelibraxi?'

_This task is the first in a series of three; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Gibbledon Cogboggle in Windsong Sanctuary, located at about 20, -185, -32 (due west of the zone-in -- the southern entrance to the inner grassy area)._

\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Gibbledon Cogboggle'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'Psst! Hey you. Come here. Can you [help] a poor gnome out?'
You say, 'Help?'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'Seems I have gotten myself into quite a pickle. Mmm. Pickles. I sure would love one of those right about now. Anyway, I am kind of stranded here and was wondering if you could find me some [food]. I haven't eaten in at least an hour or two and I am famished.'
You say, 'What kind of food?'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'Hmm. I don't know. Those kangon creatures look kinda tasty. Think you could bring me some of their [meat]?'
You say, 'I'll make some meat out of them...'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'You're a lifesaver. Bring me some kangon ribs and perhaps I can give you some information you would be interested in.'
You have been assigned the task 'Stranger in a Strange Land'.
You have met a gnome in Windsong Sanctuary who needs some help to complete his research. Intrigued, you have agreed to help him.
Get some Kangon Ribs from the Wind Striders, Fluttering Kangons, or Breezerunners.

---

Obtain some Kangon Ribs 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_These are a common drop from Kangons in the inner area of the zone. Note: These are NOT pre-lootable (nor are any other items in the task)._
Deliver the Kangon Ribs to Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Speak with Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
You say, 'Hail, Gibbledon Cogboggle'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'Some pickles would have been better, but this should do. Thanks. Now I will hold up my end of the bargain and tell you what I am doing here. I came to investigate the link between the Alarans and their god Ryken. It appears that they share a link, and Ryken can communicate to them and through them whenever Ryken so desires. Ryken can even use stones and other inanimate objects to communicate to the Alarans and others. This [intrigues] me.'
You say, 'What intrigues you?'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'I love challenges and figuring out how this link works is my next one. I think you can help me. There are a couple of problems though. Someone or something appears to have stolen my tools while I dozed off the other day. I bet it was those worshippers! Get my tools back and perhaps we can investigate this link that Ryken shares with the Alarans further.'
Find Gibbledon' Tools 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Task Window Says:_ Find Gibbledon's tools somewhere in Windsong. He thinks the worshippers might have them.
_The tools are a common drop from Alarans (any part of the zone) and golems (center of the zone)._
Deliver Gibbledon's Tools to Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Speak with Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
You say, 'Hail, Gibbledon Cogboggle'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'These are definitely my tools. I am lost without them. Thanks. Now we can get down to business. Perhaps you have seen the strange totem-like stones around Windsong? They are called Sentry Stones. Take this Harmonic Recording Device and investigate some of the stones. Perhaps they hold some clue about how Ryken can communicate to the Alarans here.'
With the Harmonic Recording Device in your inventory, speak with a sentry stone 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_There are 3-4 sentry stones located throughout the inner area of the zone._
You say, 'Hail, a sentry stone'
a sentry stone says, in Alaran, 'A series of beautiful notes dance through your mind. For a moment, you feel connected to all the beings that inhabit Windsong.'
Return the Harmonic Recording Device to Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Speak with Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
You say, 'Hail, Gibbledon Cogboggle'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'Musical notes you say? This should have been obvious. The Alarans that live here appear to communicate with musical instruments. I would love to examine some of these instruments first hand. First however, I am going to take a break and eat those kangon ribs you brought to me. Just talk to me again when you are ready to help me with my research.'

_This shared task (1-6 players) begins with Wilmina in Windsong Sanctuary, located at 650, -800, -42 (southeastern part of the inner area)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 73 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Wilmina'
Wilmina says 'Hello! It's so nice to see someone from our homeland. Just between you and me, these Alarans kind of creep me out. Now that you're here, would you like to help my business [venture]?'
You say, 'What business venture?'
Wilmina says 'I believe I can make a killing back home selling kangon mounts. The kangon are swift and sturdy. Perfect attributes for a mount. Unfortunately, the wild ones are too hard to tame. If I could get my hands on some of their [eggs] though, I believe I could raise them to become trusty mounts.'
You say, 'Their eggs?'
Wilmina says 'If you could get me some of their eggs, I could pop them into the Incubate-O-Matic next to me that I constructed. It will speed up the incubation of the eggs by at least 95 percent. Unfortunately to obtain the best quality eggs, the kangons will need to be put down. What do you say? Can you [help] me out?'
You say, 'I'll be happy to help!'
Wilmina says 'Excellent! Now get out there and get some eggs! I can't wait to try out my Incubate-O-Matic!'
You have been assigned the task 'Eggscellent Eggs'.
Wilmina needs you to collect some different colored Kangon eggs so that she can try to incubate them in her Incubate-O-Matic.
Obtain a Yellow Speckled Egg, a Blue Speckled Egg, a Green Speckled Egg, a Red Speckled Egg, a Purple Speckled Egg, a Brown Speckled Egg, an Orange Speckled Egg, a Black Speckled Egg, and a Violet Speckled Egg by killing wind striders, fluttering kangons, and breezerunners. Wilmina will want the eggs to be delivered to her in a certain order, so she will only ask for one egg at a time. Once you deliver an egg to Wilmina, select the correct power level so that it can be successfully incubated in the Incubate-O-Matic. When you are done incubating all the eggs, speak with Wilmina.

---

_All items in this task are pre-lootable._
_You'll need nine colored eggs (Yellow; Blue; Green; Red; Purple; Brown; Orange; Black; Violet). These are dropped by kangons ("a wind strider" drops yellow, blue, and green eggs; "a fluttering kangon" drops red, purple, and brown eggs; "a breezerunner" drops orange, black, and violet eggs)._
_You'll need to deliver them one at a time to Wilmina. For each one, you'll have to say the correct "Incubate-O-Matic" power level, otherwise you get an add spawn. Power levels are low, medium, or high._
_As you turn in the eggs, say the following phrases:_
\- "yellow medium power"
\- "blue high power"
\- "green low power"
\- "red low power"
\- "purple medium power"
\- "brown high power"
\- "orange high power"
\- "black low power"
\- "violet medium power"

I need to turn this dial to yellow and then set the correct power setting. What setting do you think we should try? [Low yellow power], [medium yellow power], or [high yellow power]?'

You say, 'Medium yellow power'
Wilmina says 'The egg is hatching! It's a miracle! Er, I mean, I knew my Incubate-O-Matic would work!'

_This solo task begins with Wasinai in Windsong Sanctuary, located at about 2700, 915, -27 (northwestern entrance to the inner area)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Wasinai'
Wasinai says, in Alaran, 'Ever since you and the others from Antonica have arrived here, our land has not been the same. Be gone unless you are able to [undo] the damage you have caused to Windsong.'
You say, 'Undo WHAT damage?!'
Wasinai says, in Alaran, 'Your kind has caused an evil pollution to spread throughout Windsong. It taints and destroys my brethren and this land. It must be stopped, and since your kind has brought it upon us, it is your [responsibility] to do so.'
You say, 'Responsibility?'
Wasinai says, in Alaran, 'If you truly wish to help, I thank you. I am afraid it is too late for the elementals that have succumbed to the pollution. They must be destroyed. Do so, and then return to me.'
You have been assigned the task 'Stop the Pollution'.
An Alaran named Wasinai believes that you and the other Norrathians are polluting the land. Perform the actions that Wasinai has asked of you to prove you are not to blame.

---

Kill some polluted wind elementals 0/6 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_These are found throughout the outer area of the zone._
Speak with Wasinai 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
You say, 'Hail, Wasinai'
Wasinai says, in Alaran, 'It is unfortunate the polluted elementals had to be destroyed, but it was for the benefit of all. I also must apologize to you. As much as I dislike the presence of outsiders here, it is not your fault that the elementals have become polluted. It appears that one of my brethren captured the true culprit. It is a foul creature known as a swinetor. Unfortunately this beast has escaped and his unholy presence is what caused the pollution. Please find this escaped swinetor and kill it.'
Kill the escaped swinetor prisoner 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_"an escaped swinetor prisoner" spawns at about 2400, -430, -28 (northeastern part of the inner area)._
Speak with Wasinai 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
You say, 'Hail, Wasinai'
Wasinai says, in Alaran, 'The swinetor is dead? You have done well. Unfortunately there is one more problem. A group of contaminated elementals are planning on attacking the [sentry stones]. I believe the sentry stones are trying to cleanse the pollution from the land and are angering the contaminated elementals. We cannot let them harm the stones. Please protect the stones and then return to me. I will ensure that you are rewarded for your efforts.'
You say, 'What sentry stones?'
Wasinai says, in Alaran, 'The sentry stones are sacred artifacts. They allow our god, Ryken to communicate with us. I have never seen one of the stones destroyed, and I do not want to know what would happen if one was.'

_For each sentry stone, you'll have three elemental adds to contend with. They'll spawn as you approach and/or hail the sentry stone. While they don't auto-aggro and are actually splittable, you'll likely aggro at least one of them after the trigger._
_The elementals are casters (wizards); are mezzable, stunnable, and rootable; and each hit for a max ~12,500._

_This solo task begins with Kolain in Windsong Sanctuary, located at about 2125, 1165, -37 (the northwestern part of the inner area)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Kolain'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'Do not fear me, stranger. I care not about who you are or where you are from. I only care about my [duty] in this life, and it has been put on hold due to unfortunate circumstances.'
You say, 'Your duty?'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'It is my job and my calling to play music that soothes the chaotic spirits of the wind. I cannot do that without my flute however. I awoke this morning and my flute was missing. Without it, the spirits of the wind will be in turmoil. I must get my flute [back]!'
You say, 'Get it back?'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'You would help me? Perhaps the Norrathians are not as unseemly as others say. I know not where it could be, but perhaps if you spoke with the spirits of the wind, you could get some clues. The spirits see all.'
You have been assigned the task 'Winds of Change'.
Kolain has asked you to help recover the Flute of Calming that is used to calm the spirits of the wind.
Explore the northwest edge of Windsong Sanctuary for a clue about the first piece of the Flute of Calming.
_NOTE: The items in this task are not pre-lootable by normal means (it won't automatically update), but it's been reported the steps will update if you hand the pre-looted items to an NPC (who will in turn, give it back)._

---

Search the northwest edge of Windsong for a clue about the first piece of the missing flute 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_This step updates in the extreme northwest part of Windsong, at about 3260, 1050, -26._
A gust of wind swirls around you. A wispy voice echoes in your mind. 'You seek to reconstruct the Flute of Calming. Yesss. Thisss must be done. I broke the flute into three piecessss in a fit of rage. I am not proud of thisss. Recover the piecessss. The spirits of wind need its calming melodiessssss. The first piece has fallen from Windsong to the Pillarsss of Alra below. You must get it back.'
Obtain the first piece of the Windsong flute from the Pillars of Alra 0/1 (ALL)
_Task Window Says:_ The first piece of the Flute of Calming has fallen to the ground below Windsong Sanctuary in the Pillars of Alra.
_Find "First Piece of the Flute of Calming" as a ground spawn in the Pillars of Alra. It spawns at about -980, 600, 1 (on the ground level, just southwest of the ramp leading up to the central island)._
Search the northeast edge of Windsong for a clue about the second piece of the missing flute 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Task Window Says:_ Explore the northeast edge of Windsong Sanctuary for a clue about the second piece of the Flute of Calming.
_This step updates in the extreme northeast boundary of Windsong (about 3230, -1275, -25)._
A gust of wind swirls around you. A wispy voice echoes in your mind. 'The second piece of the Flute of Calming has fallen into the handssss of the Swinetor below the Resplendent Temple. They do not know the value of the item they possesssss, thinking it junk. Get it back for ussss.'
Obtain the second piece of the Windsong flute from a swinetor in the Resplendent Temple 0/1 (ALL)
_Task Window Says:_ The second piece of the Flute of Calming is now in possession of the Swinetor below the Resplendent Temple.
_This is a random drop off Ulork and Piq`a Swinetor mobs in the "In-Between" (underground caves) of the Resplendent Temple._
Search the south edge of Windsong for a clue about the third piece of the missing flute 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_This step updates in the south-central part of Windsong (about -150, 20, -40)._
A gust of wind swirls around you. A wispy voice echoes in your mind. 'The third piece of the Flute of Calming has been taken by the filqua in Windsong Sanctuary. Find the filqua that has the piece and get it back.'
Obtain the third piece of the Windsong flute from a filqua in Windsong 0/1 (ALL)
_Task Window Says:_ The third, and final piece of the Flute of Calming has been stolen by the filqua in Windsong Sanctuary.
_This is a random drop from filquas in the inner area of Windsong._
Deliver the first piece of the Windsong flute to Kolain 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Deliver the second piece of the Windsong flute to Kolain 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Deliver the third piece of the Windsong flute to Kolain 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Speak with Kolain 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Be ready for a fight. Wisthir will go aggro about 20-25 seconds after the hail._
You say, 'Hail, Kolain'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'You have done it! What happened? Why was the flute broken into pieces?'
Wisthir says, in Alaran, 'I can answer that. It was me. The music of the flute is so soothing. I want you to play only for me.'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'But why? You know that the music I play is for all the spirits of the wind. I cannot play for you alone.'
Wisthir says, in Alaran, 'But I helped you recover the pieces and I am truly sorry for what I have done. Play the flute for me. Play only for me!'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'I cannot do that, Wisthir. You know that. I am sorry.'
Wisthir says, in Alaran, 'The music must be played for me, and me alone!'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'Help! You must defeat Wisthir! He has gone insane!'
Kill Wisthir 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Wisthir hits for a max ~17,500._
Speak with Kolain 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
You say, 'Hail, Kolain'
Kolain says, in Alaran, 'It is regrettable that Wisthir attacked us. Your assistance will allow me to play the flute once again however and calm the remaining spirits of the wind. I thank you for all you have done.'

375 platinum

You say, 'Hail, Gibbledon Cogboggle'

Are you [ready to test] the disruptor?'

You have been assigned the task 'The Sound of Silence'.

Speak with Gibbledon Cogboggle 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Whoever hails Gibbledon receives a "Harmonic Disruptor"._
You say, 'Hail, Gibbledon Cogboggle'
Gibbledon Cogboggle says 'The Alarans have set up numerous sentry stones that are generating a magical barrier preventing entry to the inner section of the temple. You must use the harmonic disruptor on the sentry stones to lower the magical barrier. Each sentry stone is tuned to listen to a particular note from an instrument. After each use of the disruptor, return it to me so that I can properly tune it to disable the next sentry stone. If you feel you are not up to handling this however, just let me know and I will help you [leave].'
_The next 16 steps open up one at a time. Whoever has the Harmonic Disruptor will right-click the first sentry stone, bring the disruptor back to Gibbledon, then go right-click the second sentry stone, bring it back to Gibbledon, etc., until all eight sentry stones have been clicked._
_If you try to enter the very center, you'll see this emote and be knocked back:_
A barrier prevents you from entering!
_The eight "an active sentry stone" are found surrounding the very center of the zone. You have to stand right under the stone for the click to take effect._
_If you click the wrong one, you'll see:_
You are not near the correct sentry stone!
_If you click the right one, you'll see:_
The harmonic disruptor has deactivated the sentry stone controlling the barrier to the inner section of the temple!
_You'll then bring it back to Gibbledon for a tuning:_
Gibbledon Cogboggle quickly tunes the harmonic disruptor and then hands it back to you.
_NOTE: After you do the first tuning with Gibbledon, golems called "an unspeaking sentinel" (hit for a max ~12,500) spawn all around the center area. The further you progress in the task, the more golems you'll see appearing. Killing them has no bearing on the task (although there are achievements for leaving them all alive as well as killing them all)._
_Once you right-click a correct active sentry stone, it turns into "a deactivated sentry stone"._

_This group mission begins with General Terasal in Windsong Sanctuary, located at -225, 1670 (northeast of the zone-in)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completion of "Stranger in a Strange Land"
\- Completion of "Getting Down to Business"
\- Completion of "Making Music"
\- Completion of "The Sound of Silence"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, General Terasal'
_Without pre-requisites:_
General Terasal says, in Alaran, 'Hello. Be careful here, friend. This is not a place of peace and song. This is a place of power, where sound can destroy as easily as it can soothe.'
_With pre-requisites:_
You say, 'Hail, General Terasal'
General Terasal says, in Alaran, 'I have heard of you. I have been preparing for your arrival, in fact. I am a general in rank, though none of us have much experience at war. I imagine that you have already been told about our history, so I will not bore you with that. I, for example, am a musician by trade. A good one, if you ask me. This, along with my military training, makes me uniquely [qualified] to help you here.'
You say, 'Qualified?'
General Terasal says, in Alaran, 'Ryken's power is in sound. Mostly in the power of the spoken word, but since our arrival here his followers have taken to song and music. I have been studying them since our war with them started, and I have some idea how they think and how their power works. With Ryken assisting them, the force of Erillion are more dangerous than they should be. With your help I think I have a way to [draw Ryken out] we can weaken alis power and perhaps lift the siege on Argath.'
You say, 'How do we draw Ryken out?'
General Terasal says, in Alaran, 'I have developed an aria of sorts that should have a dramatic effect on all the residents here, probably causing most of them to flee or even dissipate. The disturbance will certainly bring Ryken's attention here and away from Argath for a while. It might also give you a chance to defeat the avatar al has left here in alis realm. That will certainly weaken al and aid us. I am willing to risk the wrath of a god if you are ready to fight ali. Do you have many [willing] to fight, or are your numbers small, but [powerful]?'
You say, 'We're small, but powerful!'
General Terasal says, in Alaran, 'It is true that few can fight with the fervor of many, but we cannot begin battle until the aria is playing. While I consider myself an accomplished composer, it will take more than myself to bring this song to life. Many of the Windsong worshippers carry magical instruments that we will need to play the aria. Once your group has [assembled], you can begin recovering those essential musical pieces.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Cacophony of Power'.
General Terasal has composed an aria that will lure Ryken back to Windsong when played, allowing you to attack the Alaran god!
In order to perform the aria, various enchanted instruments need to be recovered from the worshippers and devotees within Windsong.
You say, 'We have assembled!'
General Terasal says, in Alaran, 'I wish you luck.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Windsong Sanctuary.

Recover an Enchanted Lute 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Recover an Enchanted Drum 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Recover an Enchanted Flute 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
Recover an Enchanted Horn 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Kill Alaran mobs in the outer area of the instanced zone until you've collected all five items._
Head into the central amphitheatre 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Head to the very center of the zone._
Place the instruments around the tomb 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Task Window Says:_ Place the instruments around the tomb, near the organ pipes.
Instruct the enchanted instruments to begin playing 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Task Window Says:_ Let the instruments know when you are ready for them to "begin" playing.
_When ready for a fight, target the instruments and tell them to "begin playing". NOTE: The task locks at this point._
As the aria plays, an Echo of Ryken manifests itself within the amphitheatre.
Defeat the Echo of Ryken while the aria plays! 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_Task Window Says:_ Defeat the Echo of Ryken while the music is playing. If the music has stopped, you may instruct the instruments to "being" again.
_The Echo of Ryken hits for a max ~20,000. Early in the fight, he casts these two spells:_
Commanding Voice: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Charm up to level 110
Wretched Rhetoric: Single Target, Magic (-900)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 26000
2: Adjust Mana (-7000)
3: Decrease Hitpoints by 13000 per tick
4: Decrease Mana by 3500 per tick
5: Increase Curse Counter by 20
_At around 50%, the named goes inactive and spawns six adds:_
As the second aria begins, a wall of sentry stones forms a protective barrier around the Echo of Ryken.
_NOTE: If you come into contact with the sentry stones surrounding the Echo of Ryken, you'll be death touched._
The Echo of Ryken calls forth als winged allies!
_At this point, you get six adds called "a filqua toneglider" (mezzable; stunnable) which immediately aggro. Each of these procs a two-second stun called "Overwhelming Screech":_
Overwhelming Screech: PB AE 25', Unresistable (0)
1: Stun (2.00 sec)
_Once the bats are dead, the named goes live again:_
As the third verse begins, the protective barrier of sentry stones explodes, leaving the Echo of Ryken vulnerable once again!
_In this stage of the encounter, the named casts a few different AEs:_
Bouncing Bombast: PB AE 40', Magic (-900)
1: Knockback (4) and Toss Up (4)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 31000
Echoing Eulogy: Single Target, Magic (-900)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 18500 per tick
2: Decrease Attack Speed by 70%
Monologue of Melancholy: PB AE 50', Magic (-900)
1: Decrease Movement by 50%
2: Decrease Attack Speed by 40%
_Soon after he goes active, 2x "Blind Dreamer" mobs spawn and power up the Echo as long as they remain alive:_
The Echo of Ryken draws power from the Blind Dreamers.
_One of these is killable only by nukes; one of these is killable only by melee. They're each permanently rooted and hit for a max ~15,500._
Collect your reward from the enchanted chest 0/1 (Windsong Sanctuary)
_General Terasal spawns nearby; as does an enchanted chest._
You say, 'Hail, General Terasal'

An aria played by enchanted instruments lured the Echo of Ryken back to Windsong, allowing you to defeat the body that it inhabited, while restoring some peace to the realm.

_This is a kill task that begins with Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found at about -330, 280, -41 -- in the southwestern jail block in the lower level of the main building)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_

You say, 'Hail, Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i'
Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i says, in Alaran, 'I honestly don't know why I'm in here, I didn't [steal] anything! They've got the wrong person.'
You say, 'Steal?'
Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i says, in Alaran, 'Alright, well maybe I did technically take a loaf of bread that wasn't mine, but I wouldn't call that stealing, per say. More like [borrowing].'
You say, 'Borrowing?'
Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i says, in Alaran, 'Yes, I borrow things all the time. I once borrowed a half dozen braxi from a total stranger and sold them to another fellow three towns away!' It cackles, 'Oh, that was a great day! On the downside, though, it does mean I have to [move] around a lot. \*sigh\* In hindsight, I think coming to here was a bad idea after all.'
You say, 'Move around a lot?'
Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i says, in Alaran, 'Indeed, friend, I'm not from this city. I'm an outsider much like you.' It gives you a conspiratorial wink, 'Hey! I don't suppose you could [help] me out by killing a few of the guards so I can get out of here?'
You say, 'I can help'
Prisoner Ii`iv Vio`i says, in Alaran, 'Wonderful! No need to bother with a key, though,' it pats a pocket, meaningfully, 'I've got that covered.'
You have been assigned the task 'It's Only a Crime If You're Caught!'.
Ii`iv has asked you to slay the guards so that it can let itself free.

You say, 'Hail, Culdylri'

You say, 'I'm not going to take you...'
Culdylri says, in Alaran, 'You- you're not here to take me away?' It stares unbelievingly, its tentacles quivering with fear, 'How did you get into this place? No, never mind - I don't care. Just please, do not release me! These bars are all that stands between me and those [carnifex] fiends!'

_This is a kill task that begins with Druthur in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found at about -5, 390, -39 -- in the west-central jail block on the lower level of the main building)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Druthur'
Druthur says, in Alaran, 'Hah! I want no part in your dream of a world for lunatics and madmen. Begone!'
_To get him to speak with you, talk to Oashim in the cell across the hall._
You say, 'Hail, Oashim'
Oashim says 'SCREEEEEEE!!' - From the opposite cell, you hear Druthur laughing uncontrollably, 'Hah! Come to give the oashim alis final meal before taking al to the carnifex, have you? And they said \*I\* was crazy! I'm not the one [imprisoning] vermin.''
You say, 'You're not imprisoning them?'
Oashim chitters softly.
You say, 'Who's imprisoning you?'
Druthur says, in Alaran, 'Hmm?' It screws its eyes up and gives you a calculating look, 'Oh, goodness! I thought you were one of those nutcase guards. I apologize for the Oashim, al only shrieks like that at people al doesn't know. The city had ali locked up, for [wandering] the streets and since then al's had something of a grudge against strangers. Not that I blame al. They're mad - ALL of them!'
You say, 'Wandering?'
Druthur says, in Alaran, 'Well, as the guards explained when I asked,' it switches to a tone of mock-arrogance, 'It is against our laws for vermin to roam the street. The oashim has broken the law, so al must be punished for alis [crimes].'
You say, 'What crimes?'
Druthur says, in Alaran, 'As if public rodency wasn't enough,' it says, switching back to its normal voice, 'they're also charging al with vagrancy, loitering, and being visibly emaciated.' It stops to ponder this last crime for a moment, then shrugs, 'I suppose emaciation is considered acceptable by the [law], as long as it's well hidden when one is in public.'
You say, 'The law?'
Druthur says, in Alaran, 'This one's fate is now sealed; al was doomed from the moment they caught al. Al will have alis trial, and then, be executed. Don't pine for al, though - I'll soon be [following], most likely, to keep the little critter company.'
You say, 'Following?'
Druthur says, in Alaran, 'To tell the truth, I've grown rather fond of the fellow. I've named al Oashim.' It shakes its head sadly, 'It's too late to save either of us, and I for one do not regret my crimes, but if you want to save others from the same fate as Oashim, go slay the citizens of this 'fine' city. As for myself, I'd just appreciate some peace and quiet in my final hours.'
_A task window pops up offering two tasks._
You have been assigned the task 'Ratting Out the Faithful'.
It seems there's nothing you can do to help Oashim; however, you may be able to prevent the same fate from befalling others by reducing the number of faithful citizens in the city.

---

Speak with Druthur 0/1 (Erillion)
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
Experience

_This task is the first in a series of four; a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Joral in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found at -640, 470, 1 -- in in the northeastern part of the city's southwestern quadrant)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Joral'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'You are the outsiders that everyone is talking about. I don't know if it's true, but the citizens of this city blame you and your people for the strange [dreams] we have been having.'
You say, 'What dreams?'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'The dreams started at the same time you and your people came to our land. Who is to blame? I, unlike the other citizens am not so quick to point fingers. The dreams fill my mind with thoughts of chaos and anarchy. I have never had such thoughts before. It is unheard of here in [Erillion].'
You say, 'Erillion?'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'The City of Bronze. Order and discipline rule here. We citizens do not have thoughts of anarchy or rebellion. But the dreams have changed many citizens as of late. Not only are the dreams making me question authority, but I see vivid images of my dear friend [Uyyina] being tortured by the [Carnifex].'
You say, 'The Carnifex?'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'The Carnifex are brutal torturers who mete out punishment to those that have broken the law. Their services are usually not needed, as the citizens obey the laws. Lately however more and more people have gone missing and rumors of once law-abiding citizens being taken to prison are circulating.'
You say, 'Who is Uyyina?'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'In my dreams, I see my friend Uyyina being imprisoned and tortured for crimes they did not commit. I know these are just dreams, but they are so vivid. I need your help. I need you to see if Uyyina is indeed being held [captive].'
You say, 'Captive?'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'If Uyyina is indeed being held captive, you can find al in the lower section of the city hall, in the prison. Will you [check] for me? I beg of you!'
You say, 'I will check'
Joral says, in Alaran, 'Thank you. I anxiously await any news you may have.'
You have been assigned the task 'Dreams of Chaos'.
A citizen of the City of Bronze, named Joral, has been having some rather strange dreams as of late. It appears that many citizens are also suffering from the same dreams. One dream in particular bothers Joral; the dream in which Joral's friend, Uyyina, is being held in prison.
Enter the prisons below the city hall and see if Uyyina is being held captive.

---

Speak with Uyyina 0/1 (Erillion)
_Uyyina is in a prison cell in the west-central jail block of the lower part of the main building (approximately 20, 445, -43)._
