You say, 'I'm here to rescue you...'
Uyyina says, in Alaran, 'There is no way for me to make it out of here without getting killed. . . Actually, if you were able to get some of the armor that the guards wear, I could disguise myself and perhaps escape.'
Obtain some Erillian Guard Armor from a guard 0/1 (Erillion)
_This is a common drop from guards._
Give the Erillian Guard Armor to Uyyina 0/1 (Erillion)
Speak with Uyyina 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Uyyina'
Uyyina says, in Alaran, 'I do not know why you would risk rescuing me, but you have my thanks. Many citizens are having strange dreams and they blame the Norrathians. I along with a small group of [others] believe there is something [more] going on.'
You say, 'Something more going on?'
Uyyina says, in Alaran, 'The government is trying to keep something hidden from the citizens. I have no proof of this as of yet, but I am sure it is related to the dreams the citizens of Erillian are having.'
You say, 'Who are the others?'
Uyyina says, in Alaran, 'I, along with a small group of other concerned citizens are investigating these dreams and believe the government is not telling us the truth. That's why I was imprisoned. They wanted to know what my group plans to do. Thankfully you showed up and the Carnifex didn't torture any answers out of me. The leader of our group, Tyzen, has escaped and is hiding somewhere in the hills nearby. I think it would be best if you find Tyzen and speak with ali.'
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Locate Tyzen, the leader of a rebel group investigating the dreams. Tyzen is said to be hiding in the hills outside the City of Bronze.
_Tyzen is found outside the city's gates in the southwestern part of the zone (about -1400, 1950, 75)._
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'You are the ones that freed Uyyina. You have our thanks. I am Tyzen and I think you can be trusted to help our [group].'
You say, 'What group?'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'As Uyyina might have explained, we are investigating the strange dreams that the citizens of Erillian are having. Most blame you and your people, the Norrathians. My group and I believe there is something else going on and the government is keeping it a secret. One of my contacts in the city hall claims there are some documents that detail exactly what is going on. If you were able to [get these documents] perhaps we can get to the bottom of this.'
You say, 'I'll get these documents'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'I don't know exactly where the documents are, but my guess is that they are somewhere in the records room of the city hall. Obtain the documents and return them to me. It is in your best interest to help us.'
Defeat record keepers and obtain the Secret Documents 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Defeat record keepers in the city hall and see if you can locate the Secret Documents.

Deliver the Secret Documents to Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'

Perhaps my contact in the city hall can decode them. Take the documents to Record Keeper Buorin. Al will most likely be found in alir's quarters in the city hall.'
Speak with Record Keeper Buorin 0/1 (Erillion)
_Record Keeper Buorin is found in the first room to the north as you enter the government/jail building)._
You say, 'Hail, Record Keeper Buorin'

Deliver the Secret Documents to Record Keeper Buorin 0/1 (Erillion)
_Hand Buorin the documents._
Speak with Record Keeper Buorin 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Record Keeper Buorin'
Record Keeper Buorin scans the documents. 'These documents are indeed coded. I think I can break the code, but the print is far too small for me to make out. If you could locate a magnifying glass, I could perhaps read the documents better. You might be able to get a magnifying glass from one of the record keepers.'
Obtain a Magnifying Glass from the record keepers 0/1 (Erillion)
_Again, this is a common drop from record keepers (NOT pre-lootable)._
Deliver the Magnifying Glass to Record Keeper Buorin 0/1 (Erillion)

Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'

This task is the second in a series of four; a shared task that begins with Nulbar in Erillion, the City of Bronze. He's found inside the main building in the center (from the entrance, go into the left hall -- the second room on the left at about 65, 140, 1)

- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Nulbar'
Nulbar says, in Alaran, 'Yes, what is it? You have some documents for me to look over?'
You have been assigned the task 'A Spy Among Us'.
You have found some documents that just may hold a clue to the strange dreams the citizens of the City of Bronze have been having. Unfortunately, they are coded. Tyzen has sent you to a contact named Nulbar. Perhaps this Nulbar can decipher the documents.
Give the Secret Documents to Nulbar 0/1 (Erillion)
Speak with Nulbar 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Nulbar'
Nulbar says, in Alaran, 'Where did you get these? These are classified. I should call the guards to haul you off to jail. That would mean a ton of paperwork though and I am already too busy. Get out of here before I change my mind.'
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
Task Window Says: Nulbar refused to speak with you. Perhaps Tyzen can convince alis otherwise. Speak with Tyzen.
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'So Nulbar refuses to cooperate, eh? Well I just happen to know a little secret that al has been keeping that could ruin alis political career. Why don't you go back and inform Nulbar of this.'
Speak with Nulbar 0/1 (Erillion)
Task Window Says: Speak with Nulbar and let alis know that you know their dirty, little secret.
You say, 'Hail, Nulbar'
Nulbar says, in Alaran, ''Tyzen! That filthy oashim. Al wouldn't dare expose my indiscretion! On second thought, perhaps al would. Very well, I will try to decode the document for you.' Nulbar carefully unrolls the parchment and begins to read it. 'It's no good I am afraid. This appears to be a very high level document and has been written in a code only known to a few top officials. There still may be a way to [decode] it however.''
You say, 'How can you decode it?'
Nulbar says, in Alaran, 'Some of the bureaucrats in the city hall use magic eyepieces to decode very sensitive coded documents. If you were able to get such an eyepiece, I could most likely use it to read these documents.'

Bureaucrats can be found on the first floor of the government building.
Give the Eyepiece to Nulbar 0/1 (Erillion)
Speak with Nulbar 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Nulbar'
Nulbar says, in Alaran, ''Very interesting. It appears that the government has planted a spy within Tyzen's little group. It does not mention who it is, but it appears the spy's mission is to get as much information about the rebellious group as possible and report the findings to a high ranking government official. It seems that Tyzen is not as smart as alis thinks!' Nulbar chuckles. 'Now begone. I have done as you have asked.''
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
Task Window Says: Return to Tyzen and let alis know of the spy within the organization.
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'

You say, 'Tell me about aleself'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'I founded the group, so I am obviously not the spy.'
You say, 'Tell me about Uyyina'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Uyyina joined the group about a month ago. I doubt Uyyina could be the spy since alis was sent to prison. Why would the government imprison one of their own?'
You say, 'Tell me about Caindi'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Caindi provides the muscle for the group. I think of alis as my bodyguard. I trust Caindi too much to believe al could be the spy.'
You say, 'Tell me about Verobi'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Verobi is wise and old. I consider alis second of command in the group. I have known Verobi for many years. I would be shocked if alis turned out to be spying for the government.'
You say, 'Tell me about Srezen'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Srezen is a healer and takes care of any wounds our members may sustain while on missions. Srezen is too nurturing and caring to be a spy in my opinion.'
You say, 'Tell me about Lijka'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Lijka is the newest member of the group. Alis acquires any supplies the group may need and keeps track of stock. I suppose Lijka could be the spy, but I don't think alis is smart enough to be honest.'

_This task is the third in a series of four; a solo task that begins with Caindi in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found at location 400, 630, 1 -- in the southern part of the city's northwestern quadrant, by a fountain)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "Dreams of Chaos"
\- Completed "A Spy Among Us"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Caindi'
Caindi scowls at you. 'I don't trust you, but if Tyzen trusts you, then I won't question alis judgement. I was approached not long ago by a guard named, Kalinir. They promised aleself a large sum of gold if I agreed to spy on the group. I declined. I would never betray the group. Find [Kalinir] and see if you can find out who alis is working for.'
You have been assigned the task 'Restoring Order'.
Tyzen's group has been infiltrated by a spy, and even worse, it was one of Tyzen's most trusted group members. Tyzen has asked you to get to the bottom of this and see who convinced Verobi to betray his group.
You say, 'Where is Kalinir?'
Caindi says, in Alaran, 'Kalinir can most likely be found in the government offices in the city hall.'

---

Question Guard Kalinir 0/1 (Erillion)
_Guard Kalinir spawns in the government office building. From the entrance, head north to the last room on the left. Be ready for a fight._
You say, 'Hail, Guard Kalinir'
Guard Kalinir says, in Alaran, 'Jerinos will praise me for killing you!'
Defeat Guard Kalinir 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Kalinir would rather fight, than speak. Kill them.
_Guard Kalinir hits for a max ~12,500 (stunnable; slowable). NOTE: If doing this as a group, you'll have to kill him once for every member of your group. Whoever is on the step "Defeat Guard Kalinir" must be the first to aggro him. Only the first on his aggro will get credit for this step._
_(He has a quick respawn time.)_
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Jerinos, eh? Funny you should mention that name. A courier just dropped off a letter for you and it says that Jerinos would like to meet with you.'

_Jerinos is found on the second floor of the government building in a room located at about 25, 180, 42. (You'll have to kill several see invis mobs to him.)_
You say, 'Hail, Jerinos'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'So you received my invitation. I apologize for the inconvenience of reaching me. Stay your sword. I am not your enemy. I have some [information] I think you will find quite interesting.'
You say, 'What information?'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'It's unfortunate you got mixed up with Tyzen's rebel group. If you knew their true plans, you would not have done so. They don't trust you. In fact, they are planning on handing you over to the guards. I on the other hand can [help] you if you do as I say.'
You say, 'How can you help?'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'One of Tyzen's members, Lijka, has been sniffing around and getting a bit too nosy for my liking. They need to be taken out. It needs to look like an [accident] however. Take care of this and then return to me.'
You say, 'An accident?'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'You didn't hear this from me, but in the hills outside the city gates, a weed known as Briltimore grows. This particular weed is known to have strange effects on braxi. Lijka works as a merchant during the day and always has alis trusty braxi along with alis. If the braxi were to unfortunately eat the Briltimore weed, who knows what would happen.'
Pick some Briltimore Weeds 0/4 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Obtain some Briltimore Weeds that grow in the hills outside the city.
_This is a ground spawn throughout the area outside the city's boundaries. There are several different types of plants growing on the ground. This one is entirely green._
Weeds are located at:
-158, +1742
-999, +1517
-1719, +1326
-1450, +1567
Give the Briltimore Weeds to Lijka's Braxi 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Give the Briltimore Weeds to Lijka's braxi. This should send the braxi into a rage, hopefully killing Lijka in the process.
_Lijka's Braxi is found at about 1050, -420, 2 (northwest part of the city's northeastern quadrant)._
Speak with Jerinos 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Jerinos'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'Did you do as I asked? Excellent work. Some of my guards recovered a letter that Tyzen was trying to send out to alis group. It details how they are going to betray you once you uncover who is behind the spy ring. Do not worry. You are safe as long as you work for me. Unfortunately I must attend to other matters at this time, but I have given my assistant, Vinloi instructions on how you are to proceed. Talk to them when you are ready to continue.'

_This task is the fourth in a series of four; a shared task that begins with Vinloi in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found on the second floor of the main building at about 10, 150, 42)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "Dreams of Chaos"
\- Completed "A Spy Among Us"
\- Completed "Restoring Order"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Vinloi'
Vinloi says, in Alaran, 'Master Jerinos believes alis has uncovered the truth behind the strange dreams the citizens of our fine city are having. Before we can reveal more however, there are a couple of [favors] I must ask of you on behalf of Jerinos.'
You have been assigned the task 'Political Favors'.
_You receive "A Vial of Deadly Poison"._
You are now working for a politician named Jerinos who believes they have uncovered the cause of the citizens' dreams. Before you get more information on that, you will need to take care of some favors for Jerinos though.
You say, 'What favors?'
Vinloi says, in Alaran, 'If Jerinos is to take action against the cause of these dreams, then alis must do so without interference. Some of Jerinos' political rivals are becoming quite a nuisance and need to be dealt with. I trust that you can [take care] of this?'
You say, 'I can take care of this'
Vinloi says, in Alaran, '[Olosir], a running mate in the upcoming elections has been causing much trouble in Jerinos' investigation of the dreams. Olosir must be taken out, but it must look like an accident. Jerinos cannot afford to be involved in his unfortunate demise if alis is to win the upcoming election.'
You say, 'Who is Olosir?'
Vinloi says, in Alaran, 'Olosir likes good food and drink, and has a personal chef prepare them every day. It would be unfortunate if Olosir's apple cider were to be poisoned. Find the jug of apple cider that is being prepared for Olosir and drop this poison into it.'

---

_This is a solo task that begins with Alchemist Xortiv in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found at about 400, 260, 1). Items for this are pre-lootable._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Alchemist Xortiv'
Alchemist Xortiv says, in Alaran, 'Nobody [listens] to me! I believe I found a list of ingredients to concoct a potion that just may end the strange dreams the citizens are having.'
You say, 'No one listens?'
Alchemist Xortiv says, in Alaran, 'I have told various members of the government about my potion, but they don't seem to care! Do you think you could try to [make] the potion for me?'
You say, 'I could make it...'
Alchemist Xortiv says, in Alaran, 'Great! Go forth and collect two [Strangleweed Seeds], a [Vial of Oashim Saliva], two [Hurpuc Fruits], a [Vial of Grendlaen Blood], a [Patch of Braxi Fur], and a [Selyrah Tooth]. Combine all of these ingredients in the mortar and pestle I gave to you to make the potions. Some citizens have agreed to test the potions. Once you make the potions, give them to Alijara, Plonari, Donair, and Wanidor.'
_You receive a Mortar and Pestle (an 8-slot container)._
You have been assigned the task 'Stop the Dreams'.
You have met an alchemist who believes they may have found a cure for the dreams that the citizens are having. Make the potion and give it to some of the citizens to see if it works or not.

You say, 'A Selyrah Tooth?'

_This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Faltar in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found outside the city boundaries, in the far western part of the zone around -930, 2000, 12)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran

---

You say, 'Hail, Faltar'
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'Hello. I suppose it is too late to invite you to our lands. Perhaps you can assist me with my [mission].'
You say, 'What mission?'
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'I have been sent here to learn about the defenses the city of our enemies. I have studied what I can, but can penetrate no deeper. Perhaps you can assist me with some [tests] I would like to make. After all, when you need to forge a weapon and you have no true steel, you must make do with whatever scraps are available.'
You say, 'Tests?'
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'I need to know whether they have left their elite soldiers in the city, or if they are the ones besieging Argath. I need to see how they react to a threat. I need to know what their infrastructure looks like. These are things that you can [help] me with.'
You say, 'I can help'
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'Well enough. Let's see what metal you are made of.'
You have been assigned the task 'Information is King'.
Faltar has asked you to help it discover the military strength of Erillion. The Argathians may have abandoned their love of war, but some of them appear to retain some of their skills. Faltar is hoping to accomplish his information gathering and perhaps more. It is important to know what sort of military sources your enemy has. Count the number of buildings dedicated to smithing in the city.

---

Count the number of buildings dedicated to smithing in Erillion 0/12 (Erillion)
_You'll need to enter all 12 smithing buildings. If you look at your map, you'll see eight clusters of buildings within the city's confines. Every cluster has at least one building dedicated to blacksmithing (some of them have two). The buildings are set up with residences on their first floors and tradeskills on their second floors. To get this step to update, you need to visit the second floors of the buildings dedicated to blacksmithing._
Speak with Faltar 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Faltar'
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'As I expected. It is pleasing to know that you went to the effort to get real information. Now I need you to test the skills of the soldiers they have left to guard their city.'
Kill 5 City Guards 0/5 (Erillion)
_Any guards will do._
Speak with Faltar 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Faltar'
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'It appears that they have left somewhat more compitent soldiers to guard their homes than they sent to attack my home. That says a lot about them. Now let us test their reaction to the unexpected.'
_This opens up the next two steps._

---

Kill 6 Edible Animals 0/6 (Erillion)
Start several campfires 0/6 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Faltar wants to see how the city responds to hints of an approaching force. Kill several edible animals like Braxi or Selyrah to simulate the needs of a small force. Light a half-dozen campfires in close proximity within sight of the city walls.
_Selyrahs and Braxis update the kill step. It is probably best to get these kill updates done before doing the campfires._
_Starting the fourth campfire triggers the spawn of the four scouts, but the scout kill step does NOT open up until you've ALSO killed the six animals._
_Once a campfire is started, a group of mobs ("an elite guard") will spawn nearby. It's believed that whoever first aggro's the scouts will draw the attention of the elite guards, who will proceed to follow the player around until the scouts are killed (possibly until the entire task is finished, but not confirmed). These guards don't hit hard or have many hitpoints, but they can be an annoyance._
Kill 4 Scouts 0/4 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ If the city sends out a small force of scouts, kill them. If they don't respond, tell Faltar that they 'failed' to arrive.
_The scouts are splittable, but it's unknown how long they will remain up before they despawn, if left idle._
Deliver 1 Fire Starter to Faltar 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Tell Faltar about the large force of elite guards heading to the fires.
Faltar says, in Alaran, 'Good, you were smart enough to avoid their elite guards. In fact, since their response was significant, let us use that to our advantage. Weaken their ability to support their war. Kill some of their skilled blacksmiths.'

---

Kill 8 Blacksmiths 0/8 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ While the elite guards are out, kill some of the smiths to reduce their war support capacity. Do so before the elite guards find you.
Speak with Faltar 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Faltar'
You have done well. My fellows appreciate your assistance. Thank you.
_Rewards:_
375 platinum
Eltarki's Diary - Rule by Order

_This is a group mission that begins with Archon Xalvir in Erillion, the City of Bronze (found at about 50, -90, -43 on the bottom floor of the central building -- if you look at the map once at the bottom of the stairs, he's in the room directly north of that area)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "Dreams of Chaos"
\- Completed "A Spy Among Us"
\- Completed "Restoring Order"
\- Completed "Political Favors"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Archon Xalvir'
Archon Xalvir says, in Alaran, 'I have been expecting you. Jerinos would like you to know that your services have been [appreciated].'
You say, 'Appreciated?'
Archon Xalvir says, in Alaran, 'Jerinos would like you to be a guest of honor at the speech alis will be holding in front of the citizens of our fine city. I am to be your personal escort. When you are ready, we can get [going].'
You have been assigned the task 'The Traitor Revealed'.
Jerinos would like to thank you for all your hard work.

---

Let Archon Xalvir escort you 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Let's get going'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Erillion, City of Bronze.
_This step updates as you enter the instance._
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ You have woken up in the jails of the City of Bronze. You remember Archon Xalvir landing a heavy blow against your head, and then darkness. Tyzen stands next to you, a dead guard at their feet. Speak to Tyzen to figure out what is going on.
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Thanks to you idiots we are all in jail now. Jerinos used you to take out anyone that stood in alis way; that included Lijka, who you murdered in cold blood! You got us into this mess, now you're going to get us out of it. I already took care of the guard who was guarding our cell. Now you need to go and rescue Caindi, Srezen, and Uyyina. If you wish to [leave] without helping us, like the true coward I believe you are, then I can make that happen.'
Find Caindi and speak with them 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Jerinos used you to do alis work and now you are trapped in jail. Tyzen asks you to help redeem your foul deeds by rescuing Caindi, Srezen, and Uyyina from their captors. Find them and speak with them. A large number of Archons are guarding the jail to prevent your escape. Take some of them out to make it easier to get out of the jail.
_Caindi is found in one of the cells by the zone-in._
You say, 'Hail, Caindi'
Caindi says, in Alaran, 'Thank goodness you came. I don't fancy the thought of rotting away in here.'
Find Srezen and speak with them 0/1 (Erillion)
_Srezen is found in one of the cells by the zone-in._
You say, 'Hail, Srezen'
Srezen says, in Alaran, 'I cannot forgive you for betraying Tyzen and our group, but you have my thanks for rescuing me.'
Find Uyyina and speak with them 0/1 (Erillion)
_Uyyina is found in one of the four circular rooms in the center of the jail area, along with two carnifex._
You say, 'Hail, Uyyina'
Uyyina says, in Alaran, 'You have a lot of explaining to do. I'm glad you came along to rescue me again though. The carnifex were getting ready to carve me up.'
Defeat archons to make escaping the prison easier 0/10 (Erillion)
_You'll find no shortage of archons in the area._
Speak with Tyzen 0/1 (Erillion)
_NOTE: The task locks upon this hail._
You say, 'Hail, Tyzen'
Tyzen says, in Alaran, 'Jerinos must be stopped! I believe alis is about to give a speech. Find Jerinos and stop alis!'
Speak with Jerinos 0/1 (Erillion)
_You'll find Jerinos above-ground outside Sepulcher of Order (eastern part of the city)._
You say, 'Hail, Jerinos'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'Looks like someone didn't want to miss my speech! Well step aside, because I am about to begin.'
Listen to Jerinos' speech 0/1 (Erillion)
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'Citizens of Erillion! It has been a difficult time for our city. The dreams have invaded many of your minds and unrest has infiltrated our orderly ways. I am here to assure you however, that this will soon stop!'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'There have also been several suspicious deaths as of late. Several of my colleagues in the government have died in mysterious ways. Fear not! The perpetrators of these foul deeds stand before you and will be punished! The Norrathians you see here are the cause of all your troubles! You have counted on your elected officials to find the cause of your troubles and now I count on you to kill them and end the chaos our city has been suffering!'
Defeat the hostile citizens 0/10 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Jerinos has whipped the crowd into a frenzy. Kill them or be killed!
_All of the citizens aggro you and need to be killed. They are grey-cons and don't hit too hard._
Speak with Jerinos 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Jerinos'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'I know that your god, Morell Thule, is in our city. Now you will tell me where he is, or you die. . . So you claim ignorance? Very well then, I shall beat the answer out of you!'
Fight Jerinos 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Jerinos believes that you know the whereabouts of Morell Thule. You don't, however. Jerinos is furious that you would defy alis. Fight Jerinos!
_Jerinos hits for a max ~17,500 and casts "Jerinos' Punishment":_
Jerinos' Punishment: Single Target, (-50)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 8000 per tick
2: Silence
3: Amnesia (Silence vs Melee Effect)
_When low in health, he goes inactive and Morell Thule appears..._
Morell Thule has appeared!
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'Morell! How nice of you to finally visit!'
Speak with Morell Thule 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, Morell Thule'
Morell Thule says 'Jerinos is correct. I am indeed here. Jerinos is incorrect in thinking that alis will win this battle however.'
Morell Thule says 'It is I that has been causing the dreams the citizens have been experiencing and I need your help to fulfill my plans. Now is not the time however. I shall speak with you again later. When you are ready to [leave] this place, just let me know.'
Jerinos says, in Alaran, 'I have been chosen by the Prophet! You cannot stop me!'
Morell Thule utters an incantation. Jerinos falls into a deep slumber!
Loot the chest for your reward 0/1 (Erillion)

_This is a group mission that begins with General Tyronith in Argath at approximately -25, 470, 9._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "Dreams of Chaos"
\- Completed "A Spy Among Us"
\- Completed "Restoring Order"
\- Completed "Political Favors"
\- Completed "Stop the Dreams"
\- Completed "The Traitor Revealed"
\- 81 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, General Tyronith'
General Tyronith says 'Hello, invader. I am hoping that you are the one that can help me. Some day we must defeat those that assault our city. If you can prove to me that you have the strength and the iron will, then I would like to send you to war with those of Erillion. Do you have the qualities that I seek? If so, will you along with a strong fighting force take on this [great task]? Even if your numbers are small, I can still use your [assistance].'
You say, 'You have my assistance'
General Tyronith says 'Good! I can see the steel in your heart. When you are ready we shall [go] into the heart of the city where our enemies dwell. Within the city walls are multiple towers fortified by magic, each kept aflame by a guardian who lingers close to their base. The first step to victory is to destroy those towers.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Order of Three'.
The citizens of the city have fled, inviting creatures to linger in the streets and allowing High Priest Jerinos absolute control. General Tyronith has asked for your help in reclaiming the City of Bronze.
General Tyronith will meet you outside the city gates with further instruction.
You say, 'Go'
General Tyronith says 'May Illdaera harden your heart and sharpen your mind.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Erillion, City of Bronze.

---

**Summary**
_Once you hail General Tyronith inside the instanced zone, you'll have to make your way to the four corners of the city and, for each one, kill six creatures lurking about and then a named._
_Throughout the task, the tower nearest you will randomly nuke you:_
_Light:_
Lightbeam: Single Target, Fire (-800)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 24000
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 10000 per tick
_Strength:_
Weight of Steel: Single Target, Magic (-800)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 31000
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 5000 per tick
3: Decrease Movement by 500%
_Skies:_
Lightning Shock: Single Target, Magic (-800)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 5000
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 15000 per tick _(4 ticks)_
_Tides:_
Water Hammer: Single Target, Magic (-800)
1: Stun (3.00 sec)
2: Knockback (6) and Toss Up (4)
3: Decrease Hitpoints by 29000
_After you've finished the towers, you'll make your way to the center of the city, outside the government building where you'll find High Priest Jerinos. Speak with Jerinos to trigger the last encounter._
_You'll fight Grand Archon Soliran and then Jerinos will summon you to the rooftop. Fight Jerinos to approximately 70%, after which you'll be ported back down to fight Arch Carnifex Wilo. Once you're done with Wilo, you're back on the rooftop to fight Jerinos to approximately 40%. You'll then be ported back down to fight Chief Official Pyntara. Once Pyntara is dead, you'll be back on the rooftop to finish off Jerinos for the win._
_NOTE: When you're ported from the ground to the rooftop, you have no opportunity for a rest. However, when you're ported from the rooftop to the ground, you can take time to rest as needed. The next mob you engage will not be in your aggro range, so you can pull it when you're ready._

---

**Speak with the General**
Speak with General Tyronith 0/1 (Erillion)
You say, 'Hail, General Tyronith'
General Tyronith says 'Your challenge lies within the city. If you feel the need, you may [leave] at any time; otherwise, we need to begin our offensive immediately. The citizens fled the city recently, or have hidden in their homes. This must be because they have summoned their allies, the priests of the other gods. They will have invested their power into those towers. You need to attract the attention of these priests, and then defeat them if you can. That should withdraw the power from most of the towers, weakening our enemies.'
_Note: There is an achievement for completing this in the order presented (Skies, Tides, Strength, Light: Southeast, Southwest, Northeast, Northwest)._
_Task Window Says:_ According to General Tyronith, destroying the towers that surround the city will weaken High Priest Jerinos' defenses. To get the tower keepers' attention however, you will need to slaughter creatures that wander the streets.

---

Defeat Vocalist Oolamar to deactivate the Tower of Skies 0/1 (Erillion)

Lightning Pulse: PB AE 50', Magic (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 30000
_Upon killing the last of the six trash mobs, you'll see the emote:_
Vocalist Oolamar appears from within the Temple of the Skies.
_Vocalist Oolamar spawns at the base of the tower. It casts "Song for the Sea" (increases incoming spell damage) and "Resounding Denial":_
Resounding Denial: Single Target, Chromatic (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 15000 per tick
2: Amnesia (Silence vs Melee Effect)
3: Silence
4: Increase Curse Counter by 12
Vocalist Oolamar has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Arch Carnifex Wilo cries out as the nearby towers grow still.

**Jerinos**
Confront High Priest Jerinos 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ High Priest Jerinos has shown aleself, likely near the center of the city.
_Find Jerinos outside the central building._
You say, 'Hail, High Priest Jerinos'
High Priest Jerinos shouts, in Alaran, 'You have invaded our land and brought war to us. We are the ones that belong on this world, for we arrived first. Leave now and you will not have to meet your [destiny] this day.'
You say, 'My destiny?'
High Priest Jerinos shouts, in Alaran, 'Yours is a legacy of death and disorder. It is inevitable that you die a bloody death. I am willing to bring that to you if you will not leave. Stay, and you choose [death].'
You say, 'It'll be your death!'
High Priest Jerinos shouts, in Alaran, 'As you wish. Our gods are here. You have no chance to defeat us.'
High Priest Jerinos flees to the roof as Grand Archon Soliran rises, possessed.

---

**The Final Fight: Task Steps**
_(Details are in the next section.)_
Battle Grand Archon Soliran 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Grand Archon Soliran has been possessed by the spirit of an Alaran god!
Battle Jerinos on the rooftop 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Jerinos has summoned you to the roof top to battle!
Battle Arch Carnifex Wilo 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Arch Carnifex Wilo has been possessed by the spirit of an Alaran god!
Battle Jerinos once again on the rooftop 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Jerinos has summoned you to the roof top to battle!
Battle Chief Official Pyntara 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Chief Official Pyntara has been possessed by the spirit of an Alaran god!
_NOTE: The task locks upon Pyntara's death._
Defeat Jerinos 0/1 (Erillion)
_Task Window Says:_ Defeat High Priest Jerinos once and for all!

---

**The Final Fight: In Detail**
_Upon saying "death" to Jerinos, the fight begins._
_While you're handling this, sharpshooters will take 10K shots at you from the rooftop (spell: "Snapshot"). These sharpshooters are killable, but do attack back, hitting for a max ~13,500. They do not respawn. It's not necessary to kill them if you don't mind the extra spell attacks._
_Kill the Grand Archon; beat Jerinos to 70%; kill the Arch Carnifex; beat Jerinos to 40%; kill the Chief Official; kill Jerinos._
_NOTE: You'll have opportunity for a break each time Jerinos ports you down from the roof (provided you don't aggro the next mob). If you wipe out on the final Jerinos fight (or otherwise leave him idle for too long), he respawns on the ground level._
_The nameds hit for a max ~20,000 and have various AEs. Grand Archon Soliran casts "Enforcement":_
Enforcement: PB AE 50', (-50)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 45000
2: Negate Levitate Effect
3: Knockback (3) and Toss Up (3)
_Arch Carnifex Wilo casts "Bonds of Guilt":_
Bonds of Guilt: Targeted AE 50', Prismatic (-800)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 16000 per tick
2: Decrease Movement by 40%
3: Decrease Mana by 3000 per tick
_The Chief Official casts "Procedural Failure" (a 6K mana drain and adds a proc that does 6K damage)._
_Jerinos casts each of the above three AEs. In addition, each time you're ported off the rooftop, you'll be hit with "Concussion":_
Concussion: Single Target, Magic (-700)
1: Blindness (1)

_This is a kill task that begins with an embittered presence at the zone-in of the Sepulcher of Order (location -185, -50, 4 -- the entrance area from the City of Bronze)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 88 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, An embittered presence'
An embittered presence fills your mind, flooding your consciousness with shattered but vivid memories of a past that was not your own; an existence filled with such anger and resentment that although life no longer remains, the [hatred] lives on as its own entity. It pulses within your mind, trying to consume you.
You say, 'Hatred?'
An embittered presence's memories whirl like a cyclone: kindness turned to [betrayal]; a friend, [buried] alive; running, being [hunted] like an animal; a waterfall; falling - [drowning]!; a hand, dragging you from the depths; and finally a single, glowing green flame, leaving you cold and numb as your fate is decided. There is no [justice].
You say, 'Betrayal?'
An embittered presence's thoughts fill your mind with murky memories, distant and vague, of a figure which radiates a kind gentleness. Although it is blurred, you can still make out the wings upon its back, as the figure turns towards you, and approaches. Your final glimpse is of a malicious grin and then - darkness.
You have been assigned the task 'Clipping An Ascended's Wings'.
An embittered presence's thoughts fill your mind with distant and vague images: a figure, clouded and blurred, as though the presence has willed for centuries that this moment had never existed. For a split second, you catch a clearer glimpse of the figure kneeling by a pool; as it rises, you realize it was a myriad of delicate wings...

---

You have been assigned the task 'Revenge Is Its Own Reward'.
Ghostly images of the torment and suffering of a friend you have never known, haunt your thoughts. These are the memories of an embittered presence, seeking revenge for the wrongs of the past.

---

Kill 10 ereths of order or law 0/10 (Sepulcher of Order)
_Upon the last kill, you see:_
A feeling of tranquility encompasses you, freeing you from a resentment which has lasted for centuries.
_Reward:_
Experience
150 platinum

_This task is the first in a series of three; a shared task (1-6 players) that starts with Therin the Ancient in the Sepulcher of Order (located at about 325, 5, 12 -- inside the building due north of the zone-in)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 88 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Therin the Ancient'
Therin the Ancient's lidless eyes gleam with preternatural light. It stares beyond you, as though it were looking up from a deep crevasse. 'I saw you coming. In slumber I dreamed the world. A plane spread before me, barren, dark, and cold. Three lights, like fiery globes of moonlight, gleamed in the blackness. Then around the lights appeared eight lesser lights, like a ring of planets orbiting a triadic star. And the three lights burned more brightly, and the [lesser lights] flamed in unison.
You say, 'Lesser lights?'
Therin the Ancient says 'Faintly at first, tiny lights across the plane pricked the darkness and bled into existence. Their number swelled and became the night sky. Around the three lights these small flames gathered. They swirled around the ring of eight; they clustered about the group of three. The lights became a galaxy, and they flared so brightly that night became day, stretching to every corner of the plane and [beyond].'
You say, 'And beyond?'
Therin the Ancient says 'The Alsa Ril, the gods of three, pulled me from the darkness. I was a husk, a dead star. Now I [live] and burn with the light of the Three. Their resurgence is mine. And I watch for you, little star. I knew you would arrive and [add] your light to ours.'
You say, 'How do you live?'
Therin the Ancient says 'The sacred Thel, blood of the Alsa Ril, flows in my veins. I do not live; it lives through me. My thoughts haunt this shell like spirits hovering above the deceased. Therin is but a [memory] lingering in the mind of the Alsa Ril.'
You say, 'What memory?'
Therin the Ancient says 'I charted the stars. They wheeled above Alaris in perfect order, watching our civilizations unfold, recording our memories in signs and symbols. I wrote their names and motions on our scrolls, in honor of the Three who gave unto us, the Alsa Thelara, perfect order. I believed the Order on Alaris and in the heavens would be [unending].'
You say, 'Unending?'
Therin the Ancient says 'The stars vanished. The sky darkened. The gate opened, and Alaris ended. Through death we were born into your world. The stars were changed, but I had not the time to chart them before the Veil covered all and we [hid] below the earth.'
You say, 'You hid?'
Therin the Ancient says 'Darkness had swallowed the light of Alsa Ril. We buried them here and built this sepulcher in their honor. Relics of fertility, battle, magic, decay, splendor, tides, beasts, and oratory stood around the fallen triad. Even in death the Order would live. The [thelasas] would ensure it.'
You say, 'The thelasas?'
Therin the Ancient says 'We governed the lands of the buried lights, those fallen planets that once orbited the Alsa Ril. Tribute was paid, and worship given. Generations were to multiply into a sea of sparks and light our extinguished fires. Once again our galaxy would blaze with living light. But it did not [happen].'
You say, 'What happened?'
Therin the Ancient says 'Fires dwindled. The plane grew black and cold. Alarans forgot their past. These halls emptied, and tribute ceased. Many thelasas abandoned the Order for the lands above, entombing those remaining in this sepulcher. But I have never regretted my [loyalty]. I remain an ereth of Order.'
You say, 'Loyalty?'
Therin the Ancient says 'We starved. We sat by the dim pools and drank from the Alsa Thel, the blood of the Ril. But it held no power. The galaxy had already dispersed, sputtering off into isolated clusters around dead stars. I [died] before the altar of the Alsa Ril, and the deepest black enveloped the night sky.'
You say, 'You died?'
Therin the Ancient's eyes blaze. It motions as if to take hold of your shoulders. 'I dreamed until wakened by the Alsa Thel. The triadic star burns! Once more the planets align around the Alsa Ril. The stronger they burn, the brighter shines our star! If you [add] your light to ours, it will not be long before the light of the Alsa Ril blazes across this plane and beyond!
You say, 'Add my light?'
Therin the Ancient says 'With your faith, our gods will once more live. The Order will be reestablished. The three will become one. But first, the bond must be strengthened. Will you [bring] this vial of Alsa Thel to Lunanyn's relic?'
You say, 'I'll bring it there'
Therin the Ancient says 'Doubt not that the stars once more will brighten the sky!'
You have been assigned the task 'The Fracturing of Order'.
_You receive a Small Vial of Alsa Thel._
Therin the Ancient has asked you to strength the Triumvirate's hold on the Alaran gods by delivering a vial of their blood to Lunanyn's relic. This might be an opportunity to discover a way to confront the Triumvirate.

---

Deliver the Alsa Thel to the Relic of Fertility 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
_You'll find the Relic of Fertility in the southeastern-most part of Sepulcher East. Clear your way to the relic, after which you'll see the following unfold:_
Whispers curl around your ear like strands of grassy hair. 'You step delicately. You are not allied with pain and death. Your visage is strange, like none I have seen, but I know you are not of the Alsa Ril. I watched you since you set foot in my valley. I watched you drive back the forces of Ereth Ril. And I watch as you hesitate with Alsa Thel in hand.
You have listened to and cared for my people. Now, hear me: I fear the Alsa Ril. My people have forgotten the Order. They have forgotten the disaster that brought us to your world, and the sacrifice that was made to do so. They have forgotten even me. And this is good. They worship Fertility; they live healthily and cultivate the land; they worry only of rain and sun and soil.
This is as it should be. My time has passed. We sacrificed all to bring our followers to your world, and I am content from my sentry stones to watch over them as they live and thrive, untroubled by the dark past that brought them hence. The Order would lead us back into darkness. They would revive our decaying bodies and bring us under their rule. My followers would once again know duty and submission. We would abandon the future and return to the past.
Even now, as you see, the Alsa Ril holds pieces of our bodies under watch, turning our powers and followers to their own designs. This must end. The future does not belong to the Order. Seek in this sepulcher the sentry stone of Illdaera. Al knows how we might stop the Alsa Ril. Step lightly, though. I feel the presence of the Order's thelasas.
a thelasa guardian says, in Alaran, 'Therin, that foolish stargazer, should not have trusted you!'
Kill 1 thelasa guardian 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
_Task Window Says:_ The thelasas have sensed your intentions to double cross them.
_"a thelasa guardian" spawns and attacks. It hits for a max ~18,000 and has no special abilities._
Find Illdaera's Sentry Stone 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
_Task Window Says:_ Lunanyn said that Illdaera has been forming a plan to prevent the Triumvirate's return to absolute power. Communicate with Illdaera's spirit via the sentry stone.
_Illdaera's Sentry Stone is in the upper of the two middle sentry stone rooms of Sepulcher West._
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'May your blade ever be wet, strange one! You have spoken to Lunanyn and killed a thelasa? Ever since you arrived in Argath, I knew your blade would cleave many of Ereth Ril. Your countenance is that of one who has taken lives beyond number -- but not without purpose. You think as I do: Some must die that others might live. Any leader of battle knows this.'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'Do you think I gladly scorched my people under waves of burning steel? Ereth Ril approached, and I had to defend my city. Most of my people survived. Many did not. But does not Argath still stand? I protected the remaining inhabitants. I sent my steel creations against Ereth Ril and outsiders like you. Even though my people have forgotten me, I did not forget them. Now that they have again turned to battle, it will not be long before they pray to me and give me life. Unless Ereth Ril crushes them.'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'I do not easily ask for assistance. To our lands you have brought powerful beings -- almost as powerful as we. They wield the might of the sun and sea, war and dreams. I know all too well that to invite assistance is to encourage occupation. Your gods may conquer us, but sound strategy leaves no other option. We shall bring them to this sepulcher to confront the Alsa Ril.'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'But first we must break the barrier projected by the Alsa Ril. If we do not, your gods will be unable to enter the sepulcher. If we can submerge parts of our bodies and essences into the thel pools of the Alsa Ril, we can weaken the Ril and drop the barrier. Lunanyn and I are still too weak to do it alone. We must have Kolos's strength. Find alis sentry stone in the sepulcher and tell ali of the plan.'
Find Kolos's Sentry Stone 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
_Task Window Says:_ Another Alaran god may be willing to reject the Triumvirate's rule. Seek out Kolos's sentry stone.
_Back in Sepulcher East, you'll find Kolos's Sentry Stone in the lower of the two middle sentry stone rooms._
Sentry Stone of Kolos shifts toward you. A growl emanates from the stone. 'Weak you are! Scars along your face run! Kolos sees where talons and fangs ripped your flesh, and you bled in alis domain. You bled the blood of weakness! Why should Kolos listen to creature beaten by Braxi?'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'You are soft-furred, with soft body. You think standing on top of burial mound give you strength of Kolos? No! Kolos hate Alsa Ril -- those tricksters! -- but Kolos more hate weakness! Illdaera trust you?'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'If Alsa Ril gain power, Kolos must again serve them. Weak they must be to steal our power for themselves! But Kolos will not willingly join with the weak. Illdaera not weak, but you are.'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'Prove Kolos wrong. Kill these followers. The weak will die, the strong will live -- as it should be. Are you [prepared]?'
Kill 1 challenger of Kolos 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
_Task Window Says:_ Kolos will not agree to the plan if there is any weakness within you. Prove to Kolos that you have the strength necessary to follow through.
You say, 'We are prepared'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says, in Alaran, 'Prove to Kolos your strength!'
a trap warden says 'Only the strongest will survive!'
_"a trap warden" spawns and attacks. It hits for a max ~18,500 and casts "Trapper's Noose":_
Trapper's Noose: Single Target, Magic (-850)

_When ready again, say "prepared" to spawn "a trap warden" and "a vicious hunter" which aggro. They each hit for a max ~18,500. The warden casts "Trapper's Noose" while the hunter casts "Rage Thrash":_
Rage Thrash: Single Target, Magic (-850)

Life Absorption: Single Target, Unresistable (-850)
1: Lifetap from Weapon Damage
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'You are strong! Kolos surprised!'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'Tell Illdaera Kolos will join with you.'
Tell Illdaera of Kolos's decision 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
_Task Window Says:_ Kolos has agreed to follow the plan. Tell Illdaera of this decision.
_Head back to the Sentry Stone of Illdaera. As you approach, the Embodiment of Ryken appears._
Speak with the Embodiment of Ryken 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
_Task Window Says:_ Ryken, the Triumvirate's closest confidant, has learned of this treachery.
You say, 'Hail, Embodiment of Ryken'
Embodiment of Ryken says 'A fletcher makes an arrow. A soldier knocks the arrow against alis bow. A troopwielder commands the soldier to fire. A blacksmith casts the iron shackles. A carnifex binds the lawbreaker. An official writes the laws. Shall a fletcher fight a war? Shall a blacksmith punish criminals?'
Embodiment of Ryken says 'We must have order. The parts must work as a whole. Can you imagine a city of blacksmiths, or a fortress of fletchers? But you would set aside a domain of beasts or a fortress of warriors?'
Embodiment of Ryken says 'The Order will be established. We who have died will live again, as the whole we once were. Our followers will multiply. Our kingdom will ascend to such greatness that it will never be challenged again from beyond our plane of existence. And you would stop this? You, who have failed to destroy us time and again? It shall not happen.'
_It attacks._
Kill 1 Embodiment of Ryken 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
_Task Window Says:_ Ryken will not allow this plan to proceed.
_The Embodiment of Ryken hits for a max ~21,000 and casts "Mind Shatter":_
Mind Shatter: Single Target, Magic (-850)

Speak with the Sentry Stone of Illdaera 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
_Task Window Says:_ You surely have not seen the last of Ryken. Tell Illdaera that Kolos agrees to the plan, and that you are ready to begin the preparations to defeat the Triumvirate.
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Stone of Illdaera'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'Kolos will join us? Then preparations must begin. We must hurry before Ryken alerts Galvos, Ragan, and Beloth. I will tell you what you must do to construct bodies for Lunanyn, Kolos, and me.'

This task is the second in a series of three; a solo task that starts with Sentry Stone of Illdaera in Sepulcher West (located at about 895, 1085, 8 -- in one of the large rooms in the north-central part of the zone).
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
\- Completed The Fracturing of Order [quest=5531]
\- 88 skill level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Stone of Illdaera'
Know this;' the stone speaks with a warm, living voice, 'we took no part in stealing your god's power. Ryken and the Alsa Ril planned such treachery. Oseka, Alra, and they regained their power more quickly than Lunanyn, Kolos, or I, for their followers were more numerous. They could inhabit and control the statues called [blind dreamers]. We could not.
You say, 'Control the blind dreamers?'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'We are still unable to do so. And that is why I turn to you. I trust you more than I do my own people, for you have proven yourself more fierce, cunning, and worthy than any inhabitant of Argath. You must construct for Lunanyn, Kolos, and me statues that can accept our [spirits].'
You say, 'What spirits?'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'To compensate for our weakened state, the statues must be constructed using the purified thel of the Alsa Ril. You have seen the thel ereth ril wandering these halls? It carries the purified essence of thel, but because of this, it is far too strong for you to [overcome].'
You say, 'How do we overcome it?'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'You must fashion a weapon that can break the defenses of the thel ereth ril. Throughout this sepulcher, the blood of the Three infuses living creatures, invading through the lungs and skin. It binds with their own blood and becomes amenable to living bodies. If you can [gather] enough of this alsa thel, the weapon can be constructed.'
You say, 'I'll gather some'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'Both Lunanyn and I know of ways to collect the larger portions of alsa thel. The smaller ones I leave for you to gather. We have thelasas loyal to us within these halls. Speak to them to find out more.'
You have been assigned the task 'Crafting the Triumvirate's Downfall'.
In order to craft bodies the gods can inhabit for a short while, Illdaera needs you to collect enough infused alsa thel from each of the areas near the relics of the gods. Speak to the thelasas of Illdaera and Lunanyn that reside near each area. They will assign tasks that will grant you infused alsa thel. You will also need to craft the Rod of Alsa Thel, a weapon capable of weakening the thel ereth ril, which carries the Essence of Purified Alsa Thel. Speak to Alchemist Vaskerin and Infiltrator Tesara to find tasks that will lead you to crafting the rod.
_Note: This task is not repeatable._

You have collected enough infused alsa thel for Illdaera to create the Combined Alsa Thel Octets. You also crafted the Rod of Alsa Thel, which will be instrumental in defeating the thel ereth ril. You can now seek to construct bodies for Illdaera, Lunanyn, and Kolos.

_This task is the third in a series of three; a shared task (1-6 players) that starts with Sentry Stone of Illdaera in Sepulcher West (located at about 895, 1085, 8 -- in one of the large rooms in the north-central part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "The Fracturing of Order"
\- Completed "Crafting the Triumvirate's Downfall"
\- 88 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Stone of Illdaera'
The sentry stone speaks to you, again in a warm, commanding voice. 'We are nearly prepared, thanks to your efforts with the [blind dreamers]. Soon the thel ereth ril will fall. But before the statues can be created, you must find pieces of our essences, culled from our [burial sites].'
You say, 'What burial sites?'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'Our bodies are bereft of life, not [power]. My body bores into the mountain of Argath, spewing endless steel. Lunanyn's hair wriggles through the soft ground of alis valley and springs up verdant life. Kolos's strength seeps into every crevice and root in alis domain, oozing from the sap of trees. Even though we are unseen, we are everywhere.'
You say, 'What power?'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'And our power enters living beings. Some have grown strong. They contain within them essences or pieces of our bodies that we have lost. We need those pieces. The beings will not be easily defeated, but it must be done. You will [do] this, will you not?'
You say, 'We will do this'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'In Argath I watched as one Argathian grew to mythical stature in prowess of blade and battle. Al began as a worker in the forge, crafting weapons. Enamored with the quality of my steel, al began saving the small steel shavings and slivers left over after days of forging. At night, al would consume the slivers. Soon, al became astonishingly skilled with a blade, and al was promoted into the ranks of the [champions].'
You have been assigned the task 'Resurrecting the Gods'.
_You receive 3x "Combined Alsa Thel Octet"._
You say, 'Champions?'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'Still al visited the forge at night, and secretly consumed more steel. Then al became a legend, besting the most renowned fighters in Argath. But alis trips to the forge became more frequent. Then al did not show up for duty. Troopwielders searched for ali but could not find ali. I know al still lives. Find ali and recover my essence. You should also speak to Lunanyn and Kolos, for they will know where to find their own essences.'
Illdaera, Lunanyn, and Kolos have turned against the Triumvirate. Illdaera has a plan to breach the magical barrier around Sepulcher that is preventing the Norrathian gods from entering. In order to carry out the plan, you will need to construct temporary bodies for the spirits of the Alaran gods to inhabit.
You must discover where to find pieces of each god's essence. Speak first to Lunanyn.
The essences reside in the Transcendent Steel, Everliving Growth, and the Ancient Well of Strength.

---

1\. Speak with the Sentry Stone of Lunanyn 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Stone of Lunanyn'
Sentry Stone of Lunanyn speaks softly. 'We are nearing that time? Yes, surely you will need a piece of my essence, but I hate to see any of my creatures harmed for my own sake. If it must be done, I will tell you of the Everliving Growth.
Sentry Stone of Lunanyn says 'Hundreds of years ago, a farmer planted a small tree near my burial site. The tree was stunted and sickly; the farmer thought my shrine would nurture the plant. Al was right. I took pity on the tree and let my essence reach its roots. It grew strong and began to flourish.'
Sentry Stone of Lunanyn says 'Years passed, and the tree grew larger and larger. Generations after generations marveled at its height and lustrous leaves. It was said that the tree had always lived and will go on living indefinitely. I wished it would be so, for I loved this creature whom I saved.'
Sentry Stone of Lunanyn says 'As it drank in more of my essence, it became more independent. It began to walk about, shifting its position to bask in the sunlight. Some farmers would remark that it had moved. Others said that was impossible, that it did not move about or care whether it was warm or cold, in the shade or in the sun. I knew the truth. Must it die? Is there no other way? Go now, before I change my mind...'
2\. Speak with the Sentry Stone of Kolos 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Stone of Kolos'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'Kolos will again stride the land! You be not weak long, for Kolos to you will give strength in plenty if you do this. Find Kolos's essence. It be very simple. The flying folk of scale and wing descended before the Veil. Oseka with much strength drove them off. But Veil gone now, and scaled wings are back.'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'One landed at burial mound of Kolos, bit off the head of strongest ape. The scaled wing lapped at the sap of Kolos's favorite tree, drinking Kolos's essence. Then scaled wing stomped around Kolos's mound, biting and crunching all challengers.'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'Scaled wing very strong. Stronger maybe than you. Do you want bones snapped?'
Sentry Stone of Kolos says 'Kolos think maybe scaled wing worthy of Kolos's power. But scaled wing is filthy killer that hates Alarans. The strong should survive, but Alarans should always be strongest. Kill the scaled wing! Bring Kolos's essence!'
_This opens up the next four parts of the task (involving the deaths of the Transcendent Steel, Everliving Growth, Ancient Well of Strength, and the thel ereth ril). They can be done in any order._

---

3\. Kill 1 Transcendent Steel 0/1 (Argath)
_This mob is found near Attendant Shirian (about 175, -325, -400) or at (-153, -28, -405) in the forge of Argath. It is not social with any other mobs in the zone and has no leash range from its spawn point._
_It hits for a max ~17,000 and casts the spells "Perfected Blades" and "Steel Against Magic":_
Perfected Blades: Single Target, Corruption (-25)
1: Summon Pets: SOOProgQ3SwordAdd x 5 for 18 sec
2: Negate Feign Death Effect
3: Negate Fade Effect
Steel Against Magic: PB AE 70', Corruption (-25)
1: Decrease Spell Haste by 30%
2: Limit: Spell Type (Detrimental only)
4: Decrease Hitpoints by 6000 per tick
5: Increase corruption counter by 20
4\. Loot 1 Hardest Steel of Illdaera from Transcendent Steel 0/1 (Argath)

---

5\. Kill 1 Everliving Growth 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)
_This mob is found near Solusek Ro (confirmed locations: 2700, -765 / 2900, -530). It is not social with any other mobs in the zone and has no leash range from its spawn point._
_It hits for a max ~17,000; casts "Fertile Sap"; and spawns at least one add called "a fertile sprout" (unknown if health-based or time-based)._
Fertile Sap: Single Target, Disease (-850)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 5000 per tick
2: Decrease Disease Resist by 100
3: Unknown #343 (100/10/0)
4: Decrease Movement by 400%
5: Increase Disease Counter by 30
6\. Loot 1 Verdant Strands of Lunanyn from the Everliving Growth 0/1 (Valley of Lunanyn)

---

7\. Kill 1 Ancient Well of Strength 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
_This mob is found on the king's hill at around -2700, 1050 or -3200, 780._
_It hits for a max ~17,000 and casts "Shedding Scales" and "Draw of the Ancient":_
Draw of the Ancient: Single Target, Corruption (-25)
1: Slow Push (-250)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 13000 per tick
Shedding Scales: Single Target, Corruption (-25) _(hits all targets on hate list)_
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 3400 per tick
6: Decrease Attack Speed by 50%
7: Increase All Skills Damage Modifier by 10%
8: 10% Chance to trigger: Dragon Press _(10% Feign Death)_
_As the dragon's health lowers, you'll see these emotes:_
Ancient Well of Strength says, in Dragon, 'Do you so despise the dragon kin that you would side with the creatures of this continent? It is they who deserve destruction. We owned this land before they arrived. They took it from us and hid it from our sight. They stole what was ours, and when we confronted their treachery, they slew my brethren and crippled my wing.'
Ancient Well of Strength says, in Dragon, 'It took centuries to heal. I swore that if I ever found this continent again, I would have my revenge. Every year I have flown about the world, searching. This year I flew with my hatchling, thinking we would never find it. But here it was. We landed and were soon beset by the land's filthy inhabitants. My hatchling was beaten and taken from me. And still you defend them? I will devour you!'
Ancient Well of Strength says, in Dragon, 'The murderers...What have they done with my little one? If I could live another day, I would rend to pieces every last one of them! None on this continent would be spared! But no, I will die at the hands of a \_\_\_\_\_, If you see my hatchling, tell him that his sire died with honor, in battle!'
Ancient Well of Strength has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
8\. Loot 1 Strength Sap of Kolos from the Ancient Well of Strength 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)

---

9\. Kill 1 thel ereth ril 0/1 (ALL)
_Task Window Says:_ You will need to find and kill a thel ereth ril in order to find the Essence of Pure Alsa Thel. To do this, you will need the Rod of Alsa Thel.
_Use the Rod (from a prior Sepulcher partisan task) on a thel ereth ril:_
You begin casting Rod of Alsa Thel.
Your Rod of Alsa Thel begins to glow.
The surge of power from the Rod of Alsa Thel strips away the protection of the thel ereth ril.
_This causes the thel ereth ril to aggro. It hits for a max ~18,000 and casts "Insidious Infusion" on people, making "Splash of Thel" hit for much greater than its base amount:_
Insidious Infusion: Single Target, (-25)
1: Increase Incoming Spell Damage by 80%
2: Limit: Resist (Unknown 9 allowed)
3: Increase corruption counter by 30
Splash of Thel: PB AE 130', (-25)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 27000
10\. Loot 3 Essence of Purified Alsa Thel from thel ereth ril 0/3 (ALL)
_It drops three per kill._

---

11\. Create 1 Lifeless Statue of Illdaera using tradeskills 0/1 (ALL)
12\. Create 1 Lifeless Statue of Lunanyn using tradeskills 0/1 (ALL)
13\. Create 1 Lifeless Statue of Kolos using tradeskills 0/1 (ALL)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have all the needed ingredients, use the pottery tradeskill to craft the statues that can house the gods' spirits.
_You'll need to do three combines in any kiln (no-fail): 1x "Combined Alsa Thel Octet" + 1x "Essence of Purified Alsa Thel" + 1 drop from one of the first three nameds in the task._
_These combines produce:_
\- Lifeless Statue of Illdaera
\- Lifeless Statue of Lunanyn
\- Lifeless Statue of Kolos

---

14, Bring the statue to Illdaera's relic 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
_Task Window Says:_ Illdaera can now inhabit the statue you created.
_Someone (doesn't have to be who's in possession of the Lifeless Statue of Illdaera) needs to make their way to the Relic of Illdaera in the back section of the Temple of Steel (west of the Sentry Stone of Illdaera's location). There are many see-invis mobs in the way, as well as two see-invis thelasas guarding the relic._
_Upon approaching the relic:_
Our plan is nearly finished. ' Illdaera opens and closes the fist of their statue. 'I can see why Ryken desired power so quickly. It is amazing to inhabit once again a physical body, as constrictive as this statue might be. If it were not for the threat of the Alsa Ril's oppression, I might not have objected as strongly to Ryken's proposals.
I had no desire to kill your god, but I must admit it is a sound strategy. Annihilating such a powerful being instills fear in the hearts of the other gods, gives us power, and places any potential invaders on the defensive. And if, as a result, we were to regain our physical forms, none could assail us.
But perhaps my followers now influence me more than I influence them. These long years of slumber have been rather peaceful with no battles to fight. I would not mind regaining my body -- which Ryken intends to do for all of us, if only to strengthen the Alsa Ril -- but I would almost wish my cunning be used for tactics in the battle of diplomacy, rather than war. Do you find that strange? So do I. But come, we must give Lunanyn alis statue.
15\. Bring the statue to Lunanyn's relic 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
_Task Window Says:_ Lunanyn can now inhabit a statue and join Illdaera.
_Do the same for the Relic of Lunanyn in Sepulcher East. Upon approaching the relic:_
Lunanyn lets out a stony sigh as they enter the statue. 'My limbs move, and I can breathe the air. This means you did it. That tree...it was my oldest friend in this land...'
Illdaera reaches their hand to Lunanyn's granite cheek and wipes away a tear that could not form. They look at each other for a moment, changed as they are from the faces they once knew. Illdaera speaks. 'Everything remains but for a time. Come, we must find Kolos while there is still a chance to save what we have.'
Lunanyn turns to follow Illdaera, averting their eyes from yours.
16\. Bring the statue to Kolos's relic 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
_Task Window Says:_ Kolos will be the last to enter a statue.
_Do the same for the Relic of Kolos:_
The statue of Kolos lurches to life, turns on its heel, and throws a punch. Illdaera catches it and looks at Kolos as sternly as a statue can. 'Kolos just testing alis new body! It fantastic! Not as good as Kolos's old body, though. Kolos want that one back.'
Lunanyn speaks to Kolos. 'Are you ready to follow the plan? You know you might not be able to keep that body for long.'
Kolos hangs their head. 'That fine. Maybe Kolos can get old body soon. Or Kolos just take Ryken's!' Illdaera motions toward the inner sanctum of the sepulcher. 'Whatever happens, it is time. The new gods we bring to this place may destroy us, or they may save us. Our days may appear to be at an end, but let us not fool ourselves: they ended long ago, when we were buried beneath this earth. What comes henceforth is for our people, not for us.

---

17\. Take the statues of the gods to the pools of alsa thel 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
_Task Window Says:_ Accompany the gods to the three pools of the Triumvirate's blood. There, Illdaera, Lunanyn, and Kolos will use their bodies and spirits to disrupt the Triumvirate's power and lower the barrier around Sepulcher. Activate the statues at the bottom ramp of the middle pool.
_This step takes place in the center of the Sepulcher of Order -- the south-central part of the alsa pool area. While not necessary for spawning the final mobs, you'll probably want to clear the area of mobs. Once ready for this step, right-click one of your Lifeless Statues._
_The zone shakes and you'll see Constructs of Lunanyn, Kolos, and Illdaera spawn and approach the three pools. Shortly after this, three mobs (Herald of Galvos, Herald of Ragan, Herald of Beloth) spawn at the base of the center ramp (they will not aggro you if you stay far enough away from their location):_
Lunanyn shouts, 'That Arelis might live in peace and grow verdantly, that the sacrifice of my friend will not be in vain, I commit my body to the blood of Ragan.'
Kolos shouts, 'That the land of Kolos grow stronger and stronger, that Kolos get old body and beat some faces, Kolos commit new body to the blood of Beloth.'
Illdaera shouts, 'That Argath might stand strong and independent, I commit my body to the blood of Galvos.'
Herald of Galvos says, in Alaran, 'Clever beings. Foolish and clever. Why do you concern yourselves with our affairs? Why do you confront us at every turn? Our order is perfection. Our rule raises all beings beyond their capabilities. You sew discord and would have us cast into the dark depths from whence we so recently emerged. There is no place for you in our new world.'
Herald of Ragan says, in Alaran, 'We should have forbidden you to come here. We knew your kind was disruptive and lawbreaking. But we had hope that your numbers would swell the ranks of our faithful. We were wrong. You are more trouble than you are worth. Forthwith a new law must be decreed: Death to any non-Alaran among us!'
Herald of Beloth says, in Alaran, 'We should have punished more harshly. They are still alive. Yes, we should have riven their limbs with stakes and set them upon our parapets. We should have fed their living entrails to the gorals and selyrahs. We should have sewn into their flesh the most poisonous of spiders. Let us not pass this opportunity again!'
18\. Destroy the Heralds of Galvos, Ragan, and Beloth 0/3 (Sepulcher of Order)
_Task Window Says:_ It has worked. The barrier has been lowered. The Triumvirate is not pleased. Confront their avatars.
_The three Heralds can be split from one another, but they have a large assist range and a large aggro range. Each of them has around 3 million hitpoints (not counting any regen effects they may have)._
_If they are left idle for too long a time, they despawn, but can be re-triggered by right-clicking a statue. Even if you have killed one of them, all three will respawn upon a re-click. Note that you don't actually need to kill the three different Heralds. You just need three kill credits. You could kill the same one back-to-back-to-back (despawning and re-triggering each time) and it will still update the task._
_"Herald of Galvos" hits for a max ~27,000 and casts "Divine Frustration"; "Oppressive Regulation"; "Strength Regained"; and "Godly Regeneration":_
Divine Frustration: PB AE 120', Corruption (-25)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 15000
Godly Regeneration: Self 0', Unresistable (-850)
1: Increase Hitpoints by 60000
Oppressive Regulation: Single Target, Corruption (-25)

2: Limit: Resist (Unknown 9 allowed)
3: Decrease Movement by 200%
4: Decrease Attack Speed by 25%
5: Decrease Hitpoints by 900 per tick
6: Increase corruption counter by 25
Strength Regained: Single Target, Unresistable (-850)
1: Increase Hitpoints by 10000 per tick
2: Add Proc: Godly Regeneration rate mod 150 _(increase hitpoints by 60000)_
Herald of Galvos has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Herald of Galvos says, in Alaran, 'Could your gods rule more wisely than we? As I recall, you killed one of your own. Who is the more foolish: those who worship gods as weak as Cazic, or gods like Cazic who would claim you as worshippers? You will forever be left in the cold darkness, unwanted by any god that could claim you. You trust not your own gods, and your gods despise and fear you. We will eliminate such disgusting creatures from this world.'
_"Herald of Ragan" hits for a max ~27,000 and casts "Divine Frustration"; "Mana Blade"; and "Head Lop":_
Divine Frustration: PB AE 120', Corruption (-25)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 15000

Herald of Ragan says, in Alaran, 'You revilers of law cannot escape it. We have seen your running about over the lands, cavorting as though free from all stricture. You steal, kill, and pillage. You destroy empires and gods. But death will find you. You cannot escape its law. Over each of your heads a death sentence has been pronounced. Your trial will be swift, the verdict final. No innocence will be found.'
_"Herald of Beloth" hits for a max ~27,000; casts "Divine Frustration"; and is believed to be the Herald that spawns the numerous adds called "a punishment" (hit for a max ~400 ? but spawn in large numbers)._

The voice of Illdaera drifts into your ears. 'It is done. The barrier has been broken. Our future now falls to you and your gods. Lead them into the heart of the sepulcher. If you need our help, seek us out. We will be waiting for you.

_This is a solo task that starts with Alchemist Vaskerin in the Sepulcher of Order (located at about 460, 415, 12 -- from the main building's entrance room, head west until you come to Vaskerin)._
_While it has no pre-requisites and isn't part of a series, it is a sub-task you have to complete in order to finish "Crafting the Triumvirate's Downfall" [quest=5532]._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- No tasks
\- 88 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Alchemist Vaskerin'
Alchemist Vaskerin says 'I did not think this tomb would be warm. Far before my memory, the sepulcher was sealed away, and it has been centuries since any living soul has entered. I thought we would be huddled around braziers, but the glowing [liquid] everywhere -- the alsa thel the thelasas call it -- still pours from the bodies of the Triumvirate and heats the cavern.'
You say, 'Liquid?'
Alchemist Vaskerin says 'The Triumvirate must be stirring. If their blood lives, their bodies will soon follow. Their power will be absolute. I do not doubt this. I have seen firsthand the power of the alsa thel. Do you know of the [thel ereth ril] that wander these halls?'
You say, 'What about the thel ereth ril?'
Alchemist Vaskerin says 'They contain the purified essence of the alsa thel, and they bestow great vitality upon the loyal servants of the Triumvirate. The thel ereth ril themselves do not know death: I saw an unruly goral slash at one's throat, but the thel ereth ril walked on as if nothing happened, the glowing wound upon its neck closing almost instantly. This made me question whether nothing could [kill it].'
You say, 'Kill it?'
Alchemist Vaskerin says 'I surely will be reprimanded for this, but I do not care. Whenever the thel ereth ril come near, I feel an overwhelming sense of dread. I have done much research on the alsa thel, and I believe I have found a way to neutralize the vitality of the thel ereth ril. It is not easy, though. I need many samples of alsa thel that can be found suffused in the blood of creatures that inhabit this sepulcher. If you could [collect] the samples, I think it would be possible to test my theories on the thel ereth ril.'
You say, 'I'll collect some samples'
Alchemist Vaskerin says 'I shall await your return. Then we will see if the thel ereth ril are truly immortal.'
You have been assigned the task 'To Kill a Thel Ereth Ril'.
Vaskerin has asked you to collect droplets of alsa thel from the creatures inside Sepulcher. With these droplets, Vaskerin can fashion a weapon that will cripple the thel ereth ril.

---

Collect 500 Alsa Thel Droplets 0/500 (ALL)
Speak with Alchemist Vaskerin 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
_Alsa Thel Droplets are found via two methods:_
_\- As a reward from shared tasks given out by Infiltrator Tesara (9-14 droplets per shared task completed -- a full task list is found below this writeup)._
_\- It drops occasionally from mobs in each of the three Sepulcher zones (it will take you quite a long time to collect enough if doing it by drops alone)._
_**NOTE:** The droplets are pre-lootable. Any droplets already in your inventory will automatically update the task._
_Upon completion:_
You say, 'Hail, Alchemist Vaskerin'
Alchemist Vaskerin says 'This is precisely what I need. Here, I have fused the droplets of alsa thel. Now, if you smith this hollow rod with the droplets, I believe we can strip the thel ereth ril of their power. Perhaps now I will be able to work here in peace! Go, do with this knowledge what you will. Just do not tell anyone where you received this information!'
Vaskerin has told you to combine the Aggregate Alsa Thel Droplet with Vaskerin's Hollow Rod in order to create a weapon that can cripple the thel ereth ril.
_Final Reward:_
900 platinum
Experience (approximately 6 AAs at Level 95)
_You also receive "Vaskerin's Hollow Rod" and "Aggregate Alsa Thel Droplet". Combine these in a forge to produce "Rod of Alsa Thel" for use in later Sepulcher tasks and missions._
