**Tesara's Tasks**
\- Dismantling the Order [quest=5710]
\-\-\-------- _Find Therin the Ancient (entrance of the building) and Alchemist Vaskerin (west from the building's entry room)._
_NOTE: This task is solo and non-repeatable. All other tasks listed here are shared (1-6 players) and require that you've completed "Dismantling the Order"._
_Say "task" to Infiltrator Tesara and you'll be offered one of 24 shared tasks (sorted here by the location in which they take place; links point to the individual task listing)._
**Splendor**
\- Illegal Mining [quest=5711]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far northwestern part of the zone (northwestern-most entrance to Sepulcher West) and use the "Resplendent Mining Pick" given to you to mine crystals in the rocks (3 updates). Note: You may encounter mob aggro as you do this._
\- Target the Healers [quest=5712]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far northwestern part of the zone (northwestern-most entrance to Sepulcher West). Kill 4 crystalline healers._
**Battle**
\- Taming the Living Blades [quest=5713]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the west side of the zone (the upper of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher West), beat living blades to low health, and use the "Weapon Gravitator" you received to gather their blades. Then with those weapons, kill 2 carnifexes, soldiers, or archons._
\- The Heat of Battle [quest=5714]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the west side of the zone (the upper of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher West) and kill 4 mobs affected with "Heat of Battle" (buffed on them near the front of the zone entrance)._
**Tides**
\- Electrocution Danger [quest=5715]
\-\-\-------- _With the "Water Spark" received, travel to the west side of the zone (the lower of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher West) and use the spark to electrocute creatures there. They'll need to be killed after being shocked (4 mobs)._
\- High Tide [quest=5716]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the west side of the zone (the lower of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher West). As mobs wander the area, they'll pass through three different tidal clouds, each of which grants the mob a buff. Kill 3 mobs that have all three buffs on them._
**Decay**
\- The Cloud of Decay [quest=5717]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far southwestern part of the zone (southwestern-most entrance to Sepulcher West). Kill several mobs to create a Cloud of Decay, and then kill 4 mobs that get affected by this cloud._
\- Summation of Nightmares [quest=5718]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far southwestern part of the zone (southwestern-most entrance to Sepulcher West). Weaken a skeleton and a soul creature at the same time to make them change into a revolting nightmare. Kill 2 revolving nightmares._
**Fertility**
\- Trimming the Overgrowth [quest=5719]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far southeastern part of the zone (southeastern-most entrance to Sepulcher East). Kill mobs there to make sprout piles spawn. Kill 15 sprout piles for the update._
\- Severing the Vines [quest=5720]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far southeastern part of the zone (southeastern-most entrance to Sepulcher East). Kill 4 mobs with the "Regeneration of Lunanyn" buff on them._
**Beasts**
\- Raptor Rampage [quest=5721]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the east side of the zone (the lower of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher East). Kill a goral, take its egg, and feed it to a raptor to cause it to go on a rampage. Do this 3 times._
\- Beastly Scavengers [quest=5722]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the east side of the zone (the lower of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher East). Pull mobs into the burrows and kill them there to lure a scavenging brute to the location. Kill 2 scavenging brutes._
**Magic**
\- Confront Your Nemesis [quest=5723]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the east side of the zone (the upper of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher East). Fight mobs there to be transformed and then kill mobs while you're transformed. Kill 3 mobs while transformed._
\- Harmonious Magic [quest=5724]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the east side of the zone (the upper of the two middle entrances to Sepulcher East). Kill 4 denizens of magic while they are resonating with "Harmonious Magic". Pull creatures into the aura of their magic type to activate resonance_
**Oratory**
\- Inherit the Wind [quest=5725]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far northeastern part of the zone (northeastern-most entrance to Sepulcher East). Use the mystical auras present to reach the rocks and be enchanted by the spell. Kill 4 denizens of oratory (mobs outside the entrance)._
\- Condeming the Next Generation [quest=5726]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far northeastern part of the zone (northeastern-most entrance to Sepulcher East). Kill the wind eggs spawned by the drakes._
**The Triumvirate's Tomb**
\- Descend to Ascend [quest=5727]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the north-central part of the zone (the Triumvirate's territory where you'll find numerous blind dreamers around). Here, you'll find several alsa thel pools. Occasionally, initiates that wander the pools will be transformed by them. Kill a transformed initiate._
\- Become the Thel Ereth Ril [quest=5728]
\-\-\-------- _While under the illusion "Form of the Thel Ereth Ril", kill 4 followers of the Triumvirate (north-central part of the zone)._
\- Conquest of the Triumvirate [quest=5729]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the north-central part of the zone (the Triumvirate's territory where you'll find numerous blind dreamers around). Pull mobs out of the tomb area so that they lose their "Conquest of the Triumvirate" buff and kill them. Do this for 4 mobs._
\- Persuading the Weak Minded [quest=5730]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the north-central part of the zone (the Triumvirate's territory where you'll find numerous blind dreamers around). Weaken initiates and use the "Commanding Words" on them, then lead them in attacks against alsa constructs._
**The Residences**
\- The Hunger of Thel [quest=5731]
\-\-\-------- _Travel to the far north-central part of the zone (past the Triumvirate tomb area) and kill undead mobs (skeletons; zombies) that are buffed with "Hunger of Thel". Kill the ones in the areas with the fountains in the living quarters, or pull others into that area._
\- Secreting Supplies [quest=5732]
\-\-\-------- _Steal boxes of supplies (found along the northernmost walls of Sepulcher) and deliver them to Tasara without being attacked._
**Randoms**
\- Gift of Stabbing [quest=5733]
\-\-\-------- _Daggers infused with alsa thel can be found scattered throughout Sepulcher. Deliver 6 thel daggers to Tasara._
\- Touched by a Thel Ereth Ril [quest=5734]
\-\-\-------- _Kill a creature empowered by the thel ereth ril (buffed with "Aegis of Alsa Thel")._

- Rod of Alsa Thel [item=57558]

Veil of Alaris Information & Guides: An Overview | Group Progression & Task List | Raid Progression | Visible Armor
This is a solo task that starts with Thado Penn in the Sepulcher of Order (located at about 1125, -360, 26 -- in the northeastern part of the zone).
Pre-requisites for requesting the task:
- No tasks
- 88 Skill Level in Alaran
You say, 'Hail, Thado Penn'
Thado Penn says, in Alaran, 'What am I going to do? I can't take this anymore! Oh, sorry. What are you doing here? You better leave, before you are forced into that cult or killed. Myself, I've given up. I was part of a team exploring this continent, and the rest of my team is dead or missing. I was going to just throw myself into one of these pools and end it. I can't do anything without my [friends].'
You say, 'Your friends?'
Thado Penn says, in Alaran, 'Yes. The ones still alive joined that awful group, the Thelasa of Order. Their only purpose is to serve the Triumvirate, the Alaran gods that are the cause of all of this mess. Of my team, the ones that are still alive have joined the cult. They are Mooli, an expert in precious stones, Dunia, our tracker and survival expert, Rayneth, our cartographer, and Jordi, our cook. I fear they are all dead, now. The cult forces them to do dangerous jobs. If they were alive, though, I'd have a reason to keep going. Maybe together we could get out of here. Would you please help me? I have no one else to turn to.'
You have been assigned the task 'Serving the Triumvirate'.
Convince Eselren you wish to join the Thelasa of Order to find Thado Penn's friends.
Talk with Thado Penn 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
You say, 'Hail, Thado Penn'
Thado Penn says 'Thank you so much! You'll need to find Thesalra Eselren to join. You can find Eselren in this part of Sepulcher, near the other high-ranking members. I'd show you myself, but I'm afraid they'll kill me.'
Speak with Thelasa Eselren in Sepulcher 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
Thelasa is found in the entrance area of the complex due north of the zone-in (east of the entrance room at about 430, -320, 12).
You say, 'Hail, Thelasa Eselren'
Thelasa Eselren says, in Alaran, 'I see, so you wish to join the Thelasa of Order? A wise decision. Do not be alarmed. If you surive the intiation, you will be well rewarded once the Triumvirate has gained the power it needs. You will see. I must say I'm glad to see some new blood from your kind. I've lost plenty of recent initiates to the tasks I have in store for you, and I assume they are dead. I am confident you are made of sterner stuff, however. Speak to me again when you are prepared.'
Agree to join the Thelasa of Order 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
Hail her again.
You say, 'Hail, Thelasa Eselren'
Thelasa Eselren says, in Alaran, 'I'm glad you've decided to join. Here are your tasks. You will need to prepare the remains in West Sepulcher in honor of Sholoth. Deliver the decayed remains scattered about to the graves. You'll also find the hungry plants of Lunayn in West Sepulcher. Take this fertilizer to feed them. In East Sepulcher, you will need to feed the beasts of Kolos with the oashim present. Also in East Sepulcher, test the strength of the tidal beasts of Oseka by combating them. Do you undestand all this? You had better, or you will end up dead.'
You receive 5x "Unusual Fertilizer". This also opens up steps 4, 6, 8, and 10.
Task Window Says: Complete the tasks issued by the Thelasa of Order to find out what happened to Thado's friends. In West Sepulcher in the area of decay, find the scattered remains of decaying corpses and bring them to the graves. In West Sepulcher in the area of tides, combat the beasts nearby. In East Sepulcher in the area of fertility, feed the plants the fertilizer granted by Eselren. In East Sepulcher in the area of beasts, feed the starving beasts with the oashim meat near the cages.
Bring the decayed remains to the graves in West Sepulcher 0/3 (Sepulcher West)
Decayed Remains are ground spawns in the Decay area of Sepulcher West (southwestern-most part of the zone). These appear on the ground as finger bones. Once you have them, walk over a grave to get an update. Do this three times to update this step (Note: You don't have to go to different graves).
Discover the fate of Dunia 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
Task Window Says: You find an engraved sheath with Dunia's name on it. She must be around here somewhere.
Hail Dunia (location -640, 1560, -70 -- in the far southwestern corner).
You say, 'Hail, Dunia'
Dunia stands before you, one of Thado's friends. Unfortunately, there is nothing you can do for her now. She has been killed and returned as a zombie.
Fertilize the hungry plants in East Sepulcher 0/5 (Sepulcher East)
Hungry plants are found in the Fertility section of Sepulcher East (southernmost section).
Discover the fate of Mooli 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
Task Window Says: You find the remains of an Order member in a plant. Maybe Mooli was eaten by one?
Kill a hungry plant and loot Mooli's Corpse.
Feed the beasts in East Sepulcher 0/2 (Sepulcher East)
This is the room east of the Sentry Stone of Kolos.
Kill a plump Oashim (low HPs) and loot "Oashim Meat". The oashim respawn fairly quickly. NOTE: The plump Oashim have bad pathing. If you try to pull them into the entrance tunnel, be careful of getting adds.
There is a mob called "a starving beast" right outside the fourth tunnel camp that you can give the meat to.
Discover the fate of Rayneth 0/1 (Sepulcher East)
Task Window Says: You find a scribbled note for help signed by Rayneth. He must be nearby.
Rayneth is in the same room where the Oashim are (northwest corner, just south of the second tunnel clockwise from the entrance tunnel at 460, -1600, -65).
You say, 'Hail, Rayneth'
Rayneth is unmoving. Unfortunately, it appears he has been dead for awhille, and bite marks of various beasts cover the remains of his body.
Test the strength of the tide beasts in West Sepulcher 0/4 (Sepulcher West)
Kill four tide mobs in the Tides section of Sepulcher West (this is the first area north of the decay section). Armored tideshells and tide drifters count towards this step.
Discover the fate of Jordi 0/1 (Sepulcher West)
Task Window Says: You hear a cry for help nearby! Jordi must be near.
Hail Jordi at location 180, 2100, -230 (in a corner in the southeastern part of the Tides area).
You say, 'Hail, Jordi'
Jordi says 'Don't hurt me! Wait, did Thado send you? I was supposed to fight these horrible creatures, but I'll be killed. I can't do this. Tell Thado as soon as I can, I'll make it out of here and join him. The Order members will leave me alone, so I just need to avoid the creatures. Together, we'll escape. Thank you.'
Give a report to Thelasa Eselren 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
Task Window Says: Report to Thelasa Eselren that you have completed the tasks.
You say, 'Hail, Thelasa Eselren'
Thelasa Eselren says, in Alaran, 'So you have finished all the tasks, and come back alive? Excellent. You should be a fine addition to the Order. Remember, the gods need our faith. It is our duty to provide it to usher in this new world.'
Return to Thado Penn 0/1 (Sepulcher of Order)
Task Window Says: Return to Thado Penn and inform him of the fate of his friends, and that Jordi will be joining him shortly.
You say, 'Hail, Thado Penn'
Thado Penn listens to your report, looking more miserable by the second until you inform him that Jordi has survived and is coming to join him. 'Really? That is a bit of good news then! We can escape since Jordi is trusted by the Order to a degree. Thank you again for all you have done. I will mourn for my friends at the proper time, assuming Jordi and I get out of here alive.'
Reward:
225 platinum
Experience (about 2 AAs at Level 95)

- Eltarki's Diary - Altar of Blood [item=100943]

_This is a group monster mission that begins with the Sentry Stone of Illdaera in Sepulcher West (located at about 895, 1085, 8 -- in one of the large rooms in the north-central part of the zone)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the task:_
\- Completed "The Fracturing of Order"
\- Completed "Crafting the Triumvirate's Downfall"
\- Completed "Resurrecting the Gods"
\- 88 Skill Level in Alaran
_**NOTE:** Mercenaries are not allowed in the instanced zone for this task._
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Stone of Illdaera'
We hear you speaking. You have cooperated with the [blind dreamers] and the [burial sites], so we will tell you something of ourselves. We are servants, mere vessels, for our masters. But time in contact with the masters has given us a sense of ourselves as separate from them, and real beings. Our masters of Battle, Fertility and Beasts have decided to help you defeat the Order. Now that you have lowered the barrier, our Illdaera wishes you to meet with your gods and guide them into the Sepulcher. Our masters hope that they are strong enough to overcome the powers there and [breach the temple].
You say, 'Let's breach the temple!'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'We note your decision. We shall not forget. We can provide teleportation to the place where you must [begin].'
You have been assigned the task 'Breaching the Barrier'.
Corrupted ereths have erected a barrier over the doorways to the central chambers of the Sepulcher of Order. Clearly they are trying to protect something important within. Clear the barriers to gain entry to the central chamber by eliminating the ereths defending the temple entrances.
You say, 'Let's begin!'
Sentry Stone of Illdaera says 'We understand your request.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Sepulcher of Order.

**The Eight Temples**
_You'll need to clear just about the entire zone's worth of trash, killing eight named mobs (one at each temple) in the process._
_The monster templates have a lot of hitpoints and the trash mobs here hit quite hard (~25,000). If you have a full group, it's a simple clear and you'll be able to handle numerous adds at once; however, it's recommended that you fight the corrupted ereths single._
_NOTE: You may want to clear the inner part of the zone prior to killing the last corrupted ereth._

Primal Strike: Single Target, Unresistable (-900)

**Arafel, Thelara Ereth & Completion**
_Once the last of the eight corrupted ereths is killed, the task locks and you'll see this emote:_
The chamber quakes as the massive doors securing the inner chamber swing open.
_Note: Arafel is much harder than the previous mini-named. It hits for a max ~56,000; single-target rampages; AE rampages; flurries; has a lot of hitpoints; charms (random, about every minute); summons adds; and casts a knockback. It is NOT leashed anywhere (can be pulled as far away as you want it, even to the zone-in)._
The Harvest: PB AE 150', Unresistable (-900)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 1325000
Touch of the Guardian: Single Target, Disease (-900)
1: Charm up to level 100
_Add spawns are signified by this emote (every 30 seconds):_
Bolts of energy fly from Alseth's hands, energizing the pools of Alra Rel.
_This signals the spawn of an add in each of the three pools:_
_They are a mix of "a pool of alsa thel" and "a flow of alsa thel". These mobs will sometimes explode, casting "Burning Thel" in the process:_
Burning Thel: PB AE 200', Unresistable (0)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 795000 to 1215000 (random)
2: Decrease Movement by 35%
_Every 60 seconds, Arafel spawns a non-aggro add called "a thelasa ereth servant":_
Arafel, Thelara Ereth shouts, 'I am weakened. Servants of the Triumvirate, I command you to aid me!'
_"a thelasa ereth servant" wanders up the ramps from the bottom and attempts to heal Arafel. These mobs can be ignored if you have a full group focused on DPS._
_NOTE: At 75%, Arafel drops all aggro and warps back to its spawn point. It must be re-aggro'd within a short time, or the event will reset._
_This emote is believed to be a reset emote (if you wipe out or leave the mob idle for too long a time after engaging):_
Arafel, Thelara Ereth shouts, 'The powers of order are divine and without error. You have been judged and found unworthy.'

As Arafel falls, the magic barrier around the Sepulcher of Order dissipates.

_This task is the second in a series of six. It's a solo task that begins with Councilman Nostulia ( map) in Shard's Landing. He is found at /location 300, 85, 1 (southwestern part of the crater, in a tent north of Overseer Drent's location)._
_In addition to being a progression task, this will also boost your Alaran language skill level to 100 (if it's not there already)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
You say, 'Hail, Councilman Nostulia'
Councilman Nostulia looks up, 'Oh yes, \_\_\_\_\_? Drent was just speaking about a rambunctious \_\_\_\_\_ that had shown some promise. I shall skip the pleasantries and get to the point, my job here is simple, I ensure that all of our recruits are ready and able to report on any and everything they see. To that end I need to know that you are fluent in their language. If you are willing to [prove] yourself ready to join our ranks then I have a simple task for you to complete.'
You say, 'I'll prove myself'
Councilman Nostulia says 'Very well, this should be an easy enough job.'
You have been assigned the task 'Words of the Unspoken'.
Councilman Nostulia has tasked you with mastering the Alaran language.
Your first order of business is to travel back to the Underground City. From there you will want to seek out some different pieces of text and then report back to him.

Travel back to the Underground City 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates as you enter the city (connected from the zone's northwestern valley)._
Obtain a Councilor's Memo 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Just east of the council chambers is where many of the councilmen and citizens live. See if you can find a memo or diary from one of them.
_"A Councilor's Memo" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location -715, 1710, -500 -- bottom level, second residence to your left if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain a Page of a Citizen's Diary 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ North of the council chambers is another living barracks, see if you can find any personal writings from one of the citizens.
_"Page of a Citizen's Diary" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location -280, 2350, -295 -- upper level, first residence to your left if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain a Page of a High Guard's Diary 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ In the barracks north of the council chambers on the northern side are four rooms that the High Guards inhabit. See if you can find any writings of theirs there.
_"Page of a High Guard's Diary" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location 5, 2250, -292 -- upper level of the residence to your right if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain a page of Council Minutes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ In the barracks east of the council chambers are the houses of many councilmen. See if you can find any official documentation about their meetings.
_"Council Minutes" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location -925, 1765, -465 -- upper level, first residence to your right if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain A Gardener's Notes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ To the south of the council chambers is the indoor garden of believers. This area produces nearly all the food to sustain the city and may have some detailed documentation that would be worth examining.
_"A Gardener's Notes" is a ground spawn in this area (/location -1200, 2120, -602 -- just to your right upon entering the area, if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain an Armsman's Missive 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ In the northeastern section of the Underground City is the armory. See if you can find any text of interest in that area.
_"An Armsman's Missive" is a ground spawn on a table at /location 165, 975, -500 (on your map, this is the large room northwest of the Silent Hall)._
Obtain a Sentry's Log 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Just east of the city's entrance is a barracks where a number of miners are housed. They are under constant supervision from the enforcers and taskmasters in the city. See if you can find anything of interest in that area.
_"A Sentry's Log" is a ground spawn on a table in the open area east of the city's entrance (/location 230, 1375, -442 -- central part of this area)._
Obtain a Page of a Gladiator's Journal 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Our understanding of the society is that there are several distinct castes, the lowest being 'the conscripted'. Many of them are housed as gladiators that perform for the entertainment of the citizens. See if you can find any writings by these warriors in their barracks southeast of the city gates.
_"Page of a Gladiator's Journal" is a ground spawn on a table in the open area just northeast of the arena (/location -50, 1350, -502 -- in the north-central part of this area)._
Obtain a Believer's Private Notes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The devout worshippers are a curious group. We understand very little about their form of worship. See if you can find anything of use in the silent hall.
_"A Believer's Private Notes" is a ground spawn in front of a bench at about -190, 750, -747 in the Silent Hall (northeastern part of the city -- in the west-central part of the Hall)._
Obtain a Nondescript Clergy Memo 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Reports have stated that a number of clergy stand watch in the arena. See if you can find any texts of note by this group.
_"A Nondescript Clergy Memo" is a ground spawn at /location -585, 1770, -482 (in the arena which is the large area just northeast of the council chambers -- ground spawn along the south-central wall of the arena)._
Report back to Councilman Nostulia 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have collected a wide variety of texts, report back to Councilman Nostulia and he will give you further instructions.
You say, 'Hail, Councilman Nostulia'
Councilman Nostulia says 'Ah, so you've collected the texts?' He takes a moment to look over the pieces of paper you present him, 'Very well, this will be a rather simple lesson, which I assume you find to be the best kind of lesson.' He smirks, 'Take this tome and piece together the papers into a master document, copy them -exactly- as written. After you've done that, translate the paper into common and return the perfectly translated work to me. I will not accept anything less than a perfect translation!' The wizened erudite hands you a tome full of blank pages and a quill.'
_You receive a container: "Simple Empty Tome"_
Copy the notes exactly as written 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Combine the 10 texts inside the container to produce a "Tome of Blank Pages" (container) + "Nostulia's Quill" + "Hand Copied Alaran Notes"._
You slowly copy the elaborate symbols that make up the Alaran language onto a series of blank pages until a perfect replica is made.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Hand Copied Alaran Notes.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Nostulia's Quill.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Tome of Blank Pages.
Translate the notes into Common 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_In the Tome, combine the Quill and Copied Notes until the step updates and you produce "Translated Notes" (as you do this, your Alaran will progress to 100)._
You review your work to find a number of glaring errors.
You review your work to find a handful of minor errors.
You review your work and find one or two simple mistakes.
You review your work and realize you've misspelled something.
After several minutes of careful translation you review your work and find it immaculate! You have a clear understanding of the Alaran language.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Translated Notes.
Deliver the Translated Notes to Councilman Nostulia 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Deliver the Translated Notes to Councilman Nostulia so he can assess your success.
Councilman Nostulia looks over the paper carefully then looks back up at you, 'Well, you've proven to be quicker learner than I had anticipated. I suppose some minor congratulations are in order. You are now fully qualified to speak to the natives. I have another simple task for you should you be up for it, though I think Engineer Eilisia may also be interested in your talents.'
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule got better.
Although his methods felt somewhat patronizing, you feel inspired by the haste in which Councilman Nostulia was able to help you master the Alaran language. Whether or not you have any real use for their native tongue is another matter though...
_Rewards:_
262 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (11% regular exp at Level 88 and 3 AAs at any level)
_Note: This task is not repeatable._
- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]
